domains.name: crop
domains.description: Core operational domain governing the full crop production lifecycle — from crop planning, seed selection, and planting schedules through cultivation, IPM-based pest and disease management, irrigation (ET-driven), VRA prescriptions, and NDVI-monitored field health. Manages field-level agronomic data, crop varieties, yield metrics (YPM, BU/acre), PHI and REI compliance, and FMIS integration with systems such as Climate FieldView, Trimble Ag Software, and SAP S/4HANA PP. Serves as the SSOT for all agronomic activity aligned with GAP standards.

products.name: growing_season
products.description: Defines each agricultural growing season (e.g., Spring 2024 Corn, Fall 2024 Soybean) including season type (spring, fall, double-crop, cover crop), start and end dates, target crop, associated field zones, and season status (planned, active, completed). Acts as the temporal anchor for all crop production activities — planting, cultivation, harvest, and loss events — and links agronomic plans to financial crop enterprise budgets. Supports multi-crop and double-crop scenarios common in southern US and tropical operations. Aligns with FMIS season management in Climate FieldView and Granular.
products.reference: Crop Season / Production Year

attributes.name: crop_year

Used for WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates) alignment, USDA FSA program reporting, and financial crop enterprise budget year-over-year comparisons.

attributes.name: fsma_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this growing season's production activities are documented and compliant with FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) Produce Safety Rule requirements, including water testing, worker hygiene, and equipment sanitation records. Mandatory for covered produce operations under FDA jurisdiction.

attributes.name: gap_certification_status
attributes.description: Current GAP (Good Agricultural Practices) certification status for this growing season. Indicates whether the production practices meet USDA GAP audit standards, GLOBALG.A.P. certification requirements, or buyer-mandated food safety standards (SQF, BRC, IFS). Required for retail and food manufacturer customer contracts.
attributes.references: USDA GAP (Good Agricultural Practices) audit program; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF (Safe Quality Food); BRC (British Retail Consortium)

attributes.name: gdd_target
attributes.description: Target cumulative GDD (Growing Degree Days) required for the primary crop variety to reach maturity during this growing season. Used to project harvest timing, align PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval) compliance windows, and calibrate ET (Evapotranspiration)-based irrigation scheduling. Sourced from seed company variety data and NOAA climate records.
attributes.references: NOAA climate data; USDA crop maturity GDD tables; Climate FieldView GDD analytics

attributes.name: ipm_program_code
attributes.description: Reference code identifying the IPM (Integrated Pest Management) program or protocol applied during this growing season. Links to the crop protection plan governing pesticide applications, REI (Restricted Entry Interval) compliance, MRL (Maximum Residue Limit) monitoring, and EPA pesticide registration requirements. Aligns with Trimble Ag Software scouting protocols.
attributes.references: EPA IPM (Integrated Pest Management) guidelines; USDA APHIS; GLOBALG.A.P. crop protection module; MRL (Maximum Residue Limit) compliance

attributes.name: irrigation_method
attributes.description: Primary irrigation system used during this growing season. Determines ET (Evapotranspiration)-based water scheduling approach, water use efficiency reporting, and compliance with state water rights regulations. 'rainfed' indicates no supplemental irrigation. Integrated with IoT (Internet of Things) soil moisture sensors and FMIS irrigation scheduling modules.
attributes.references: EPA water use regulations; USDA NRCS irrigation water management; ET (Evapotranspiration) scheduling standards

attributes.name: is_gmo
attributes.description: Indicates whether the target crop variety for this season is a GMO (Genetically Modified Organism). Critical for USDA APHIS (Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service) regulatory compliance, COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) requirements, export documentation, and customer segregation requirements for non-GMO supply chains.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS GMO regulations; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling); GLOBALG.A.P. GMO traceability

attributes.name: is_organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this growing season is conducted under USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certified organic production standards. Triggers organic-specific input restrictions, record-keeping requirements, and supply chain segregation protocols. Linked to organic certificate management in compliance systems.
attributes.references: USDA NOP (National Organic Program); USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; GLOBALG.A.P. organic module

attributes.name: ndvi_baseline_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) Baseline Score
attributes.description: NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) baseline score established at the start of the growing season, ranging from -1.0 to 1.0. Derived from satellite or drone imagery processed through Esri ArcGIS or Climate FieldView. Used as the reference benchmark for in-season crop health monitoring, stress detection, and VRA (Variable Rate Application) prescription adjustments.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS remote sensing; Climate FieldView NDVI analytics; USDA NASS crop condition monitoring

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for agronomic observations, management decisions, weather events, or operational notes relevant to this growing season. attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. record-keeping requirements; FSMA documentation standards; Granular Farm Management notes

attributes.name: phi_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days required between the last pesticide application and harvest for this growing season's primary crop, as mandated by EPA pesticide label requirements (PHI — Pre-Harvest Interval). Critical for food safety compliance, MRL (Maximum Residue Limit) adherence, and FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) produce safety rule compliance.
attributes.references: EPA pesticide label PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval) requirements; FSMA Produce Safety Rule; FDA MRL (Maximum Residue Limit) standards

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: The agronomically planned end date for the growing season, representing the expected completion of harvest and post-harvest handling operations. Derived from expected days-to-maturity of the target crop variety and planned planting date. Used for financial crop enterprise budget planning in Granular Farm Management.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management financial planning; Climate FieldView harvest analytics; USDA crop maturity data

attributes.name: planned_start_date

attributes.name: planting_method

attributes.references: USDA EQIP BMP standards; GLOBALG.A.P. soil management; Trimble Ag Software field planning

attributes.name: rei_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours workers must stay out of treated fields after pesticide application during this growing season, as mandated by EPA Worker Protection Standard (REI — Restricted Entry Interval). Drives workforce scheduling in SAP SuccessFactors and OSHA compliance documentation for field worker safety.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard REI (Restricted Entry Interval); OSHA agricultural worker safety; FSMA

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the growing season, used across FMIS systems such as Climate FieldView and Granular Farm Management for cross-system reference. Example: 'SPRING-2024-CORN', 'FALL-2024-SOY'. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA PP production order season coding conventions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP module; Climate FieldView season management; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: season_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the growing season, combining season type, year, and primary crop for operational clarity. Example: 'Spring 2024 Corn', 'Fall 2024 Soybean', 'Double-Crop 2024 Winter Wheat'. Used in reporting dashboards and FMIS displays.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; Climate FieldView; USDA NASS crop season terminology

attributes.name: season_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the growing season. 'planned' indicates agronomic planning is underway but field operations have not commenced. 'active' indicates planting through harvest operations are in progress. 'completed' indicates harvest and post-harvest handling are finalized. 'cancelled' indicates the season was abandoned (e.g., due to extreme weather or market conditions). 'suspended' indicates temporary halt due to regulatory or operational constraints.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management season lifecycle; SAP S/4HANA PP production order status

attributes.name: season_type
attributes.description: Classification of the growing season by its agronomic timing and production strategy. 'double_crop' supports sequential planting common in southern US and tropical operations. 'cover_crop' denotes non-cash-crop seasons for soil health management per BMP (Best Management Practices). Drives planting window scheduling and FMIS season templates.
attributes.references: USDA NASS; GLOBALG.A.P. crop calendar standards; GAP (Good Agricultural Practices)

attributes.name: target_crop_variety

Drives seed procurement, VRA (Variable Rate Application) prescriptions, and yield benchmarking by variety. Aligns with seed catalog codes in SAP S/4HANA MM and Trimble Ag Software variety trials.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software variety management; Climate FieldView seed performance analytics; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: target_yield_bu_acre
attributes.description: Agronomically planned yield target for this growing season expressed in BU (Bushels) per acre, representing the YPM (Yield Per Acre Metric) goal. Established during crop planning based on historical yield data, soil productivity ratings, and variety performance benchmarks. Used as the baseline for financial crop enterprise budgets and crop insurance APH (Actual Production History).
attributes.references: USDA RMA APH (Actual Production History); Granular Farm Management financial planning; WASDE yield benchmarks

attributes.name: total_actual_area_acres
attributes.description: Total land area actually planted during this growing season, expressed in acres. May differ from planned area due to weather delays, equipment failures, or agronomic decisions. Captured from John Deere Operations Center planting telematics and Climate FieldView as-planted maps. Used for yield calculation (YPM) and insurance reporting.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Climate FieldView as-planted data; USDA RMA crop insurance

attributes.name: total_planned_area_acres
attributes.description: Total land area planned for production under this growing season, expressed in acres. Aggregated from associated field zone assignments. Used for input planning (seed, fertilizer, crop protection), equipment scheduling, and financial crop enterprise budget calculations in Granular Farm Management. Aligns with FSA farm records.
attributes.references: USDA FSA farm records; Granular Farm Management land management; Esri ArcGIS field mapping

attributes.name: total_yield_mt
attributes.description: Total harvested production volume for the growing season expressed in MT (Metric Tons), converted from bushel-based yield for international trade, export documentation, and supply chain logistics. Used in BOL (Bill of Lading) preparation, CIF/FOB export contracts, and WASDE supply estimates.
attributes.references: WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates); Codex Alimentarius; USDA FAS export reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this growing season record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse pipeline, optimistic concurrency control, and audit trail maintenance per SOX and GLOBALG.A.P. record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5; GLOBALG.A.P. record-keeping; ISO 22000

products.name: field_crop_plan
products.description: Comprehensive agronomic plan for a specific field and growing season, serving as the single operational blueprint for all planned crop activities. Consolidates all sub-planning disciplines into one authoritative document. Captures: (1) Crop selection — intended crop variety, target planting population (seeds/acre), row spacing, tillage method. (2) Nutrient management — target NPK removal rates, soil test baseline (pH, NPK, CEC, OM), recommended fertilizer products and rates, application timing windows, environmental setback zones, EPA nutrient management compliance. (3) Irrigation strategy — ET-deficit and soil moisture trigger thresholds, target application depth (acre-inches), water allocation limits, irrigation system type. (4) IPM program — target pests and diseases, economic threshold levels, monitoring frequency, preferred intervention hierarchy (biological, cultural, chemical), approved agrochemicals, responsible agronomist. (5) Yield target — expected yield (BU/acre or YPM), benchmark comparisons. Integrates with Trimble Ag Software and Climate FieldView for VRA prescription generation. Supports EPA nutrient management compliance, BMP documentation, GLOBALG.A.P. crop protection standards, and IPM guidelines.

attributes.name: certification_class
attributes.description: AOSCA-defined seed certification class indicating the generation and purity level of the seed lot. 'breeder' = source seed from plant breeder; 'foundation' = first generation from breeder seed; 'registered' = second generation; 'certified' = third generation approved for commercial use; 'uncertified' = not certified.
attributes.references: AOSCA (Association of Official Seed Certifying Agencies) Seed Certification Standards; USDA AMS Seed Regulatory Program

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this seed lot record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and FSMA record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule (21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit_cost of this seed lot (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'BRL'). Required for multi-currency financial reporting under IFRS and GAAP, and for SAP S/4HANA FI currency management.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS IAS 21 (Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates); SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Management

attributes.name: germination_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the germination rate certification is no longer valid and retesting is required per USDA Federal Seed Act regulations. Drives lot status transitions to 'expired' and triggers procurement or retesting workflows.
attributes.references: USDA Federal Seed Act (7 U.S.C. 1551-1611); AOSA Rules for Testing Seeds; AOSCA Seed Certification Standards

attributes.name: germination_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of seeds in this lot that germinated under standard test conditions, as reported on the seed tag or Certificate of Analysis (COA). Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Critical for seeding rate calculations, yield forecasting (YPM), and USDA Federal Seed Act minimum germination standards compliance.
attributes.references: USDA Federal Seed Act (7 U.S.C. 1551-1611); AOSA (Association of Official Seed Analysts) Rules for Testing Seeds; AOSCA Seed Certification Standards

attributes.name: germination_test_date
attributes.description: Date on which the germination test was conducted for this seed lot, as reported on the seed tag or COA (Certificate of Analysis). Used to determine germination validity period and compliance with USDA Federal Seed Act labeling requirements.
attributes.references: USDA Federal Seed Act (7 U.S.C. 1551-1611); AOSA Rules for Testing Seeds; AOSCA Seed Certification Standards

attributes.name: gmo_trait_stack
attributes.description: Identifier or description of the GMO (Genetically Modified Organism) trait stack present in this seed lot (e.g., 'RR2Y/YGCB', 'Roundup Ready 2 Yield + YieldGard Corn Borer'). NULL if non-GMO. Required for USDA APHIS biotech regulatory compliance, COOL labeling, and customer GMO disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services (BRS); USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (NBFDS); EPA Biopesticide Registration

attributes.name: is_gmo
attributes.description: Indicates whether this seed lot contains genetically modified organisms (GMO). True = GMO seed; False = non-GMO seed. Required for USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard compliance, customer labeling, and export documentation.
attributes.references: USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (NBFDS); USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: is_organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this seed lot is certified under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). True = NOP-certified organic seed; False = conventional seed. Required for organic crop production compliance and NOP audit trails.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; IFOAM Organic Standards

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric lot number (LOT) assigned by the seed supplier or internal seed processing facility. Used for seed traceability from procurement through planting to harvest, and for FSMA seed traceability compliance. Maps to SAP S/4HANA MM batch number (CHARG) and Granular Farm Management lot tracking.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule (21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S); USDA AOSCA Seed Certification Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management

attributes.name: lot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the seed lot. 'available' = in storage and ready for use; 'reserved' = allocated to a planting plan; 'planted' = fully consumed in field operations; 'depleted' = quantity exhausted; 'quarantined' = held pending quality or regulatory review; 'expired' = past germination validity date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Status Management; USDA AOSCA Seed Certification Standards

attributes.name: moisture_content_pct
attributes.description: Moisture content of the seed lot expressed as a percentage at time of testing or receipt. Critical for safe storage, preventing mold and mycotoxin development, and maintaining germination viability. Monitored per USDA grain storage standards.
attributes.references: USDA Federal Grain Inspection Service (FGIS); USDA AMS Grain Grading Standards; ISO 6540 (Maize moisture content determination)

attributes.name: noxious_weed_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether this seed lot has been certified as free of noxious weed seeds as defined by USDA Federal Seed Act and applicable state seed laws. True = certified noxious weed free; False = noxious weed seeds detected or certification not obtained. Required for interstate commerce compliance.
attributes.references: USDA Federal Seed Act (7 U.S.C. 1551-1611); USDA APHIS Noxious Weed Program; State Seed Laws

attributes.name: purity_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of pure seed (by weight) in this lot as determined by seed analysis, excluding inert matter, other crop seed, and weed seed. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Required for USDA Federal Seed Act labeling compliance and AOSCA certification standards.
attributes.references: USDA Federal Seed Act (7 U.S.C. 1551-1611); AOSA Rules for Testing Seeds; AOSCA Seed Certification Standards

attributes.name: quantity_remaining
attributes.description: Current remaining quantity of seed in this lot available for planting, expressed in the unit_of_measure. Updated as seed is allocated to planting operations. Supports inventory planning, seeding rate calculations, and procurement replenishment decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management; Manhattan Associates WMS; Granular Farm Management Inventory

attributes.name: quantity_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of seed in this lot expressed in the applicable unit of measure (seeds, bags, CWT, or BU as defined in unit_of_measure). Tracks available inventory for planting planning, procurement, and WMS (Warehouse Management System) inventory control in Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management; Manhattan Associates WMS; USDA AMS Seed Regulatory Program

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which this seed lot was physically received at the storage facility. Marks the start of the lot's custody chain for FSMA traceability, FIFO inventory management, and storage duration tracking.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule (21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S); SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt; USDA GAP Standards

attributes.name: relative_maturity_days
attributes.description: Relative maturity rating of the crop variety in this seed lot, expressed in days or heat units (e.g., 95-day corn, 3.8 maturity group soybean). Critical for crop planning, harvest scheduling, and matching variety to growing season length in the FMIS.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Crop Maturity Guidelines; Climate FieldView Planting Analytics; Granular Farm Management Crop Planning

attributes.name: seed_origin_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where this seed lot was produced or conditioned. Required for USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance, import/export documentation, and APHIS phytosanitary certification.
attributes.references: USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) 7 CFR Part 60; USDA APHIS Phytosanitary Certification; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3

attributes.name: seed_rate_per_acre
attributes.description: Supplier-recommended seeding rate for this seed lot expressed in seeds or units per acre. Used in VRA (Variable Rate Application) prescription generation in Trimble Ag Software and Climate FieldView, and for planting plan calculations in FMIS.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software VRA Prescriptions; Climate FieldView Planting Analytics; USDA GAP Standards

attributes.name: seed_treatment_product
attributes.description: Commercial name of the seed treatment product applied to this lot (e.g., 'Cruiser Maxx', 'Poncho/VOTiVO', 'Apron XL'). Required for EPA FIFRA compliance, SDS (Safety Data Sheet) reference, and agronomic record-keeping under GAP standards.
attributes.references: EPA Federal Insecticide Fungicide and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA); EPA Pesticide Registration; USDA GAP (Good Agricultural Practices)

attributes.name: seed_treatment_type
attributes.description: Type of chemical or biological coating applied to the seed lot prior to packaging. 'fungicide' = fungicide-only coating; 'insecticide' = insecticide-only coating; 'fungicide_insecticide' = combined coating; 'biological' = biological agent coating; 'untreated' = no treatment applied. Required for EPA pesticide registration compliance, REI (Restricted Entry Interval) tracking, and PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval) management.
attributes.references: EPA Federal Insecticide Fungicide and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA); EPA Pesticide Registration; USDA AMS Seed Regulatory Program

attributes.name: test_weight_lbs_bu
attributes.description: Test weight of the seed lot expressed in pounds per bushel (BU), indicating seed density and quality. Used for quality grading, storage planning, and yield estimation. Aligns with USDA grain grading standards.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Grain Grading Standards; USDA Federal Grain Inspection Service (FGIS)

attributes.name: thousand_seed_weight_g
attributes.description: Weight of 1,000 seeds in grams (TSW), used to calculate seeding rates by weight, estimate seed counts per bag, and assess seed size uniformity. Standard agronomic quality metric used in FMIS and precision planting systems.
attributes.references: ISTA (International Seed Testing Association) Rules for Seed Testing; AOSA Rules for Testing Seeds; ISO 520 (Cereals and pulses - determination of the mass of 1000 grains)

attributes.name: treatment_active_ingredient
attributes.description: Active Ingredient (AI) of the seed treatment applied to this lot (e.g., 'thiamethoxam', 'fludioxonil', 'metalaxyl'). Required for EPA FIFRA compliance, MRL (Maximum Residue Limit) tracking, and food safety regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Federal Insecticide Fungicide and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA); Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards; USDA AMS Pesticide Data Program

attributes.name: treatment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the seed treatment was applied to this lot. Used to calculate treatment age, validate treatment efficacy windows, and support EPA FIFRA compliance and PHI/REI tracking.
attributes.references: EPA Federal Insecticide Fungicide and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA); USDA GAP Standards; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Procurement cost per unit of measure for this seed lot (in USD), as recorded at time of purchase. Used for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation, crop enterprise budgeting, CAPEX/OPEX reporting, and financial planning in SAP S/4HANA CO and Granular Farm Management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/CO Material Valuation; Granular Farm Management Financial Planning; GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles); IFRS IAS 2 (Inventories)

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the seed lot quantity (e.g., 'seeds' for precision count, 'bags' for packaged units, 'CWT' for hundredweight, 'BU' for bushels, 'kg' or 'lbs' for weight-based). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA MM base unit of measure (MEINS) and USDA commodity reporting standards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; USDA AMS Commodity Reporting; NIST Handbook 44

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this seed lot record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, data lineage, and audit compliance for FSMA and SOX requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule (21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 8601

attributes.name: vigor_score
attributes.description: Seed vigor test score indicating the potential for rapid, uniform emergence under field stress conditions, expressed as a percentage or index (0.00–100.00). Complements germination rate for predicting field performance. Tested per AOSA/ISTA vigor testing protocols.
attributes.references: AOSA (Association of Official Seed Analysts) Seed Vigor Testing Handbook; ISTA Rules for Seed Testing; USDA Federal Seed Act

attributes.name: weed_seed_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of weed seed (by weight) found in this seed lot during purity analysis. Must meet USDA Federal Seed Act and state seed law maximum thresholds. High weed seed content may trigger quarantine or rejection.
attributes.references: USDA Federal Seed Act (7 U.S.C. 1551-1611); AOSA Rules for Testing Seeds; State Seed Laws

products.name: fertilization_event
products.description: Transactional record of a fertilizer application event on a field, capturing application date, product applied (NPK formulation), application rate (lbs/acre or gallons/acre), application method (broadcast, banded, fertigation), equipment used, operator, and VRA prescription reference. Tracks actual vs. planned nutrient application for agronomic compliance and environmental reporting (EPA nutrient management). Sourced from John Deere Operations Center and Trimble Ag.
products.reference: Fertilizer Application Record / Nutrient Management Log

attributes.name: actual_rate
attributes.description: The actual fertilizer application rate recorded during the field operation, expressed in the unit defined by rate_unit. Sourced from John Deere Operations Center or Trimble Ag as-applied data. Compared against planned_rate for VRA compliance and agronomic audit.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center as-applied data; Trimble Ag Software; GLOBALG.A.P. record-keeping

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the fertilizer was applied to the field. This is the principal real-world business event date used for agronomic scheduling, PHI/REI compliance tracking, and nutrient management reporting.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; EPA nutrient management reporting; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: application_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the fertilizer application operation was completed in the field. Used to calculate application duration, equipment OEE, and to confirm REI start time.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center telematics; OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation; EPA REI compliance

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: The agronomic method used to apply the fertilizer to the field or crop. Determines nutrient placement efficiency and environmental risk profile. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broadcast|banded|side_dress|fertigation|foliar|injection|top_dress — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; GAP (Good Agricultural Practices); Trimble Ag Software application method codes

attributes.name: application_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the fertilizer application operation began in the field. Sourced from John Deere Operations Center or Trimble Ag telematics. Used for REI (Restricted Entry Interval) compliance and equipment utilization analysis.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center telematics; EPA REI (Restricted Entry Interval) compliance; OSHA worker safety

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fertilization event workflow. 'planned' indicates a scheduled event not yet executed; 'in_progress' indicates active application; 'completed' indicates successful execution; 'cancelled' indicates the event was called off before execution; 'voided' indicates a data correction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP production order status; GLOBALG.A.P. field activity record

attributes.name: application_type
attributes.description: Agronomic timing classification of the fertilizer application relative to the crop growth stage. Distinguishes pre-plant, at-plant, and in-season applications for nutrient management planning and compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pre_plant|at_plant|side_dress|top_dress|in_season|post_harvest — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; GLOBALG.A.P. crop nutrition records

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fertilization event record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data governance, lineage tracking, and Silver layer ingestion auditing.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 timestamp standard; Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer audit trail; GLOBALG.A.P. record-keeping requirements

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the fertilization event, used in field records, agronomic reports, and regulatory submissions. Format: FERT-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}.
attributes.references: FMIS (Farm Management Information System) event numbering; GLOBALG.A.P. record-keeping requirements

attributes.name: fertilizer_form
attributes.description: Physical form of the fertilizer product applied. Determines equipment requirements, handling procedures, and SDS (Safety Data Sheet) compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dry_granular|liquid|anhydrous_ammonia|suspension|slow_release|controlled_release — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA fertilizer product registration; SDS (Safety Data Sheet) requirements; OSHA hazardous materials handling

attributes.name: is_gmo_derived
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fertilizer product contains or is derived from GMO (Genetically Modified Organism) sources (e.g., certain biofertilizers). Relevant for organic certification exclusion and international export compliance.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS GMO regulatory framework; GLOBALG.A.P. GMO traceability; EU GMO labeling regulations for export

attributes.name: is_organic
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fertilizer product applied is certified organic under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). True = organic-approved input; False = conventional synthetic fertilizer. Critical for organic certification compliance and audit trails.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); USDA Agricultural Marketing Service organic certification; GLOBALG.A.P. organic module

attributes.name: is_vra_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fertilization event was executed using Variable Rate Application (VRA) technology, applying different rates across management zones within the field. True = VRA prescription followed; False = flat-rate uniform application.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software VRA module; John Deere Operations Center precision agriculture; GLOBALG.A.P. precision farming records

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fertilization event record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), Silver layer incremental loads, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 timestamp standard; Databricks Lakehouse CDC pattern; GLOBALG.A.P. record amendment tracking

attributes.name: nitrogen_applied_lbs_acre
attributes.description: Actual pounds of elemental nitrogen applied per acre during this event, derived from actual_rate and nitrogen_pct. Stored as a raw field value from the source system for EPA nutrient management plan compliance and environmental reporting. Critical KPI for nitrogen use efficiency (NUE) analysis.
attributes.references: EPA nutrient management reporting; USDA NRCS Practice Standard 590; FSMA Produce Safety Rule environmental monitoring

attributes.name: nitrogen_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of nitrogen (N) in the NPK formulation of the fertilizer product applied. Used for nutrient budget calculations, soil nitrogen loading analysis, and EPA nutrient management plan compliance.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; EPA nutrient management; NPK (Nitrogen Phosphorus Potassium) formulation standard

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator or agronomist notes related to this fertilization event. May include observations about field conditions, equipment issues, deviations from prescription, or agronomic rationale. Supports GAP documentation requirements.
attributes.references: GAP (Good Agricultural Practices) field record documentation; GLOBALG.A.P. activity log requirements

attributes.name: nutrient_management_plan_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the USDA NRCS-approved Nutrient Management Plan (NMP) that governs this fertilization event. Required for USDA conservation program compliance (e.g., EQIP) and EPA nutrient management reporting.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; EPA Clean Water Act; USDA EQIP (Environmental Quality Incentives Program)

attributes.name: phosphorus_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of phosphorus (P2O5) in the NPK formulation of the fertilizer product applied. Used for phosphorus loading calculations, water quality compliance, and soil nutrient balance reporting.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; EPA Clean Water Act nutrient runoff compliance; NPK formulation standard

attributes.name: planned_rate
attributes.description: The target or prescribed fertilizer application rate as specified in the agronomic plan or VRA prescription, expressed in the unit defined by rate_unit. Represents the intended nutrient loading before actual application.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software VRA prescription; USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590

attributes.name: potassium_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of potassium (K2O) in the NPK formulation of the fertilizer product applied. Used for potassium budget calculations and soil fertility management reporting.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; NPK (Nitrogen Phosphorus Potassium) formulation standard

attributes.name: rate_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for both planned_rate and actual_rate fields. Common units include lbs/acre (CWT-based), gallons/acre for liquid fertilizers, and metric equivalents for international operations.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS measurement standards; CWT (Hundredweight) and BU (Bushel) unit conventions; ISO 80000 measurement standards

attributes.name: rei_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the Restricted Entry Interval (REI) expires following the fertilizer application, after which workers may safely re-enter the treated field. Calculated from application_end_timestamp plus the product-specific REI duration. Critical for OSHA and EPA worker safety compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS); OSHA 29 CFR 1928.110 agricultural worker safety; REI (Restricted Entry Interval) product label requirement

attributes.name: soil_temperature_f
attributes.description: Soil temperature in degrees Fahrenheit at the time of fertilizer application. Critical for nitrogen application timing decisions (e.g., nitrification inhibitor effectiveness, anhydrous ammonia fall application restrictions) and nutrient uptake efficiency.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; Climate FieldView soil temperature data; agronomic best practices for nitrogen timing

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this fertilization event record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer ingestion audit for the Databricks Lakehouse pipeline.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Trimble Ag Software; Climate FieldView; Granular Farm Management; FMIS data integration standards

attributes.name: source_system_event_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this fertilization event record in the originating operational system (e.g., John Deere Operations Center task ID, Trimble Ag field activity ID). Enables deduplication and reconciliation between the Silver layer and source systems.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Trimble Ag Software; Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer data lineage standards

attributes.name: total_product_applied
attributes.description: Total quantity of fertilizer product applied across the entire treated area during this event, expressed in the unit defined by rate_unit. Calculated from actual_rate multiplied by treated_area_acres but stored as a raw field value from the source system for inventory reconciliation and nutrient management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM goods issue; Manhattan Associates WMS inventory depletion; EPA nutrient management reporting

attributes.name: treated_area_acres
attributes.description: The actual field area covered by the fertilizer application, measured in acres. May differ from the total field area if only a portion of the field was treated. Sourced from GPS/RTK boundary data in John Deere Operations Center.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center GPS/RTK field mapping; Esri ArcGIS geospatial area calculation; USDA FSA field acreage records

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Observed weather condition at the time of fertilizer application. Relevant for assessing nutrient runoff risk, volatilization potential, and GAP compliance. Recorded by the operator or sourced from field weather station data.
attributes.references: GAP (Good Agricultural Practices) application conditions; EPA nutrient runoff risk assessment; USDA NRCS conservation practice standards

attributes.name: wind_speed_mph

attributes.name: application_start_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the crop protection application operation commenced. Used for REI (Restricted Entry Interval) calculation, operator exposure tracking, and OSHA compliance. Sourced from John Deere Operations Center or Trimble Ag telematics.
attributes.references: EPA REI Regulations 40 CFR Part 170; OSHA Worker Protection Standard

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle workflow status of the crop protection application event. Drives PHI compliance checks, agronomist sign-off workflows, and FSMA audit readiness. 'pending_review' indicates awaiting agronomist approval.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. CB 7.6 Pesticide Application Records; FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112

attributes.name: application_type
attributes.description: Classification of the crop protection product by its mode of action or target pest category. attributes.name: earliest_harvest_date
attributes.description: Calculated earliest date on which the treated crop may be harvested in compliance with the PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval). Computed as application_date + phi_days_required. Enforced in harvest scheduling to prevent MRL violations and FSMA non-compliance.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA PHI Compliance; FSMA Produce Safety Rule; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 7.5; Codex Alimentarius MRL

attributes.name: epa_registration_number
attributes.description: EPA registration number of the pesticide product applied, as printed on the product label. Mandatory for FIFRA compliance recordkeeping. Format: registrant-product[-state suffix]. Must match the EPA-registered label used at time of application.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3 Registration; 40 CFR Part 152; EPA Pesticide Label Requirements

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this crop protection application event, formatted as CPE-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}. Used in audit trails, GLOBALG.A.P. pesticide records, EPA recordkeeping submissions, and FSMA traceability documentation.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 8(a) Recordkeeping; FSMA Produce Safety Rule; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 7.6

attributes.name: gps_coverage_polygon
attributes.description: Well-Known Text (WKT) representation of the GPS-tracked coverage polygon for this application event, as recorded by John Deere Operations Center or Trimble RTK positioning. Enables GIS-based spatial analysis in Esri ArcGIS for drift buffer compliance and field coverage verification.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center GPS Tracking; Esri ArcGIS Spatial Standards; OGC WKT Standard

attributes.name: ipm_justified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crop protection application was justified by an IPM (Integrated Pest Management) scouting threshold or economic injury level assessment, rather than a calendar-based schedule. True = IPM threshold-triggered; False = preventive/calendar application. Required for GLOBALG.A.P. IPM program compliance.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. CB 7.2 IPM; USDA IPM Program; EPA Pesticide Risk Reduction

attributes.name: phi_compliance_status
attributes.description: Compliance determination for the PHI requirement relative to the planned harvest date. 'compliant' = harvest date is after earliest_harvest_date; 'non_compliant' = harvest scheduled before PHI expiry; 'pending' = harvest date not yet confirmed; 'waived' = regulatory exemption applied.
attributes.references: FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 7.5; EPA FIFRA PHI

attributes.name: phi_days_required
attributes.description: Number of days that must elapse between the last application of this crop protection product and the earliest permissible harvest date, as specified on the EPA-registered label. Core compliance field for FSMA, GLOBALG.A.P., and MRL verification.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA PHI Label Requirement; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 7.5; FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112

attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard 40 CFR Part 170; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 7.5

attributes.name: rei_compliance_status
attributes.description: Compliance determination for the REI requirement. 'compliant' = no worker re-entry before rei_clearance_datetime; 'non_compliant' = documented early re-entry violation; 'pending' = REI period still active; 'waived' = PPE exception per label.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard 40 CFR Part 170; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 7.5

attributes.name: rei_hours_required
attributes.description: Number of hours that workers must stay out of the treated field following application, as specified on the EPA-registered label under the Worker Protection Standard (WPS). Decimal to support half-hour increments (e.g., 4.0, 12.0, 24.0, 48.0 hours).

products.name: yield_record
products.description: Single source of truth for all yield and harvest performance data at the field-season-variety level. Captures individual harvest operation details: harvest date, combine/equipment used, operator, load ticket references, moisture content at harvest, test weight, grain quality grade, GPS-tracked harvest area, and field coverage. Aggregates production metrics: total production (BU, MT, CWT), average yield per acre (YPM), moisture-adjusted yield, quality grade distribution, and variance against the field crop plan's yield target. Each harvest pass on a field is recorded as a yield_record entry, with season-level rollups computed for financial and agronomic reporting. Sourced from John Deere Operations Center and Climate FieldView harvest data. Serves as the authoritative yield SSOT for financial crop enterprise accounting, grain receipt (GRN) creation, sales contract fulfillment, crop insurance (USDA RMA) documentation, and agronomic benchmarking. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA PP and Granular Farm Management.

attributes.name: test_weight_lbs_per_bu

attributes.name: total_production_bu

attributes.name: yield_variance_bu_per_acre
attributes.description: Difference between actual yield_per_acre and yield_target_bu_per_acre. Positive value indicates above-plan performance; negative value indicates shortfall. Used for financial crop enterprise accounting, crop insurance (USDA RMA APH), and agronomic benchmarking.
attributes.references: USDA RMA; Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.references: EPA MRL regulations; FDA; Codex Alimentarius; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: ndvi_at_harvest
attributes.business_glossary_term: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) at Harvest
attributes.description: NDVI value captured from satellite or drone imagery at or near the time of harvest. Used to correlate canopy health with final yield outcomes and validate remote sensing models.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; Climate FieldView; Trimble Ag Software; NASA NDVI standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator or agronomist observations about the harvest event, including equipment issues, field conditions, crop anomalies, or other contextual information not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P.; GAP Standards

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the harvested crop was produced under USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certified conditions. Required for organic premium pricing, identity preservation, and NOP compliance documentation.
attributes.references: USDA NOP; USDA AMS; GLOBALG.A.P. Organic

attributes.name: phi_compliance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) for all applied crop protection products has been satisfied prior to this harvest event. Mandatory for food safety and MRL compliance under FSMA and EPA regulations.
attributes.references: EPA PHI requirements; FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P.; FDA MRL standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this harvest event data originated (e.g., John Deere Operations Center, Climate FieldView, SAP S/4HANA PP). Supports data lineage and SSOT governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; John Deere Operations Center; Climate FieldView

attributes.name: source_system_event_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this harvest event in the originating operational system (e.g., John Deere Operations Center machine data ID, Climate FieldView harvest activity ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and audit traceability.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Climate FieldView; SAP S/4HANA PP Module

attributes.name: standard_moisture_pct
attributes.description: Industry-standard moisture percentage used as the basis for moisture-adjusted yield calculations and grain pricing (e.g., 15.5% for corn, 13.0% for soybeans per USDA GIPSA standards).
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA; CBOT grain standards

attributes.name: test_weight_lbs_per_bu
attributes.description: Grain density measurement expressed as pounds per bushel (lbs/bu), indicating grain quality and maturity. Used for grade determination and price dockage calculations per USDA GIPSA standards.
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA; Federal Grain Inspection Service (FGIS)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this harvest event record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 22000; FSMA; SOX; GDPR Article 5

products.name: crop
products.description: Master reference table for crop. Referenced by crop_id.

attributes.name: crop_id
attributes.description: Primary key for crop

attributes.name: parent_crop_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on crop (parent_crop_id)

attributes.name: average_yield
attributes.description: Historical average yield for this crop expressed in the yield_unit, used for crop planning and forecasting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this crop master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: crop_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the crop type based on agricultural use and market segment.

attributes.name: crop_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code used for crop identification in Farm Management Information Systems (FMIS) and regulatory reporting. Externally-known unique identifier.

attributes.name: crop_name
attributes.description: Common name of the crop (e.g., Corn, Wheat, Soybeans, Cotton). Human-readable identifier used across all agronomic systems.

attributes.name: crop_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the crop in the master reference system. Active crops are available for planting schedules and field assignments.

attributes.name: crop_type
attributes.description: Classification based on the crop's lifecycle duration: annual (single season), perennial (multi-year), or biennial (two-year cycle).

attributes.name: disease_susceptibility
attributes.description: General susceptibility of the crop to disease infections, used in IPM-based disease management strategies.

attributes.name: drought_tolerance
attributes.description: Crop's ability to withstand water stress and drought conditions, critical for irrigation planning.

attributes.name: frost_tolerance
attributes.description: Crop's ability to withstand frost conditions during growing season.

attributes.name: gmo_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether genetically modified varieties of this crop are available and approved for cultivation.

attributes.name: growing_season
attributes.description: Primary season during which the crop is typically cultivated, used for crop planning and rotation scheduling.

attributes.name: harvest_method
attributes.description: Primary method used for harvesting the crop: manual labor, mechanical equipment, or combination.

attributes.name: market_price_per_unit
attributes.description: Current market price per yield unit (e.g., price per bushel, price per kilogram), used for revenue forecasting and crop selection decisions.

attributes.name: maturity_days_max
attributes.description: Maximum number of days from planting to harvest maturity for late-maturing varieties of this crop.

attributes.name: maturity_days_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of days from planting to harvest maturity for early-maturing varieties of this crop.

attributes.name: ndvi_threshold_healthy
attributes.description: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) threshold value indicating healthy crop vigor, used for remote sensing and field health monitoring.

attributes.name: nitrogen_requirement_kg_per_hectare
attributes.description: Recommended nitrogen fertilizer application rate in kilograms per hectare for optimal yield, used in Variable Rate Application (VRA) prescriptions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional agronomic notes, special cultivation requirements, or regional considerations for this crop.

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crop can be grown under organic certification standards.

attributes.name: pest_susceptibility
attributes.description: General susceptibility of the crop to pest infestations, used in Integrated Pest Management (IPM) planning.

attributes.name: phi_days
attributes.description: Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) - minimum number of days required between last pesticide application and harvest to ensure compliance with food safety regulations.

attributes.name: phosphorus_requirement_kg_per_hectare
attributes.description: Recommended phosphorus fertilizer application rate in kilograms per hectare for optimal yield.

attributes.name: planting_depth_cm
attributes.description: Recommended seed planting depth in centimeters for optimal germination and establishment.

attributes.name: potassium_requirement_kg_per_hectare
attributes.description: Recommended potassium fertilizer application rate in kilograms per hectare for optimal yield.

attributes.name: rei_hours
attributes.description: Restricted Entry Interval (REI) - minimum number of hours workers must wait before entering treated fields after pesticide application, ensuring worker safety compliance.

attributes.name: rotation_compatible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crop is suitable for inclusion in crop rotation schedules to maintain soil health and reduce pest pressure.

attributes.name: row_spacing_cm
attributes.description: Recommended distance between crop rows in centimeters for optimal growth and equipment access.

attributes.name: scientific_name
attributes.description: Scientific botanical name of the crop using binomial nomenclature (e.g., Zea mays for corn, Triticum aestivum for wheat).

attributes.name: seeding_rate_kg_per_hectare
attributes.description: Recommended seeding rate in kilograms per hectare for standard planting density.

attributes.name: soil_ph_max
attributes.description: Maximum soil pH level tolerated by the crop for healthy growth.

attributes.name: soil_ph_min
attributes.description: Minimum soil pH level required for optimal crop growth and nutrient availability.

attributes.name: temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in Celsius tolerated by the crop before heat stress occurs.

attributes.name: temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in Celsius required for crop germination and growth.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this crop master record was last modified.

attributes.name: water_requirement_mm
attributes.description: Total seasonal water requirement in millimeters, used for Evapotranspiration (ET)-driven irrigation planning.

attributes.name: yield_unit
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for crop yield reporting (e.g., bushels per acre for corn, kilograms per hectare for wheat). Used in Yield Per Minute (YPM) calculations.

domains.name: livestock
domains.description: Manages all animal husbandry and breeding operations including herd and flock records, animal identification (RFID/ear tag), breeding programs, health and veterinary treatment logs, feed ration and nutrition planning, vaccination schedules, growth performance, and animal welfare compliance. Serves as the SSOT for animal lifecycle data from birth through harvest, supporting APHIS regulatory requirements, FSIS compliance, and antibiotic/withdrawal period tracking.

products.name: animal
products.description: Core master record for every individual animal in the herd or flock. Serves as the SSOT for animal identity across the full lifecycle from birth through harvest, sale, or disposal. Captures RFID tag, ear tag, electronic ID (EID), species, breed reference, sex, birth date, birth weight, dam/sire references (self-referencing lineage), origin (born on farm vs. purchased), current herd assignment, current location (pen/pasture), production class, production group assignment, GMO status, current lifecycle stage, and disposition status. Supports APHIS traceability requirements, USDA NAIS/RFID compliance, and COOL country-of-origin documentation.
products.reference: APHIS Animal Identification / USDA NAIS

attributes.name: animal_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for each individual animal record. Serves as the primary key and universal reference across all livestock management systems.
attributes.references: USDA NAIS (National Animal Identification System); APHIS Animal Traceability Framework

attributes.name: breed_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the breed master record for this animal's registered or recognized breed (e.g., Angus, Hereford, Duroc, Merino). Supports genetic performance benchmarking, EPD (Expected Progeny Difference) analysis, and breed association reporting.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Breed Standards; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: USDA-assigned Premises Identification Number (PIN) for the physical location where the animal currently resides. 10-character alphanumeric code (3-letter state abbreviation + 7 digits). Required for USDA NAIS/ADT interstate movement documentation and disease traceability.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Premises Registration; USDA NAIS; 9 CFR Part 86

attributes.name: herd_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the herd or flock to which this animal is currently assigned. Drives management group decisions, vaccination scheduling, and regulatory reporting at the herd level. Sourced from Granular Farm Management herd master.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Herd Identification Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module

attributes.name: inspection_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organic_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.organic_certification. Business justification: animal.organic_certified is a boolean denormalization of an organic certification record. USDA NOP requires traceability from individual animals to the specific organic certification under which they
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: pen_location_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the current physical pen, pasture, or paddock where the animal is housed or grazing. Supports daily management, feeding operations, and biosecurity zone tracking. Linked to the facility location master.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; USDA APHIS Premises Registration

attributes.name: primary_dam_animal_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the mother (dam) animal record within this same table. Enables maternal lineage tracing for genetic performance analysis, EPD calculations, and pedigree documentation. Null for purchased animals with unknown dam.
attributes.references: Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines; USDA AMS Breed Association Standards

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Each purchased animal must reference the procurement PO for cost basis establishment, financial reconciliation, and COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) documentation. animal.source_vendor_id already lin
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: source_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the external vendor, auction house, or producer from whom the animal was purchased. Null for born-on-farm animals. Supports supplier traceability, biosecurity source tracking, and procurement analytics in SAP S/4HANA MM module.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; USDA COOL 7 USC 1638; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Purchase price or capitalized cost basis of the animal at time of acquisition, expressed in USD. For born-on-farm animals, represents the capitalized cost of raising to weaning. Used for inventory valuation, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation, and financial reporting under GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 905 (Agriculture); IFRS IAS 41 (Agriculture); FASB Agricultural Accounting

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date the animal was acquired by the operation — either the birth date for born-on-farm animals or the purchase/transfer-in date for externally sourced animals. Used for inventory aging, cost basis calculation, and COOL documentation.
attributes.references: USDA COOL 7 USC 1638; FSMA Traceability Rule; GAAP Inventory Accounting

attributes.name: antibiotic_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether the animal has never received antibiotic treatments and qualifies for 'Never Ever 3' (NE3) or antibiotic-free marketing programs. Drives premium market channel eligibility and label claim compliance.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS Labeling Policy; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock; FDA Guidance for Industry #213

attributes.name: birth_date
attributes.description: Actual or estimated calendar date the animal was born. Used to calculate age, determine production class eligibility, schedule vaccinations, and compute days-on-feed (DOF). Required for USDA age verification programs and COOL documentation.
attributes.references: USDA COOL 7 USC 1638; USDA Age and Source Verification Program; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: birth_weight_kg
attributes.description: Body weight of the animal recorded at or shortly after birth, expressed in kilograms. Baseline measurement for growth performance tracking, EPD (Expected Progeny Difference) calculations, and dam/sire genetic evaluation.
attributes.references: Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module

attributes.name: brand_description
attributes.description: Description of the hot iron or freeze brand applied to the animal for permanent ownership identification. Includes brand symbol, location on body, and registration state. Required for cattle ownership verification in brand-law states and theft prevention.
attributes.references: State Brand Laws (varies by state); USDA APHIS; Western States Livestock Brand Registries

attributes.name: breed_composition_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the animal's genetics attributable to the primary breed identified in breed_id. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 75.00 for 75% Angus). Used for crossbreeding program management, breed association registration eligibility, and genetic improvement analytics.
attributes.references: Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines; USDA AMS Breed Association Standards

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the animal was born, raised, or slaughtered as required by USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) regulations. Mandatory for retail muscle cut labeling compliance.
attributes.references: USDA COOL 7 USC 1638; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; USDA AMS COOL Final Rule

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the animal record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements, and FSMA traceability documentation. Populated automatically at record creation and never updated.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; ISO 8601; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: current_weight_kg
attributes.description: Most recently recorded live body weight of the animal in kilograms. Updated at each weigh event. Used for feed ration calculation, marketing weight assessment, and growth performance monitoring. Distinct from birth weight and harvest weight.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: Date the animal was removed from active inventory through harvest, sale, death, condemnation, or transfer out. Used for inventory reconciliation, mortality reporting, and lifecycle cost analysis. Null while animal is in ACTIVE disposition status.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS 9 CFR Part 309; GAAP ASC 905; APHIS 9 CFR Part 86

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: Current disposition status representing the animal's standing in the operation. ACTIVE=currently on inventory; HARVESTED=sent to harvest/slaughter; SOLD=sold to external party; DIED=natural or accidental death; CONDEMNED=condemned at ante/post-mortem inspection; TRANSFERRED_OUT=moved to another facility. Core lifecycle status field for inventory reconciliation and FSIS compliance.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS 9 CFR Part 309; APHIS 9 CFR Part 86; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: ear_tag_number
attributes.description: Visual alphanumeric identifier printed on the physical ear tag applied to the animal. Used for visual identification in the field and pen. May be a farm-assigned number or official USDA 840 tag number. Supports COOL country-of-origin labeling traceability.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 86; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) 7 USC 1638

attributes.name: eid
attributes.description: Electronic Identification number as printed on the visual ear tag and encoded in the RFID transponder. May differ from the raw RFID tag number in formatted display. Used in John Deere Operations Center and Granular Farm Management for animal-level record linkage.
attributes.references: ISO 11784/11785; USDA APHIS Animal Traceability Rule (9 CFR Part 86)

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the animal is derived from genetically modified genetics (GMO), confirmed non-GMO, or status is unknown. Required for non-GMO certification programs, organic certification under USDA NOP, and export documentation to GMO-sensitive markets.
attributes.references: USDA NOP (National Organic Program) 7 CFR Part 205; Non-GMO Project Standard; EU Regulation 1829/2003

attributes.name: health_status
attributes.description: Current veterinary health status of the animal. HEALTHY=no active health concerns; SICK=active illness under observation; QUARANTINE=isolated for biosecurity or regulatory reasons; TREATED=currently under veterinary treatment with active withdrawal period; RECOVERED=returned to healthy status post-treatment; CONDEMNED=condemned by veterinary inspection.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS 9 CFR Part 309; APHIS Veterinary Accreditation; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Health Module

attributes.name: last_weigh_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the most recent live weight measurement. Used to assess recency of weight data, calculate average daily gain (ADG) since last weigh, and trigger re-weigh alerts when interval exceeds operational thresholds.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current biological and production lifecycle stage of the animal. Drives nutritional requirements, veterinary protocols, and management interventions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NEONATAL|WEANED|GROWING|FINISHING|MATURE|GESTATING|LACTATING|DRY — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; NRC Nutrient Requirements of Domestic Animals

attributes.name: official_usda_tag
attributes.description: Official USDA 840-prefix 15-digit national uniform ear tag number assigned under the USDA Animal Disease Traceability (ADT) framework. Required for interstate movement of cattle, bison, and other covered species. Begins with country code 840 (USA).
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 86; USDA Animal Disease Traceability (ADT) Rule

attributes.name: origin_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the animal was born on the operation, purchased from an external source, or transferred in from another company-owned facility. Critical for COOL country-of-origin labeling, FSMA traceability, and biosecurity risk classification.
attributes.references: USDA COOL 7 USC 1638; FSMA Produce Safety Rule; APHIS 9 CFR Part 86

attributes.name: parity_number
attributes.description: Number of times a female animal has given birth (parturitions). Parity 0 = never calved/farrowed/lambed; Parity 1 = first calf/litter; etc. Used for reproductive performance analysis, culling decisions, and production benchmarking for dairy and cow-calf operations.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Reproductive Module; Dairy Herd Improvement Association (DHIA) Standards

attributes.name: production_class
attributes.description: Operational production class that defines the animal's role in the production system. Determines applicable management protocols, feed rations, performance benchmarks, and marketing channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: COW_CALF|STOCKER|FEEDLOT|DAIRY|BREEDING|SHOW|SEEDSTOCK|REPLACEMENT_HEIFER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NASS Livestock Survey; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration number issued by a recognized breed association (e.g., American Angus Association, National Swine Registry) for purebred or registered animals. Required for seedstock marketing, EPD publication, and breed association reporting.
attributes.references: American Angus Association; National Swine Registry; American Hereford Association; USDA AMS

attributes.name: rfid_tag_number
attributes.description: 15-digit ISO 11784/11785 compliant RFID electronic tag number embedded in the animal's ear tag or bolus. Primary electronic identifier used for automated reading at chutes, scales, and gates. Required for USDA NAIS traceability and APHIS interstate movement compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 11784/11785; USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 86; USDA NAIS

attributes.name: sex_code
attributes.description: Biological sex and reproductive status of the animal. M=Male (intact bull/boar/ram), F=Female (cow/sow/ewe), C=Castrated male (steer/barrow/wether), S=Spayed female, B=Barrow. Drives production class assignment, feed ration, and harvest yield expectations.
attributes.references: USDA NASS Livestock Survey Codes; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines

attributes.name: species_code
attributes.description: Standardized species classification of the animal. Drives applicable regulatory frameworks (FSIS, APHIS), withdrawal period rules, and feed ration formulations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BOVINE|SWINE|OVINE|CAPRINE|EQUINE|POULTRY|CERVID|BISON|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FSIS 9 CFR; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: tattoo_number
attributes.description: Permanent alphanumeric tattoo applied inside the ear or on the body for permanent identification, particularly for swine, sheep, and registered cattle. Used as a backup identifier when ear tags are lost and for breed association registration.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Swine Identification Standards; National Swine Registry; American Angus Association

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent modification to the animal record. Used for change data capture (CDC), data synchronization between SAP S/4HANA and Granular Farm Management, and audit trail compliance under SOX and FSMA.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; SOX Section 404; ISO 8601

attributes.name: cost_per_unit

attributes.name: epd_birth_weight
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for birth weight for the sire, expressed in pounds. Positive values indicate heavier-than-average offspring. Used in sire selection to manage calving difficulty and neonatal survival.
attributes.references: USDA AMS EPD calculation standards; breed association genetic evaluation methodologies

attributes.name: epd_calving_ease
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for calving ease for the sire. Expressed as a percentage advantage in unassisted births compared to breed average. Used in sire selection to minimize dystocia risk.

attributes.name: epd_marbling
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for marbling (intramuscular fat) for the sire. Expressed as a USDA marbling score unit advantage. Used in beef quality grade prediction and premium market targeting.
attributes.references: USDA AMS EPD calculation standards; USDA beef quality grading standards; breed association genetic evaluation methodologies

attributes.name: epd_milk
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for milk production for the sire, expressed in pounds. Reflects the milking ability transmitted through daughters. Used in maternal breed selection for calf nutrition and growth.
attributes.references: USDA AMS EPD calculation standards; breed association genetic evaluation methodologies

attributes.name: epd_rea
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for Ribeye Area (REA) for the sire, expressed in square inches. Indicates genetic merit for muscle expression and cutability. Used in carcass merit prediction and sire selection for yield grade improvement.
attributes.references: USDA AMS EPD calculation standards; USDA beef yield grading standards; breed association genetic evaluation methodologies

attributes.name: epd_weaning_weight

attributes.references: USDA AMS EPD calculation standards; breed association genetic evaluation methodologies

attributes.name: epd_yearling_weight
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for yearling weight for the sire, expressed in pounds. Indicates the sire's genetic merit for post-weaning growth rate. Used in feedlot performance prediction and sire selection.
attributes.references: USDA AMS EPD calculation standards; breed association genetic evaluation methodologies

attributes.name: event_status

attributes.name: expected_parturition_date

attributes.name: offspring_count

attributes.name: post_thaw_motility_pct

attributes.name: clinical_signs
attributes.description: Free-text description of the observable clinical signs or symptoms presented by the animal or group at the time of treatment, as recorded by the attending veterinarian or farm staff. Supports HACCP documentation and veterinary case history.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp recording when this health treatment record was first created in the FMIS or SAP QM system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record-keeping compliance.

attributes.name: diagnosis_code
attributes.description: Standardized veterinary diagnosis code identifying the disease or condition being treated, aligned with USDA APHIS disease reporting codes or ICD-10-CM veterinary adaptations. Used for APHIS disease surveillance reporting and herd health analytics.
