attributes.name: dosage_amount
attributes.description: Numeric quantity of the drug or vaccine product administered per animal or per unit of body weight, as prescribed. Used in conjunction with dosage_unit for complete dosage documentation required by FDA VFD and FSIS withdrawal compliance.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Regulations 21 CFR Part 558; FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance

attributes.name: dosage_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the administered dosage amount (e.g., mL, mg, mg/kg body weight). Required for accurate withdrawal period calculation and FDA VFD documentation.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Regulations 21 CFR Part 558; FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance

attributes.name: ear_tag_number
attributes.description: Physical ear tag identifier of the treated animal, denormalized from the animal master for rapid field lookup and cross-referencing with paper-based treatment logs. Supports USDA NAIS (National Animal Identification System) traceability.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS National Animal Identification System (NAIS); COOL 7 CFR Part 60

attributes.name: earliest_harvest_date
attributes.description: Calculated date on which the animal first becomes eligible for harvest or product collection after completing the mandatory withdrawal period. Derived from treatment_date plus withdrawal_days; stored as a business-critical compliance field to prevent premature slaughter and FSIS violations.
attributes.references: FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance; USDA Residue Avoidance Program; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations, special instructions, or contextual information recorded by the veterinarian or farm staff at the time of treatment. Supports HACCP documentation and veterinary case history completeness.
attributes.references: HACCP 21 CFR Part 120; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health Standard; ISO 22000

attributes.name: number_of_animals_treated
attributes.description: Count of individual animals included in this treatment event. Value is 1 for individual animal treatments; greater than 1 for group-level treatments such as metaphylaxis or arrival processing. Used for drug inventory reconciliation and treatment cost allocation.
attributes.references: FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance; SAP S/4HANA MM Drug Inventory; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health

attributes.name: product_used_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the total_product_used quantity (e.g., mL, mg, doses). Required for drug inventory reconciliation and cost reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; FDA CVM Drug Label Requirements

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating whether this record represents an actual treatment event applied to an animal or group (treatment_instance) or a standardized health management protocol template used as a reference for future treatments (protocol_template). Drives downstream processing logic and reporting.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health and Welfare Standard; USDA APHIS Veterinary Biologics

attributes.name: retreatment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this treatment record represents a re-treatment of an animal that did not respond adequately to a prior treatment for the same condition. True when this is a follow-up treatment; False for initial treatments. Supports antibiotic stewardship and treatment efficacy analytics.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Disease Surveillance; Antibiotic Stewardship Program Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health

attributes.name: rfid_tag
attributes.description: Electronic RFID tag identifier associated with the treated animal, used for automated identification in chute-side treatment systems and integration with John Deere Operations Center livestock modules. Supports ISO 11784/11785 RFID standards.
attributes.references: ISO 11784/11785 RFID Animal Identification; USDA APHIS NAIS

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The method by which the drug or vaccine was delivered to the animal (e.g., subcutaneous injection, intramuscular injection, oral drench, topical pour-on, intranasal spray). Affects withdrawal period applicability and FSIS residue compliance.
attributes.references: FDA CVM Drug Approval; FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health

attributes.name: total_product_used
attributes.description: Total quantity of the drug or vaccine product consumed for this treatment event, calculated as dosage_amount multiplied by number_of_animals_treated. Stored for drug inventory depletion recording in SAP MM and cost-of-treatment reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module Drug Inventory; FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance

attributes.name: treatment_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of the treatment event in the farm's operating currency, including drug product cost and veterinary service fees where applicable. Used for herd health cost-of-production analysis, OPEX reporting, and Granular Farm Management financial planning integration.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management Financial Planning; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP Cost Accounting

attributes.name: treatment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the veterinary treatment, vaccination, or health intervention was administered to the animal or group. This is the principal real-world event date used for withdrawal period calculations, FSIS compliance, and HACCP records.
attributes.references: FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance; USDA APHIS Disease Surveillance; HACCP 21 CFR Part 120

attributes.name: treatment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the treatment event or protocol template, used for cross-referencing with veterinary records, VFD documentation, and SAP QM notifications. Format typically follows farm-assigned numbering conventions (e.g., TRT-2024-00123).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; FDA Veterinary Feed Directive (VFD) Regulations 21 CFR Part 558

attributes.name: treatment_outcome
attributes.description: Clinical outcome of the treatment as assessed at the end of the treatment course or at follow-up evaluation. Used for herd health analytics, treatment efficacy reporting, and antibiotic stewardship program monitoring.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Disease Surveillance; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health; Antibiotic Stewardship Program Guidelines

attributes.name: treatment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the treatment record. 'draft' indicates a record in preparation; 'active' indicates an ongoing treatment; 'completed' indicates the treatment course is finished; 'cancelled' indicates the treatment was voided; 'pending_approval' indicates awaiting veterinarian sign-off for VFD-regulated products.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Regulations 21 CFR Part 558; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: treatment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the treatment was administered, captured for IoT-integrated barn management systems and time-sensitive drug administration protocols requiring exact timing records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: treatment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the treatment purpose. 'therapeutic' treats an existing disease; 'prophylactic' prevents disease in healthy animals; 'vaccination' administers a biological vaccine; 'metaphylaxis' treats an entire group when a portion shows disease; 'arrival_processing' covers standard processing at receiving; 'parasite_control' targets internal or external parasites.
attributes.references: FDA Center for Veterinary Medicine (CVM); USDA APHIS Veterinary Biologics; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health

attributes.name: trigger_criteria
attributes.description: For protocol_template records, describes the specific conditions that trigger execution of this protocol (e.g., 'rectal temperature > 104°F', 'morbidity rate > 10% in pen within 7 days', 'BRD pull rate exceeds threshold'). Null for treatment_instance records.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health Standard; USDA APHIS Herd Health Protocol Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp recording the most recent modification to this health treatment record. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting Controls; FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: veterinarian_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the supervising veterinarian reviewed and approved this treatment record or protocol template. Required for VFD-regulated antibiotic treatments and GLOBALG.A.P. animal health certification audits.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Regulations 21 CFR Part 558; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health Standard; HACCP 21 CFR Part 120

attributes.name: veterinarian_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued veterinary license number of the attending or supervising veterinarian responsible for the treatment authorization. Required for VFD documentation and VCPR compliance. Null when treatment is administered by non-veterinary farm staff under a standing order.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Regulations 21 CFR Part 558; VCPR Requirements; State Veterinary Practice Acts

attributes.name: vfd_reference_number
attributes.description: The official Veterinary Feed Directive (VFD) document reference number issued by the licensed veterinarian authorizing the use of a VFD antibiotic in animal feed. Mandatory for medically important antimicrobials used in feed per FDA VFD regulations. Null for non-VFD treatments.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Regulations 21 CFR Part 558; FDA Guidance for Industry #213 Antimicrobial Resistance

attributes.name: withdrawal_days
attributes.description: The mandatory number of days that must elapse after the last treatment before the animal or its products (meat, milk, eggs) may enter the food supply, as specified on the drug label. Also referred to as Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) for meat animals. Critical for FSIS residue avoidance compliance.
attributes.references: FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance; FDA CVM Drug Label Requirements; USDA Residue Avoidance Program

attributes.name: withdrawal_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the animal with respect to drug withdrawal period. 'in_withdrawal' indicates the animal cannot yet be harvested; 'cleared' indicates the withdrawal period has elapsed; 'not_applicable' applies to non-withdrawal products or protocol templates.
attributes.references: FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance; USDA Residue Avoidance Program

attributes.description: Precise date and time the vaccine was administered, captured from the farm management system or mobile device. Supports time-sensitive withdrawal period calculations and audit trail integrity.

attributes.name: adverse_reaction_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any adverse reaction observed following vaccination (e.g., anaphylaxis, injection site swelling, fever). Populated only when adverse_reaction_observed is True. Supports APHIS CVB adverse event reporting.

attributes.name: adverse_reaction_observed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an adverse reaction was observed in the animal(s) following vaccination. A value of True triggers creation of an adverse event report to USDA APHIS Center for Veterinary Biologics (CVB) and initiates veterinary follow-up.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS CVB Adverse Event Reporting; 9 CFR Part 113; FDA 21 CFR Part 600

attributes.name: animal_count
attributes.description: Count of animals vaccinated in a group/herd-level vaccination event. Populated when herd_group_id is set and individual animal records are not created. Used for herd immunity coverage calculations.

attributes.name: booster_due_date
attributes.description: Calculated or label-specified date by which the next booster dose must be administered to maintain protective immunity. Drives automated alerts in the herd vaccination schedule and GLOBALG.A.P. compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v5.4 LB.3; APHIS Vaccination Program Standards

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Certificate of Analysis (COA) issued by the vaccine manufacturer for the specific lot, confirming potency, purity, and safety testing results. Corresponds to COA in common agricultural jargon.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 113; FDA 21 CFR Part 600.12

attributes.name: cold_chain_maintained
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required cold chain storage conditions were maintained for the vaccine from receipt through administration. A value of False triggers a non-compliance flag and may invalidate the vaccination record for regulatory purposes.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 113; WHO Cold Chain Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v5.4 LB.3

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance state of this vaccination record against the herd vaccination schedule and regulatory requirements. Drives APHIS disease surveillance alerts and GLOBALG.A.P. certification audits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: compliant|non_compliant|pending|overdue|waived|under_review — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: APHIS Animal Disease Traceability; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v5.4 LB.3; FSIS 9 CFR Part 417

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this vaccination record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2); ISO 22000:2018 Clause 8

attributes.name: disease_target
attributes.description: The disease, pathogen, or condition the vaccine is intended to prevent or control (e.g., 'Bovine Respiratory Disease', 'Porcine Reproductive and Respiratory Syndrome', 'Newcastle Disease'). Supports disease surveillance analytics and APHIS reportable disease tracking.
attributes.references: APHIS Animal Disease Traceability; OIE Terrestrial Animal Health Code; USDA NAHMS

attributes.name: dosage_ml
attributes.description: Volume of vaccine administered in milliliters (mL) per animal or per dose. Must conform to label-approved dosage. Deviations from label dosage require veterinary authorization and are flagged for compliance review.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 113; FDA 21 CFR Part 600; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v5.4 LB.3

attributes.name: dose_number
attributes.description: Sequential dose number within a multi-dose vaccination series (e.g., 1 = primary, 2 = booster). Enables tracking of vaccination series completion and booster compliance.
attributes.references: APHIS Vaccination Program Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v5.4 LB.3

attributes.name: ear_tag_number
attributes.description: Official ear tag or visual identification number of the individual animal at time of vaccination. Denormalized for rapid lookup and regulatory reporting without joining to the animal master. Supports APHIS Animal Disease Traceability (ADT) requirements.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Animal Disease Traceability 9 CFR Part 86; COOL 7 CFR Part 60

attributes.name: earliest_harvest_date
attributes.description: The earliest date on which the animal may be harvested for human consumption, calculated as administration_date plus withdrawal_period_days. Critical for FSIS pre-harvest food safety compliance and scheduling harvest operations.
attributes.references: FSIS 9 CFR Part 309; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v5.4 LB.3

attributes.name: injection_site
attributes.description: Specific anatomical location on the animal where the vaccine was injected (e.g., 'neck', 'behind ear', 'rump'). Supports Beef Quality Assurance (BQA) compliance and carcass quality tracking to avoid injection site lesions.
attributes.references: USDA Beef Quality Assurance (BQA) Program; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v5.4 LB.3

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations, deviations from standard protocol, animal behavior notes, or other contextual information recorded by the administering technician or supervising veterinarian.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v5.4 LB.3; ISO 22000:2018 Clause 8.9

attributes.name: record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this vaccination event, used in veterinary documentation, APHIS reporting, and GLOBALG.A.P. audit trails. Format: VAC-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: APHIS Animal Disease Traceability; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v5.4 AF.11

attributes.name: rfid_tag_number
attributes.description: RFID electronic identification number of the animal at time of vaccination, conforming to ISO 11784/11785 standards. Enables automated identification during chute-side vaccination and integrates with John Deere Operations Center livestock tracking.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS ADT 9 CFR Part 86; ISO 11784/11785 RFID Animal Identification

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: USDA-assigned serial number for the specific biologics product lot, distinct from the manufacturer lot number. Required for APHIS Center for Veterinary Biologics (CVB) compliance and product release verification.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 113.5; CVB Biologics Regulations

attributes.name: species
attributes.description: Species of the animal(s) vaccinated. Determines applicable regulatory framework (APHIS, FSIS), withdrawal period tables, and label compliance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bovine|porcine|poultry|ovine|caprine|equine|aquaculture|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 9 CFR; FSIS 9 CFR Part 381; OIE Terrestrial Animal Health Code

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius at which the vaccine was stored prior to administration. Verified against label-required cold chain specifications (typically 2–8°C for refrigerated biologics). Out-of-range values trigger cold chain breach alerts.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 113; WHO Cold Chain Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v5.4 LB.3

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to this vaccination record. Supports change detection, data quality monitoring, and regulatory audit requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2); FSMA 21 CFR Part 117

attributes.name: vaccine_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date printed on the vaccine vial or packaging. Used to verify that the vaccine was not expired at time of administration and to flag non-compliant records for regulatory review.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 113; FDA 21 CFR Part 600.12

attributes.name: vaccine_type
attributes.description: Biological classification of the vaccine formulation. Determines handling requirements, storage conditions, and regulatory classification under APHIS biologics licensing.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 113; CVB Veterinary Biologics Regulations

attributes.name: withdrawal_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days that must elapse after vaccination before the animal or its products (meat, milk, eggs) may enter the food supply. Derived from the vaccine label and used to calculate the earliest eligible harvest date for FSIS pre-harvest food safety compliance.
attributes.references: FSIS 9 CFR Part 309; FDA 21 CFR Part 530; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v5.4 LB.3

products.description: Transactional record of individual or group weight measurements taken at defined production checkpoints (weaning, backgrounding, feedlot entry, pre-harvest). Captures measurement date, animal ID or group ID, scale ID, body weight (lbs/kg), average daily gain (ADG) since last measurement, body condition score (BCS), frame score, measurement method (individual scale, load cell, weigh tape), and operator. Feeds into growth performance tracking, feed conversion ratio (FCR) calculations, and harvest readiness assessment.
products.reference: YPM / ADG / BCS Scoring / FMIS

attributes.name: weight_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each individual weight measurement record. Serves as the primary key for the weight_measurement data product in the livestock domain Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: animal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual animal record being weighed. Populated for individual-scale measurements; null for group/pen-level measurements. Links to the animal master record in the livestock domain.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Animal Identification; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the weighing equipment (scale, load cell, or weigh tape device) used to capture the measurement. Links to the equipment asset master for calibration traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; ISO 8196 Livestock Weighing

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.crew. Business justification: Feedlot weigh events are performed by processing crews for piece-rate payroll and H2A labor compliance reporting. Crew-level tracking enables cost-of-gain calculations per crew and supports labor comp
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce employee or contractor who performed and recorded the weight measurement. Required for audit trail and operator performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the farm, feedlot, barn, or production facility where the weight measurement was taken. Supports geographic and facility-level performance analytics.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; USDA APHIS Premises Identification

attributes.name: herd_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to livestock.herd. Business justification: weight_measurement records individual and group weights at production checkpoints. The herd context is essential for herd-level average daily gain (ADG) reporting, performance benchmarking, and market
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: pen_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to livestock.pen_location. Business justification: weight_measurement records are taken at specific pen/scale locations within the livestock facility. Adding pen_location_id → livestock.pen_location.pen_location_id enables location-based weight perfor
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: adg_kg
attributes.description: Average Daily Gain (ADG) in kilograms per day, calculated as the difference between current and previous body weight divided by the number of days elapsed. A key Key Performance Indicator (KPI) for growth performance tracking and feed conversion ratio (FCR) analysis. Stored as a captured/confirmed value from the source system, not recomputed.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Research Service; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: adjusted_weight_kg
attributes.description: Body weight after applying shrink percentage adjustment, representing the net pay weight used for sale, transfer, or harvest transactions. Calculated as body_weight_kg × (1 - shrink_pct/100) and stored for traceability.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; Livestock Marketing Association

attributes.name: age_days
attributes.description: Age of the animal in days at the time of measurement, calculated from the recorded birth date. Used to compute age-adjusted weight benchmarks, frame scores, and to assess growth performance relative to breed and production stage expectations.
attributes.references: Beef Improvement Federation (BIF); GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: body_condition_score
attributes.description: Body Condition Score (BCS) assigned to the animal at the time of weighing, typically on a 1–9 scale for beef cattle or 1–5 scale for dairy/sheep. Assesses fat cover and muscle mass relative to skeletal frame. Critical for animal welfare compliance, breeding readiness, and nutritional management decisions.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Animal Welfare; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard; Beef Quality Assurance (BQA) Guidelines

attributes.name: body_weight_kg
attributes.description: The measured live body weight of the individual animal or average body weight per head for a group measurement, expressed in kilograms. This is the principal quantitative outcome of the measurement event. Used in ADG calculations, FCR analysis, and harvest readiness assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 8196 Livestock Weighing; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: body_weight_lbs
attributes.description: The measured live body weight expressed in pounds (lbs), the primary unit of measure used in US domestic livestock markets, USDA reporting, and sale/harvest transactions. Maintained alongside kg for dual-unit reporting compliance.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; USDA APHIS; CWT/BU unit standards

attributes.name: breed_code
attributes.description: Standardized breed code for the animal being weighed (e.g., ANGUS, HEREFORD, DUROC, HOLSTEIN). Used to apply breed-specific growth curves, expected weight benchmarks, and frame score standards in performance analytics.
attributes.references: Beef Improvement Federation (BIF); USDA APHIS; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this weight measurement record was first created in the system of record. Distinct from measurement_timestamp which captures the real-world event time. Required for data lineage and Silver Layer audit trail.
attributes.references: ISO 22000; FSMA Traceability Rule; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: days_on_feed
attributes.description: Number of days the animal or group has been on the current feed ration since feedlot entry or last production stage transition. Used in conjunction with ADG to assess feed conversion efficiency and project harvest readiness date.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Granular Farm Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard

attributes.name: ear_tag_number
attributes.description: Visual ear tag identifier recorded at the time of weighing for cross-verification with RFID and as a backup identification method. Used in manual weighing operations and visual lot reconciliation.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard

attributes.name: frame_score
attributes.description: Numerical frame score (typically 1–9 for beef cattle) based on hip height measurement at a standard age, used to predict mature body size and optimal harvest weight. Supports breed selection, feeding program design, and market endpoint targeting.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines

attributes.name: harvest_ready_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator set to True when the animal's current body weight, BCS, and days on feed meet the defined harvest readiness criteria for the production program. Triggers harvest scheduling workflow and FSIS pre-harvest notification processes.
attributes.references: FSIS; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: head_count
attributes.description: Number of animals included in the measurement event. For individual measurements this is 1. For group/pen measurements this is the total number of animals weighed, used to calculate average body weight per head and total pen weight.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: hip_height_cm
attributes.description: Measured hip height of the animal in centimeters at the time of weighing, used to calculate frame score and assess skeletal development relative to body weight. Supports growth curve modeling and breed standard compliance.
attributes.references: Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Lot Number (LOT) identifying the production batch or consignment group to which the animal belongs at the time of measurement. Enables batch-level traceability from farm through harvest, supporting FSMA and FSIS compliance requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; FSIS; USDA APHIS; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the weight measurement was taken, stored as a DATE type for day-level partitioning, reporting, and production checkpoint scheduling. Derived from measurement_timestamp but retained for query performance.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: The technique or equipment type used to obtain the body weight. Affects measurement precision and confidence. Individual scale and load cell are most accurate; weigh tape and estimated methods carry higher variance and are flagged accordingly in analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 8196 Livestock Weighing; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard

attributes.name: measurement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator observations recorded at the time of weighing, such as animal behavior, equipment anomalies, environmental conditions, or reasons for weight variance. Supports audit trail and veterinary follow-up.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: measurement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the weight measurement event, used for cross-referencing with farm management systems, scale printouts, and audit trails. Format: WM-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA PP Module

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the weight measurement record. 'recorded' = initial capture; 'verified' = validated by supervisor or QA; 'rejected' = failed validation rules; 'voided' = cancelled after entry error.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the weight measurement was physically taken. This is the principal real-world event timestamp, distinct from record audit timestamps. Critical for Average Daily Gain (ADG) calculations and production checkpoint tracking.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard; USDA APHIS; ISO 22000

attributes.name: previous_measurement_date
attributes.description: The date of the immediately preceding weight measurement for the same animal or group. Used to calculate the interval in days for ADG computation and to validate measurement frequency compliance.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard

attributes.name: previous_weight_kg
attributes.description: The body weight recorded at the immediately preceding measurement event for the same animal or group, in kilograms. Stored on this record to support ADG validation and trend analysis without requiring a self-join.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard

attributes.name: production_stage
attributes.description: Defined production checkpoint at which the weight measurement was taken, representing the animal's lifecycle stage. Drives growth performance benchmarking, feed conversion ratio (FCR) calculations, and harvest readiness assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: birth|weaning|backgrounding|feedlot_entry|mid_feed|pre_harvest|harvest — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FSIS; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: rfid_tag_number
attributes.description: The Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) electronic tag number read from the animal at the time of weighing, used to confirm animal identity and enable automated data capture from walk-over scales and electronic identification systems. Supports USDA APHIS traceability requirements.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS National Animal Identification System (NAIS); ISO 11784/11785 RFID Animal Identification

attributes.name: sex_code
attributes.description: Sex classification of the animal: M=Male (intact bull/boar/ram), F=Female (heifer/cow/gilt/ewe), C=Castrated male (steer/barrow/wether), S=Spayed female. Affects expected growth rates, weight benchmarks, and market endpoint targets.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard

attributes.name: shrink_pct
attributes.description: Estimated or measured percentage of body weight lost due to gut fill, stress, or transit prior to weighing (pencil shrink or actual shrink). Applied in sale weight calculations and market price negotiations. Standard industry practice in US livestock markets.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; Livestock Marketing Association

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this weight measurement record was ingested into the Silver Layer (e.g., Granular Farm Management, Climate FieldView, SAP S/4HANA PP, John Deere Operations Center, or manual entry). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Granular Farm Management; Climate FieldView; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: species_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the livestock species being weighed. Determines applicable weight benchmarks, BCS scales, frame score standards, and regulatory reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BEEF|DAIRY|SWINE|SHEEP|GOAT|POULTRY|EQUINE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FSIS; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard

attributes.name: total_group_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total combined live weight of all animals in a group measurement event, expressed in kilograms. Null for individual animal measurements. Used for pen-level inventory valuation and feed planning.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The primary unit of measure in which the weight was recorded at the point of capture (kg or lbs). Determines which weight field is the source-of-truth value; the alternate unit field is a conversion.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-4 Mechanics; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this weight measurement record was last modified, including status changes, corrections, or verification actions. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer pipeline.
attributes.references: ISO 22000; FSMA Traceability Rule; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: weigh_condition
attributes.description: Describes the gut-fill or fasting condition of the animal at the time of weighing, which directly affects the accuracy and comparability of weight measurements. Used to apply appropriate shrink adjustments and flag outlier weights.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; Beef Quality Assurance (BQA) Guidelines

attributes.name: weight_variance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator set to True when the measured body weight deviates from the expected weight by more than the configured tolerance threshold (e.g., ±15% from breed/age/stage benchmark). Triggers data quality review and potential animal health investigation.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

products.name: feed_ration
products.description: Master and transactional record for feed nutrition management — encompassing both ration formulations (master) and feed delivery events (transactional). For formulations: captures ration name, version number, target species and production class, formulation date, nutritionist reference, ingredient list with inclusion rates (percent as-fed and DM basis), calculated nutrient profile (crude protein, TDN, NEm, NEg, calcium, phosphorus, trace minerals, vitamins), dry matter basis, target daily intake (lbs/head/day), cost per head per day, mixing instructions, and approval status. For delivery events: captures delivery date and time, pen/group ID, ration reference, quantity delivered (lbs/kg as-fed and dry matter), delivery method (TMR mixer, bunk feeder, automated system), operator, refusal amount, and feed bunk score. Record type discriminator (formulation vs delivery) separates the two concerns. Serves as the SSOT for feed formulation and delivery, supporting NRC nutritional compliance, feed cost allocation per animal, FCR tracking, and ration plan management.
products.reference: NRC Nutrient Requirements / Feed Formulation Software

attributes.name: feed_ration_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each feed ration record (formulation or delivery event). Primary key for the feed_ration data product in the livestock domain.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA PP Module

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset. Business justification: Feed rations are mixed using specific TMR mixer assets. Linking feed_ration to the mixing asset supports calibration tracking (accurate ingredient inclusion rates), maintenance scheduling based on mix
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.facility. Business justification: Feed rations are approved and managed at the facility level for FDA VFD medicated feed compliance and organic certification scope. A facility_id FK enables facility-specific ration approval workflows
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: haccp_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.haccp_plan. Business justification: Medicated and antibiotic-containing feed rations (antibiotic_flag, withdrawal_period_days) fall under HACCP/FSMA Preventive Controls for Animal Food. Linking feed_ration to its governing haccp_plan do
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: herd_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to livestock.herd. Business justification: Feed rations are formulated for specific herds or production classes within a herd. Linking feed_ration to herd enables herd-level nutritional management, cost-per-head analysis by herd, and supports
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: mrl_threshold_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.mrl_threshold. Business justification: Medicated feed rations (antibiotic_flag=true) are subject to FDA VFD requirements and MRL thresholds for drug residues in food animals. Linking feed_ration to product.mrl_threshold enables automated w
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: pen_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the pen or animal group to which this ration is assigned (formulation) or to which feed was delivered (delivery event). Links ration records to specific animal housing units for FCR tracking and feed cost allocation per animal group.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; APHIS Animal Identification

attributes.name: primary_feed_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed animal nutritionist or feed specialist responsible for formulating or approving this ration. Supports accountability, NRC compliance documentation, and audit trail for regulatory inspections.
attributes.references: APHIS; NRC Nutrient Requirements; USDA

attributes.name: antibiotic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ration contains any antibiotic or medicated feed additive subject to VFD (Veterinary Feed Directive) or withdrawal period requirements. True = medicated; False = non-medicated. Critical for FSIS antibiotic residue compliance and withdrawal period tracking.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558; FSIS; APHIS

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the ration formulation in the approval lifecycle: draft (in preparation), pending_review (submitted to nutritionist), approved (cleared for use), rejected (not approved), superseded (replaced by newer version). Applicable to formulation records.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; ISO 22000; GFSI

attributes.name: bunk_score
attributes.description: Standardized numeric score (typically 0–4) assessing the feed bunk condition at the time of delivery: 0=empty/slick, 1=light cover, 2=normal, 3=heavy cover, 4=full refusal. Applicable to delivery records. Guides feeding rate adjustments and animal health monitoring.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; NRC Nutrient Requirements; BMP

attributes.name: calcium_pct
attributes.description: Calculated calcium (Ca) content of the ration as a percentage of dry matter. Critical macro-mineral for bone development, milk production, and metabolic health. NRC compliance metric for all species.
attributes.references: NRC Nutrient Requirements; AOAC International

attributes.name: cost_per_head_per_day
attributes.business_glossary_term: Feed Cost per Head per Day (USD)
attributes.description: Calculated feed cost in USD per animal per day based on ingredient prices and inclusion rates in the formulation. Applicable to formulation records. Key input for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) allocation, OPEX tracking, and ROI analysis per production class.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this feed ration record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and FSMA traceability requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA; ISO 22000; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: crude_protein_pct
attributes.description: Calculated crude protein content of the ration as a percentage of dry matter. Key NRC nutritional compliance metric for protein adequacy across species and production classes. Applicable to formulation records.
attributes.references: NRC Nutrient Requirements; AOAC International; USDA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost_per_head_per_day field (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international agriculture enterprises.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method used to deliver feed to the animal group: TMR (Total Mixed Ration) mixer wagon, bunk feeder, automated feeding system, hand feed, or conveyor. Applicable to delivery records. Impacts feed uniformity and labor cost allocation.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; NRC Nutrient Requirements

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which feed was physically delivered to the pen or bunk. Principal business event timestamp for delivery records. Supports feeding schedule compliance, FCR (Feed Conversion Ratio) tracking, and daily intake analysis.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; FSMA Preventive Controls

attributes.name: dry_matter_pct
attributes.description: Dry matter content of the ration expressed as a percentage of as-fed weight. Used to convert as-fed quantities to DM basis for NRC nutrient requirement compliance and ration balancing.
attributes.references: NRC Nutrient Requirements; AOAC International Feed Analysis Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this ration formulation becomes active and approved for use in feed delivery operations. Supports ration plan management and ensures animals receive the correct approved formulation.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; NRC Nutrient Requirements

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this ration formulation is no longer valid for use. Triggers review or replacement of the formulation. Applicable to formulation records.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: formulation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ration formulation was created or last revised by the nutritionist. Applicable to formulation records. Used for version control and audit trail of recipe changes.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; ISO 22000

attributes.name: gmo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ration formulation contains any GMO (Genetically Modified Organism) ingredients. True = contains GMO ingredients; False = non-GMO. Supports USDA National Organic Program (NOP) compliance, COOL labeling, and customer transparency requirements.
attributes.references: USDA NOP; COOL; GLOBALG.A.P.; Non-GMO Project

attributes.name: mixing_instructions
attributes.description: Operational instructions for preparing the TMR or batch mix, including ingredient loading sequence, mixer run time, and any special handling notes. Applicable to formulation records. Supports SOP compliance and feed uniformity.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; GMP; SOP

attributes.name: neg_mcal_per_cwt
attributes.description: Net Energy for Gain (NEg) value of the ration expressed in megacalories per hundredweight (CWT) of dry matter. Used for NRC-compliant growth performance prediction and ration optimization in beef cattle finishing programs.
attributes.references: NRC Nutrient Requirements of Beef Cattle; USDA

attributes.name: nem_mcal_per_cwt
attributes.description: Net Energy for Maintenance (NEm) value of the ration expressed in megacalories per hundredweight (CWT) of dry matter. Used for NRC-compliant energy adequacy assessment in beef and dairy cattle rations.
attributes.references: NRC Nutrient Requirements of Beef Cattle; USDA

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional nutritionist comments, special handling instructions, or operational observations related to the ration formulation or delivery event. Supports audit trail and knowledge transfer.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; ISO 22000

attributes.name: nrc_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ration formulation meets all NRC (National Research Council) nutrient requirement thresholds for the target species and production class. True = compliant; False = one or more NRC thresholds not met. Applicable to formulation records.
attributes.references: NRC Nutrient Requirements; USDA

attributes.name: phosphorus_pct
attributes.description: Calculated phosphorus (P) content of the ration as a percentage of dry matter. Key macro-mineral for energy metabolism and bone structure. NRC compliance metric; also tracked for environmental nutrient management under EPA guidelines.
attributes.references: NRC Nutrient Requirements; EPA Nutrient Management; AOAC International

attributes.name: production_class
attributes.description: Specific production class or physiological stage of the target animal group (e.g., 'Finishing Steers', 'Lactating Dairy Cows', 'Nursery Pigs', 'Broiler Grower'). Used for NRC-compliant nutrient requirement matching and ration cost allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NRC Nutrient Requirements; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: quantity_delivered_dm_lbs
attributes.description: Total weight of feed delivered expressed on a dry matter (DM) basis in pounds. Calculated from as-fed quantity and dry matter percentage. Used for NRC-compliant nutrient intake calculations and ration balancing.
attributes.references: NRC Nutrient Requirements; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: quantity_delivered_lbs
attributes.description: Total weight of feed delivered to the pen on an as-fed basis, measured in pounds (lbs). Applicable to delivery records. Used for feed cost allocation per animal, FCR tracking, and daily intake monitoring.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; NRC Nutrient Requirements

attributes.name: ration_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to the feed ration formulation (e.g., 'Grower Phase 2 TMR', 'Lactating Cow High-Energy'). Used for identification in feed management systems and nutritionist communications.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; NRC Nutrient Requirements

attributes.name: ration_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the ration formulation or delivery event, used for cross-system reference and traceability (e.g., RAT-2024-00123). Sourced from Granular Farm Management or SAP PP.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA PP Module

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Discriminator field separating the two concerns captured in this product: 'formulation' for master ration recipes and 'delivery' for transactional feed delivery events. Drives downstream processing logic and reporting segmentation.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; NRC Nutrient Requirements of Beef Cattle

attributes.name: refusal_amount_lbs
attributes.description: Weight of feed remaining uneaten in the bunk at the time of the next feeding, measured in pounds. Applicable to delivery records. Used to calculate actual intake, adjust ration quantities, and monitor animal health and appetite.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; NRC Nutrient Requirements

attributes.name: target_daily_intake_lbs
attributes.description: Planned daily feed intake per head per day on an as-fed basis, in pounds. Applicable to formulation records. Derived from NRC nutrient requirements for the target species and production class. Drives delivery quantity planning.
attributes.references: NRC Nutrient Requirements; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: target_species
attributes.description: Animal species for which this ration is formulated or delivered (e.g., cattle, swine, poultry). Drives NRC nutritional compliance checks and species-specific regulatory requirements under APHIS and FSIS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cattle|swine|poultry|sheep|goat|equine|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: APHIS; NRC Nutrient Requirements; USDA FSIS

attributes.name: tdn_pct
attributes.description: Total Digestible Nutrients (TDN) content of the ration as a percentage of dry matter. Primary energy metric for ruminant rations used in NRC compliance and ration balancing. Applicable to formulation records.
attributes.references: NRC Nutrient Requirements; AOAC International

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this feed ration record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data quality monitoring in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: FSMA; ISO 22000; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the ration formulation, incremented each time the recipe is revised. Enables tracking of formulation changes over time and ensures delivery events reference the correct recipe version.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: withdrawal_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days animals must not receive this medicated ration prior to slaughter to ensure antibiotic residue levels are within FDA/FSIS MRL (Maximum Residue Limit) tolerances. Applicable when antibiotic_flag is True. Critical for FSIS compliance and food safety.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 558; FSIS; MRL; APHIS

products.name: feed_delivery
products.description: Transactional record of each feed delivery event to a pen or group. Captures delivery date and time, pen/group ID, ration ID, quantity delivered (lbs/kg as-fed and dry matter), delivery method (TMR mixer, bunk feeder, automated system), operator, refusal amount recorded, and feed bunk score. Enables feed cost allocation per animal, FCR tracking, and nutritional compliance verification against prescribed rations.
products.reference: TMR Feed Management / Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: feed_delivery_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each feed delivery event. Primary key for the feed_delivery data product in the livestock domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the TMR mixer wagon or automated feeding equipment used for this delivery. Supports equipment utilization tracking, maintenance scheduling, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) analysis, and feed delivery cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; John Deere Operations Center; equipment.asset

attributes.name: commodity_lot_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the feed inventory lot (LOT) consumed in this delivery. Enables batch-level traceability, feed cost allocation, and withdrawal period tracking for medicated feeds per APHIS and FDA requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; FDA Veterinary Feed Directive; APHIS; inventory.commodity_lot

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Feed is the largest cost in livestock operations (60-70% of total cost). Cost center assignment on feed_delivery enables feed cost per head per day reporting, ration cost variance analysis, and cost c

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.crew. Business justification: Feed delivery in large feedlots is performed by feed crews operating mixer wagons. Crew-level tracking enables labor cost allocation per delivery, piece-rate payroll for feed drivers, and H2A complian
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the farm operator or employee who performed or supervised the feed delivery. Supports workforce accountability, SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) compliance, and FSMA traceability requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; SAP SuccessFactors; OSHA

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the farm facility or barn where the feed delivery took place. Supports multi-site operations, feed cost allocation by facility, and regulatory site-level reporting.
attributes.references: APHIS; FSMA; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: feed_ration_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the prescribed feed ration formulation delivered. Used to verify nutritional compliance against the prescribed ration, support GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) audits, and enable deviation analysis.

attributes.name: delivery_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the feed delivery event, used for cross-referencing with feed management systems, SAP production orders, and operator logs. Follows the format FD-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: delivery_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential order number of this delivery within the daily feeding schedule (e.g., 1st feeding, 2nd feeding). Supports multi-feeding-per-day operations, feeding frequency analysis, and nutritional timing compliance.
attributes.references: GMP; Granular Farm Management; APHIS

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the feed delivery event, tracking progression from scheduled through completion or cancellation. Supports operational monitoring and FCR (Feed Conversion Ratio) completeness checks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world date and time when the feed delivery event occurred at the pen or group location. Used for feed scheduling compliance, nutritional timing analysis, and FCR (Feed Conversion Ratio) tracking.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; APHIS Animal Identification; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: delivery_variance_kg
attributes.description: Difference between the prescribed quantity and the actual quantity delivered on an as-fed basis, in kilograms (actual minus prescribed). Positive values indicate over-delivery; negative values indicate under-delivery. Used for nutritional compliance verification and ration adherence KPI (Key Performance Indicator) reporting.
attributes.references: GMP; GLOBALG.A.P.; Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: dry_matter_pct
attributes.description: Dry matter percentage of the delivered ration at the time of delivery, expressed as a percentage. Used to convert as-fed quantities to dry matter basis and to verify ration moisture content against the prescribed formulation.
attributes.references: GMP; GLOBALG.A.P.; Granular Farm Management; APHIS

attributes.name: feed_cost_per_kg
attributes.description: Unit cost of the delivered feed ration per kilogram on an as-fed basis, sourced from the feed inventory lot or procurement record. Used for feed cost allocation per animal group, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation, and financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA CO module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO/FI Module; Granular Farm Management; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: feed_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the feed source for this delivery. Indicates whether the ration was mixed on-farm (TMR), purchased as a complete feed, custom-mixed by a feed mill, or derived from co-products. Supports feed cost analysis, supply chain traceability, and GLOBALG.A.P. compliance.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P.; GMP; FSMA Traceability Rule; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the feed ration delivered contains GMO (Genetically Modified Organism) ingredients, is certified non-GMO, or has unknown GMO status. Required for USDA National Organic Program (NOP) compliance, GLOBALG.A.P. certification, and customer supply chain transparency reporting.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); GLOBALG.A.P.; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling); FDA

attributes.name: is_medicated_feed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivered ration contains a medicated additive subject to FDA Veterinary Feed Directive (VFD) or APHIS withdrawal period requirements. When True, triggers mandatory withdrawal period tracking and regulatory documentation requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Veterinary Feed Directive (VFD); APHIS; FSIS; FSMA

attributes.name: mixing_duration_min
attributes.description: Duration in minutes that the TMR (Total Mixed Ration) mixer was operated to prepare the ration batch prior to delivery. Mixing time affects ration uniformity and particle size distribution; tracked for GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) compliance and equipment OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) analysis.
attributes.references: GMP; GLOBALG.A.P.; Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivered feed ration is certified organic under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). When True, the feed must originate from certified organic sources and the delivery must be documented for NOP audit compliance.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

attributes.name: prescribed_quantity_asfed_kg
attributes.description: The ration-prescribed target quantity of feed to be delivered on an as-fed basis, in kilograms. Compared against actual quantity delivered to calculate delivery variance and assess nutritional compliance against the prescribed ration.
attributes.references: GMP; GLOBALG.A.P.; Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: quantity_delivered_asfed_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of feed delivered to the pen or group on an as-fed basis, measured in kilograms. As-fed weight includes moisture content and is the primary operational quantity recorded at delivery. Used for feed cost allocation and FCR (Feed Conversion Ratio) calculations.
attributes.references: APHIS; FSIS; GMP; Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: quantity_delivered_dm_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of feed delivered expressed on a dry matter (DM) basis, measured in kilograms. Dry matter quantity normalizes for moisture variation across ration ingredients and is the standard basis for nutritional compliance verification and FCR (Feed Conversion Ratio) analysis.
attributes.references: APHIS; FSIS; GMP; GLOBALG.A.P.; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: ration_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the feed ration delivered (e.g., 'Grower Phase 2 TMR', 'Lactating Cow Ration'). Provides operational context for operators and supports reporting without requiring a ration master lookup.
attributes.references: GMP; Granular Farm Management; APHIS

attributes.name: refusal_quantity_kg

Refusal data is critical for adjusting ration delivery amounts, monitoring animal health, and calculating net intake for FCR (Feed Conversion Ratio) analysis.
attributes.references: GMP; GLOBALG.A.P.; Granular Farm Management; APHIS

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The planned date and time for the feed delivery as defined in the feeding schedule. Compared against actual delivery_timestamp to calculate delivery timing variance and assess adherence to the nutritional management plan.
attributes.references: GMP; Granular Farm Management; APHIS Animal Welfare

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; Granular Farm Management; Climate FieldView; FSMA Record-Keeping

attributes.name: total_feed_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of feed delivered in this event, calculated as quantity_delivered_asfed_kg multiplied by feed_cost_per_kg. Used for feed cost allocation per pen/group, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) reporting, and EBITDA analysis. Stored as a transactional fact to preserve the cost at time of delivery.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO/FI Module; Granular Farm Management; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the feed delivery record was last modified. Supports audit trail, data quality monitoring, and change detection in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements

attributes.name: origin_state_code

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total live weight in kilograms of all animals in this movement at time of loading. Used for transport billing, sale contracts, and FSIS ante-mortem documentation.

attributes.name: transport_distance_km
attributes.description: Total distance in kilometers traveled during this movement. Used for animal welfare compliance (EU transport regulations, USDA 28-Hour Law), transport cost allocation, and carbon footprint reporting.

attributes.description: The number of days milk must be withheld from sale following drug administration in dairy animals. Separate from meat withdrawal period as milk and meat withdrawal periods often differ for the same drug.
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Part 514; FSIS Residue Avoidance; Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards

attributes.name: number_of_animals
attributes.description: The total count of animals covered under this prescription or VFD. Required on VFD documents per FDA regulation and used for dosage calculation and antibiotic use density metrics.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(7); FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship

attributes.name: prescription_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the prescription or VFD at issuance. Used for regulatory filing, pharmacy dispensing, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6; FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship Documentation

attributes.name: prescription_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the veterinary prescription. Active indicates the prescription is valid and may be dispensed; expired indicates the expiration date has passed; cancelled indicates the prescribing veterinarian voided the order; filled indicates the full authorized quantity has been dispensed.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558; FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship

attributes.name: prescription_type
attributes.description: Classification of the prescription by regulatory category. VFD (Veterinary Feed Directive) applies to medicated feed products; prescription_drug covers legend drugs requiring a valid VCPR; OTC_extra_label covers over-the-counter drugs used in an extra-label manner; compounded covers compounded preparations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VFD|prescription_drug|OTC_extra_label|compounded — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Parts 514, 558; AMDUCA Extra-Label Drug Use

attributes.name: production_class
attributes.description: The production class or use category of the animals covered by the prescription (e.g., beef cattle, dairy cattle, broiler, layer). Determines applicable withdrawal periods and regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: beef_cattle|dairy_cattle|swine_market|swine_breeding|broiler|layer|turkey|sheep|goat|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Part 514; FSIS Residue Avoidance; USDA NASS

attributes.name: quantity_authorized
attributes.description: The total quantity of drug or medicated feed product authorized under this prescription (e.g., total grams, total pounds of medicated feed, total vials). Controls dispensing limits and prevents over-use.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(8); FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship

attributes.name: quantity_dispensed
attributes.description: The cumulative quantity of drug or medicated feed product actually dispensed against this prescription to date. Used to track partial fills and ensure authorized quantity is not exceeded.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558; FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the authorized quantity (e.g., lbs of medicated feed, mL of injectable solution, number of vials). Required for dispensing accuracy and inventory reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lbs|kg|g|tons|mL|vials|tablets|oz — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(8); USP Veterinary Drug Standards

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The method by which the drug is to be administered to the animal (e.g., oral via medicated feed, intramuscular injection, subcutaneous injection). Required for proper drug use and withdrawal period determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oral|injectable_IM|injectable_IV|injectable_SQ|topical|intramammary|intrauterine — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Part 514; AMDUCA Extra-Label Drug Use

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for any additional veterinarian instructions, warnings, or conditions associated with the prescription (e.g., do not use in animals producing milk for human consumption, refrigerate after opening). Captures label-specific or VCPR-specific guidance.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(10); AVMA Prescribing Guidelines

attributes.name: treatment_duration_days
attributes.description: The number of days the prescribed drug treatment is to be administered. Used to calculate total drug quantity needed, withdrawal period start date, and antibiotic use days for stewardship reporting.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(6); FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this veterinary prescription record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(c) Record Retention; FSMA Recordkeeping Requirements; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: vcpr_reference
attributes.description: The reference number or identifier for the established Veterinarian-Client-Patient Relationship (VCPR) under which this prescription was issued. A valid VCPR is a legal prerequisite for issuing any veterinary prescription or VFD under FDA regulations.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(2); AVMA VCPR Policy; State Veterinary Practice Acts

attributes.name: vfd_distributor_name
attributes.description: The name of the licensed feed manufacturer or distributor authorized to produce and supply the medicated feed under this VFD. Required on VFD documents per FDA regulation for medicated feed traceability.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(4); FDA Medicated Feed Regulations

attributes.name: withdrawal_end_date
attributes.description: The calculated calendar date on which the withdrawal period ends and the animal or animal products are cleared for harvest or sale. Derived from last treatment date plus withdrawal_period_days; stored for operational scheduling and FSIS compliance verification.
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Part 514; FSIS Residue Avoidance; USDA FSIS Directive 10,800.1

attributes.name: withdrawal_period_days
attributes.description: The mandatory Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) — the number of days that must elapse after the last drug administration before the animal or animal products (meat, milk, eggs) may enter the food supply. Critical for FSIS food safety compliance and MRL (Maximum Residue Limit) adherence.
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Part 514; FSIS Residue Avoidance; USDA FSIS Directive 10,800.1; Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards

products.name: animal_transaction
products.description: Transactional record of all livestock transfer events — both purchases (inbound) and sales (outbound) — between the operation and external parties. Captures transaction date, transaction direction (purchase/sale), counterparty premises ID (vendor for purchases, buyer for sales), species, breed, head count, weight (purchase weight or sale weight), price per head or per CWT, total transaction value, transaction channel (direct, auction, video auction, formula), origin state/country, health certificate number, brand inspection certificate, import permit (if applicable for purchases), quarantine period required (for purchases), receiving pen assignment (for purchases), transport carrier, BOL reference, grade and yield basis (for sales), and COOL chain-of-custody documentation. Purchase-specific attributes (quarantine period, receiving pen, import permit) are populated only for purchase transactions. Sale-specific attributes (grade/yield basis, sale channel) are populated only for sale transactions. Serves as the consolidated SSOT for all livestock commercial transfers. Supports livestock cost basis accounting, revenue recognition, enterprise profitability analysis, COOL compliance, and APHIS traceability. Distinguished from procurement/sales domain records by being animal-specific with livestock traceability attributes (health certificates, brand inspections, premises IDs) that generic commercial transaction records do not carry.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special conditions, or remarks associated with the livestock transaction. May include auction lot descriptions, special handling instructions, or negotiated contract terms not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: origin_country
