attributes.description: Calendar date on which the soil sample was physically collected from the field. Critical for seasonal trend analysis and determining the agronomic context (pre-plant, post-harvest, etc.).
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Protocols; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Health Standards

attributes.name: sample_depth_in
attributes.description: Depth in inches at which the soil sample was collected from the surface. Standard agronomic sampling depths are 0-6 inches (topsoil) or 6-12 inches (subsoil). Critical for interpreting nutrient availability relative to root zone.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Depth Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Management; Trimble Ag Software

attributes.name: sample_method
attributes.description: Method used to collect the soil sample. Grid sampling uses a systematic spatial grid; zone sampling collects within defined management zones; composite combines multiple cores; benchmark uses fixed reference points for longitudinal tracking.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Protocols; Trimble Ag Software VRA Sampling; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable sample identifier assigned at time of collection, used for lab submission tracking and field cross-referencing. Typically formatted as a lab accession or farm-assigned code (e.g., FARM-2024-F01-Z3).
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Management Standards

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the soil sample record, tracking progression from field collection through laboratory analysis to agronomic approval for use in fertilizer prescriptions.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Workflow; ISO 14001 Environmental Records Management

attributes.name: sampling_technician
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the agronomist, certified crop advisor (CCA), or field technician who physically collected the soil sample. Used for chain-of-custody documentation and quality assurance traceability.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Chain of Custody Requirements; USDA NRCS Soil Sampling SOPs; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: soil_texture_class
attributes.description: USDA soil texture classification based on the relative proportions of sand, silt, and clay particles. Texture class influences water-holding capacity, drainage, tillage requirements, and nutrient management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sand|loamy_sand|sandy_loam|loam|silt_loam|silt|sandy_clay_loam|clay_loam|silty_clay_loam|sandy_clay|silty_clay|clay — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Texture Classification System; USDA Soil Survey Manual

attributes.name: sulfur_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available sulfur (S) concentration in parts per million (ppm). Sulfur is a secondary macronutrient critical for protein synthesis and enzyme function. Deficiencies are increasingly common in high-yield cropping systems and drive sulfur fertilizer recommendations.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Nutrient Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this soil sample record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Standards; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: zinc_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available zinc (Zn) micronutrient concentration in parts per million (ppm), measured by Mehlich-3 or DTPA extraction. Zinc deficiency is common in high-pH soils and drives micronutrient fertilizer recommendations for corn and other sensitive crops.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Micronutrient Management; Mehlich-3 / DTPA Extraction Methods; GLOBALG.A.P.

products.name: management_zone
products.description: Spatially defined sub-field management zone used for variable rate application (VRA) prescriptions, precision nutrient management, and yield zone analysis. Captures zone name, zone code, zone type (soil type, EC zone, yield zone, topographic zone), delineation method (EC scanning, yield history, satellite NDVI, manual), zone area (acres), GIS polygon geometry, NDVI index value, EC shallow/deep readings, zone classification (high/medium/low productivity), and active flag. Integrates with Trimble Ag and John Deere Operations Center for VRA prescription generation.
products.reference: Trimble Ag VRA / FMIS Management Zone

attributes.name: management_zone_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the management zone record in the Databricks Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ISO 11179 - Metadata Registry

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent agricultural field within which this management zone is spatially defined. Links to the land domain field entity.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Control Point CB 1.1 - Field Identification

attributes.name: growing_season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the growing season for which this management zone configuration is active. Management zone boundaries and soil attribute values may be updated between growing seasons as new soil sampling and yield data become available.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management - Season Planning; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 1.1

attributes.name: seed_variety_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.seed_variety. Business justification: Variable-rate seeding (VRS) prescriptions assign specific seed varieties per management zone. management_zone already has vra_eligible flag. Precision agriculture operations require zone-level variety
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: soil_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.soil_profile. Business justification: A management zone is delineated based on soil characteristics (EC, pH, OM, CEC, texture) that are authoritatively captured in the soil_profile entity. Linking management_zone to soil_profile formalize
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: agronomist_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for agronomist or crop consultant observations about the management zone, including special management considerations, historical problem areas, or recommendations for upcoming season. Captured in Granular Farm Management or Trimble Ag Software during field scouting.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management - Field Notes; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 1.3 - Record Keeping

attributes.name: area_acres
attributes.description: Calculated spatial area of the management zone expressed in acres, derived from the GIS polygon geometry. Used for VRA prescription rate calculations, input cost allocation, and yield-per-acre (YPM) reporting. Precision to four decimal places supports sub-acre zone granularity.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Spatial Analysis; USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) Field Acreage Standards

attributes.name: area_hectares
attributes.description: Calculated spatial area of the management zone expressed in hectares for international reporting and metric-system compliance. Supports GLOBALG.A.P. and ISO 14001 environmental reporting requirements.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. CB 1.1; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: cec_meq_100g
attributes.description: Mean cation exchange capacity (CEC) of the management zone soil expressed in milliequivalents per 100 grams (meq/100g). Measures the soil's ability to hold and supply positively charged nutrient ions (Ca, Mg, K, Na). Higher CEC indicates greater nutrient-holding capacity. Used for fertilizer rate calibration and soil amendment planning.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey; ISO 11260 Soil Quality - CEC Determination; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 4.2

attributes.name: centroid_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the management zone polygon centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for GPS (Global Positioning System) navigation, weather station proximity matching, and spatial analytics in Esri ArcGIS.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS - Coordinate Reference Systems; WGS84 Standard; John Deere Operations Center GPS

attributes.name: centroid_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the management zone polygon centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for GPS navigation, weather data correlation, and spatial analytics in Esri ArcGIS.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS - Coordinate Reference Systems; WGS84 Standard; John Deere Operations Center GPS

attributes.name: conservation_practice_code
attributes.description: USDA NRCS conservation practice standard code applied to this management zone (e.g., 590 - Nutrient Management, 329 - Residue and Tillage Management, 340 - Cover Crop, 412 - Grassed Waterway). Supports USDA EQIP (Environmental Quality Incentives Program) compliance reporting and ISO 14001 environmental management documentation.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; USDA EQIP Program Requirements; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this management zone record was first created in the lakehouse Silver Layer, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Standards; SOX Section 404 - Data Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity

attributes.name: delineation_method
attributes.description: Method used to spatially delineate the management zone boundary. EC (Electrical Conductivity) scanning uses Veris or EM38 sensors; yield history uses multi-year combine yield monitor data from Climate FieldView or John Deere Operations Center; satellite NDVI uses remote sensing imagery; manual uses operator-drawn boundaries in Esri ArcGIS or Trimble Ag; soil sampling uses interpolated soil test point data; topographic analysis uses digital elevation model (DEM) data.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - Prescription Management; Climate FieldView Analytics; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: delineation_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the management zone boundary was originally delineated or most recently revised. Used to assess zone data currency and schedule periodic re-delineation based on updated EC scanning, yield history, or satellite imagery data.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - Zone Version Management; USDA NRCS BMP Guidelines

attributes.name: drainage_class
attributes.description: USDA NRCS soil drainage class for the management zone, indicating the natural rate of water removal from the soil profile. Affects crop selection, planting date decisions, and tile drainage infrastructure planning. Poorly drained zones may qualify for wetland conservation programs.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey - Drainage Class Definitions; USDA Farm Service Agency Conservation Programs

attributes.name: ec_deep_ds_m
attributes.description: Apparent soil electrical conductivity (EC) reading at deep depth (typically 0-90 cm) expressed in deciSiemens per meter (dS/m). Measured via Veris 3100 or EM38 sensor. Reflects subsoil characteristics including clay pan depth and water-holding capacity. Complements shallow EC for comprehensive zone delineation.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - EC Zone Delineation; USDA NRCS Soil EC Standards; Veris Technologies Measurement Protocol

attributes.name: ec_scan_date
attributes.description: Date on which the soil electrical conductivity (EC) scanning survey was conducted for this management zone. Used to assess data currency and schedule re-scanning intervals (typically every 3-5 years per BMP guidelines).
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - EC Scanning Protocol; USDA NRCS BMP Guidelines

attributes.name: ec_shallow_ds_m
attributes.description: Apparent soil electrical conductivity (EC) reading at shallow depth (typically 0-30 cm) expressed in deciSiemens per meter (dS/m). Measured via Veris 3100 or EM38 sensor during EC scanning. Correlates with soil texture, clay content, and salinity. Used as primary input for EC-based zone delineation and VRA (Variable Rate Application) prescription generation.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - EC Zone Delineation; USDA NRCS Soil EC Standards; Veris Technologies Measurement Protocol

attributes.name: external_zone_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this management zone in the originating source system (e.g., Trimble Ag zone GUID, John Deere Operations Center zone ID, Esri ArcGIS feature OID). Enables bidirectional synchronization and traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer and operational precision agriculture platforms.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - Zone API; John Deere Operations Center - Field Boundary API; Esri ArcGIS REST API

attributes.name: gis_polygon_wkt
attributes.description: Spatial boundary of the management zone stored as Well-Known Text (WKT) polygon geometry in WGS84 coordinate reference system (EPSG:4326). Sourced from Esri ArcGIS or John Deere Operations Center RTK-accurate field mapping. Enables spatial joins with soil sampling points, yield data, and satellite imagery layers.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS - Feature Class Standards; OGC Simple Features Standard; ISO 19125

attributes.name: last_soil_sample_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent composite soil sampling event conducted within this management zone. Used to assess soil data currency and trigger re-sampling workflows. GLOBALG.A.P. and USDA NRCS BMP guidelines recommend soil sampling every 2-4 years.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 4.2; ISO 10381 Soil Sampling Standards

attributes.name: ndvi_image_date
attributes.description: Date on which the satellite or aerial imagery used to calculate the current NDVI value was captured. Critical for assessing data currency and seasonal relevance of the vegetation index reading.
attributes.references: Climate FieldView - Imagery Metadata; Sentinel-2 / Landsat Data Standards

attributes.name: ndvi_value
attributes.description: Most recent NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) value for the management zone, ranging from -1.0 to 1.0. Derived from satellite or aerial multispectral imagery. Values above 0.5 indicate dense, healthy vegetation; values below 0.2 indicate sparse or stressed vegetation. Used for in-season crop monitoring and zone reclassification.
attributes.references: Climate FieldView - NDVI Analytics; NASA Landsat / Sentinel-2 Remote Sensing Standards; USDA NASS Crop Monitoring

attributes.name: nitrogen_lbs_acre
attributes.description: Mean available nitrogen (N) level in the management zone soil expressed in pounds per acre (lbs/acre), derived from composite soil sampling. Component of NPK (Nitrogen Phosphorus Potassium) nutrient profile. Used to calculate nitrogen fertilizer application rates in VRA prescriptions and comply with nutrient management plan requirements.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; EPA Nutrient Management Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 4.2

attributes.name: organic_matter_pct
attributes.description: Mean soil organic matter (OM) content expressed as a percentage of dry soil weight for the management zone. Measured via loss-on-ignition or Walkley-Black method from composite soil samples. Higher OM improves water retention, nutrient cycling, and soil structure. Key indicator for carbon sequestration reporting under ISCC and sustainability programs.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Health Framework; ISO 14235 Soil Quality - Organic Carbon; ISCC Carbon Certification

attributes.name: phosphorus_lbs_acre
attributes.description: Mean available phosphorus (P) level in the management zone soil expressed in pounds per acre (lbs/acre), derived from composite soil sampling. Component of NPK nutrient profile. Used to calculate phosphorus fertilizer application rates in VRA prescriptions and support EPA water quality compliance for phosphorus runoff management.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; EPA Clean Water Act - Nutrient Runoff; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 4.2

attributes.name: potassium_lbs_acre
attributes.description: Mean available potassium (K) level in the management zone soil expressed in pounds per acre (lbs/acre), derived from composite soil sampling. Component of NPK nutrient profile. Used to calculate potassium fertilizer application rates in VRA prescriptions.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 4.2

attributes.name: productivity_class
attributes.description: Agronomic productivity classification of the management zone based on historical yield performance and soil capability. High productivity zones receive premium input rates; low productivity zones may receive reduced inputs or conservation treatment under BMP (Best Management Practices) guidelines.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Land Capability Classification; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 1.1; BMP Guidelines

attributes.name: slope_pct
attributes.description: Mean slope gradient of the management zone expressed as a percentage (rise over run × 100), derived from digital elevation model (DEM) analysis in Esri ArcGIS. Used for erosion risk assessment, drainage planning, and equipment operation safety. Slopes above 8% may require conservation practices under USDA NRCS BMP guidelines.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Land Capability Classification; Esri ArcGIS Terrain Analysis; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: soil_ph_mean
attributes.description: Mean soil pH (Potential of Hydrogen) value for the management zone, representing average soil acidity or alkalinity on a 0-14 scale. Calculated from composite soil samples within the zone. Critical for nutrient availability assessment and lime application rate determination in VRA prescriptions. Optimal range for most crops is 6.0-7.0.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Health Assessment; ISO 10390 Soil Quality - pH Determination; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 4.2

attributes.name: soil_texture_class
attributes.description: USDA soil texture classification for the dominant soil type within the management zone, based on relative proportions of sand, silt, and clay particles. Determines water infiltration rate, water-holding capacity, and tillage characteristics. Used for irrigation scheduling and equipment operation planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sand|loamy_sand|sandy_loam|loam|silt_loam|silt|sandy_clay_loam|clay_loam|silty_clay_loam|sandy_clay|silty_clay|clay — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Texture Triangle Classification; ISO 11277 Soil Particle Size Analysis

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this management zone record was originated or last updated. Supports data lineage tracking and conflict resolution when zone data is synchronized across multiple precision agriculture platforms.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards; ISO 8000 Data Quality

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this management zone record was most recently modified in the lakehouse Silver Layer, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used to detect stale zone configurations and trigger re-synchronization with source precision agriculture systems.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Standards; SOX Section 404 - Data Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity

attributes.name: vra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this management zone is eligible for variable rate application (VRA) prescription generation in Trimble Ag Software or John Deere Operations Center. Zones must meet minimum area thresholds and have current soil data to qualify for VRA. True = eligible for VRA prescriptions; False = not eligible.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - VRA Prescription Rules; John Deere Operations Center - Prescription Management

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the management zone within the farm management information system (FMIS). Used as the business key in Trimble Ag Software and John Deere Operations Center for variable rate application (VRA) prescription generation.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - Zone Management; John Deere Operations Center Field Mapping

attributes.name: zone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name assigned to the management zone (e.g., 'North Field High Productivity Zone', 'EC Zone 3 - Sandy Loam'). Used in FMIS reporting and VRA prescription labeling.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - Zone Management; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 1.1

attributes.name: zone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the management zone. Active zones are used in current-season VRA prescriptions; inactive zones are temporarily suspended; archived zones are retained for historical analysis; draft zones are pending agronomist review and approval.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management - Zone Lifecycle; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 1.1

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the zone based on the primary agronomic criterion used to define it. Soil type zones are delineated by soil series; EC (Electrical Conductivity) zones by apparent soil EC readings; yield zones by multi-year yield history; topographic zones by elevation and slope; NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) zones by satellite-derived vegetation index; management zones by operator-defined boundaries.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - Zone Types; USDA NRCS Soil Survey; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: zone_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the management zone boundary definition, incremented each time the zone polygon or classification attributes are revised. Supports audit trail and historical comparison of zone configurations across growing seasons.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management - Data Versioning; ISO 14001 Environmental Records Management

products.name: field_boundary
products.description: Versioned GIS boundary geometry record for each field, supporting boundary change history as fields are split, merged, or re-surveyed. Stores boundary version number, effective start date, effective end date, geometry type (polygon/multipolygon), coordinate reference system (CRS/EPSG code), boundary source (RTK GPS survey, drone imagery, ArcGIS digitized), total calculated area (acres), perimeter (feet/meters), boundary accuracy class (RTK/sub-meter/meter), ArcGIS feature class reference, and John Deere Operations Center field ID. Enables temporal boundary tracking for FSA compliance and crop insurance.
products.reference: Esri ArcGIS Feature Layer / John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: field_boundary_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each versioned field boundary record in the land domain. Primary key for the field_boundary data product. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Feature Class Standard; ISO 19125 (Simple Features for SQL)

attributes.name: farm_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the farm or operation that owns or manages this field boundary. Supports multi-farm enterprise hierarchies in Granular Farm Management and SAP S/4HANA land management.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) Farm Records

attributes.name: primary_field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent agricultural field entity that this boundary version describes. Multiple boundary versions may exist for the same field over time as boundaries are split, merged, or re-surveyed.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; John Deere Operations Center Field Management

attributes.name: surveying_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Field boundary surveys are procured services — GIS/survey vendors are contracted to establish legal boundaries for FSA compliance, title insurance, and precision ag setup. The existing surveyed_by pla
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tertiary_trimble_field_id
attributes.description: Field identifier assigned by Trimble Ag Software for variable rate prescription (VRA) and crop scouting integration. Enables linkage of boundary geometry with Trimble-generated field plans and prescription maps.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software Field Management; VRA (Variable Rate Application) Standards

attributes.name: accuracy_class
attributes.description: Positional accuracy classification of the boundary geometry. 'RTK' indicates centimeter-level accuracy from Real-Time Kinematic GPS survey; 'sub_meter' indicates accuracy better than 1 meter; 'meter' indicates accuracy within 1-5 meters; 'multi_meter' indicates accuracy greater than 5 meters (e.g., from manual digitization or low-resolution imagery).
attributes.references: RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) GPS Standards; USDA NRCS Geospatial Data Standards; ISO 19157 (Data Quality)

attributes.name: accuracy_meters
attributes.description: Quantitative positional accuracy of the boundary geometry expressed in meters (root mean square error or circular error probable). Complements accuracy_class with a precise numeric value for spatial quality assessment and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 19157 (Geographic Information — Data Quality); USDA NRCS Geospatial Standards

attributes.name: arcgis_feature_class_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the corresponding feature class and object ID within the Esri ArcGIS geodatabase. Enables direct linkage between this data product and the authoritative GIS source layer for spatial queries and map rendering.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Geodatabase Standards; ISO 19110 (Feature Catalogue)

attributes.name: area_acres
attributes.description: Total calculated area of the field boundary in acres, derived from the boundary geometry. Used for FSA compliance reporting, crop insurance acreage certification, input application rate calculations, and yield per acre (YPM) computations. This is the authoritative GIS-calculated area, not a surveyed or estimated value.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Acreage Reporting; Crop Insurance Regulations (RMA); GLOBALG.A.P. Field Registration

attributes.name: area_hectares
attributes.description: Total calculated area of the field boundary in hectares, derived from the boundary geometry. Used for international reporting, metric-system compliance, and integration with global agricultural standards (GLOBALG.A.P., ISO 14001 environmental reporting).
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Field Registration; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: boundary_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this field boundary within the farm management information system (FMIS). Used for cross-system referencing between ArcGIS, John Deere Operations Center, and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: FMIS (Farm Management Information System) Standards; Esri ArcGIS Feature Class Naming

attributes.name: boundary_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to this field boundary, typically matching the field name used operationally (e.g., 'North 40', 'River Bottom Field'). Serves as the primary identity label for business users.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Trimble Ag Software Field Naming Convention

attributes.name: boundary_source
attributes.description: Method or technology used to capture or derive this field boundary. 'RTK_GPS_survey' indicates Real-Time Kinematic (RTK) GPS ground survey; 'drone_imagery' indicates boundary derived from UAV aerial imagery; 'ArcGIS_digitized' indicates manual digitization in Esri ArcGIS; 'satellite_imagery' indicates derivation from satellite imagery; 'manual_entry' indicates operator-entered coordinates.
attributes.references: RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) GPS Standards; Esri ArcGIS; John Deere Operations Center; GLOBALG.A.P. Field Mapping

attributes.name: boundary_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this boundary version. 'active' indicates the current operative boundary; 'superseded' indicates a prior version replaced by a newer one; 'draft' indicates a boundary under review before activation; 'retired' indicates a boundary no longer in use; 'pending_review' indicates awaiting FSA or agronomist validation.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Compliance; GLOBALG.A.P. Field Registration; ISO 19125

attributes.name: boundary_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this boundary record for the parent field. Increments each time the boundary is re-surveyed, split, merged, or corrected. Version 1 is the initial boundary; higher numbers represent subsequent revisions.
attributes.references: ISO 19125 (Simple Features); USDA FSA Field Boundary Versioning Requirements

attributes.name: centroid_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the field boundary centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84 / EPSG:4326). Used for weather station assignment, solar radiation modeling, and quick spatial lookups without full geometry processing.
attributes.references: WGS84 (World Geodetic System 1984); GPS (Global Positioning System) Standards; Esri ArcGIS

attributes.name: centroid_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the field boundary centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84 / EPSG:4326). Used alongside centroid_latitude for weather station assignment, logistics routing, and spatial indexing.
attributes.references: WGS84 (World Geodetic System 1984); GPS (Global Positioning System) Standards; Esri ArcGIS

attributes.name: clu_identifier
attributes.description: USDA Common Land Unit (CLU) unique identifier for this field boundary. The CLU is the smallest unit of land that has a permanent, contiguous boundary and is used as the basis for USDA farm program administration and acreage reporting.
attributes.references: USDA Common Land Unit (CLU) Program; USDA FSA; NRCS Geospatial Data Gateway

attributes.name: conservation_program
attributes.description: Name or code of the USDA conservation program in which this field boundary is enrolled (e.g., 'CRP' for Conservation Reserve Program, 'EQIP' for Environmental Quality Incentives Program, 'WRP' for Wetland Reserve Program). Null if not enrolled in any conservation program.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Conservation Reserve Program (CRP); USDA NRCS EQIP; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the country in which this field boundary is located (e.g., 'USA'). Supports international operations and GLOBALG.A.P. country-of-origin labeling (COOL) compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling); GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: county_fips_code
attributes.description: Five-digit Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) code identifying the US county in which this field boundary is located. Required for USDA FSA county office assignment, crop insurance rating, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: USDA FSA County Records; FIPS 6-4 (Counties and County Equivalents); USDA RMA Crop Insurance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this field boundary record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation anchor for data lineage and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: crs_epsg_code
attributes.description: EPSG (European Petroleum Survey Group) numeric code identifying the coordinate reference system (CRS) in which the boundary geometry coordinates are expressed (e.g., 4326 for WGS84, 32614 for UTM Zone 14N). Critical for accurate spatial calculations and cross-system interoperability.
attributes.references: EPSG Geodetic Parameter Registry; OGC CRS Standards; Esri ArcGIS Spatial Reference

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this boundary version ceases to be operative, typically when superseded by a new version due to field split, merge, or re-survey. Null indicates the boundary is currently active with no defined end date.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Farm Records; FSMA Traceability Rule; Crop Insurance Regulations (RMA)

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this boundary version is considered operative and legally binding for FSA compliance, crop insurance, and land management purposes. Marks the beginning of the temporal validity window for this boundary record.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Farm Records; FSMA Traceability Rule; Crop Insurance Regulations (RMA)

attributes.name: elevation_avg_meters
attributes.description: Average elevation of the field above mean sea level in meters, derived from digital elevation model (DEM) data. Used for microclimate analysis, frost risk assessment, and precision agriculture zone delineation.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS National Elevation Dataset; Esri ArcGIS DEM Analysis

attributes.name: fsa_field_number
attributes.description: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) field number within the assigned tract. Together with fsa_tract_number, uniquely identifies this field in the USDA Common Land Unit (CLU) registry for federal program compliance and acreage certification.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Common Land Unit (CLU); USDA Farm Records; Crop Insurance Regulations (RMA)

attributes.name: fsa_tract_number
attributes.description: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) tract number assigned to this field for federal program compliance, acreage reporting, and crop insurance purposes. Required for ARC/PLC program enrollment and FSA farm records.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Farm Records; USDA Common Land Unit (CLU) Standards; Crop Insurance Regulations (RMA)

attributes.name: geometry_type
attributes.description: GIS geometry type of the boundary shape as defined by ISO 19125 Simple Features. 'Polygon' for contiguous single-parcel fields; 'MultiPolygon' for non-contiguous fields composed of multiple disconnected parcels (e.g., fields separated by roads or waterways).
attributes.references: ISO 19125 (Simple Features for SQL); Esri ArcGIS Geometry Standards; OGC (Open Geospatial Consortium)

attributes.name: geometry_wkt
attributes.description: Full boundary geometry encoded in Well-Known Text (WKT) format as per OGC standards. Stores the polygon or multipolygon coordinate ring defining the precise field boundary. Used by Esri ArcGIS and John Deere Operations Center for spatial analysis and field mapping.
attributes.references: OGC Well-Known Text (WKT) Standard; ISO 19125; Esri ArcGIS

attributes.name: irrigation_type
attributes.description: Primary irrigation method applied to this field boundary. Informs water resource management planning, evapotranspiration (ET) calculations, and irrigation event scheduling in the crop management domain.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Irrigation Water Management; EPA Water Quality Standards; BMP (Best Management Practices)

attributes.name: is_gmo_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this field boundary has a contractual or certification-based restriction prohibiting the planting of genetically modified organism (GMO) crops. True if GMO planting is prohibited; False if GMO crops are permitted.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulations; Non-GMO Project Standard; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: is_organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this field boundary is enrolled in and certified under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). True if the field carries active organic certification; False otherwise. Drives organic input restrictions and segregation requirements.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS); GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: land_use_type
attributes.description: Primary land use classification for this field boundary. Determines applicable regulatory requirements, conservation program eligibility, and crop planning constraints. products.name: irrigation_zone
products.description: Spatial and operational record for all field-level water management infrastructure — the single source of truth for both irrigation delivery systems and subsurface tile drainage systems within a field. For irrigation: captures zone name, system type (center pivot, drip, flood, subsurface drip, linear move, traveling gun), water source (well, river, reservoir, canal), water right permit reference, permitted volume (acre-feet), irrigated acres, application efficiency (%), design application rate (in/hr), soil moisture sensor locations, and ET-based scheduling parameters. For subsurface drainage: captures tile system type (pattern, random, interceptor), tile material (clay, concrete, corrugated plastic/HDPE), tile diameter (inches), tile depth (inches), outlet location GPS, drainage area (acres), drainage coefficient (inches/day), tile map GIS reference, installation contractor, installation year, estimated cost, system condition (good/fair/poor), and drainage district permit reference. Integrates with John Deere Operations Center for precision water management. Links to field for spatial context and to water_right for entitlement compliance. SSOT for all field-level water infrastructure including both irrigation and drainage.
products.reference: John Deere Operations Center / Trimble Ag Irrigation

attributes.name: fsa_state_code
attributes.description: USDA FSA numeric state code assigned to the state where this farm unit is registered. Used in conjunction with FSA county code and farm number for unique FSA record identification and program payment routing.

attributes.name: fsa_tract_number

attributes.name: latitude

attributes.name: leased_acres

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) of the farm unit's centroid or primary reference point. Supports GIS mapping, GPS navigation, precision agriculture applications, and spatial analytics in Esri ArcGIS.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; Esri ArcGIS; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special conditions, or contextual information about this farm unit not captured in structured fields. Used by farm managers and data stewards for supplemental documentation.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the farm unit indicating whether it is actively managed, temporarily inactive, under transition (e.g., organic conversion), or permanently retired from operation.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; USDA FSA Farm Records

attributes.name: organic_certification_status
attributes.description: Current USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification status of the farm unit. Drives premium pricing, market channel eligibility, input restrictions, and compliance reporting requirements under USDA NOP regulations.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: owned_acres

attributes.name: tillage_practice

attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; ISO 14001

attributes.name: total_operated_acres
attributes.description: Total land area operated by this farm unit in acres, encompassing both owned and leased parcels. Used for FSA acreage reporting, crop insurance unit sizing, enterprise budgeting, and USDA program payment calculations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

Captures permit number, issuing agency, priority date, right type (surface, groundwater, riparian, appropriative), permitted use, volume (acre-feet/year), flow rate (CFS/GPM), source water body, well registration, aquifer, status (active/inactive/transferred/forfeited), and transfer history. SSOT for water entitlement compliance — critical for western-state prior appropriation doctrine and state water resource regulation.
products.reference: State Water Resources Control Board / USGS Water Rights

attributes.name: water_right_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the water right record. Primary key for the water_right data product in the land domain.
attributes.references: ISO 19153 Geospatial Digital Rights Management

attributes.name: holder_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Water rights are held by legal entities (accounts). Water right transfers, annual use reporting to state agencies, and curtailment notifications are directed to the holder account. Water rights can be
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the land parcel or farm unit to which this water right is appurtenant or associated. Links the water entitlement to the physical land asset.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) Parcel Records; GLOBALG.A.P. Land Management

attributes.name: annual_use_report_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the permit requires submission of an annual water use report to the issuing regulatory agency. True if mandatory reporting is required; False otherwise. Drives compliance calendar and reporting workflow.
attributes.references: State Water Code; USDA NRCS; EPA Clean Water Act; FSMA

attributes.name: annual_volume_acre_feet
attributes.description: Maximum volume of water authorized for diversion or extraction per calendar or water year, expressed in acre-feet. One acre-foot equals approximately 325,851 US gallons. This is the primary volumetric entitlement cap for compliance and water budget planning.
attributes.references: State Water Code; USDA NRCS Water Rights; Bureau of Reclamation; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: aquifer_name
attributes.description: Name or designation of the groundwater aquifer from which extraction is authorized. Applicable for groundwater rights only. Used for aquifer management, depletion tracking, and state groundwater conservation district compliance.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; EPA Underground Injection Control; State Groundwater Conservation District Regulations

attributes.name: certificate_document_ref
attributes.description: Document management system reference or file path to the scanned water right certificate, permit, or decree. Enables retrieval of the original legal instrument for audit, compliance, and due diligence purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 15489 Records Management; USDA NRCS; State Water Code

attributes.name: curtailment_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current curtailment order became effective. Null if no curtailment is in effect. Used for operational planning and water supply risk management.
attributes.references: State Water Code; State Water Resource Control Board; Prior Appropriation Doctrine

attributes.name: curtailment_status
attributes.description: Current curtailment status indicating whether the regulatory authority has restricted or reduced authorized diversions due to drought, shortage, or senior right priority calls. Not_curtailed means full use is authorized; curtailed means diversion is prohibited; partially_curtailed means reduced diversion is allowed.
attributes.references: State Water Code; Prior Appropriation Doctrine; State Water Resource Control Board; EPA Clean Water Act

attributes.name: flow_rate_cfs
attributes.business_glossary_term: Permitted Flow Rate (Cubic Feet per Second)
attributes.description: Maximum instantaneous diversion or extraction rate authorized under the water right, expressed in cubic feet per second (CFS). Governs the rate of water withdrawal at any given moment, distinct from the annual volume cap.
attributes.references: State Water Code; USDA NRCS; Bureau of Reclamation; EPA Clean Water Act

attributes.name: flow_rate_gpm
attributes.description: Maximum instantaneous diversion or extraction rate expressed in gallons per minute (GPM). Commonly used for groundwater well permits and pump specifications. Complements the CFS measure for operational pump management.
attributes.references: State Water Code; USDA NRCS; EPA Clean Water Act; Well Permit Regulations

attributes.name: holder_type
attributes.description: Legal entity classification of the water right holder. Determines applicable regulatory requirements, reporting obligations, and transfer restrictions under state water law.
attributes.references: State Water Code; USDA NRCS; GAAP Entity Classification

attributes.name: irrigated_acres
attributes.description: Total acreage authorized for irrigation under this water right. Defines the maximum land area that may receive water from this entitlement. Used for water use efficiency calculations and USDA farm program compliance.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; USDA NRCS; State Water Code; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: is_adjudicated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this water right has been formally adjudicated (confirmed by a court or administrative proceeding) as part of a general stream adjudication. Adjudicated rights have legally confirmed priority and volume.
attributes.references: State Water Code; Prior Appropriation Doctrine; State Engineer's Office

attributes.name: is_transferable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this water right may be legally transferred, sold, or leased to another party under applicable state water law. True if transferable; False if appurtenant to the land and non-transferable.
attributes.references: State Water Code; Prior Appropriation Doctrine; USDA NRCS

attributes.name: issuing_agency
attributes.description: Name of the governmental or regulatory authority that issued the water right permit or certificate (e.g., State Engineer's Office, State Water Resources Control Board, Bureau of Reclamation). Required for regulatory correspondence and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; EPA Clean Water Act; State Water Resource Control Board; Bureau of Reclamation

attributes.name: issuing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the jurisdiction that issued the water right. Determines the applicable state water law doctrine (prior appropriation vs. riparian) and regulatory framework.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; State Water Code; ISO 3166-2:US

attributes.name: last_use_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent annual water use report was submitted to the regulatory agency. Used to track reporting compliance and identify overdue filings.
attributes.references: State Water Code; USDA NRCS; EPA Clean Water Act

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional legal conditions, special permit stipulations, environmental mitigation requirements, or operational notes associated with this water right that are not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; State Water Code; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: permit_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the water permit or certificate expires and must be renewed. Null for perpetual rights. Used for compliance calendar management and renewal workflow triggers.
attributes.references: State Water Resource Control Board; USDA NRCS; EPA Clean Water Act

attributes.name: permit_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the water permit or certificate was officially issued by the issuing regulatory agency. May differ from the priority date in appropriative systems.
attributes.references: State Water Resource Control Board; USDA NRCS; EPA Clean Water Act

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Externally-issued permit or certificate number assigned by the state water resource agency or regulatory authority. Serves as the official legal identifier for the water right on regulatory filings and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: State Water Resource Control Board; USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS); EPA Clean Water Act

attributes.name: permitted_use
attributes.description: The authorized beneficial use category for which the water right was granted. Irrigation covers crop and field watering; livestock covers animal husbandry water supply; domestic covers on-farm household use; municipal, industrial, and recreational uses apply where applicable. Use must match actual application for compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: irrigation|livestock|domestic|municipal|industrial|recreational|aquaculture|dust_suppression — promote to reference product if additional uses are needed]
attributes.references: State Water Code; USDA NRCS; EPA Clean Water Act; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: place_of_use_description
attributes.description: Legal description or narrative of the authorized place(s) where diverted or extracted water may be beneficially used. May reference legal land descriptions (township, range, section) or parcel identifiers. Restricts where water can be applied under the permit.
attributes.references: State Water Code; USDA FSA Land Records; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: point_of_diversion_lat
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) of the authorized point of diversion or extraction. Required for regulatory mapping, GIS integration with Esri ArcGIS, and field verification of diversion infrastructure.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; USDA NRCS; State Water Code; ISO 19111 Geographic Coordinate Reference Systems

attributes.name: point_of_diversion_lon
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) of the authorized point of diversion or extraction. Required for regulatory mapping, GIS integration with Esri ArcGIS, and field verification of diversion infrastructure.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; USDA NRCS; State Water Code; ISO 19111 Geographic Coordinate Reference Systems

attributes.name: previous_holder_name
attributes.description: Name of the entity or individual from whom this water right was most recently transferred. Supports chain-of-title documentation and transfer history for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: State Water Code; USDA NRCS; Prior Appropriation Doctrine

attributes.name: priority_date
attributes.description: The legally established date that determines the seniority of this water right relative to other rights on the same water source. Under prior appropriation doctrine, earlier priority dates have superior claim during shortage conditions. Critical for western-state water allocation compliance.
attributes.references: Prior Appropriation Doctrine; State Water Code; USDA NRCS Water Rights Administration

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this water right record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this water right record was most recently modified. Supports change detection, incremental processing, and audit trail requirements in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: right_type
attributes.description: Legal classification of the water right doctrine under which the entitlement is held. Surface rights derive from surface water bodies; groundwater rights pertain to aquifer extraction; riparian rights attach to land adjacent to a water body; appropriative rights follow prior appropriation doctrine (first-in-time, first-in-right) common in western US states; prescriptive rights arise from long-term use. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: surface|groundwater|riparian|appropriative|prescriptive|adjudicated — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: Prior Appropriation Doctrine; Riparian Rights Doctrine; State Water Code; USDA NRCS; EPA Clean Water Act

attributes.name: season_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which authorized water diversion or use must cease each year under seasonal restrictions of the permit. Null if the right has no seasonal restriction.
attributes.references: State Water Code; USDA NRCS; Bureau of Reclamation

attributes.name: season_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which authorized water diversion or use may begin each year under seasonal restrictions of the permit. Null if the right has no seasonal restriction.
attributes.references: State Water Code; USDA NRCS; Bureau of Reclamation

attributes.name: source_water_body
attributes.description: Name of the surface water body (river, stream, canal, reservoir, lake) or groundwater basin from which water is authorized to be diverted or extracted. Required for source identification in regulatory filings and environmental monitoring.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Water Act Section 404; USDA NRCS; State Water Code; Esri ArcGIS Hydrography

attributes.name: source_water_body_type
attributes.description: Classification of the water source type. Distinguishes surface water sources (river, stream, canal, reservoir, lake, spring) from groundwater sources (aquifer) for regulatory categorization and environmental impact assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: river|stream|canal|reservoir|lake|spring|aquifer — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA Clean Water Act; USDA NRCS; State Water Code

attributes.name: transfer_date
attributes.description: The date on which ownership or appurtenance of this water right was most recently transferred to the current holder. Null if no transfer has occurred. Supports transfer history tracking and chain-of-title documentation.
attributes.references: State Water Code; USDA NRCS; Prior Appropriation Doctrine

attributes.name: water_district
attributes.description: Name of the irrigation district, water conservation district, or water management area within which this water right is administered. Relevant for district-level allocation, assessment fees, and delivery scheduling.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; Bureau of Reclamation; State Water Code; Irrigation District Act

attributes.name: water_right_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the water right. Active indicates the right is valid and in use; inactive indicates the right is held but not currently exercised; transferred indicates ownership or appurtenance has changed; forfeited indicates the right has been lost due to non-use or regulatory action; suspended indicates temporary regulatory hold.
attributes.references: State Water Resource Control Board; USDA NRCS; EPA Clean Water Act; FSMA

attributes.name: well_depth_ft
attributes.description: Total drilled depth of the extraction well in feet below ground surface. Applicable for groundwater rights. Used for aquifer characterization, pump sizing, and regulatory well construction compliance.
attributes.references: State Well Construction Standards; USDA NRCS; EPA Underground Injection Control

attributes.name: well_registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration or permit number assigned to the extraction well by the state well permitting authority. Applicable for groundwater rights. Links the water right to the physical well infrastructure for compliance and inspection records.
attributes.references: State Well Permit Regulations; USDA NRCS; EPA Underground Injection Control; State Engineer's Office

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_rate_lph

attributes.name: implement_depth_cm

attributes.name: implement_width_m

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: RTK-corrected WGS84 longitude coordinate of the equipment at the time of the reading, in decimal degrees. Supports fleet position tracking, field coverage monitoring, geofence evaluation, and theft detection.

attributes.name: ndvi_reading

attributes.name: operational_status

attributes.name: pto_engaged

attributes.name: pto_rpm

attributes.name: reading_quality_flag

attributes.name: reading_timestamp

attributes.name: rtk_correction_status

products.name: work_order
products.description: Corrective and preventive maintenance work orders for agricultural equipment managed through CMMS (e.g., SAP PM). Header captures work order number, order type (PM/CM/inspection), priority, asset reference, fault description, reported fault code, assigned technician, planned and actual start/end dates, labor hours, total maintenance cost (OPEX), work order status (open/in-progress/completed/cancelled), and sign-off details. Embedded parts consumption line items (replacing standalone parts_usage) capture part number, quantity used, unit cost, total cost, issue date, issuing warehouse/bin, and technician ID — SSOT for actual material consumption data supporting OPEX cost tracking, inventory replenishment triggers, and maintenance cost analysis by asset and crop enterprise. Core CMMS transactional record for all maintenance activities. Integrates with SAP MM goods issue and SAP CO cost allocation.

products.name: parts_issue
products.description: This association product represents the Parts Issue (Material Reservation) event between work_order and parts_inventory. It captures each line-item-level consumption of a spare part or consumable against a specific maintenance work order, as recorded in the CMMS (SAP PM goods issue / IBM Maximo material usage). Each record links one work_order to one parts_inventory item and carries the quantity issued, unit cost at time of issue, issue date, reservation status, and return quantity — data that exists only in the context of this specific work-order-to-part consumption event. Serves as the SSOT for actual material consumption supporting OPEX cost tracking, inventory replenishment triggers, and maintenance cost analysis by asset and crop enterprise.. Existence Justification: In agricultural CMMS operations, a single work order consumes multiple spare parts from inventory (e.g., a combine harvester repair may require an air filter, hydraulic seal, and drive belt simultaneously), and each part number is consumed across many different work orders over time. This is a textbook operational M:N: the 'parts issue' or 'material reservation' is a well-established CMMS business concept actively created, updated, and closed by maintenance planners and technicians. The relationship carries its own data — quantity issued, unit cost at time of issue, issue date, reservation status, and return quantity — none of which belong solely to the work order header or the parts inventory master.

domains.name: supply
domains.description: Orchestrates end-to-end agricultural supply chain and logistics from farm inputs through storage, processing, and delivery to food manufacturers and retailers. Manages TMS-driven transportation planning, shipment tracking (BOL, AWB), route optimization, cold chain management, carrier and 3PL relationships, and traceability lot (LOT) tracking with RFID. Ensures compliance with FSMA transportation rules for food safety. Integrates with Manhattan Associates WMS and SAP S/4HANA MM for inbound and outbound logistics.

products.name: shipment
products.description: SSOT for every agricultural shipment — grain, produce, livestock feed, and processed food movements from farm to food manufacturer or retailer. Master record capturing shipment identity, BOL/AWB legal documentation (shipper, consignee, freight terms, seal numbers, electronic signatures per 49 CFR), origin and destination facility, commodity lot (LOT), carrier assignment, transport mode (road, rail, air, sea), shipment status lifecycle, scheduled and actual departure/arrival dates, total weight (MT/CWT/BU), temperature requirements for cold chain, FSMA Sanitary Transportation rule compliance flag, container identifiers, delivery milestone events (pickup confirmation, in-transit checkpoints, border crossing, proof of delivery with GPS coordinates, photo evidence, and electronic signature capture), and exception events (delay, damage, refusal). Single authoritative record for shipment identity, legal shipping documentation, execution tracking, and delivery event history within the supply domain. Subsumes BOL document data and delivery event tracking — no separate products exist for these concepts.

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Item Value; USDA COOL; Customs and Border Protection

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot tracking identifier assigned to the agricultural commodity lot on this shipment line. Used for one-up/one-back traceability and recall response per FSMA Section 204. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA batch number.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204 - Food Traceability Rule; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: moisture_content_pct
attributes.description: Moisture content percentage of the commodity on this shipment line as measured at time of loading or grading. Critical quality parameter for grain commodities affecting storage life, weight dockage, and pricing under USDA grade standards.
attributes.references: USDA Federal Grain Inspection Service (FGIS); USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; ISO 6540

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of the commodity on this shipment line excluding packaging and tare weight in kilograms. Used for commodity valuation, yield reconciliation, and food safety compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Net Weight; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: pallet_count
attributes.description: Number of pallets used to load the commodity on this shipment line. Used for warehouse space planning, carrier capacity management, and loading dock operations in Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Pallet Management; GS1 Pallet Standards

attributes.name: phi_days
attributes.description: Number of days of the Pre-Harvest Interval observed before harvest for the commodity lot on this shipment line. Confirms that the required waiting period after pesticide application was met before harvest, ensuring MRL compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Pre-Harvest Interval Requirements; FSMA Produce Safety Rule (21 CFR Part 112); GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the commodity loaded on this shipment line expressed in the designated unit of measure (BU, MT, CWT, etc.). Required TRANSACTION_LINE category: LINE_QUANTITY.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Delivery Quantity; USDA Commodity Measurement Standards

attributes.name: required_temp_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum required storage and transport temperature in degrees Celsius for this shipment line. Used for cold chain compliance monitoring and FSMA sanitary transportation rule adherence.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule (21 CFR Part 1.900); HACCP; FDA

attributes.name: required_temp_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum required storage and transport temperature in degrees Celsius for this shipment line. Used for cold chain compliance monitoring and FSMA sanitary transportation rule adherence.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule (21 CFR Part 1.900); HACCP; FDA

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier assigned to the pallet or container for this shipment line. Enables automated lot-level traceability scanning at receiving docks, storage locations, and delivery points per FSMA traceability requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204; GS1 EPC/RFID Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit code identifying the specific commodity product variant (e.g., crop type, grade, packaging format) loaded on this shipment line. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA material number and Manhattan Associates WMS item master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Number; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this shipment line record originated. Enables data lineage tracking and reconciliation across integrated systems in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Manhattan Associates WMS; Granular Farm Management; Oracle NetSuite

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature zone classification assigned to this shipment line for cold chain management. Determines storage and transport temperature requirements to maintain food safety and commodity quality.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule (21 CFR Part 1.900); FDA Food Safety; HACCP

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the shipment line quantity. BU = Bushel, MT = Metric Ton, CWT = Hundredweight, LB = Pound, KG = Kilogram, TON = Short Ton. Aligns with USDA commodity measurement standards and SAP S/4HANA base unit of measure.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; SAP S/4HANA MM - Base Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-1

attributes.name: upc_code
attributes.description: Universal Product Code barcode identifier for the commodity SKU on this shipment line. Used for retail scanning, inventory management, and point-of-sale identification of packaged agricultural products.
attributes.references: GS1 UPC Standards; USDA COOL; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shipment line record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture, audit trails, and data freshness monitoring in the Databricks silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA - Record Change Timestamp; SOX Compliance; GDPR Article 5

products.name: transport_order
products.description: SSOT for TMS-generated transportation orders authorizing and managing the full lifecycle of agricultural commodity movements — from order creation through carrier booking, load planning, and dispatch execution. Captures order type (inbound/outbound/inter-facility), requested and confirmed pickup/delivery windows, priority level, freight terms (FOB/CIF), carrier or 3PL assignment, route plan reference, load type (FTL, LTL, intermodal), FSMA compliance checklist status, equipment type (reefer, dry van, flatbed, hopper), freight rate applied, booking confirmation details (booked capacity, appointment times, cancellation terms, booking status), and load planning details (loading sequence, commodity lot assignments per position, weight distribution, center-of-gravity compliance, temperature zone mapping, dock assignment, vehicle/container ID, planned load start/completion times). Single authoritative record for carrier dispatch authorization, freight capacity commitment, booking management, and load execution planning within the supply domain. Subsumes freight booking and load plan data — no separate products exist for these concepts.
products.reference: TMS Transportation Order — SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: transport_order_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a single transportation order record within the supply domain. Primary key for the transport_order data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD Transport Order Object

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: The carrier-assigned vehicle unit number, trailer number, or intermodal container ID assigned to execute this transportation order. Used for RFID tracking, GPS telematics integration, and FSMA vehicle inspection records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Vehicle Assignment; FMCSA Vehicle Identification; FSMA 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the assigned motor carrier or 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) provider responsible for executing this transportation order. Links to the carrier master record for FMCSA authority, insurance, and rate information.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; FMCSA Carrier Registration; FSMA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart O

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.delivery_location. Business justification: Transport orders in agriculture require the customer delivery location for route planning, carrier assignment, dock scheduling, and FSMA sanitary transport compliance. No current FK on transport_order

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Transport orders generate freight cost postings to a specific GL account for cost accounting and AP accrual. Agriculture logistics operations require GL account assignment on transport orders for auto
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_transport_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the origin facility (farm, grain elevator, processing plant, or warehouse) from which the agricultural commodity shipment originates. Used for FSMA traceability and BOL generation.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; SAP S/4HANA MM Plant/Storage Location

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Transport order freight costs are attributed to a profit center for logistics P&L reporting by business segment. Agriculture companies segment freight spend by grain division, oilseed division, or geo
