attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Inbound transport orders in agriculture are created to execute purchase order deliveries (moving purchased seeds, chemicals, or grain to farm/facility). Linking transport_order to purchase_order enabl
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the TMS-generated route plan that defines the optimized path, waypoints, and leg sequence for this transportation order. Supports route optimization analytics and fuel cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Route Planning; Manhattan Associates TMS

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: TMS-to-OMS integration: transport orders are created to fulfill customer sales orders in grain/commodity logistics. Dispatchers and planners must reference the originating sales order when creating tr
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: service_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.service_contract. Business justification: A transport order is executed under the terms of a service contract with the carrier or 3PL. Adding service_contract_id to transport_order links the TMS order to the governing contract, enabling valid
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: Transport orders in grain/ag operations specify the exact storage bin or silo for pickup. Load planning, FIFO/FEFO compliance, and WMS task generation require the transport order to reference the spec
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: transport_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.transport_unit. Business justification: A transport order authorizes movement using a specific transport unit. transport_order.equipment_type is a string denormalization of the unit type; with transport_unit_id FK, the unit_type, capacity,
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: The Bill of Lading number issued by the carrier as the legal contract of carriage and receipt of goods. Required for FSMA traceability, customs clearance, and dispute resolution. Cross-references the physical BOL document.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 373 (Bills of Lading); FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; UCC Article 7

attributes.name: booked_volume_m3
attributes.description: The confirmed booked cargo volume in cubic meters committed with the carrier. Used for load planning, space utilization optimization, and LTL rate calculation based on dimensional weight.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Freight Unit Volume; NMFC (National Motor Freight Classification)

attributes.name: booked_weight_kg
attributes.description: The confirmed booked cargo weight in kilograms committed with the carrier for this transportation order. Used for freight rate calculation, weight distribution compliance, and carrier capacity management. Expressed in metric tons (MT) equivalent for bulk grain reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Freight Unit Weight; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service Weight Standards

attributes.name: booking_confirmation_number
attributes.description: The carrier or 3PL-issued booking confirmation reference number acknowledging capacity commitment for this transportation order. Used for capacity management, cancellation processing, and carrier invoice reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Freight Booking; Manhattan Associates TMS

attributes.name: booking_status
attributes.description: Current status of the carrier capacity booking associated with this transportation order. Tracks the booking lifecycle from initial request through confirmation, amendment, or cancellation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Freight Booking Status; Manhattan Associates TMS

attributes.name: cancellation_terms
attributes.description: Free-text description of the carrier booking cancellation terms applicable to this transportation order, including notice period requirements and penalty charges. Sourced from the carrier rate agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Freight Agreement; USDOT Carrier Contract Terms

attributes.name: center_of_gravity_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the load plan for this transportation order meets DOT center-of-gravity and axle weight distribution requirements. Non-compliant loads must be re-planned before dispatch authorization.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 393 (Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations); DOT FMCSA Weight Distribution

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The carrier-confirmed appointment date and time for cargo delivery at the destination facility. Used for consignee receiving dock scheduling and cold chain compliance window validation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Appointment Management; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: confirmed_pickup_date
attributes.description: The carrier-confirmed appointment date and time for cargo pickup at the origin facility. May differ from requested pickup date due to carrier availability. Drives dock assignment and load planning execution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Appointment Management; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when this transport order record was first persisted in the data platform. Used for data lineage, SLA measurement, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the freight rate and charges on this transportation order (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Required for multi-currency freight cost reporting and IFRS financial consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 21 (Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates); SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: dock_assignment
attributes.description: The specific dock door or bay number assigned at the origin facility for loading this transportation order. Sourced from Manhattan Associates WMS dock scheduling. Used for load sequencing and yard management.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Dock Scheduling; SAP S/4HANA MM Warehouse Management

attributes.name: freight_rate
attributes.description: The agreed freight rate applied to this transportation order, expressed in the transaction currency per unit (per CWT, per MT, per mile, or flat rate). Sourced from carrier rate agreements in SAP S/4HANA MM. Business-confidential pricing data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Freight Condition; USDA Agricultural Transportation Rate Reporting

attributes.name: freight_rate_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure basis for the freight rate applied to this order. CWT (Hundredweight) and MT (Metric Ton) are standard agricultural commodity freight rate bases; flat rate applies to FTL movements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Freight Condition Type; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Commercial freight terms (Incoterms) governing risk transfer and cost responsibility between shipper and consignee. FOB (Free On Board) and CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight) are standard in agricultural commodity trade. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FOB_origin|FOB_destination|CIF|DAP|EXW|FCA — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020 (ICC); SAP S/4HANA SD Incoterms; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: fsma_compliance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Compliance Status
attributes.description: Compliance status of this transportation order against FSMA Sanitary Transportation of Human and Animal Food rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O). Tracks whether required vehicle cleanliness, temperature control, and shipper/carrier agreement requirements are met.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart O; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act

attributes.name: load_type
attributes.description: Transportation mode and capacity utilization classification. FTL (Full Truckload) and LTL (Less Than Truckload) are primary modes for agricultural commodities; intermodal, rail, and barge are used for bulk grain movements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Shipment Type; SCOR Model; USDA Agricultural Transportation

attributes.name: loading_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence defining the order in which commodity lots are loaded onto the vehicle for this transportation order. Optimized for delivery stop sequence (last-in-first-out) and center-of-gravity compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Load Planning; Manhattan Associates WMS Load Sequencing

attributes.name: max_temp_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable cargo temperature in degrees Celsius during transport. Exceedance triggers FSMA non-compliance flag and may require cargo rejection or quality hold upon delivery.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Safety; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: min_temp_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable cargo temperature in degrees Celsius during transport. Used for cold chain compliance monitoring, reefer set-point configuration, and FSMA temperature excursion alerting.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Safety; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The business event timestamp when the transportation order was officially created and entered into the TMS. Represents the principal real-world event time for this transaction, distinct from system audit timestamps.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Order Management; ISO 8601

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transportation order from creation through execution and closure. Drives workflow routing in TMS and SAP S/4HANA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|confirmed|booked|dispatched|in_transit|delivered|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Transportation Order Status; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Directional classification of the transportation order indicating whether it moves agricultural commodities inbound from suppliers/farms, outbound to food manufacturers/retailers, between internal facilities, or as a return movement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD Transport Order Type; Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: planned_load_end
attributes.description: Planned date and time for completion of cargo loading operations at the origin dock. Used to calculate planned loading duration, driver detention time, and dispatch readiness.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Load Planning; SAP S/4HANA MM Warehouse Management

attributes.name: planned_load_start
attributes.description: Planned date and time for commencement of cargo loading operations at the origin dock. Used for labor planning, dock scheduling coordination with Manhattan Associates WMS, and on-time loading KPI measurement.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Load Planning; SAP S/4HANA MM Warehouse Management

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority classification assigned to this transportation order, influencing carrier selection, equipment allocation, and dispatch sequencing. Critical priority is used for perishable commodities with tight PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval) windows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Priority; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Standard

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The consignee-requested date and time for cargo delivery at the destination facility. Establishes the contractual delivery commitment and drives SLA measurement for on-time delivery performance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Scheduling; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Standard

attributes.name: requested_pickup_date
attributes.description: The shipper-requested date and time window start for cargo pickup at the origin facility. Used for dock scheduling, carrier appointment booking, and on-time pickup KPI measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Scheduling; Manhattan Associates WMS Appointment Scheduling

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier attached to the shipment or pallet for automated traceability tracking throughout the supply chain. Enables real-time lot-level visibility from loading through delivery in compliance with FSMA traceability requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Food Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; GS1 RFID Standards; EPC Global

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing commodity-specific handling requirements such as hazmat placarding, organic segregation requirements, GMO separation protocols, or fragile produce stacking restrictions. Printed on BOL and communicated to carrier.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; USDA National Organic Program (NOP); EPA Hazmat Regulations 49 CFR

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required temperature zone classification for the cargo during transport. Drives reefer equipment selection, cold chain monitoring requirements, and FSMA temperature control documentation. Critical for perishable produce and dairy commodities.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Safety; GLOBALG.A.P. Cold Chain Standard

attributes.name: tms_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable transportation order number generated by the TMS (e.g., SAP TM or Manhattan Associates TMS). Used for carrier communication, BOL cross-reference, and customer-facing shipment tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/MM Transportation Order; Manhattan Associates TMS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when this transport order record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change detection, incremental ETL, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability

products.name: carrier
products.description: SSOT for all approved freight carriers and 3PL providers in the agricultural supply chain. Master record storing carrier legal name, SCAC code, DOT/MC number, carrier type (trucking, rail, air freight, ocean), service modes, insurance certificate expiry, FSMA Sanitary Transportation certification status, cold chain capability, RFID tracking capability, preferred lane assignments, and rolling performance metrics (on-time pickup/delivery rates, damage claim rate, temperature excursion rate, compliance score, performance tier by evaluation period, total shipments executed, rejected loads count). Single authoritative record for carrier identity, qualification, and operational performance within the supply domain. Subsumes carrier performance tracking — no separate product exists for this concept.
products.reference: SCAC — DOT Carrier Registration

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the freight carrier or third-party logistics (3PL) provider record within the agricultural supply chain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Vendor Master

attributes.name: quality_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_certification. Business justification: Food-grade carriers must hold quality/food safety certifications (FSMA Sanitary Transport, SQF Transport). carrier has fsma_sanitary_transport_certified flag and fsma_cert_expiry_date (denormalized) b
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sap_vendor_id
attributes.description: Vendor master record number assigned to this carrier in SAP S/4HANA MM module. Used for cross-referencing freight invoices, purchase orders (PO), and goods receipt notes (GRN) in the ERP system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1/LFB1 tables)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the carrier was formally approved to transport trial materials to or from this specific trial site. Belongs to the approval relationship, not to the carrier or site master records.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 date

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the carrier's approval for this trial site. Controls whether the carrier may be tendered loads for this site. Derived from the approval management process.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: approved_commodity_types
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of agricultural commodity categories this carrier is approved to transport (e.g., 'grain', 'fresh_produce', 'livestock', 'fertilizer', 'pesticides'). Derived from carrier certifications and equipment capabilities.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Act; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; EPA Pesticide Transport Regulations

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: The specific date on which audit activities were conducted for this carrier. Relevant when a multi-carrier audit spans multiple site visits on different dates.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: audit_outcome
attributes.description: The audit outcome determined specifically for this carrier within the audit engagement. A multi-carrier audit may yield different outcomes per carrier.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: audit_scope_for_carrier
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific operations, routes, facilities, or practices within scope for this carrier in the context of this audit. May be a subset of the overall audit scope when the audit covers multiple carriers.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: carrier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the carrier record within the agricultural supply chain master data. Controls whether the carrier is eligible for new shipment assignments in the TMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: carrier_type
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation the carrier operates. Drives TMS routing logic, BOL/AWB document selection, and FSMA Sanitary Transportation rule applicability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: trucking|rail|air_freight|ocean|intermodal|3pl — promote to reference product if additional modes are needed]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TMS; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: cold_chain_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has certified refrigerated or temperature-controlled transport capability for cold chain agricultural commodities (e.g., fresh produce, dairy, meat). Required for perishable shipment routing in TMS.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; GLOBALG.A.P. Cold Chain Standard

attributes.name: cold_chain_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier's cold chain capability has been specifically verified and validated for this trial site's requirements. Distinct from the carrier-level cold_chain_capable flag, which is a general capability indicator. A carrier may be generally cold-chain capable but not yet verified for a specific site's temperature profile or containment requirements.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: compliance_score
attributes.description: Composite compliance score (0-100) reflecting the carrier's adherence to regulatory requirements (FSMA, DOT, FMCSA) and contractual obligations. Calculated from documentation currency, audit results, and violation history.
attributes.references: FMCSA Safety Measurement System (SMS); FSMA; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the current master carrier agreement or rate contract. Triggers renewal workflow alerts in SAP S/4HANA MM. Null indicates an open-ended evergreen agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement; Oracle NetSuite Procurement

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the current master carrier agreement or rate contract between the agricultural enterprise and the carrier. Defines the period during which contracted rates and service commitments apply.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement; Oracle NetSuite Procurement

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this carrier is required to submit or implement corrective actions as a result of findings identified during this audit. Drives follow-up workflow in the compliance domain.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the carrier is legally registered. Determines applicable regulatory frameworks (FMCSA, Transport Canada, etc.) and COOL compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; USDA COOL Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the carrier master record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and FSMA record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements; SOX Internal Controls; ISO 22000

attributes.name: damage_claim_rate
attributes.description: Rolling ratio of shipments resulting in a cargo damage claim to total shipments executed. Used to assess carrier handling quality for sensitive agricultural commodities and inform carrier tier scoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation; USDA Agricultural Marketing Act

attributes.name: dot_number
attributes.description: USDOT number issued by the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) to identify commercial motor carriers operating in interstate commerce. Required for FSMA Sanitary Transportation compliance verification.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 390; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: edi_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier supports EDI transaction sets (e.g., 204 Motor Carrier Load Tender, 214 Shipment Status, 210 Freight Invoice) for automated load tendering and status updates in the agricultural supply chain.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM EDI Integration

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the carrier's site-specific approval expires and must be renewed. Approval periods may align with annual carrier qualification cycles or cooperator agreement renewal dates.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 date

attributes.name: fsma_cert_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Certification Expiry Date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the carrier's FSMA Sanitary Transportation certification. Triggers compliance alerts when approaching expiry to prevent use of non-compliant carriers for food-grade agricultural shipments.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart O; FDA

attributes.name: fsma_sanitary_transport_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Sanitary Transportation Certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier holds a valid FSMA Sanitary Transportation of Human and Animal Food certification (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O). Mandatory for carriers transporting food-grade agricultural products to food manufacturers.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart O; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act

attributes.name: gps_tracking_capable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Positioning System (GPS) Real-Time Tracking Capability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier provides real-time GPS-based shipment location tracking integrated with the TMS for visibility into in-transit agricultural commodity shipments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TMS; John Deere Operations Center Fleet Telematics

attributes.name: hazmat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier holds USDOT hazardous materials (HAZMAT) certification for transporting regulated agricultural inputs such as pesticides, fertilizers, and fumigants with Safety Data Sheet (SDS) requirements.
attributes.references: USDOT 49 CFR Parts 171-180 HAZMAT Regulations; EPA; OSHA

attributes.name: insurance_cert_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the carrier's current insurance certificate (cargo liability, general liability, and auto liability). Carrier is ineligible for load assignment if this date has passed. Monitored for proactive renewal alerts.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 387; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Total cargo liability insurance coverage amount in USD as stated on the carrier's current insurance certificate. Used to validate coverage adequacy for high-value agricultural commodity shipments.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 387; USDA Agricultural Commodity Standards

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the carrier master record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements; SAP S/4HANA Change Documents

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal registered business name of the freight carrier or 3PL provider as recorded with the relevant regulatory authority (e.g., FMCSA, DOT). Used for contracts, BOL documentation, and compliance filings.
attributes.references: FMCSA Carrier Registration; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: max_temp_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in degrees Celsius that the carrier's temperature-controlled units can maintain. Defines the upper bound of the carrier's cold chain capability for fresh produce and ambient-chilled agricultural shipments.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: mc_number
attributes.description: Operating authority number (MC number) issued by FMCSA to carriers transporting regulated commodities for hire in interstate commerce. Validates carrier authority to haul agricultural products.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 365; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: min_temp_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in degrees Celsius that the carrier's refrigerated units can maintain. Used for TMS routing of frozen or deep-chilled agricultural products requiring specific temperature ranges.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate
attributes.description: Rolling percentage of shipments delivered within the committed delivery window. Primary KPI for carrier performance evaluation, tier assignment, and preferred carrier status in TMS routing for agricultural logistics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Standard

attributes.name: on_time_pickup_rate
attributes.description: Rolling percentage of shipments where the carrier completed pickup within the agreed pickup window. Key performance indicator (KPI) for carrier scorecard evaluation and performance tier assignment in the agricultural supply chain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Standard

attributes.name: performance_eval_period
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter and year (e.g., '2024-Q3') for which the current rolling performance metrics (on-time rates, damage claim rate, compliance score, performance tier) were last evaluated and updated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: performance_rating_at_site
attributes.description: Performance rating (0.00–5.00) assigned to the carrier based on observed performance specifically at this trial site. Distinct from the carrier's aggregate rolling performance metrics, which span all sites and shipments. Enables site managers to flag carriers that perform well globally but poorly at their specific location.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Current performance tier classification assigned based on the carrier's rolling KPI scores (on-time rates, damage claims, compliance score). Drives TMS primary/secondary/tertiary carrier selection logic for agricultural shipment routing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Standard

attributes.name: preferred_lane_assignments
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of preferred origin-destination lane codes (e.g., 'MIDWEST-SOUTHEAST', 'CA-TX') where this carrier has committed capacity or preferred routing agreements. Used by TMS for primary carrier selection in route optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TMS Route Determination; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the carrier's operational contact used for load tender notifications, BOL transmissions, and compliance document exchange.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the carrier organization responsible for load tendering, dispatch coordination, and issue resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the carrier's operational contact used for dispatch coordination, load tendering, and exception management in the agricultural supply chain.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: rejected_loads_count
attributes.description: Count of loads rejected or refused by the carrier after tender acceptance within the current evaluation period. High rejection rates indicate capacity reliability issues and impact carrier tier scoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TMS; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: rfid_tracking_capable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Tracking Capability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier supports RFID-based shipment and lot (LOT) tracking for end-to-end traceability of agricultural commodities from farm to food manufacturer. Integrates with Manhattan Associates WMS RFID infrastructure.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; GS1 RFID Standards

attributes.name: scac_code
attributes.description: Unique 2-4 character Standard Carrier Alpha Code (SCAC) assigned by the National Motor Freight Traffic Association (NMFTA) to identify the carrier in EDI transactions, BOL documents, and TMS routing.
attributes.references: NMFTA SCAC Directory; ANSI X12 EDI Standards

attributes.name: service_modes
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of transportation service modes offered by the carrier (e.g., FTL, LTL, refrigerated, flatbed, bulk, tanker, intermodal). Used for TMS lane matching and load tendering in agricultural logistics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TMS; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_rate
attributes.description: Rolling ratio of cold chain shipments where a temperature excursion (deviation outside the specified range) was recorded to total cold chain shipments. Critical metric for FSMA compliance and food safety risk management.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: total_shipments_executed
attributes.description: Cumulative count of shipments executed by this carrier within the current evaluation period. Provides volume context for interpreting rate-based KPIs (on-time, damage, temperature excursion) in carrier performance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TMS; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Operating or 'doing business as' (DBA) trade name of the carrier, if different from the legal name. Used in day-to-day communications and TMS lane assignments.
attributes.references: FMCSA Carrier Registration

products.name: route
products.description: SSOT for planned transportation routes used in agricultural commodity and input movements across the supply chain network. Defines origin facility node, destination facility node, intermediate waypoints, distance (miles/km), estimated transit time by transport mode, preferred carrier assignments, seasonal road restriction flags (spring weight limits, harvest season congestion), cold chain corridor designation, toll and border crossing points, bridge weight limit constraints, and GPS/RTK route geometry reference. Used by TMS for route optimization, freight cost estimation, and VRA delivery planning for precision agriculture inputs. Single authoritative record for transportation route definitions within the supply domain.
products.reference: TMS Route Master

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for a transportation route definition within the agricultural supply chain network. Primary key for the route data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM (Transportation Management); Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Agricultural routes are commodity-specific (grain corridors, cold-chain produce lanes). commodity_class is a denormalized text field; a proper FK to commodity enables commodity-specific route planning
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: destination_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the destination facility node (distribution center, food manufacturer, retailer DC, port terminal) where the route ends. Used for delivery planning, customer service level management, and COOL compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Shipping Point; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) 7 CFR Part 60; FSMA

attributes.name: origin_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the origin facility node (farm, elevator, warehouse, processing plant) where the route begins. Used for network planning, freight cost estimation, and FSMA traceability. Links to the facility/location master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Plant/Storage Location; FSMA Food Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: preferred_carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the preferred carrier or 3PL assigned to this route based on contracted rates, service performance, and commodity handling capabilities. Used by TMS for automated carrier selection and freight tendering.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Carrier Master; Manhattan Associates TMS

attributes.name: avg_transit_delay_hours
attributes.description: Historical average delay in hours experienced on this route beyond the estimated transit time, calculated from actual shipment performance data. Used for realistic delivery promise date calculation, carrier performance benchmarking, and TMS transit time buffer planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Performance Analytics; KPI (Key Performance Indicator) Transportation; USDA Agricultural Transportation Statistics

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this route record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, data lineage tracking, and SOX financial reporting controls for transportation cost records.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for freight cost values on this route (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN). Required for multi-currency international route cost management and IFRS/GAAP financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the route destination location. Required for COOL compliance, import/export documentation, APHIS permits, and international freight cost calculation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; COOL 7 CFR Part 60; USDA APHIS; CBP Customs

attributes.name: distance_km
attributes.description: Total planned distance of the route in kilometers, as calculated from GPS/RTK route geometry or GIS network analysis. Used for freight cost estimation, fuel consumption planning, driver hours-of-service compliance, and carbon footprint calculation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Network Analysis; FMCSA Hours of Service 49 CFR Part 395; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: distance_miles
attributes.description: Total planned distance of the route in miles, the standard unit for US domestic trucking freight rate calculations, FMCSA compliance, and carrier contract negotiations. Maintained alongside kilometers for dual-unit reporting.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR; USDA Agricultural Transportation; SAP S/4HANA TM

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this route definition is no longer valid for TMS planning. Null indicates an open-ended route with no planned expiry. Used for seasonal route deactivation, road closure management, and contract expiry alignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Route Validity; FHWA Road Closure Management

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this route definition becomes valid and available for TMS transportation planning. Supports seasonal route activation (e.g., harvest season routes, post-spring-thaw routes) and contract-aligned route management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Route Validity; FSMA Transportation Planning

attributes.name: estimated_transit_hours
attributes.description: Estimated total transit time in hours for the route under standard operating conditions, accounting for transport mode, distance, and typical delays. Used for delivery scheduling, customer promise dates, and cold chain temperature exposure calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Transit Time; FSMA Sanitary Transportation 21 CFR Part 1; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: freight_cost_per_km
attributes.description: Standard contracted freight cost per kilometer for this route in the base currency (USD). Used by TMS for freight cost estimation, carrier rate benchmarking, and transportation spend analytics. Derived from carrier contracts negotiated in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing; TMS Freight Cost Calculation; GAAP Transportation Cost Accounting

attributes.name: fsma_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) Compliance Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route and its designated carriers have been validated as compliant with FSMA Sanitary Transportation of Human and Animal Food rules (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O), including vehicle sanitation, temperature control, and shipper-carrier agreement requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart O; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act

attributes.name: gps_geometry_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI pointing to the GPS/RTK route geometry definition stored in Esri ArcGIS or the GIS layer repository. Contains the spatial polyline representation of the route for map visualization, precision agriculture VRA delivery planning, and geofencing. Follows GeoJSON or Esri feature service reference convention.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS GIS Standards; RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) Positioning; ISO 19115 Geographic Metadata

attributes.name: has_border_crossing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route includes one or more international border crossings requiring customs documentation, phytosanitary certificates, APHIS import/export permits, or COOL compliance. Triggers additional documentation requirements in SAP S/4HANA GTS.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Import/Export; COOL 7 CFR Part 60; CBP Customs Regulations; CFIA (Canada); SAP GTS

attributes.name: has_harvest_congestion
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route experiences significant traffic congestion during harvest season due to high agricultural vehicle volumes. Used by TMS for seasonal transit time adjustments, route optimization, and harvest logistics planning.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Transportation; SAP S/4HANA TM Seasonal Planning; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: has_spring_weight_restriction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is subject to seasonal spring weight limit restrictions (spring thaw load restrictions) that reduce allowable gross vehicle weight on roads during spring months. Affects load planning, carrier selection, and delivery scheduling during spring planting season.
attributes.references: FHWA Spring Weight Restrictions; State DOT Seasonal Load Restrictions; USDA Farm-to-Market Road Standards

attributes.name: has_toll_road
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route includes toll roads, bridges, or tunnels that incur additional freight costs. Used for accurate freight cost estimation, carrier rate negotiations, and transportation spend analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Freight Cost Calculation; FHWA Toll Facilities

attributes.name: hazmat_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is approved for transportation of hazardous agricultural materials including pesticides, fertilizers (ammonium nitrate), and fumigants under DOT/EPA hazmat regulations. Drives carrier certification requirements and routing restrictions through populated areas.
attributes.references: DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations 49 CFR Parts 171-180; EPA RCRA; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: is_cold_chain_corridor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is designated as a cold chain corridor requiring temperature-controlled transport equipment (refrigerated trailers, insulated containers) throughout the entire route. Critical for perishable agricultural commodities, fresh produce, and dairy products under FSMA Sanitary Transportation rules.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart O; FDA Food Safety; GFSI Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: max_temp_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in Celsius that must not be exceeded throughout the cold chain corridor route. Null for non-cold-chain routes. Used for carrier equipment specification, temperature monitoring alert thresholds, and FSMA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Safety; HACCP Temperature Control

attributes.name: max_vehicle_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum allowable gross vehicle weight in kilograms for this route, determined by the most restrictive bridge weight limit or road weight restriction along the route. Critical for load planning of heavy agricultural commodities (grain, fertilizer, equipment) to prevent infrastructure damage and regulatory violations.
attributes.references: FHWA Bridge Weight Limits 23 CFR Part 658; State DOT Weight Regulations; FMCSA 49 CFR Part 658

attributes.name: min_temp_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in Celsius that must be maintained throughout the cold chain corridor route. Null for non-cold-chain routes. Used for carrier equipment specification, temperature monitoring alert thresholds, and FSMA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Safety; HACCP Temperature Control

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special handling instructions, known road hazards, carrier-specific requirements, or regulatory advisories relevant to this route. Used by dispatchers, logistics planners, and carrier coordinators for route-specific guidance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Route Notes; Manhattan Associates WMS Operational Notes; SOP (Standard Operating Procedure)

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the route origin location (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Required for COOL compliance, APHIS phytosanitary documentation, customs declarations, and international freight rate determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; COOL 7 CFR Part 60; USDA APHIS; CBP Customs

attributes.name: rfid_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) lot tracking infrastructure is available along this route for real-time shipment visibility and LOT traceability. Supports FSMA traceability requirements and Manhattan Associates WMS RFID integration.
attributes.references: RFID (Radio Frequency Identification); FSMA Food Traceability Rule; Manhattan Associates WMS RFID; GS1 RFID Standards

attributes.name: route_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the transportation route, used in TMS, BOL documentation, and carrier communications. Serves as the business-facing identifier across SAP S/4HANA SD/MM and Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Transportation; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the transportation route (e.g., 'Midwest Grain Corridor - Chicago to Memphis'). Used in TMS planning screens, carrier briefings, and operational reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: route_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the route definition. 'active' indicates the route is available for TMS planning; 'seasonal' indicates availability limited to specific periods; 'restricted' indicates regulatory or physical constraints are in effect; 'under_review' indicates pending validation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Route Master; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the route by its supply chain function: 'inbound' for farm inputs to storage/processing, 'outbound' for finished goods to customers, 'inter_facility' for transfers between company facilities, 'last_mile' for final delivery to farm or retailer, 'backhaul' for return load optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD Transportation; Manhattan Associates WMS; USDA Agricultural Supply Chain

attributes.name: seasonal_restriction_end_month
attributes.description: Calendar month number (1-12) when seasonal restrictions end on this route. Used alongside seasonal_restriction_start_month for automated TMS seasonal planning windows and carrier capacity pre-booking.
attributes.references: State DOT Seasonal Load Restriction Programs; USDA Agricultural Transportation Seasonal Planning

attributes.name: seasonal_restriction_start_month
attributes.description: Calendar month number (1-12) when seasonal restrictions (spring weight limits, harvest congestion, winter road closures) begin on this route. Used for automated TMS seasonal planning and proactive carrier notification.
attributes.references: State DOT Seasonal Load Restriction Programs; USDA Agricultural Transportation Seasonal Planning

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation for this route (e.g., truck for over-the-road, rail for grain shuttle, intermodal for container movements, barge for river grain transport). Drives carrier selection, freight cost estimation, and transit time calculation in TMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; USDA Agricultural Transportation; FSMA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart O

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this route record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data synchronization between TMS and SAP S/4HANA, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5; SAP S/4HANA Change Documents

attributes.name: vra_delivery_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Variable Rate Application (VRA) Delivery Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is designated for precision agriculture VRA (Variable Rate Application) input deliveries, requiring GPS-guided last-mile delivery to specific field zones. Integrates with Trimble Ag Software and John Deere Operations Center for precision delivery coordination.
attributes.references: VRA (Variable Rate Application) Precision Agriculture; Trimble Ag Software; John Deere Operations Center; FMIS

attributes.name: waypoint_count
attributes.description: Number of intermediate waypoints (stops, transfer points, relay stations, grain elevators) along the route between origin and destination. Used for multi-stop delivery planning, driver relay scheduling, and route complexity assessment in TMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Multi-Stop Route; Manhattan Associates TMS

products.name: freight_booking
products.description: Records the confirmed booking of freight capacity with a carrier or 3PL for a specific transport order. Captures booking confirmation number, carrier assignment, booked capacity (weight/volume), equipment type (reefer, dry van, flatbed, hopper), pickup appointment date/time, delivery appointment date/time, freight rate applied, accessorial charges, booking status, and cancellation terms. Bridges transport order to actual carrier execution and BOL issuance.
products.reference: Freight Booking Confirmation — TMS

attributes.name: freight_booking_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the freight booking record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Freight bookings in agriculture are made on behalf of a specific customer account for billing, credit exposure checking, and freight cost allocation. Bookings can precede shipment confirmation; credit
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or third-party logistics (3PL) provider assigned to execute this freight booking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Vendor Master

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Freight bookings in agriculture are commodity-specific for rate determination, equipment type selection, and food-grade certification requirements. Linking to commodity enables automated commodity-spe

attributes.name: commodity_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.commodity_lot. Business justification: Freight bookings in ag are made for specific commodity lots to enforce GMO segregation, organic certification, and temperature zone requirements. Booking a reefer for a certified organic lot requires

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Freight bookings are made under a specific legal entity for intercompany billing and regulatory compliance. Agriculture multinationals book freight under distinct company codes for cross-border shipme

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.delivery_order. Business justification: A freight booking is created to arrange carrier transport for a commercial delivery order. TMS-to-OMS integration in agriculture logistics requires this link for delivery order fulfillment tracking, f

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.delivery_schedule. Business justification: Freight bookings in agriculture inbound logistics are triggered by procurement delivery schedule lines becoming due. Linking freight_booking to delivery_schedule enables inbound freight planning again

attributes.name: destination_location_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination facility, customer delivery point, or distribution center where the freight is to be delivered.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Plant/Storage Location Master; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: freight_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.freight_rate. Business justification: A freight booking is made at a specific negotiated rate. Adding freight_rate_id to freight_booking links the booking to the rate schedule used for pricing. This enables rate audit (comparing booked ra

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Freight bookings generate payable amounts requiring GL account coding for AP accrual and cost posting. Agriculture commodity logistics operations code freight bookings to specific GL accounts (e.g., f
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organic_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.organic_certification. Business justification: Organic commodity freight bookings must reference organic certification to ensure certified transport conditions are booked (food-grade, non-contaminated equipment). This FK supports NOP organic chain
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_freight_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the origin facility, farm, warehouse, or storage location from which the freight will be picked up.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Plant/Storage Location Master; Esri ArcGIS

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Freight booking costs are attributed to a profit center for logistics segment P&L reporting. Agriculture operations segment freight spend by commodity type or business unit at booking level for manage
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Freight bookings are created to fulfill confirmed sales orders in agriculture logistics. TMS-to-OMS integration and freight cost allocation to sales orders require this direct link. No existing FK on
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: service_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.service_contract. Business justification: A freight booking is made against a service contract that defines the committed volume, rate basis, and service level with the carrier. Adding service_contract_id to freight_booking normalizes the con
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated shipment record once the booking transitions to active carrier execution and a Bill of Lading (BOL) is issued.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Shipment

attributes.name: transport_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent transport order that initiated this freight booking. Links the booking to the originating logistics request.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management

attributes.name: transport_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.transport_unit. Business justification: A freight booking reserves capacity on a specific transport unit (container, reefer truck, railcar). freight_booking.equipment_type is a string that denormalizes the unit type; with transport_unit_id
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accessorial_amount
attributes.description: Total additional charges beyond the base freight rate, including fuel surcharges, detention, lumper fees, layover, and FSMA-required temperature monitoring fees.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management; NMFC Accessorial Tariff

attributes.name: awb_number
attributes.description: Air Waybill (AWB) number for air freight shipments. Serves as the air transport equivalent of the BOL. Populated only for air mode bookings.
attributes.references: IATA Air Waybill Standards; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: base_freight_amount
attributes.description: Gross base freight charge for this booking before accessorial charges, fuel surcharges, or discounts. Core component of the freight cost monetary triplet.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module - Cost Accounting; GAAP; IFRS 16

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading (BOL) number issued upon carrier pickup. Legal document of title and receipt for agricultural goods in transit. Populated after pickup confirmation.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; UCC Article 7 - Documents of Title; USDOT

attributes.name: booked_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units, pallets, cases, or bulk quantity (in applicable unit of measure) booked for transport. Supports lot traceability and inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: booked_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total cubic volume of cargo booked, expressed in cubic meters. Used alongside weight for dimensional weight calculations and equipment capacity utilization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management; IATA Dimensional Weight Standards

attributes.name: booked_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of cargo booked with the carrier, expressed in kilograms. Used for freight rate calculation, weight-based compliance checks, and capacity planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management; USDOT Federal Bridge Formula

attributes.name: booking_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable booking confirmation number assigned upon carrier acceptance. Used for cross-system reference and carrier communication.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: booking_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the freight booking. Tracks progression from initial draft through carrier confirmation, active transit, completion, or cancellation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management; FSMA Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: booking_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the freight booking was confirmed with the carrier or 3PL. Represents the principal business event time for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management

attributes.name: cancellation_deadline
attributes.description: The latest date and time by which this booking can be cancelled without incurring cancellation penalties. Defined by carrier contract terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management; Carrier Contract Terms

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for booking cancellation. Populated only when booking_status is cancelled. Used for carrier performance analysis and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this freight booking record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: ISO 22000; FSMA Food Safety Modernization Act - Record Keeping Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which freight amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Required for multi-currency operations and IFRS financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: delivery_appointment_timestamp
attributes.description: Confirmed date and time of the scheduled delivery appointment at the destination. Used for receiving dock scheduling and customer SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Delivery; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: freight_rate
attributes.description: Contracted or spot freight rate applied to this booking, expressed as a monetary amount per unit of measure (e.g., per MT, per mile, per load). Commercially sensitive pricing data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Condition Records; DTN Market Data

attributes.name: incoterm_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the transfer of risk, cost responsibility, and delivery obligations between shipper and consignee. FOB and CIF are common in agricultural commodity trade. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; USDA Foreign Agricultural Service; Codex Alimentarius Commission

attributes.name: is_food_grade
attributes.description: Indicates whether this booking requires food-grade transport equipment and handling procedures compliant with FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule. Critical for edible agricultural commodities.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; FDA; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains hazardous materials (e.g., agricultural chemicals, pesticides, fertilizers) requiring special handling, placarding, and regulatory documentation under DOT HazMat regulations.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; OSHA; SDS Requirements

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Lot Number (LOT) identifying the specific production batch of agricultural commodity being transported. Enables end-to-end traceability from farm to table and supports recall management.
attributes.references: FSMA Food Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1; GLOBALG.A.P.; GS1 Traceability Standards; USDA AMS

attributes.name: mode_of_transport
attributes.description: Primary transportation mode used for this freight booking. Determines applicable regulatory requirements, documentation (BOL vs AWB), and rate structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management; IATA; USDOT

attributes.name: pickup_appointment_timestamp
attributes.description: Confirmed date and time of the scheduled pickup appointment at the origin location. Used for dock scheduling and carrier arrival coordination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the booked quantity. Agricultural-specific units include Bushel (BU), Hundredweight (CWT), and Metric Ton (MT) for bulk commodities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|MT|BU|CWT|PAL|EA|CS — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Unit of Measure

attributes.name: rate_basis
attributes.description: Unit basis on which the freight rate is applied. Determines how total freight charges are calculated from the rate and booked quantity or distance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management; NMFC Freight Classification

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) tag identifier associated with the shipment for real-time traceability tracking throughout the supply chain. Supports lot-level traceability per FSMA Traceability Rule.
attributes.references: FSMA Food Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1; GS1 RFID Standards; EPC Global

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Service tier contracted for this booking, defining transit time commitments and priority handling. Spot bookings are ad-hoc market-rate engagements outside contracted lanes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for carrier-specific handling instructions, including loading sequence requirements, fragile cargo notes, PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval) compliance notes, or customer-specific delivery requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Transportation Management; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold chain compliance during transport. Paired with minimum temperature to define the acceptable cold chain range for perishable goods.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Code; HACCP Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold chain compliance during transport. Mandatory for perishable agricultural products under FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Code; HACCP Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: total_freight_amount
attributes.description: Net total freight cost for this booking, calculated as base freight amount plus all accessorial charges. Used for COGS allocation, OPEX reporting, and carrier invoice reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module - Cost Accounting; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this freight booking record was most recently modified.
attributes.references: ISO 22000; FSMA Food Safety Modernization Act - Record Keeping Requirements

Mandatory for FSMA food safety traceability and COOL compliance.

attributes.name: origin_location_code

attributes.name: pallet_count
attributes.description: Number of pallets included in the shipment. Used for trailer space planning, dock scheduling, and warehouse receiving operations in Manhattan Associates WMS.

attributes.name: payment_method

attributes.description: Carrier-assigned Progressive (PRO) number used to track the shipment within the carrier's system. Distinct from the BOL number; used for freight claims, shipment tracing, and carrier invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: required_temp_min_c

products.name: lot_trace

Single authoritative record for lot-level supply chain traceability supporting FSMA Section 204 food traceability rule, GLOBALG.A.P. chain of custody, and one-up/one-back recall response.

attributes.name: route_id

attributes.name: service_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent freight contract or rate agreement under which this rate schedule is established. Supports contract lifecycle management and volume commitment tracking.
