attributes.name: base_rate
attributes.description: The contracted base freight rate amount, expressed in the unit defined by rate_type (e.g., USD per mile, USD per CWT, USD per MT, USD per BU, or flat USD amount). This is the principal monetary fact for the rate record, excluding fuel surcharge and accessorial charges. Used as the foundation for freight cost estimation and carrier invoice audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Condition Amount; GAAP; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: commitment_discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the base rate when the contracted volume commitment tier is met or exceeded. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 = 5% discount). Incentivizes volume commitment with carriers and 3PLs for agricultural commodity lanes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Condition Discount; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this freight rate record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial reporting controls. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - Internal Controls; GAAP Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the freight rate is denominated (e.g., USD for US Dollar, CAD for Canadian Dollar, EUR for Euro). Required for multi-currency freight cost estimation and financial reporting under GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the destination of the freight lane. Required for export documentation, customs compliance, and international freight rate applicability.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; USDA COOL Regulations; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: destination_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code of the destination point for the freight lane. Used for lane-level rate matching in TMS when a specific facility ID is not available. Supports zone-based and mileage-based rate calculations.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standard; TMS Lane Rate Management

attributes.name: detention_rate_per_hour
attributes.description: Accessorial charge rate applied per hour when a carrier's equipment is detained beyond the contracted free time at origin or destination. A key component of the accessorial rate schedule for agricultural commodity shipments where loading/unloading delays are common.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Accessorial Condition; Carrier Tariff - Detention/Demurrage Rules

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this freight rate becomes binding and applicable for freight cost estimation and carrier selection. Aligns with contract start date in carrier agreements. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Condition Record Validity Start; GAAP Contract Accounting

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of transportation equipment required for this rate. Refrigerated (reefer) equipment is required for cold chain management of perishable agricultural commodities. Hopper trailers are used for bulk grain. Tankers for liquid commodities. Critical for cold chain compliance under FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O); SAP S/4HANA TM Equipment Type

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this freight rate is no longer valid for new shipment cost estimation. Null indicates an open-ended rate with no defined expiration. Retained post-expiry for freight audit variance analysis. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Condition Record Validity End; GAAP Contract Accounting

attributes.name: free_time_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours of free loading/unloading time included in the base rate before detention charges begin to accrue. Standard free time for agricultural commodity shipments is typically 2 hours. Critical for managing detention/demurrage cost exposure at grain elevators and processing facilities.
attributes.references: Carrier Tariff - Detention Rules; SAP S/4HANA TM Freight Agreement

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Contractual freight payment terms defining who bears the freight cost and when title transfers. FOB (Free On Board) origin and destination are standard agricultural commodity trade terms. Prepaid = shipper pays; Collect = consignee pays; Third Party = billed to a third party. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA SD billing and SAP MM purchasing conditions.
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020 (ICC); SAP S/4HANA SD - Freight Terms; GAAP

attributes.name: fsma_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this freight rate is associated with a carrier that has been verified as compliant with the FSMA Sanitary Transportation of Human and Animal Food Rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O). True = carrier has confirmed FSMA compliance for this lane and equipment type. Required for food safety audit and carrier qualification.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) - Sanitary Transportation Rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O)

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_formula
attributes.description: Description or formula code defining how the fuel surcharge is calculated, typically indexed to the US Department of Energy (DOE) weekly diesel retail price index. Examples: 'DOE_TABLE_LOOKUP', 'DOE_PERCENT_OF_BASE', 'FIXED_CPM' (cents per mile). Drives dynamic fuel surcharge computation in TMS freight cost estimation.
attributes.references: US Department of Energy (DOE) Diesel Retail Price Index; SAP S/4HANA MM Condition Supplement

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_rate
attributes.description: The current or baseline fuel surcharge rate expressed as a percentage of the base rate or as a fixed amount per mile (depending on fuel_surcharge_formula). Updated periodically based on DOE index triggers. Used in freight cost estimation and carrier invoice audit.
attributes.references: US Department of Energy (DOE) Diesel Retail Price Index; SAP S/4HANA MM Condition Rate

attributes.name: lane_distance_miles
attributes.description: Contracted or calculated mileage for the origin-destination freight lane. Used for per-mile rate calculations, fuel surcharge computation, and route optimization analysis. Typically derived from PC*MILER or equivalent mileage engine integrated with TMS.
attributes.references: PC*MILER Mileage Standard; SAP S/4HANA TM - Distance Calculation

attributes.name: lumper_rate
attributes.description: Accessorial charge for lumper (third-party unloading labor) services at destination facilities such as food manufacturer warehouses and retail distribution centers. Included in the accessorial rate schedule when the carrier is responsible for arranging unloading labor.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Accessorial Condition; Manhattan Associates WMS - Receiving Labor

attributes.name: minimum_charge
attributes.description: The minimum freight charge applicable regardless of shipment weight, volume, or distance. Ensures carrier cost recovery for small or short-haul shipments. Applied during freight cost estimation when the calculated base rate falls below this threshold.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Minimum Condition Value; Carrier Tariff Standards

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the origin of the freight lane. Required for cross-border agricultural commodity movements and Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) Regulations

attributes.name: origin_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code of the origin point for the freight lane. Used for lane-level rate matching in TMS when a specific facility ID is not available. Supports zone-based and mileage-based rate calculations.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standard; TMS Lane Rate Management

attributes.name: rate_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the freight rate record, used in carrier negotiations, freight audit, and SAP S/4HANA condition record references. Enables cross-system traceability between TMS, ERP, and carrier portals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Condition Record Number; TMS Rate Management

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the freight rate record. Active rates are available for freight cost estimation and carrier selection. Expired rates are retained for freight audit variance analysis against historical invoices. Pending rates are awaiting carrier confirmation. Suspended rates are temporarily unavailable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Condition Record Status; TMS Rate Management

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the freight rate is calculated and applied. Per mile applies to truckload movements; per CWT (Hundredweight) and per MT (Metric Ton) apply to weight-based commodity pricing; per BU (Bushel) applies to grain and oilseed movements; flat rate applies to fixed-price lane agreements. Drives freight cost estimation logic in TMS.
attributes.references: NMFC (National Motor Freight Classification); SAP S/4HANA MM Condition Type

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this freight rate record originated. SAP_S4HANA indicates the rate was created in SAP S/4HANA MM condition records; TMS indicates origin from the Transportation Management System; MANUAL indicates direct entry. Supports data lineage and freight audit traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Condition Record; Oracle NetSuite Procurement

attributes.name: stop_off_charge
attributes.description: Accessorial charge applied for each additional stop beyond the primary origin-destination pair on a multi-stop shipment. Common in agricultural distribution routes serving multiple farm locations or delivery points. Part of the accessorial rate schedule.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Accessorial Condition; NMFTA Tariff Rules

attributes.name: temp_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold chain shipments covered by this rate. Applicable to refrigerated equipment rates for perishable agricultural commodities. Enforces FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule cold chain requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O); FDA Food Safety Regulations; ISO 22000

attributes.name: temp_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum required temperature in degrees Celsius for cold chain shipments covered by this rate. Applicable to refrigerated equipment rates for perishable agricultural commodities (produce, dairy, meat). Enforces FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule cold chain requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O); FDA Food Safety Regulations; ISO 22000

attributes.name: transit_days
attributes.description: Contracted standard transit time in calendar days for the origin-destination lane at this rate. Used for delivery scheduling, cold chain management planning, and carrier service level evaluation. Critical for perishable agricultural commodity shipments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM - Transit Time; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation for which this freight rate applies. Truckload (TL) and less-than-truckload (LTL) are primary modes for domestic agricultural commodity movements; rail and intermodal for bulk grain; ocean for export; air for high-value perishables. Aligns with BOL and AWB documentation requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM - Freight Order; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this freight rate record was last modified. Supports change tracking, freight audit variance analysis, and Silver Layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - Internal Controls; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: volume_tier_max
attributes.description: Maximum contracted volume (in the unit defined by rate_type) applicable for this rate tier. Null indicates no upper bound. Defines the upper boundary of the volume commitment tier for tiered discount rate structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Scale Quantity; Carrier Contract Volume Commitment

attributes.name: volume_tier_min
attributes.description: Minimum contracted volume commitment (in the unit defined by rate_type, e.g., CWT, MT, BU, or number of loads) required to qualify for this rate tier. Supports volume-based discount structures in carrier contracts. Used for commitment tracking and carrier performance management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Scale Quantity; Carrier Contract Volume Commitment

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the volume tier commitment quantities (volume_tier_min, volume_tier_max). Aligns with the rate_type unit. CWT (Hundredweight), MT (Metric Ton), and BU (Bushel) are standard agricultural commodity units. Ensures consistent volume commitment tracking across carrier contracts.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service - Commodity Units; SAP S/4HANA MM - Unit of Measure

Single authoritative record for logistics service agreements within the supply domain — distinct from procurement input supply contracts owned by the procurement domain.

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: SSOT for all agricultural inventory positions across grain bins, cold storage, warehouses, and field stockpiles. Tracks commodity lots (LOT/GRN), quantities in CWT, BU, and MT, storage location assignments, FIFO/FEFO rotation, shrinkage, expiration dates (PHI), stock rotation, and WMS-driven cycle counts. Manages seed, chemical, fertilizer, and harvested commodity stock levels with SAP S/4HANA MM and Manhattan Associates WMS integration. Ensures GRN processing and inventory accuracy for supply chain continuity.
domains.references: FSMA Preventive Controls, SAP MM / WMS Standards

products.name: stock_position
products.description: Core master record of current inventory positions across all agricultural storage locations (grain bins, cold storage, warehouses, field stockpiles). Tracks on-hand, reserved, and available-to-promise quantities in CWT, BU, and MT by material, commodity lot, and location. Includes stock type (unrestricted, quality inspection, blocked), valuation class, unit price, total value, and valuation method (standard cost, moving average, FIFO). Supports period-end valuation snapshots capturing valuation date, quantity, unit price, total value in USD, price variance, and SAP accounting document reference for GAAP/IFRS inventory valuation, COGS calculation, and commodity position reporting. Serves as the SSOT for real-time stock levels, inventory valuation, and period-end financial inventory reporting. Supports GS1 GTIN and SSCC identifiers for global supply chain interoperability. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA MM and Manhattan Associates WMS.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the goods receipt record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: crop_season
attributes.description: Agricultural crop season or marketing year associated with the harvested commodity (e.g., '2024-2025'). Used for seasonal inventory segregation, WASDE reporting alignment, and crop year cost accounting.
attributes.references: USDA WASDE; USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA); Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: crop_variety
attributes.description: Specific crop variety or cultivar of the harvested commodity received (e.g., 'Pioneer P1197AM', 'Asgrow AG36X6'). Supports variety-level traceability, seed performance tracking, and GMO segregation requirements.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; GLOBALG.A.P.; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling)

attributes.name: elevator_ticket_number
attributes.description: Grain elevator scale ticket number issued at the point of harvest intake. Captures the official weight and grade determination at the elevator. Applicable to harvest receipt types only.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Inspection, Packers and Stockyards Administration (GIPSA); FSMA Section 204

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration or best-before date for the received material. Mandatory for seed, chemical, and fertilizer inputs. Drives FEFO lot rotation and shelf-life compliance. Null for bulk grain commodities without defined shelf life.
attributes.references: EPA Pesticide Registration; USDA NOP; GLOBALG.A.P.; SAP S/4HANA MM - Shelf Life

attributes.name: fifo_fefo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the stock rotation method applied to this receipt for lot assignment and inventory consumption sequencing. FIFO is standard for grain commodities; FEFO is applied for seed, chemical, and fertilizer inputs with expiration dates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Batch Determination; FSMA Section 204; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: grade_determination
attributes.description: Official USDA grade assigned to the received commodity based on test weight, moisture, damage, and other grade factors per USDA GIPSA Official Grain Standards. Drives pricing, storage assignment, and end-use routing.
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA Official Grain Standards of the United States; 7 U.S.C. § 71-87k

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the received shipment in kilograms, including packaging and container weight. Used in conjunction with tare weight to calculate net commodity weight.
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA Grain Weighing Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) identifying the received material at the trade item level. Supports GS1 standards-based supply chain traceability and FSMA Section 204 compliance.
attributes.references: GS1 Standards; FSMA Section 204; EU General Food Law Regulation 178/2002

attributes.name: harvest_date
attributes.description: Date on which the crop was harvested in the field prior to intake. Populated for harvest receipt types only. Supports FSMA Section 204 traceability linking field harvest events to inventory lot creation.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204; EU General Food Law Regulation 178/2002; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: is_gmo
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received commodity is a Genetically Modified Organism (GMO) or contains GMO material. Critical for identity preservation, segregation, labeling compliance, and export market eligibility.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003; GLOBALG.A.P.; COOL

attributes.name: is_organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received material is certified organic under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP) or equivalent certification. Drives segregated storage, premium pricing, and organic chain-of-custody documentation.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) - 7 CFR Part 205; IFOAM Organic Standards

attributes.name: migo_document_number
attributes.description: SAP goods movement document number generated by the MIGO transaction upon posting the goods receipt. Used for financial posting reconciliation and audit trail back to SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Material Document (MKPF/MSEG)

attributes.name: moisture_pct
attributes.description: Moisture content of the received commodity expressed as a percentage, measured at intake. Critical for grain quality grading, shrinkage calculation, storage condition assignment, and USDA grade determination.
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA Official Grain Standards; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 6540 (Maize moisture)

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Net commodity weight in kilograms, calculated as gross weight minus tare weight. Represents the actual quantity of commodity received for inventory posting.
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA Grain Weighing Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: po_line_number
attributes.description: Line item number within the originating Purchase Order (PO) against which this receipt is posted. Enables partial receipt tracking and PO line-level quantity reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchase Order Item (EKPO-EBELP)

attributes.name: quantity_bu
attributes.description: Received quantity expressed in Bushels (BU), the standard unit of measure for grain commodities in North American agricultural markets. Used for commodity trading, WASDE reporting, and inventory valuation.
attributes.references: USDA WASDE; USDA GIPSA; SAP S/4HANA MM - Unit of Measure

attributes.name: quantity_cwt
attributes.description: Received quantity expressed in Hundredweight (CWT), used for livestock feed, fertilizer, and certain commodity inventory positions. Supports multi-unit inventory management.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; SAP S/4HANA MM - Unit of Measure

attributes.name: quantity_mt
attributes.description: Received quantity expressed in Metric Tons (MT), used for international trade, export documentation, and global supply chain reporting.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius Commission; EU General Food Law Regulation 178/2002; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the goods were physically received at the facility. Used for FIFO/FEFO lot rotation, aging calculations, and regulatory traceability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Posting Date (MKPF-BUDAT); FSMA Section 204

attributes.name: receipt_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods receipt record. Drives downstream inventory posting, quality inspection workflow, and lot assignment. Rejected receipts trigger return-to-vendor or disposition processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Quality Inspection; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the goods receipt was recorded in the system. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for audit, traceability, and WMS integration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MIGO Posting Timestamp; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: receipt_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receipt event: purchase (supplier delivery against PO), harvest (field intake from crop operations), return (customer return), or transfer (inter-facility stock movement). Determines processing workflow and traceability requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Movement Type (MSEG-BWART); FSMA Section 204

attributes.name: sscc
attributes.description: GS1 Serial Shipping Container Code (SSCC) for shipment-level tracking of the received pallet or container. Enables end-to-end supply chain traceability from supplier to storage bin.
attributes.references: GS1 Standards; FSMA Section 204; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: tare_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of the empty container, truck, or packaging in kilograms. Subtracted from gross weight to determine net commodity weight at intake.
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA Grain Weighing Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: test_weight_lb_bu
attributes.description: Test weight of the received grain commodity expressed in pounds per bushel (lb/bu). A key USDA grade factor indicating grain density and quality. Used for grade determination and pricing adjustments.
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA Official Grain Standards of the United States

attributes.name: uom_primary
attributes.description: Primary unit of measure in which the received quantity is officially recorded for inventory posting. Determines which quantity field (BU, CWT, MT, KG) is the authoritative inventory position.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Base Unit of Measure (MARA-MEINS); ISO 80000-1

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the goods receipt record. Supports change data capture (CDC) and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting Controls; FSMA Section 204

products.name: goods_issue
products.description: Transactional record of all inventory withdrawals and outbound goods movements including shipments to customers, internal consumption, field application of agricultural inputs (seeds, fertilizers NPK, crop protection chemicals, feed), livestock feed issuance, and production orders. Captures goods issue document number, movement type (shipment, consumption, field_application, feed_issuance, production), material with GS1 GTIN/SSCC, lot, quantity in CWT/BU/MT, issuing location, destination or field/pen of application, operator, equipment used, VRA prescription reference, application rate, REI/PHI compliance flag per EPA WPS, cost center, sales order or production order reference, and SAP movement document. Serves as the SSOT for all inventory consumption including field input application. Supports FIFO/FEFO depletion, IPM tracking, MRL compliance per EU Regulation 396/2005 and Codex Alimentarius, and COGS allocation.

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Document Creation; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost valuation (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL). Supports multi-currency operations for international agricultural trading entities.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI - Currency Configuration

attributes.name: destination_reference
attributes.description: Business identifier of the destination entity receiving the goods: field ID, pen number, customer delivery address code, production order number, or cost center code. Provides operational traceability to the point of consumption or application.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD/PP; John Deere Operations Center - Field Mapping; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: destination_type
attributes.description: Classification of the destination receiving the issued goods: agricultural field (for input application), livestock pen (for feed issuance), customer (for sales delivery), production order, cost center (internal consumption), project, or scrap. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: field|pen|customer|production_order|cost_center|project|scrap — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD/PP; GLOBALG.A.P.; IPM Framework

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP material document number generated upon posting the goods issue (movement type 201, 261, 601, etc.). Serves as the primary business identifier for audit and traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Material Document (MIGO/MBST)

attributes.name: grn_number
attributes.description: Goods Receipt Note (GRN) number from the originating inbound receipt, linking the goods issue back to the original procurement receipt for full supply chain traceability and COGS matching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Goods Receipt (MIGO); FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN-14) identifying the material at the trade item level. Supports supply chain traceability, MRL compliance verification, and FSMA Traceability Rule requirements.
attributes.references: GS1 Standards; FSMA Traceability Rule (21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S); EU Regulation 396/2005

attributes.name: is_gmo
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issued material is a Genetically Modified Organism (GMO). Required for identity preservation programs, COOL (Country of Origin Labeling), EU GMO labeling regulations, and non-GMO certification compliance.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; EU Regulation 1829/2003; COOL; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: is_organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issued material is certified organic under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). Ensures organic integrity is maintained through the supply chain and prevents co-mingling with conventional materials.
attributes.references: USDA NOP (7 CFR Part 205); GLOBALG.A.P. Organic; ISO 22000

attributes.name: issue_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods issue document: draft (not yet posted), posted (inventory deducted), reversed (corrected via reversal document), cancelled, or pending_approval (awaiting authorization for restricted materials).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Document Status; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: issue_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the goods issue was posted and inventory was physically withdrawn or applied. This is the principal business event timestamp used for FIFO/FEFO depletion sequencing and COGS recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Posting Date; GAAP Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the material being issued (e.g., 'Glyphosate 41% Herbicide', 'Urea 46-0-0 Fertilizer', 'Pioneer P1197AM Corn Seed', 'Corn #2 Yellow Dent').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Material Master Description

attributes.name: movement_category
attributes.description: Business-level classification of the goods issue purpose: shipment to customer, internal consumption, field application of agricultural inputs (seeds/NPK fertilizers/crop protection chemicals), livestock feed issuance, production order issue, quality sample, or inventory write-off. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shipment|consumption|field_application|feed_issuance|production|sample|write_off — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; GLOBALG.A.P.; IPM Framework

attributes.name: movement_type_code
attributes.description: SAP MM movement type code governing the inventory transaction (e.g., 201=cost center consumption, 261=production order issue, 601=customer delivery, 281=project issue). Drives accounting entries and stock depletion logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Movement Types (OMJJ)

attributes.name: phi_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the goods issue of a crop protection chemical complies with the Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) — the minimum number of days required between last application and harvest. True = compliant; False = PHI violation requiring corrective action.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; EU Regulation 396/2005; GLOBALG.A.P.; Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting period date on which the goods issue is recognized in the general ledger for COGS allocation. May differ from issue_timestamp when backdating is required for period-end close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Posting Date; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: production_order_number
attributes.description: SAP Production Order number linked to this goods issue when materials are issued to a manufacturing or processing order (movement type 261). Supports production cost tracking and yield analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Production Order; GAAP; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: quantity_issued
attributes.description: The quantity of material withdrawn from inventory in the primary unit of measure (UOM). This is the principal quantitative fact of the goods issue transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Quantity Fields; USDA Commodity Measurement Standards

attributes.name: quantity_issued_mt
attributes.description: Issued quantity normalized to Metric Tons (MT) for cross-commodity analytics, WASDE reporting alignment, and international trade compliance. Derived from quantity_issued and uom at ingestion.
attributes.references: USDA WASDE; Codex Alimentarius; IFRS Commodity Reporting

attributes.name: rei_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the goods issue and field application of a pesticide complies with the Restricted Entry Interval (REI) per EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS). True = compliant; False = REI violation requiring immediate safety response.
attributes.references: EPA WPS (40 CFR Part 170); OSHA; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: SAP material document number of the reversal posting (movement type 202, 262, etc.) if this goods issue was reversed. Null if no reversal has been posted. Supports audit trail and inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Document Reversal (MBST); SOX; GAAP

attributes.name: total_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total COGS value of the goods issue (quantity_issued × unit_cost_usd). Used for cost center allocation, production order costing, and financial period-end close. Stored as a raw transactional value, not a derived KPI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - COGS Posting; GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: unit_cost_usd
attributes.description: Standard or moving average cost per unit of measure at the time of goods issue, used for COGS valuation. Sourced from SAP material valuation (standard price or MAP).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Product Costing; GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: Primary unit of measure for the issued quantity. Agricultural commodities use CWT (Hundredweight), BU (Bushel), or MT (Metric Ton); chemicals/fertilizers use KG, LB, L, or GAL; seeds use BAG or EA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CWT|BU|MT|KG|LB|L|GAL|EA|BAG|TON — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Unit of Measure; USDA AMS; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this goods issue record in the Silver Layer (e.g., status update, reversal flag, compliance flag recalculation). Supports data lineage and audit requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; SOX; GDPR Article 5; Databricks Delta Lake

attributes.name: wms_task_number
attributes.description: Manhattan Associates WMS task or transfer order number associated with this goods issue, enabling end-to-end warehouse operation traceability from pick task to inventory deduction.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Transfer Orders; SAP S/4HANA EWM Integration

products.name: stock_transfer
products.description: Transactional record of inventory movements between storage locations, bins, warehouses, or facilities. Captures transfer order number, source location, destination location, material with GS1 GTIN/SSCC, lot, quantity in CWT/BU/MT, transfer type (bin-to-bin, plant-to-plant, warehouse transfer), WMS transfer order reference, BOL number for inter-facility transfers, carrier, estimated transit time, and transfer reason. Integrates with Manhattan Associates WMS transfer order management and SAP MM stock transport orders.
products.reference: SAP MM / WMS Transfer Order

attributes.description: Expected number of days for the material to travel from source to destination facility. Used for in-transit inventory planning, supply chain continuity, and carrier performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: goods_issue_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the goods issue was posted in SAP S/4HANA MM, recording the moment inventory was decremented from the source location. Critical for real-time inventory accuracy and audit trails.

attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the goods receipt was posted at the destination location in SAP S/4HANA MM or confirmed in Manhattan Associates WMS. Marks the completion of the transfer and inventory increment at destination.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (14-digit) identifying the product being transferred. Supports GS1 supply chain standards, COOL compliance, and interoperability with trading partners and regulatory systems.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL); FDA FSMA

attributes.name: is_inter_company
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stock transfer crosses legal entity or company code boundaries, triggering inter-company billing and financial settlement processes in SAP FI/CO. True for transfers between separate legal entities; False for intra-company movements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Inter-Company Posting; IFRS 10; GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or instructions associated with the stock transfer, such as special handling requirements, temperature conditions, or regulatory remarks. Captured by warehouse or logistics personnel.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: qty_transferred
attributes.description: The quantity of material being transferred, expressed in the primary unit of measure (UOM). This is the principal quantitative fact of the transfer transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; USDA Commodity Measurement Standards

attributes.name: qty_transferred_mt
attributes.description: Transferred quantity normalized to Metric Tons (MT) for cross-commodity comparison, international reporting, and WASDE-aligned analytics. Derived from qty_transferred and uom at ingestion time.
attributes.references: USDA WASDE; Codex Alimentarius; ISO 80000-4 (Quantities and Units)

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a quality inspection (QM inspection lot) must be completed upon goods receipt at the destination before the transferred stock is released to unrestricted use. Supports HACCP and food safety compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; HACCP; FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF

attributes.name: rotation_method
attributes.description: Stock rotation method applied to select the lot for this transfer. FIFO (First In First Out) is standard for grain commodities; FEFO (First Expired First Out) is applied for perishables and seed with expiration dates. Ensures compliance with food safety and quality standards.
attributes.references: FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF; BRC Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Determination

attributes.name: sap_movement_type
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA MM movement type code governing the inventory posting logic for this transfer (e.g., 311 for storage location transfer, 641 for STO goods issue, 101 for goods receipt). Determines accounting entries and stock update behavior.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Movement Type Configuration

attributes.name: sap_sto_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA MM stock transport order document number associated with this inter-plant or inter-facility transfer. Enables reconciliation with SAP financial and materials management postings.

attributes.name: sscc

attributes.name: transfer_date

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS Transfer Order Management

attributes.name: transfer_priority

attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Task Management; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: transfer_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for initiating the stock transfer, such as stock rebalancing, FIFO/FEFO rotation enforcement, quality hold relocation, consolidation, replenishment, or pre-shipment staging. Supports audit and operational reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; FSMA Traceability Rule; GLOBALG.A.P.

Drives routing logic and documentation requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bin_to_bin|plant_to_plant|warehouse_transfer|storage_location_transfer|cross_dock|field_to_bin — promote to reference product]

Supports inventory accuracy KPI tracking and triggers inventory_adjustment records for confirmed variances.

Captures nonconformance type (product, process, system, MRL_exceedance, food_safety_incident), severity level (minor, major, critical, food_safety_crisis), affected lot, commodity or product SKU, detection point and source. For standard nonconformances: disposition decision, financial impact estimate, regulatory notification flag. For MRL-type: pesticide active ingredient, detected residue level, applicable MRL standard (EPA, EU, Codex), exceedance magnitude, affected export market. For food safety incidents: incident subtype (contamination, foreign material, allergen, pathogen, chemical), hazard classification, recall class (I, II, III), mock recall flag, affected quantity and value, regulatory agencies notified, root cause category, and incident closure status. SSOT for ALL quality failures from minor process deviations through food safety crises, recalls, and market withdrawals.

attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius CAC/RCP 1-1969; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FDA 21 CFR Part 110

attributes.name: pesticide_residue_result_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pesticide Residue Test Result (Parts Per Million)
attributes.description: Measured pesticide residue concentration in parts per million (ppm). Compared against EPA-established Maximum Residue Limits (MRL) and Codex Alimentarius MRL tables for regulatory compliance and export eligibility.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180 — Tolerances for Pesticide Residues; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; EU Regulation 396/2005

attributes.name: phi_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) was observed between the last pesticide application and harvest date. True = PHI observed; False = potential PHI violation. Verified against protection_event records.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA — Federal Insecticide Fungicide and Rodenticide Act; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6 CB 7.4; USDA GAP Audit Standards

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the commodity or product as it appears on the COA document, including variety, grade, or specification designation where applicable.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Grading Standards; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) 7 CFR Part 60

attributes.name: protein_pct
attributes.description: Measured protein content of the commodity expressed as a percentage of dry weight. Key nutritional and commercial quality parameter for grain, feed, and food ingredient specifications.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Grain Grading Standards; AOAC International Method 990.03

attributes.name: release_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lot covered by this COA has been approved for customer shipment and commercial release. 'blocked' prevents order fulfillment in SAP SD. Distinct from coa_status which tracks the document lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Usage Decision Stock Posting; FSMA Preventive Controls 21 CFR Part 117

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date on which laboratory analysis was performed on the sample. Used to determine result validity windows and compliance with regulatory testing timelines.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Inspection Lot Results Recording; FDA 21 CFR Part 111

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this COA record. Supports audit trail requirements and change management tracking for regulatory documentation integrity.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 Subpart F — Records; ISO 22000:2018 Section 7.5 — Documented Information; SOX Section 404

products.name: lab_sample
products.description: Laboratory sample submission and tracking records for all quality testing activities. Captures sample collection point (field, bin, processing line, receiving dock), sample type (grain, soil, water, tissue, feed, environmental swab), collection date/time, chain of custody, assigned laboratory, requested test panel, sample condition at receipt, and disposition after testing. Includes testing protocol metadata: sampling plan reference, sampling frequency, approved analytical methods, test parameters, and acceptance criteria. Supports field-to-COA traceability, FSMA sampling plan compliance, and HACCP verification sampling.
products.reference: FSMA Sampling Plan / HACCP Sampling Record

attributes.name: analytical_method_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the approved analytical method used for testing this sample (e.g., AOAC 2007.01 for pesticide residues, EPA Method 8270 for organics, USDA FSIS MLG for microbiology). Ensures regulatory acceptance of test results and supports method validation documentation.
attributes.references: AOAC International Official Methods; EPA Analytical Methods; USDA FSIS Microbiology Laboratory Guidebook (MLG); FDA BAM

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the chain-of-custody document accompanying this sample from collection through laboratory receipt. Provides legal defensibility for test results and supports FSMA traceability and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: FSMA Subpart O; EPA Chain of Custody Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6 CB 7.6

attributes.name: coa_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Certificate of Analysis (COA) issued by the laboratory upon completion of testing. The COA is the primary quality document used for product release, customer delivery, and regulatory compliance. Aligns with COA business jargon.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.194; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code Edition 9; BRC Global Standard Issue 9

attributes.name: collection_point_description
attributes.description: Specific description of the exact collection point within the facility or field (e.g., 'North field block 3, row 12', 'Bin 7 - top layer', 'Processing Line 2 - post-wash CCP'). Provides granular traceability beyond the collection point type classification.
attributes.references: FSMA Subpart O; HACCP Verification Sampling Documentation

attributes.name: collection_point_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical location or process stage where the sample was collected. Supports field-to-COA traceability and HACCP critical control point mapping. Values: field (in-crop collection), bin (grain storage), processing_line (in-process), receiving_dock (incoming goods), storage (warehouse), transport (in-transit).
attributes.references: HACCP Critical Control Point (CCP) Framework; FSMA Preventive Controls; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sample was physically collected from the collection point. The principal real-world event time for this transaction. Critical for chain-of-custody integrity, PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval) compliance verification, and FSMA traceability records.
attributes.references: FSMA Subpart O; HACCP Chain of Custody; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6 CB 7.6

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the lab sample record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Data Integrity Controls; FSMA Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: disposition_action
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the physical sample material after testing is complete. Released: sample returned or discarded per protocol after passing; Quarantined: held pending further investigation; Destroyed: sample destroyed per biohazard or regulatory protocol; Returned: sample returned to submitter; Resampled: additional sampling required.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Usage Decision; ISO/IEC 17025 Section 7.4.4; FSMA Sample Retention Requirements

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the final disposition action was executed for the physical sample material. Required for sample retention compliance and laboratory space management.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Section 7.4.4; FSMA Record Retention; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: fsma_sampling_plan_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Sampling Plan Reference
attributes.description: Reference code or document identifier for the FSMA-compliant sampling plan under which this sample was collected. Supports FDA inspection readiness and FSMA Subpart O environmental monitoring and food safety plan documentation. Aligns with FSMA business jargon.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 Subpart C; FDA Food Safety Plan Builder; FSMA Subpart O

attributes.name: gfsi_scheme_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Scheme Code
attributes.description: Identifies the GFSI-benchmarked certification scheme under which this sample was collected or is being used to demonstrate compliance. Supports certification audit readiness for SQF, BRC, IFS, and GLOBALG.A.P. schemes. Aligns with GFSI, SQF, BRC, IFS business jargons.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements v2020; SQF Code Edition 9; BRC Global Standard Issue 9; IFS Food Version 7; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6

attributes.name: haccp_ccp_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sample was collected as part of HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points) critical control point monitoring or verification activities. True requires enhanced documentation and regulatory retention per FSMA Preventive Controls rule. Aligns with HACCP business jargon.
attributes.references: HACCP Principle 4 - Monitoring CCPs; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 Subpart C; Codex Alimentarius HACCP Guidelines

attributes.name: mrl_exceedance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any test parameter in this sample exceeded the applicable Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) as defined by EPA, Codex Alimentarius, or customer specification. True triggers non-conformance workflow and regulatory notification procedures. Aligns with MRL business jargon.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180 - Pesticide Tolerances; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; EU Regulation 396/2005

attributes.name: overall_result
attributes.description: Consolidated pass/fail determination for the sample based on all test parameters in the requested panel against defined acceptance criteria. Pass: all parameters within specification; Fail: one or more parameters exceeded MRL or acceptance threshold; Inconclusive: results require further review; Pending: testing not yet complete.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Usage Decision; HACCP CCP Acceptance Criteria; MRL (Maximum Residue Limit) Compliance

attributes.name: phi_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sample collection date was verified to be after the required Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) for any applied crop protection products. True confirms PHI compliance at time of sampling. Critical for pesticide residue MRL compliance. Aligns with PHI business jargon.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA PHI Requirements; USDA AMS Pesticide Data Program; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6 CB 7.6.4

attributes.name: received_at_lab_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sample was officially received and logged at the testing laboratory. Used to calculate sample transit time, assess sample integrity, and enforce holding time limits per analytical method requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Section 7.4 - Sample Handling; FDA Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: required_completion_date
attributes.description: Target date by which laboratory testing and result reporting must be completed. Drives laboratory scheduling, SLA monitoring, and release-hold decisions for production lots awaiting quality clearance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Inspection Deadline; HACCP Verification Turnaround Requirements

attributes.name: results_released_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the laboratory officially released the test results and COA. Marks the completion of the testing lifecycle and triggers downstream quality disposition workflows in SAP QM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Usage Decision Timestamp; ISO/IEC 17025 Section 7.8

attributes.name: sample_condition
attributes.description: Assessment of the physical condition of the sample upon receipt at the laboratory. Acceptable: sample integrity maintained; Compromised: minor integrity issues noted but testing may proceed with caveats; Rejected: sample integrity failed, testing cannot proceed. Drives chain-of-custody decisions.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Section 7.4.2 - Sample Condition Assessment; FSMA Chain of Custody

attributes.name: sample_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations, anomalies, or contextual information recorded at the time of sample collection or receipt. Captures field conditions, equipment calibration notes, or deviations from standard sampling protocol that may affect result interpretation.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Section 7.4.2; HACCP Monitoring Records; FSMA Preventive Controls Documentation

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier assigned to the sample at collection or submission. Used for chain-of-custody documentation, COA traceability, and communication with external laboratories. Follows enterprise sample numbering convention (e.g., LAB-2024-000123).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module - Inspection Lot Number; FSMA Subpart O Sampling Plan

attributes.name: sample_quantity
attributes.description: Measured quantity of material collected for the sample (e.g., weight in grams, volume in milliliters). Used to verify adequacy of sample size per analytical method requirements and sampling plan specifications.
attributes.references: AOAC Sampling Procedures; SAP S/4HANA QM - Sample Quantity; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: sample_quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the sample quantity field. Standard units include grams (g), kilograms (kg), milliliters (mL), liters (L), milligrams (mg), and ounces (oz). Must align with the unit specified in the analytical method.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Unit of Measure; ISO/IEC 17025 Section 7.4

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the laboratory sample from submission through disposition. Drives workflow routing in SAP QM and laboratory tracking systems. Values: submitted (collected and logged), received (confirmed at lab), in_testing (analysis underway), completed (results available), rejected (sample failed receipt criteria), disposed (sample destroyed or returned per protocol).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module - Usage Decision; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical material collected for laboratory analysis. Determines applicable analytical methods, acceptance criteria, and regulatory reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grain|soil|water|tissue|feed|environmental_swab|air|product — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA AMS Sampling Procedures; FDA FSMA Environmental Monitoring; HACCP CCP Classification

attributes.name: sampling_frequency_code
attributes.description: Classification of why this sample was collected relative to the sampling plan schedule. Routine: scheduled periodic sampling; Triggered: collected in response to an event or non-conformance; Regulatory: mandated by USDA/FDA/EPA inspection; Verification: HACCP verification sampling; Validation: process or method validation sampling.
attributes.references: HACCP Principle 6 - Verification; FSMA Preventive Controls Verification; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius at which the sample was stored during transit and prior to analysis. Critical for maintaining sample integrity for microbiological and chemical analyses. Deviations may invalidate results per ISO/IEC 17025 requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Section 7.4.2; FDA BAM Chapter 1 - Sample Handling; HACCP Cold Chain

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the lab sample record. Supports incremental data processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Data Integrity Controls; ISO 22000 Record Management

attributes.name: action_limit
attributes.description: Internal or regulatory action threshold below the MRL that triggers corrective action or investigation before the regulatory limit is breached. Supports HACCP CCP monitoring and FSMA preventive controls.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls; HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI; SQF

attributes.name: analyst_signoff_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the laboratory analyst formally reviewed and signed off on the test result. Required for COA issuance and ISO/IEC 17025 quality system compliance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; FDA FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this test result record was first created in the quality management system. Supports audit trail requirements under FSMA, ISO 22000, and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; ISO 22000; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: detection_limit
attributes.description: The lowest concentration or quantity of the analyte that can be reliably detected by the test method. Critical for interpreting non-detect results and MRL compliance reporting to FDA and USDA.
attributes.references: AOAC International; EPA Method Guidelines; Codex Alimentarius; FDA

attributes.name: dilution_factor
attributes.description: The dilution factor applied to the sample prior to analysis. Used to back-calculate the actual concentration in the original sample matrix and ensure accurate MRL compliance determination.
attributes.references: AOAC International; ISO/IEC 17025; EPA Method Guidelines

attributes.name: haccp_ccp_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) Critical Control Point (CCP) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test result is associated with a HACCP Critical Control Point (CCP) monitoring activity. CCP-flagged results require immediate corrective action upon failure and are subject to FSIS and FDA regulatory review.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; FDA FSMA Preventive Controls; FSIS; ISO 22000

attributes.name: laboratory_accreditation_number
attributes.description: The ISO/IEC 17025 or equivalent accreditation number of the laboratory that performed the test. Printed on COAs and required for regulatory submissions to USDA, FDA, and FSIS to validate laboratory competency.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; USDA; FDA; FSIS; A2LA; PJLA

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The quantitative result of the analytical test as reported by the laboratory instrument or analyst. For qualitative tests (e.g., Salmonella presence/absence), this field is null and qualitative_result is used instead.
attributes.references: AOAC International; ISO 22000; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: parameter_category
attributes.description: Broad classification of the test parameter type. Supports regulatory reporting segmentation and HACCP critical control point (CCP) categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mycotoxin|pesticide_residue|microbiological|physical|chemical|nutritional|heavy_metal|sensory — promote to reference product if additional categories are needed]
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; FDA FSMA; GFSI; SQF; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Name of the analytical parameter being tested (e.g., aflatoxin B1, glyphosate residue, Salmonella spp., moisture content, pH, Electrical Conductivity (EC), nitrate). Drives COA line-item labeling and MRL threshold comparison.
attributes.references: AOAC International; ISO 22000; Codex Alimentarius; EPA; USDA; FDA

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: The compliance determination for this individual test result based on comparison of the measured value against the MRL threshold and action limit. Drives COA issuance, lot release decisions, and regulatory reporting to USDA, FDA, and FSIS.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; USDA; FSIS; ISO 22000; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: qualitative_result
attributes.description: Qualitative outcome for presence/absence or positive/negative tests (e.g., Salmonella not detected, GMO absent). Used when a numeric measured_value is not applicable. Supports FSIS microbiological reporting.
attributes.references: FSIS; FDA FSMA; USDA APHIS; ISO 22000

attributes.name: quantitation_limit
attributes.description: The lowest concentration at which the analyte can be quantitatively measured with acceptable precision and accuracy. Distinct from LOD; used for MRL compliance determination and COA reporting.
attributes.references: AOAC International; EPA Method Guidelines; Codex Alimentarius; FDA

attributes.name: recovery_percent
attributes.description: The percentage recovery of a spiked control sample used to validate the analytical method performance for this test run. Acceptable recovery ranges are defined by AOAC and Codex Alimentarius guidelines (typically 70–120%).
attributes.references: AOAC International; Codex Alimentarius; ISO/IEC 17025; EPA

attributes.name: regulatory_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regulatory monitoring or surveillance program under which this test was conducted (e.g., USDA Pesticide Data Program (PDP), FDA Pesticide Residue Monitoring Program, FSIS National Residue Program (NRP), USDA AMS Microbiological Data Program).
attributes.references: USDA PDP; FDA PRMM; FSIS NRP; EPA; APHIS

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test result must be reported to a regulatory authority (USDA, FDA, FSIS, EPA, or APHIS). Triggered by failed MRL results, CCP deviations, or mandatory surveillance program requirements.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; USDA; FSIS; EPA; APHIS; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: result_reported_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the test result was formally reported and made available for COA generation and lot release decisions. Used to calculate laboratory turnaround time KPIs.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; FDA FSMA; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the test result record within the quality management system. Controls whether the result is eligible for COA inclusion and lot release authorization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; ISO 22000; GFSI

attributes.name: result_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this result is an original first-run test, a repeat test, a confirmatory test following a suspect result, or a retest after corrective action. Supports regulatory investigation workflows.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; USDA; ISO 22000; HACCP Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: sample_matrix
attributes.description: The physical material or commodity type being tested (e.g., grain, soil, water, feed, fresh produce, processed food, animal tissue). Determines applicable MRL thresholds and regulatory reporting pathways under USDA, FDA, or FSIS jurisdiction.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius; USDA; FDA; FSIS; EPA

attributes.name: test_method_code
attributes.description: The standardized analytical method reference code used to perform the test (e.g., AOAC 2007.01, ISO 6579, EPA Method 8270D, USDA FSIS MLG 4.10). Required for COA documentation and regulatory method validation compliance.
attributes.references: AOAC International; ISO 22000; EPA; USDA FSIS; FDA BAM

attributes.name: test_method_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the analytical method used (e.g., 'AOAC QuEChERS Multi-Residue Pesticide Method', 'ISO Horizontal Method for Salmonella Detection'). Complements the method code for COA readability.

products.name: haccp_plan
products.description: HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points) plan master records with embedded CCP monitoring logs for each production process, commodity, or facility. CCP monitoring log detail: captures real-time or periodic measurements at each CCP including monitoring parameter (temperature, pH, chlorine concentration, metal detector sensitivity), measured value, critical limit, monitoring frequency, operator identity, timestamp, deviation flag, and immediate corrective action taken. Provides both the plan framework and continuous compliance evidence required by FDA FSMA Preventive Controls rule and GFSI scheme auditors (SQF, BRC, IFS).

attributes.name: critical_limit_description
attributes.description: Documented critical limit(s) for each CCP that distinguish safe from unsafe product (e.g., 'Internal temperature ≥ 72°C for ≥ 15 seconds', 'Chlorine concentration 50–200 ppm', 'Metal detector sensitivity: 1.5mm ferrous'). Corresponds to Codex Alimentarius Principle 3.

attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Public Law 111-353

attributes.name: gfsi_scheme
attributes.description: GFSI-benchmarked certification scheme under which this HACCP plan is audited (Safe Quality Food (SQF), British Retail Consortium (BRC), International Featured Standards (IFS), FSSC 22000, or GLOBALG.A.P.). Drives audit scope and documentation requirements.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements v2020.1; SQF Code Edition 9; BRC Global Standard Issue 9; IFS Food Version 7

attributes.name: intended_use

attributes.name: monitoring_parameter

attributes.description: Total number of calendar days the audit spanned from actual start to actual end. Used for audit program benchmarking and resource planning.

attributes.name: minor_nonconformance_count

attributes.references: GFSI, BRC Global Standards, SQF Institute, IFS, ISO 22000

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, auditor remarks, or internal quality team commentary not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: observation_count
attributes.description: Total number of observations or opportunities for improvement noted during the audit. Observations are not non-conformances but indicate areas where practices could be strengthened.
attributes.references: ISO 19011, GFSI, BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: overall_score
attributes.description: Numeric score or percentage achieved in the audit against the applicable standard. Scoring methodology varies by standard (e.g., SQF uses percentage, BRC uses weighted scoring). Null if the standard uses grade-only outcomes.
attributes.references: SQF Institute, BRC Global Standards, IFS, GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: report_issued_date

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: The unique reference number of the formal audit report document issued by the auditing body. Used for document management, regulatory submissions, and customer sharing.

attributes.name: standard_version
attributes.description: The specific version or edition of the certification standard used for this audit (e.g., SQF Edition 9, BRC Issue 9, IFS Food Version 8). Critical for tracking compliance against evolving standard requirements.
attributes.references: SQF Institute, BRC Global Standards, IFS, GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this audit record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with SAP S/4HANA QM module, and Silver layer delta processing.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The specific date on which the auditor verified this credential during the audit. Distinct from workforce_certification.verification_date, which records the general HR verification date independent of any audit.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: duns_number

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: employee_count

attributes.name: fsma_registered_facility_flag

attributes.name: gmo_preference

attributes.name: industry_code

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the customer account as filed with the relevant government authority (e.g., food manufacturer, distributor, cooperative, or individual consumer). Used for contracts, invoicing, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; GAAP; IFRS; USDA FSMA

attributes.name: organic_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer account requires USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certified products for all or part of their purchases. Triggers organic supply chain routing and COA documentation requirements.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the customer account, used for order confirmations, invoices, compliance notifications, and CRM communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary business telephone number for the customer account, including country code. Used for order management, logistics coordination, and customer service.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: salesforce_account_code
attributes.description: Unique account identifier from Salesforce CRM, used to synchronize customer relationship data, sales pipeline, and partner management activities between the CRM and the enterprise data platform.

attributes.name: sap_customer_number

attributes.name: tax_identification_number

attributes.name: termination_date

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; GAAP; GDPR Article 17 (right to erasure)

attributes.name: trade_name
