attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the customer account record. Used for change data capture, audit trail, and CRM synchronization.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX; Salesforce CRM

products.name: contact
products.description: Individual contact persons associated with a customer account — including procurement managers, food safety officers, agronomists, and buying agents at food manufacturers, distributors, and retail chains. Stores full name, job title, department, primary phone, email, preferred communication channel, LinkedIn profile, Salesforce CRM contact ID, FSMA point-of-contact flag, HACCP coordinator flag, and opt-in/opt-out marketing consent status per GDPR requirements for international operations.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Contact

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the individual contact person record within the customer domain. Serves as the primary key for all contact-related data.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent customer account with which this contact is associated (e.g., food manufacturer, distributor, retailer, cooperative).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact-Account Relationship

attributes.name: reports_to_contact_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the contact's manager or superior within the same customer organization. Enables organizational hierarchy mapping for enterprise B2B accounts (e.g., a buying agent reporting to a procurement director).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Reports To Field

attributes.name: account_role
attributes.description: The contact's functional role within the sales and account management process. Supports Salesforce CRM opportunity management and stakeholder mapping for complex B2B agricultural supply chain deals.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Role Object

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record. 'active' indicates an engaged contact; 'inactive' indicates a former contact no longer at the organization; 'pending' indicates awaiting verification; 'do_not_contact' indicates opt-out or legal restriction.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); Salesforce CRM — Contact Status

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact's functional role in the business relationship. 'primary' is the main account contact; 'technical' covers agronomists and food safety officers; 'billing' covers accounts payable; 'regulatory' covers FSMA/HACCP compliance officers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: primary|secondary|technical|billing|regulatory|emergency — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Type Field; SAP S/4HANA SD Partner Functions

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the contact is based. Used for GDPR jurisdiction determination, COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) preference alignment, and regional sales territory assignment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) — USDA AMS; GDPR Article 3

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the contact record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail anchor for record lineage, GDPR data retention calculations, and data governance compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) (Storage Limitation); SOX Section 404; ISO 22000

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organizational department or functional area of the contact within their company (e.g., Procurement, Food Safety, Quality Assurance, Logistics, Agronomy, Finance). Supports targeted communication and segmentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Object

attributes.name: do_not_call
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has requested to not be contacted by phone. Enforces compliance with telemarketing regulations and respects contact communication preferences. True = do not call.
attributes.references: FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule; GDPR Article 21 (Right to Object); Salesforce CRM — Do Not Call Field

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary business email address of the contact. Used for order confirmations, compliance notifications, FSMA correspondence, and marketing communications subject to GDPR consent.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CAN-SPAM Act; FSMA Section 204

attributes.name: email_bounced
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact's email address has produced a hard bounce, rendering it undeliverable. Used to suppress invalid email addresses from marketing and transactional communications and trigger data quality remediation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Email Bounced Field; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: email_bounced_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contact's email address first produced a hard bounce. Used to track data quality degradation over time and prioritize contact record remediation efforts.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Email Bounced Date Field

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given (first) name of the individual contact person. Used for personalized communication and CRM correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; GLOBALG.A.P. Contact Record Standard

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_basis
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Lawful Processing Basis
attributes.description: The GDPR lawful basis under which this contact's personal data is processed. Required for all contacts associated with EU/international operations. 'consent' requires explicit opt-in; 'contract' applies to contacts involved in active supply agreements; 'legitimate_interest' applies to B2B prospecting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 9; General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679

attributes.name: is_decision_maker
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact holds purchasing or contractual decision-making authority at the customer organization. Used by sales teams to prioritize engagement and route proposals through Salesforce CRM opportunity management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Role (Decision Maker); SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: is_fsma_point_of_contact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Point of Contact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the designated FSMA point of contact at the customer organization. FSMA Section 204 requires traceability recordkeeping contacts to be identified for food safety compliance and regulatory communications with the FDA.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Section 204; 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S

attributes.name: is_haccp_coordinator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) Coordinator Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact serves as the HACCP coordinator at the customer organization. HACCP coordinators are responsible for food safety plan oversight and are key contacts for quality assurance, audit communications, and corrective action notifications.
attributes.references: FDA HACCP Regulations (21 CFR Part 120, 123); Codex Alimentarius HACCP Guidelines; GFSI Standards

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the primary/main point of contact for the associated customer account. Only one contact per customer account should be flagged as primary. Used for default routing of account communications and escalations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Role; SAP S/4HANA SD Partner Functions

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title or position of the contact at their organization (e.g., Procurement Manager, Food Safety Officer, Agronomist, Buying Agent, Quality Assurance Director). Used for routing communications and identifying decision-making authority.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Object; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 region subtag) representing the contact's preferred language for communications (e.g., en-US, es-MX, fr-FR, pt-BR). Supports multilingual correspondence for global food manufacturer and distributor contacts.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ISO 3166-1; GDPR Article 12 (Transparent Communication in Intelligible Language)

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent logged activity (call, email, meeting, task) associated with this contact in Salesforce CRM. Used to identify dormant contacts, measure engagement health, and trigger re-engagement workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Last Activity Date Field; CRM KPI Best Practices

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family (last) name of the individual contact person. Combined with first_name to form the full display name for reporting and correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; GLOBALG.A.P. Contact Record Standard

attributes.name: lead_source
attributes.description: The originating channel or event through which this contact was first acquired or identified. Used for marketing attribution, ROI analysis of lead generation programs, and sales pipeline reporting in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Lead Source Field; Marketing ROI (Return on Investment) Analytics

attributes.name: linkedin_profile_url
attributes.description: URL to the contact's LinkedIn professional profile. Used by sales and account management teams for relationship intelligence, prospecting, and partner engagement via Salesforce CRM integration.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Social Fields; GDPR Article 6 (Legitimate Interest)

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has provided explicit consent to receive marketing communications (newsletters, product promotions, agricultural insights). Required under GDPR for international operations and CAN-SPAM for US contacts. True = opted in; False = opted out or no consent given.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; CAN-SPAM Act; CASL (Canada Anti-Spam Legislation)

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contact provided explicit marketing consent. Required for GDPR audit trail demonstrating lawful basis for processing personal data for marketing purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 42

attributes.name: marketing_opt_out_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contact withdrew marketing consent or requested opt-out. Triggers suppression from all marketing campaigns. Required for GDPR compliance and CAN-SPAM unsubscribe processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3) (Right to Withdraw Consent); CAN-SPAM Act Section 5

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile/cell phone number of the contact in E.164 international format. Used for SMS alerts, two-factor authentication, and field-level communications with agronomists or logistics coordinators.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ITU-T E.164 Standard

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for account managers and sales representatives to capture qualitative context about the contact, including relationship history, communication preferences, and strategic account notes. Classified as confidential due to potential inclusion of sensitive business relationship details.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Description/Notes Field

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary business phone number of the contact in E.164 international format. Used for urgent supply chain communications, food safety alerts, and account management calls.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ITU-T E.164 Standard

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The contact's preferred channel for receiving business communications. Drives outreach strategy for sales, compliance notifications, and marketing campaigns. Aligns with GDPR consent management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Salesforce CRM — Contact Preferences

attributes.name: salesforce_contact_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this contact record in Salesforce CRM, used for bidirectional synchronization between the lakehouse silver layer and the CRM system of record for sales pipeline and partner management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Object

attributes.name: salutation
attributes.description: Formal salutation or honorific prefix for the contact (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr.). Used in formal correspondence, contract documents, and regulatory communications.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Salutation Field

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the contact's location (e.g., America/Chicago, Europe/London). Used to schedule communications, meetings, and automated alerts at appropriate local times for global agricultural supply chain partners.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; Salesforce CRM — Contact Time Zone

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the contact record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer pipeline, data freshness monitoring, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy Principle); SOX Section 404; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

products.name: address
products.description: Physical and mailing addresses associated with customer accounts and contacts — including billing addresses, shipping/delivery locations, farm gate pickup points, cold storage facility addresses, and registered business addresses. Stores address type (billing, shipping, registered, farm gate), street lines, city, state/province, postal code, country, GIS coordinates (latitude/longitude from Esri ArcGIS), COOL country of origin code, address validation status, and primary address flag. Supports multi-location customers such as retail chains and distribution networks.
products.reference: SAP SD Ship-To / Bill-To Party Address

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each address record associated with a customer account or contact. Serves as the primary key for the address entity in the customer domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module – Business Partner Address Object

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account this address belongs to. Links the address record to the parent customer entity in the customer domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM – Account Object; SAP S/4HANA SD – Business Partner

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual contact person this address is associated with, when the address belongs to a specific contact rather than the overall account. Nullable for account-level addresses.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM – Contact Object

attributes.name: parent_address_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on address (parent_address_id)

attributes.name: address_source
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this address was originally sourced or last updated. Supports data lineage tracking and conflict resolution during master data management synchronization across Salesforce CRM, SAP S/4HANA, Oracle NetSuite, and Granular Farm Management.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance – Master Data Management (MDM); GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing)

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classifies the functional purpose of the address. 'billing' is the invoicing address; 'shipping' is the delivery destination; 'registered' is the legal business registration address; 'farm_gate' is a pickup point at the farm; 'cold_storage' is a refrigerated facility address; 'mailing' is for general correspondence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing|shipping|registered|farm_gate|cold_storage|mailing|warehouse|processing_plant — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD – Address Usage Type; Salesforce CRM – Address Type Field

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City, town, municipality, or locality name of the address. For rural agricultural addresses, may reference the nearest incorporated municipality.
attributes.references: USPS Addressing Standards; ISO 19160-1 (Addressing)

attributes.name: cool_country_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Country Code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code designating the country of origin for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance purposes. May differ from the physical address country for re-export or processing facility scenarios. Mandatory for USDA COOL compliance on covered commodities including beef, pork, lamb, chicken, fish, shellfish, perishable agricultural commodities, peanuts, pecans, ginseng, and macadamia nuts.
attributes.references: COOL – Country of Origin Labeling (7 CFR Part 60 and 65); USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS); FSMA

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the address (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'MEX', 'BRA'). Used for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance, international shipping documentation (BOL, AWB), and FDA/USDA import/export regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; COOL – Country of Origin Labeling (7 CFR Part 60); FDA Import Regulations; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County or parish name of the address. Critical for USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) county-level agricultural program eligibility, crop insurance administration, and state agricultural reporting. Also used for EPA and APHIS county-level regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) County Office Structure; USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS); EPA County-Level Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the system. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under FSMA, GDPR, and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing Activities); SOX Section 404; FSMA Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for special delivery instructions specific to this address. Includes gate access codes, dock numbers, receiving hours, refrigeration requirements for cold chain deliveries, and farm-specific access directions not captured in structured address fields. Sourced from Manhattan Associates WMS and TMS delivery notes.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS – Delivery Notes; SAP S/4HANA SD – Delivery Instructions

attributes.name: do_not_ship
attributes.description: Indicates that shipments must not be dispatched to this address. May be set due to regulatory restrictions, customer request, failed delivery history, or compliance holds. Enforced during order fulfillment in Manhattan Associates WMS and SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS – Address Restrictions; SAP S/4HANA SD – Delivery Block

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS (Data Universal Numbering System) nine-digit identifier for the business entity at this address. Used for supplier qualification, credit risk assessment, USDA program eligibility verification, and federal procurement compliance.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Number Standard; USDA Supplier Qualification; SAM.gov Federal Procurement

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this address record is valid and effective for business use. Supports time-bounded address management for seasonal farm gate locations, temporary cold storage facilities, and lease-based distribution points.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD – Address Validity Period; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which this address record is no longer valid for business use. Nullable for indefinitely active addresses. Used to manage seasonal farm gate closures, facility relocations, and lease expirations for distribution network addresses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD – Address Validity Period; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of physical facility at this address. Supports logistics planning, cold chain management, and regulatory compliance routing. 'farm' indicates a production site; 'cold_storage' indicates temperature-controlled facility relevant to food safety (FSMA, HACCP); 'cooperative' indicates an agricultural cooperative location. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: farm|warehouse|distribution_center|cold_storage|processing_plant|retail_store|office|cooperative|grain_elevator|packing_house — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FSMA – Food Safety Modernization Act; HACCP – Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points; USDA FSIS

attributes.name: fips_code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS (Federal Information Processing Standards) county code assigned by the U.S. Census Bureau. Used for USDA program administration, FSA county office routing, crop insurance mapping, and federal agricultural subsidy eligibility determination.
attributes.references: FIPS 6-4 (Counties and Equivalent Entities); USDA Farm Service Agency; USDA Risk Management Agency (RMA)

attributes.name: geocode_accuracy
attributes.description: Precision level of the latitude/longitude geocoding result from Esri ArcGIS. 'rooftop' indicates exact parcel-level match; 'range_interpolated' is street-level interpolation; 'geometric_center' is centroid of a polygon; 'approximate' is postal code or city centroid; 'unverified' means coordinates have not been validated.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Geocoding Quality Codes; ISO 19160-4 (Address Quality)

attributes.name: gln
attributes.description: GS1 Global Location Number (GLN) — a 13-digit identifier uniquely identifying this physical location in the global supply chain. Used for EDI transactions, traceability in food supply chains, GLOBALG.A.P. location registration, and GS1-compliant logistics documentation including BOL and ASN.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Location Number (GLN) Standard; GLOBALG.A.P. Location Registration; GS1-128 Logistics Label Standard; FSMA Traceability Rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart S)

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address record is currently active and usable for business operations. Inactive addresses are retained for historical audit and traceability but excluded from operational address selection for orders, invoices, and shipments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD – Address Validity; Salesforce CRM – Address Status

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary address for the customer account or contact. Only one address per customer per address type should be flagged as primary. Used to determine the default address for billing, shipping, or correspondence when multiple addresses exist.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM – Primary Address Flag; SAP S/4HANA SD – Standard Address

attributes.name: is_residential
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a residential address as opposed to a commercial or agricultural business address. Affects carrier surcharge calculations, delivery scheduling windows, and B2C vs B2B routing logic for direct-to-consumer agricultural product deliveries.
attributes.references: USPS Residential Delivery Indicator; UPS/FedEx Residential Surcharge Standards

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum), sourced from Esri ArcGIS geocoding. Supports GIS-based spatial analysis, delivery route optimization via TMS, farm gate proximity calculations, and precision agriculture field mapping. Range: -90.0000000 to +90.0000000.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Geocoding Service; WGS84 Datum (EPSG:4326); ISO 6709

attributes.name: line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including street number and street name. For farm gate addresses, may include rural route or farm road designation.
attributes.references: USPS Addressing Standards; GDPR Article 4; ISO 19160-1 (Addressing)

attributes.name: line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, unit, building, floor, dock number, or additional location detail. Commonly used for distribution center dock numbers or warehouse unit identifiers.

attributes.name: dispute_count_open

attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling); USDA APHIS; FDA FSMA; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: coa_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or document path for the Certificate of Analysis (COA) associated with this certification record. Links product quality test results to the certification for GFSI and MRL compliance verification.
attributes.references: GFSI; Codex Alimentarius; FDA FSMA; USDA AMS

attributes.name: cool_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification record satisfies COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) requirements for the certified commodity and site. True = COOL eligible; False = not eligible. Drives COOL compliance reporting and trade documentation.
attributes.references: USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling); 7 CFR Part 60; 7 CFR Part 65

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the certified entity must submit evidence of corrective actions for non-conformances identified during the audit. Supports compliance monitoring and certification reinstatement workflows.
attributes.references: GFSI; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF; BRC; ISO 22000; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the Agriculture data lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 22000; GFSI; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification expires and must be renewed to maintain trade eligibility. Used to trigger renewal workflows, preferential pricing reviews, and GFSI supply chain disqualification alerts.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF; BRC; ISO 22000; USDA NOP; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: fsma_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Registration Number
attributes.description: FDA facility registration number issued under the Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA). Required for FSMA-registered food facilities and used to verify buyer compliance with FDA import and supply chain requirements.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart H; FDA Food Facility Registration

attributes.name: globalg_ap_option
attributes.description: GLOBALG.A.P. certification option applicable to this record: Option 1 (individual producer), Option 2 (producer group), Group, or Multisite. Relevant only for GLOBALG.A.P. certification type; null for other certification types.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. (Global Good Agricultural Practices) General Regulations

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: GMO (Genetically Modified Organism) status declared within the scope of this certification. Supports buyer GMO preference matching and COOL/labeling compliance for food manufacturers and retailers.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; EU Regulation 1829/2003; Codex Alimentarius; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: internal_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the internal quality or compliance team completed their review of this certification record. Part of the internal audit trail for GFSI, FSMA, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: GFSI; ISO 22000; FDA FSMA; SOX

attributes.name: internal_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification record has been reviewed and approved by the internal quality or compliance team. True = internally reviewed and approved; False = pending internal review. Supports internal QA workflow management.
attributes.references: GFSI; ISO 22000; FDA FSMA; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certifying body formally issued the certificate. Marks the start of the certification's validity period and is used for trade eligibility determination and COOL compliance verification.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF; BRC; ISO 22000; USDA NOP; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: major_nonconformance_count
attributes.description: Number of major non-conformances identified during the most recent certification audit. Major non-conformances may result in certification suspension and are a critical input to buyer risk management and GFSI qualification decisions.
attributes.references: GFSI; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF; BRC; IFS; ISO 22000

attributes.name: mrl_compliance_verified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) Compliance Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer's certification scope has been verified as compliant with applicable Maximum Residue Limits (MRL) for the relevant commodity and destination market. True = MRL compliance confirmed; False = not yet verified or non-compliant.
attributes.references: EPA; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; EU Regulation 396/2005; USDA AMS

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next certification audit or surveillance visit. Used for proactive compliance management and supply chain qualification planning.
attributes.references: GFSI; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF; BRC; ISO 22000

attributes.name: nonconformance_count
attributes.description: Total number of non-conformances (major and minor) identified during the most recent certification audit. Used for supplier risk scoring and GFSI-aligned supply chain qualification assessments.
attributes.references: GFSI; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF; BRC; IFS; ISO 22000

attributes.name: organic_operation_type
attributes.description: Type of organic operation certified under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP): producer, handler, processor, retailer, or broker. Applicable only for USDA Organic NOP certification type.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: preferential_pricing_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification qualifies the customer account for preferential pricing tiers in the sales and distribution process. True = eligible for preferential pricing; False = standard pricing applies. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA SD pricing conditions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; GFSI; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: salesforce_cert_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the corresponding certification record in Salesforce CRM. Enables bidirectional synchronization between the Agriculture data lakehouse and Salesforce for sales pipeline and partner management workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: sap_vendor_cert_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA QM module vendor certification code associated with this certification record. Used for quality management integration, goods receipt inspection, and procurement qualification in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; ISO 22000; GFSI

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Textual description of the reason for certification suspension or revocation, as communicated by the certifying body. Populated only when certification_status is 'suspended', 'withdrawn', or 'revoked'. Supports corrective action tracking.
attributes.references: GFSI; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF; BRC; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: trade_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account is currently eligible to trade based on the active status of this certification. True = trade eligible; False = trade blocked pending certification renewal or remediation. Used in order management and supply chain qualification gates.
attributes.references: GFSI; GLOBALG.A.P.; FDA FSMA; USDA APHIS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was last modified in the Agriculture data lakehouse. Supports change data capture, audit trail, and Silver layer delta processing.
attributes.references: ISO 22000; GFSI; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the validity of this certification: third-party audit, self-declaration, document review, or regulatory inspection. Supports risk-based supplier qualification and GFSI compliance tiering.
attributes.references: GFSI; GLOBALG.A.P.; FDA FSMA; ISO 22000; Codex Alimentarius

products.name: account_relationship
products.description: Captures lateral and cross-account relationships between customer entities beyond parent-child hierarchy — including cooperative membership networks, buying group affiliations, co-packer relationships, toll processing partnerships, and broker-buyer relationships. Stores relationship type, both account parties, relationship direction, effective and expiry dates, contractual basis flag, and relationship manager. Enables network-level analysis of customer interdependencies critical for agricultural commodity trading and cooperative grain marketing.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Account Relationship / Partner Role

attributes.name: account_relationship_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each account-to-account relationship record in the customer domain. Primary key for the account_relationship data product.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Business relationships between agriculture accounts (broker-buyer, co-packer, cooperative member) are scoped to specific commodities. Volume commitment tracking, exclusivity agreements, and toll proce
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.contract. Business justification: Inter-account relationships in agriculture (broker-buyer, co-packer, cooperative membership) are formalized through sales contracts. The existing plain-text 'contract_reference_number' is denormalized
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_account_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal employee or account manager responsible for managing and maintaining this account relationship. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors workforce records and aligned with Salesforce CRM owner assignments.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Owner; SAP SuccessFactors Employee Master

attributes.name: seed_variety_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.seed_variety. Business justification: Seed licensing and dealer agreements between breeders and distributors are tied to specific seed varieties. account_relationship has broker_license_number and contract_reference_number; linking to see
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: source_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating or initiating account party in the relationship (e.g., the cooperative, buying group, or broker initiating the affiliation). Represents side A of the lateral relationship.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master

attributes.name: target_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the receiving or counterpart account party in the relationship (e.g., the grain elevator, food manufacturer, or retailer on the receiving end). Represents side B of the lateral relationship.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master

attributes.name: annual_volume_commitment_mt
attributes.description: Contractually committed annual commodity volume in Metric Tons (MT) that the source account agrees to supply or the target account agrees to purchase within this relationship. Supports WASDE-aligned supply planning and cooperative grain pool management.
attributes.references: USDA WASDE; USDA AMS Grain Marketing; SAP S/4HANA SD Scheduling Agreements

attributes.name: broker_license_number
attributes.description: Regulatory license number of the agricultural commodity broker when relationship_type is broker_buyer. Required for compliance with USDA Packers and Stockyards Act and grain broker licensing regulations.
attributes.references: USDA Packers and Stockyards Act; USDA GIPSA Grain Broker Licensing

attributes.name: buying_group_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the buying group or purchasing alliance to which the target account belongs when relationship_type is buying_group. Supports volume-based pricing and consolidated procurement negotiations in SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Buying Group Configuration; USDA Agricultural Marketing Act

attributes.name: co_packer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the target account acts as a co-packer (True) for the source account, manufacturing or packaging agricultural products under the source accounts brand or specifications. Supports FSMA supplier verification and GFSI audit tracking.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 103 Preventive Controls; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; BRC Global Standard Issue 9

attributes.name: contractual_basis_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account relationship is underpinned by a formal written contract (True) or is an informal/operational arrangement (False). Supports legal and compliance review processes under FSMA and GLOBALG.A.P. requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Supplier Verification; GLOBALG.A.P. Contract Farming Standard; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: cool_compliance_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance documentation is required for commodity transactions within this relationship. Applicable to covered commodities under USDA AMS COOL regulations.
attributes.references: USDA AMS COOL Regulations (7 CFR Part 60 and 65); Agricultural Marketing Act of 1946

attributes.name: cooperative_membership_number
attributes.description: Formal membership identifier assigned by the agricultural cooperative to the member account. Applicable when relationship_type is cooperative_member. Used for grain marketing pool allocations and patronage dividend calculations.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Cooperative Service; USDA AMS Grain Marketing Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account relationship record was first created in the system. Provides full audit trail for data lineage and SOX compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 22000 Record Keeping

attributes.name: credit_exposure_limit
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate credit exposure permitted across both accounts within this relationship, expressed in the base currency. Used for combined credit risk management in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR and Oracle NetSuite AR modules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310 Credit Risk

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to financial terms within this relationship (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Governs credit exposure limit and any contractual monetary thresholds.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the account relationship becomes or became legally and operationally binding. Used for time-bounded network analysis and contract compliance tracking.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the relationship carries an exclusivity clause (True), preventing either party from entering into equivalent relationships with competing accounts within the defined commodity and geographic scope.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Terms; USDA Agricultural Marketing Act; IFRS 15

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the account relationship expires or is scheduled to terminate. Null indicates an open-ended relationship with no defined end. Supports proactive renewal management in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Expiry; Salesforce CRM Opportunity Management

attributes.name: fsma_verified_supplier_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Verified Supplier Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the target account has been verified as a qualified supplier under FSMA Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP) or Preventive Controls supplier verification requirements applicable to this relationship.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 301 FSVP; FDA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart L; FSMA Preventive Controls Rule

attributes.name: geographic_scope_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code or region code defining the geographic territory within which this account relationship is operative. Supports COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance and territorial sales analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; USDA COOL Regulations (7 CFR Part 60); GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: globalg_ap_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the target account holds a valid GLOBALG.A.P. (Global Good Agricultural Practices) certification relevant to this relationship. Supports buyer certification requirements and supply chain compliance audits.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Certification Standard v5.4; GFSI Benchmarking

attributes.name: gmo_preference
attributes.description: GMO handling preference governing commodity transactions within this relationship. Drives identity preservation protocols, segregation requirements, and labeling compliance under USDA BE Disclosure Standard.
attributes.references: USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (7 CFR Part 66); GLOBALG.A.P. GMO Module

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the account relationship was most recently formally reviewed by the relationship manager or account team. Supports periodic relationship health checks and CRM activity tracking in Salesforce.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Management; Internal KPI — Relationship Review Cadence SOP

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next formal review of this account relationship. Enables proactive relationship management workflows and CRM task generation in Salesforce for the assigned relationship manager.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Task Management; Internal Account Management SOP

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the relationship involves certified organic commodity transactions (True), requiring both parties to maintain USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification. Drives organic supply chain segregation and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; USDA AMS Organic Integrity Database

attributes.name: preferred_partner_flag
attributes.description: Designates the target account as a preferred or strategic partner (True) for the source account. Influences pricing tiers, allocation priority during commodity shortages, and CRM opportunity scoring in Salesforce.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Partner Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Classification

attributes.name: pricing_arrangement_type
attributes.description: Type of pricing mechanism governing commodity transactions within this relationship. Fixed pricing locks a rate; basis pricing ties to a futures market spread; spot uses current market price; formula uses a defined calculation; negotiated is case-by-case.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Commodity Pricing; DTN Market Data Standards; CME Group Grain Futures

attributes.name: relationship_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the relationship is directional (source acts upon target only) or mutual (both parties share equal standing). Critical for cooperative membership networks where obligations may flow one way.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Relationship Model; GLOBALG.A.P. Group Certification

attributes.name: relationship_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing qualitative context, special terms, operational nuances, or historical background relevant to this account relationship. Used by relationship managers for CRM narrative and account planning in Salesforce.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Notes and Attachments; Internal Account Management SOP

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the account relationship. Drives CRM pipeline visibility and supply chain partner eligibility checks in Salesforce and SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD Partner Functions

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the lateral relationship between the two account parties. Drives network analysis for agricultural commodity trading and cooperative grain marketing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cooperative_member|buying_group|co_packer|toll_processor|broker_buyer|distributor_retailer|preferred_supplier — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Standard; USDA Agricultural Marketing Act; Salesforce CRM Relationship Type

attributes.name: salesforce_relationship_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this account relationship record as stored in Salesforce CRM. Enables bidirectional synchronization between the lakehouse silver layer and the CRM system of record for sales pipeline and partner management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Relationship Object

attributes.name: toll_processing_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this relationship involves a toll processing arrangement (True), where one party processes agricultural commodities owned by the other party for a fee. Relevant for grain milling, oilseed crushing, and feed manufacturing partnerships.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS Processing Agreements; FSMA Preventive Controls Rule; SAP S/4HANA PP Subcontracting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this account relationship record. Supports incremental data loading, change data capture, and audit trail requirements in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 22000 Record Keeping; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the annual_volume_commitment field. Standard agricultural units include Metric Ton (MT), Bushel (BU), Hundredweight (CWT), Pound (LB), and Kilogram (KG). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA MM unit of measure configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; USDA NASS Commodity Reporting Standards

products.name: delivery_location
products.description: Authorized delivery and receiving locations registered for customer accounts — including grain elevator receiving points, cold storage facilities, food manufacturing plant docks, distribution center addresses, and retail distribution hubs. Captures location name, location type, physical address, GIS coordinates, receiving hours, dock capacity, commodity types accepted, temperature control capability (for perishables), FSMA facility registration number, USDA establishment number (for meat/poultry), preferred carrier, and BOL delivery instructions. Distinct from the address entity — this is an operational receiving point with logistics and compliance attributes.
products.reference: SAP SD Ship-To Party / Manhattan Associates WMS Delivery Location

attributes.name: delivery_location_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each authorized delivery and receiving location registered to a customer account. Primary key for the delivery_location entity.
attributes.references: Internal Data Standard

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that owns or is associated with this delivery location. Links the receiving point to the customer master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Customer Master

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: delivery_location has fully embedded address fields (address_line1, address_line2, city, state_province, postal_code, country_code) that duplicate the normalized address table. The address table is th
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: In Agriculture commodity sales, ship-to delivery locations (sap_ship_to_party_number) are assigned to company codes for sales tax jurisdiction determination, revenue recognition by legal entity, and C
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Agricultural delivery locations (grain elevators, cold storage, processing facilities) incur operating costs — receiving labor, refrigeration, dock management — tracked by cost center for logistics co
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: grading_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.grading_standard. Business justification: USDA-approved grading facilities and packing houses are certified to specific grading standards. Linking delivery_location to grading_standard enables routing decisions (only ship to locations certifi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: parent_delivery_location_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on delivery_location (parent_delivery_location_id)

attributes.name: receiving_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact. Business justification: Each delivery location in agriculture (grain elevator, cold storage, processing facility) has a designated receiving contact responsible for coordinating deliveries, signing bills of lading, and manag
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: site_coordinator_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Agriculture supply chain operations assign a responsible employee as site coordinator for each customer delivery location to manage FSMA receiving compliance, temperature-controlled receiving, and USD
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Delivery locations (grain elevators, processing plants, distribution centers) in agriculture are assigned to sales territories for coverage planning, logistics routing, and territory-level delivery vo
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: appointment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a scheduled delivery appointment is required before a carrier can deliver to this location. When true, the TMS must generate an appointment request prior to dispatch.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Appointment Scheduling; SAP TMS

attributes.name: bol_delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text delivery instructions printed on the Bill of Lading (BOL) for this location, such as gate access codes, dock assignment rules, required check-in procedures, or special unloading requirements. Critical for carrier compliance at receiving.
attributes.references: BOL Standard — VICS Bill of Lading; SAP S/4HANA SD Shipping Instructions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery location record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability; Internal Audit Standard

attributes.name: dock_count
attributes.description: Total number of loading and unloading dock doors available at this receiving location. Used for capacity planning, appointment scheduling, and throughput analysis in the WMS.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Dock Management

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this delivery location is authorized and active for use in shipment routing and order fulfillment. Locations cannot be used for deliveries prior to this date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Validity Period; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: fsma_facility_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Facility Registration Number
attributes.description: FDA-issued facility registration number under the Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) for food facilities that manufacture, process, pack, or hold food for human or animal consumption. Required for FSMA traceability compliance and Prior Notice submissions.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Section 415; 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart H; Food Safety Modernization Act

attributes.name: hazmat_accepted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery location is authorized and equipped to receive hazardous materials such as agricultural chemicals, pesticides, or fertilizers regulated under EPA and DOT standards.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the delivery location in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Captured via GPS or GIS geocoding for precision routing, geofencing, and spatial analytics in Esri ArcGIS.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Spatial Reference; WGS84 Datum; GPS Standard

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric business identifier for the delivery location used in ERP, WMS, and TMS systems for routing and order fulfillment. Corresponds to the SAP S/4HANA SD ship-to party code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Ship-To Party

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for the delivery and receiving location, such as 'Chicago Cold Storage Dock 3', 'Midwest Grain Elevator — Receiving', or 'Plant A Food Manufacturing Dock'. Used in shipping documents and BOL instructions.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Location Master

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the delivery location. Inactive or suspended locations must not be used for new shipment routing. Pending approval locations are awaiting compliance verification.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Location Lifecycle

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Operational classification of the receiving facility. Determines applicable compliance requirements, commodity acceptance rules, and logistics handling procedures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grain_elevator|cold_storage|food_manufacturing_plant|distribution_center|retail_hub|cooperative_facility|farm_direct — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; FSMA Facility Classification

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the delivery location in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used alongside latitude for GIS-based route optimization, proximity analysis, and carrier dispatch.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Spatial Reference; WGS84 Datum; GPS Standard

attributes.name: max_temperature_c
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in degrees Celsius that this location can maintain for cold chain storage. Used alongside min_temperature_c to define the acceptable temperature range for perishable commodity receiving.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Produce Safety Rule; HACCP Critical Control Points; ISO 22000

attributes.name: max_vehicle_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum gross vehicle weight in kilograms that the facility's access roads, docks, or receiving infrastructure can accommodate. Used by TMS to validate carrier vehicle selection and prevent infrastructure damage.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Bridge Formula; SAP TMS Vehicle Constraints

attributes.name: min_temperature_c
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in degrees Celsius that this location can maintain for cold chain storage. Applicable only when temperature_controlled_flag is true. Used to validate commodity compatibility for perishable shipments.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Produce Safety Rule; HACCP Critical Control Points; ISO 22000

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this receiving location holds USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification, enabling it to receive and handle certified organic commodities without compromising organic integrity.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: receiving_days
attributes.description: Days of the week on which this location accepts deliveries, expressed as a comma-separated list (e.g., 'MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI'). Used for carrier scheduling and delivery appointment planning.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Receiving Schedule

attributes.name: receiving_hours_close
attributes.description: Scheduled closing time for receiving operations at this location in HH:MM (24-hour) format. Deliveries arriving after this time may be refused or require special arrangement.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Receiving Schedule; SAP TMS

attributes.name: receiving_hours_open
attributes.description: Scheduled opening time for receiving operations at this location in HH:MM (24-hour) format. Used by TMS and carrier scheduling to ensure deliveries are dispatched within the facility's operating window.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Receiving Schedule; SAP TMS

attributes.name: salesforce_location_code
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM record ID for this delivery location as stored in the Salesforce account or contact hierarchy. Enables bidirectional synchronization between the CRM sales pipeline and the operational delivery location master.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account and Location Object

attributes.name: sap_ship_to_party_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA SD module ship-to party number corresponding to this delivery location. Used for ERP order-to-cash integration, delivery document creation, and outbound shipment processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Ship-To Party Master

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery location has temperature-controlled receiving and storage capability for perishable commodities such as fresh produce, dairy, or meat. Required for cold chain compliance and HACCP documentation.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this delivery location is decommissioned or no longer authorized for use. Null indicates the location is open-ended and currently active. Used to enforce routing validity in TMS and WMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Validity Period; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this delivery location record. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability; Internal Audit Standard

attributes.name: usda_establishment_number
attributes.description: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS) establishment number assigned to meat, poultry, or egg product processing facilities. Required for FSIS-regulated shipments and must appear on shipping labels and BOL documents.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS 9 CFR Part 301; FSIS Establishment Registration

domains.name: product
domains.description: SSOT for the agricultural product and commodity catalog — defining all sellable and transferable items including crop commodities (grains, produce, fiber), livestock products (meat, dairy, eggs), processed goods, seed/input products, and value-added products. Manages SKU/PLU/UPC codes, GMO status, organic certification flags (NOP), grading standards, MRL thresholds, product hierarchy classifications, COA and labeling (COOL) requirements aligned with USDA commodity codes. Supports organic, non-GMO, and conventional product lines.
domains.references: USDA AMS Product Standards, FDA Labeling, GLOBALG.A.P.

products.name: agrochemical_product
products.description: Master catalog of all registered agrochemical products (pesticides, herbicides, fungicides, insecticides, fertilizers) used in crop protection and nutrition programs. Captures EPA registration number, active ingredient (AI), formulation type, MRL limits by crop, PHI, REI, SDS reference, restricted use status, and approved application methods. Serves as the SSOT for agrochemical compliance data supporting FSMA, EPA, and GLOBALG.A.P. requirements.
products.reference: Agrochemical / Pesticide Product Master

attributes.name: agrochemical_product_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each agrochemical product record in the master catalog. Primary key for the agrochemical_product data product. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Master

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_master. Business justification: agrochemical_product is a specialized subtype of the product master catalog. Every registered agrochemical (pesticide, herbicide, fungicide) must have a corresponding master product record for SKU/UPC
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: mrl_threshold_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.mrl_threshold. Business justification: agrochemical_product.mrl_threshold_ppm is a denormalized copy of the authoritative MRL value stored in mrl_threshold. Adding mrl_threshold_id FK normalizes this reference, ensuring MRL values are main
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: active_ingredient_concentration
attributes.description: The concentration of the active ingredient (AI) expressed as a percentage by weight (% w/w) or grams per liter (g/L) as stated on the EPA-registered label. Used to calculate application rates and verify MRL compliance.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; FAO/WHO Pesticide Specifications; 40 CFR Part 156

attributes.name: active_ingredient_name
attributes.description: The common chemical name of the primary active ingredient (AI) in the agrochemical product as defined by the EPA and IUPAC nomenclature (e.g., 'glyphosate', 'azoxystrobin', 'chlorpyrifos'). Critical for MRL compliance, PHI determination, and resistance management programs.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; IUPAC Chemical Nomenclature; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: The EPA-label approved method(s) for applying the agrochemical product to crops or soil (e.g., foliar spray, soil incorporation, seed treatment, aerial application). Determines equipment requirements and VRA prescription compatibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: foliar_spray|soil_incorporation|seed_treatment|aerial_application|drip_irrigation|broadcast|banding|fumigation|chemigation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; 40 CFR Part 156; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard CB 7.4

attributes.name: application_rate_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the maximum application rate (e.g., oz/acre, lb/acre, L/ha). Required to correctly interpret and enforce the max_application_rate field for VRA prescriptions and compliance audits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oz/acre|fl_oz/acre|lb/acre|pt/acre|qt/acre|gal/acre|kg/ha|L/ha — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; USDA NRCS; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard

attributes.name: concentration_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the active ingredient concentration value (e.g., percent by weight, grams per liter). Ensures correct interpretation of the concentration field for application rate calculations.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; FAO/WHO Pesticide Specifications

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the agrochemical product record was first created in the master catalog system. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements, and SOX financial reporting controls. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements; ISO 22000; SAP S/4HANA MM Audit Log

attributes.name: epa_registration_number
attributes.description: The United States Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) registration number assigned to the pesticide product under FIFRA. Format: registrant-number-product-number (e.g., '524-308'). Mandatory for all pesticide products sold or distributed in the US. Required for FSMA and GLOBALG.A.P. compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3; 40 CFR Part 152; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard; FSMA Produce Safety Rule

attributes.name: epa_toxicity_category
attributes.description: The EPA acute toxicity category (I through IV) assigned to the agrochemical product based on oral, dermal, inhalation, and eye/skin irritation studies. Category I = most toxic (DANGER label); Category IV = least toxic. Drives PPE requirements, worker safety training, and medical surveillance programs.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA 40 CFR Part 156.62; EPA Pesticide Registration Notice; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: formulation_type
attributes.description: The physical and chemical formulation classification of the agrochemical product (e.g., emulsifiable concentrate, wettable powder, suspension concentrate, granule). Determines mixing, handling, and application equipment requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: emulsifiable_concentrate|wettable_powder|suspension_concentrate|granule|soluble_liquid|dry_flowable|water_dispersible_granule|microencapsulated|ultra_low_volume — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FAO/WHO Pesticide Specifications; CIPAC (Collaborative International Pesticides Analytical Council); EPA FIFRA

attributes.name: groundwater_advisory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the EPA-registered label includes a groundwater advisory statement, signaling potential for leaching into groundwater under certain soil and climatic conditions. True = groundwater advisory present; False = no advisory. Drives BMP (Best Management Practices) and buffer zone requirements.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; 40 CFR Part 156; EPA Groundwater Protection Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard AF 1.2

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: The US DOT hazardous materials classification for the agrochemical product as defined in 49 CFR. Determines transportation, labeling, placarding, and emergency response requirements. Used in TMS (Transportation Management System) for shipment compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Class_1|Class_2|Class_3|Class_4|Class_5|Class_6|Class_8|Class_9|Not_Regulated — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: US DOT 49 CFR Parts 171-180; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; GHS; EPA FIFRA; TMS (Transportation Management System)

attributes.name: label_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current version of the EPA-registered product label was approved. The label is the law under FIFRA — this date establishes the authoritative version for compliance purposes and triggers label update workflows when amendments are approved.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 2(p); 40 CFR Part 156; SAP S/4HANA QM Document Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the agrochemical product record was most recently modified in the master catalog. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with source systems (SAP S/4HANA), and regulatory audit trails. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements; ISO 22000; SAP S/4HANA MM Change Documents

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: The name of the company that physically manufactures or formulates the agrochemical product. May differ from the EPA registrant for generic or private-label products. Used for supplier management and procurement in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; EPA FIFRA

attributes.name: max_application_rate
attributes.description: The maximum allowable application rate of the agrochemical product per application event as specified on the EPA-registered label. Used in conjunction with application_rate_unit to enforce label compliance and prevent over-application.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; 40 CFR Part 156; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard

attributes.name: max_seasonal_applications
attributes.description: The maximum number of times the agrochemical product may be applied per growing season per crop as specified on the EPA-registered label. Enforces resistance management and prevents MRL exceedances from cumulative applications.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard CB 7.6; IPM (Integrated Pest Management) guidelines

attributes.name: mode_of_action_code
attributes.description: The IRAC (Insecticide Resistance Action Committee), HRAC (Herbicide Resistance Action Committee), or FRAC (Fungicide Resistance Action Committee) mode of action classification code for the active ingredient. Critical for IPM resistance management rotation planning (e.g., HRAC Group 9 for glyphosate, FRAC Group 11 for strobilurins).
attributes.references: IRAC Mode of Action Classification; HRAC Mode of Action Classification; FRAC Code List; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard; IPM guidelines

attributes.name: omri_listed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agrochemical product appears on the Organic Materials Review Institute (OMRI) Products List, confirming suitability for use in certified organic operations. True = OMRI listed; False = not listed. Complements organic_approved_flag with third-party verification.
attributes.references: OMRI (Organic Materials Review Institute) Products List; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: organic_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agrochemical product is approved for use in certified organic production systems under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). True = approved for organic use; False = not approved. Drives product selection for organic-certified fields and NOP compliance documentation.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; OMRI (Organic Materials Review Institute) Listed; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard

attributes.name: package_size
attributes.description: The quantity of agrochemical product contained in the standard commercial packaging unit (e.g., 2.5, 1.0, 5.0). Used in conjunction with package_unit for procurement, inventory management, and application rate calculations in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; Manhattan Associates WMS Unit of Measure

attributes.name: package_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the package size (e.g., gallon, liter, kg, lb). Combined with package_size to define the standard commercial unit for procurement, inventory, and cost tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gallon|quart|pint|liter|kg|lb|oz|fl_oz|ton — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; USDA NASS; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: pre_harvest_interval_days
attributes.description: The minimum number of days that must elapse between the last application of the agrochemical product and the harvest of the treated crop, as specified on the EPA-registered label. Critical for MRL compliance and food safety under FSMA and GLOBALG.A.P. requirements.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard CB 7.6; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Internal SKU or material number assigned in SAP S/4HANA MM to uniquely identify the agrochemical product within the enterprise ERP system. Used for procurement, inventory, and cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Master; SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) standard

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: The registered commercial or trade name of the agrochemical product as it appears on the EPA-registered label and product packaging (e.g., 'Roundup PowerMAX', 'Headline AMP Fungicide').
attributes.references: EPA Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA); SAP S/4HANA MM Material Description

attributes.name: product_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the agrochemical product in the master catalog. 'active' = currently registered and available for use; 'discontinued' = no longer manufactured or sold; 'suspended' = EPA registration suspended pending review; 'pending_registration' = awaiting EPA approval; 'cancelled' = EPA registration voluntarily cancelled.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 6; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Status; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the agrochemical product by its primary mode of action or functional category. Drives regulatory compliance requirements, application protocols, and PHI/REI enforcement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pesticide|herbicide|fungicide|insecticide|fertilizer|adjuvant|plant_growth_regulator|rodenticide|nematicide|fumigant — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; USDA NASS Pesticide Use Survey; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard CB 7

attributes.name: registrant_name
attributes.description: The name of the company or individual holding the EPA registration for the agrochemical product (e.g., 'Bayer CropScience', 'Syngenta AG', 'BASF Corporation'). Used for regulatory correspondence, label verification, and supplier qualification.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3; EPA Pesticide Registration System (PRISM)

attributes.name: registration_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the EPA registration for the agrochemical product expires and must be renewed. Used to trigger re-registration workflows and prevent use of products with lapsed registrations. Critical for FSMA and GLOBALG.A.P. compliance audits.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3(g); 40 CFR Part 152; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard

attributes.name: resistance_group
attributes.description: The resistance management group designation (e.g., 'HRAC Group 9', 'IRAC Group 4A', 'FRAC Group 3') used to plan chemical rotation programs and prevent development of resistant pest populations. Supports IPM compliance and GLOBALG.A.P. requirements.
attributes.references: IRAC; HRAC; FRAC; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard CB 7.7; IPM (Integrated Pest Management) Best Practices

attributes.name: restricted_entry_interval_hours
attributes.description: The minimum number of hours that must pass after a pesticide application before workers may re-enter the treated area without personal protective equipment (PPE), as mandated by the EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS). Required for OSHA and EPA compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS) 40 CFR Part 170; OSHA 29 CFR 1928.110; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard

attributes.name: restricted_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agrochemical product is classified as a Restricted Use Pesticide (RUP) by the EPA, requiring purchase and application only by certified pesticide applicators. True = restricted use; False = general use. Drives applicator certification verification workflows.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3(d); 40 CFR Part 152 Subpart I; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: sds_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the current Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for the agrochemical product, compliant with OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom 2012) and GHS format. Required for worker safety, emergency response, and regulatory compliance. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA QM document management.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 2012 29 CFR 1910.1200; GHS (Globally Harmonized System) Rev. 9; EPA FIFRA; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: The guaranteed shelf life of the agrochemical product in months from the date of manufacture, as specified by the manufacturer. Used for inventory rotation (FIFO), expiry date tracking, and procurement planning in SAP S/4HANA MM and Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Shelf Life Management; Manhattan Associates WMS; EPA FIFRA Label; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices)

attributes.name: signal_word
attributes.description: The EPA-mandated signal word appearing on the pesticide label indicating the acute toxicity category of the product: DANGER (Category I - most toxic), WARNING (Category II), CAUTION (Category III - least toxic), or EXEMPT. Drives PPE requirements and worker safety protocols.
