attributes.references: EPA FIFRA 40 CFR Part 156.62; OSHA Hazard Communication Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; GHS (Globally Harmonized System)

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: The maximum storage temperature in degrees Celsius permitted for safe storage of the agrochemical product, as specified in the SDS and product label. Exceeding this threshold may cause product degradation, pressure buildup, or hazardous reactions. Used for WMS storage compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 2012; EPA FIFRA Label; GHS SDS Section 7; Manhattan Associates WMS Storage Conditions

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: The minimum storage temperature in degrees Celsius required to maintain product integrity and prevent degradation, as specified in the SDS and product label. Used for warehouse storage condition compliance in Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 2012; EPA FIFRA Label; GHS SDS Section 7; Manhattan Associates WMS Storage Conditions

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: The United Nations (UN) four-digit identification number assigned to hazardous materials for international transport (e.g., 'UN1993' for flammable liquids, 'UN2902' for pesticides). Required on shipping documents, BOL, and placards for DOT and IATA compliance.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods; US DOT 49 CFR; IATA DGR; GHS

products.name: commodity
products.description: Reference catalog of all agricultural commodities traded and produced by the enterprise — the raw, unprocessed agricultural outputs before they become sellable products. Includes grains (corn, wheat, soybeans, rice, barley), oilseeds (canola, sunflower), fiber crops (cotton), produce categories, and livestock commodity classes. Captures USDA commodity codes, HS (Harmonized System) tariff codes for international trade classification, commodity class, unit of measure (BU, CWT, MT), GMO status flag, organic eligibility, and commodity exchange ticker symbols (CBOT, CME). Linked to grading_standard and mrl_threshold for quality and compliance reference. Distinct from product_master: commodity defines WHAT is grown/raised; product_master defines HOW it is packaged and sold.
products.reference: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service Commodity Classification

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each agricultural commodity record in the enterprise catalog. Serves as the primary key for the commodity reference table. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Master

attributes.name: mrl_threshold_id
attributes.description: Reference to the applicable Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) threshold record for this commodity. MRL defines the maximum concentration of pesticide residues legally permitted in or on food and feed commodities per EPA and Codex Alimentarius standards.
attributes.references: EPA Pesticide Tolerances (40 CFR Part 180); Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; EU Regulation 396/2005

attributes.name: allergen_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity is classified as a major food allergen under FDA regulations (e.g., wheat, soybeans, peanuts, tree nuts, milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, sesame). Triggers allergen labeling and cross-contact prevention requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA) - 21 USC 343; FDA FSMA Preventive Controls for Human Food

attributes.name: allergen_type
attributes.description: Specific allergen classification when allergen_flag is True (e.g., 'gluten/wheat', 'soy', 'peanut', 'tree nut', 'milk', 'egg', 'fish', 'shellfish', 'sesame'). Required for FDA-compliant allergen labeling and HACCP allergen control plans.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA); FASTER Act of 2021 (sesame addition)

attributes.name: alternate_uom
attributes.description: Secondary unit of measure used for conversion, international trade, or customer-specific reporting (e.g., MT as alternate to BU for export contracts). Supports dual-unit inventory management in SAP MM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|CWT|MT|LB|KG|TON|BBL|GAL|DOZ|HEAD|OTHER — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Unit of Measure Conversion; ISO 80000-1

attributes.name: benchmark_price
attributes.description: Reference benchmark price per standard unit of measure for this commodity, typically derived from the nearest futures contract or USDA AMS market report. Used for budget planning, contract pricing, and financial reporting. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Market News; WASDE Report; CBOT/CME Futures Settlement Prices

attributes.name: commodity_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the commodity by agricultural category. Drives domain-specific processing rules, storage requirements, and regulatory compliance workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grain|oilseed|fiber|produce|livestock|dairy|poultry|aquaculture|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS) Commodity Classification

attributes.name: commodity_code
attributes.description: Externally-known enterprise code uniquely identifying the commodity across operational systems (SAP MM material number, Granular Farm Management commodity code). Used for cross-system reconciliation and procurement referencing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Number

attributes.name: commodity_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the agricultural commodity (e.g., 'Yellow Corn No. 2', 'Hard Red Winter Wheat', 'Soybeans'). Used in reporting, labeling, and trade documentation.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Commodity Standards

attributes.name: commodity_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the commodity record in the enterprise catalog. Active = currently traded/produced; Inactive = temporarily suspended; Discontinued = no longer produced or traded; Pending Approval = awaiting regulatory or internal approval for new commodity onboarding.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Status

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: Sub-classification within the commodity class providing finer granularity (e.g., 'cereal grain', 'legume', 'root vegetable', 'red meat', 'whole milk'). Supports product hierarchy analytics and USDA reporting segmentation.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Commodity Classification

attributes.name: cool_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) is mandatory for this commodity under USDA AMS regulations. True = COOL labeling required at retail (e.g., beef, pork, lamb, chicken, fish, fresh/frozen produce); False = exempt.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) - 7 CFR Part 65; Agricultural Marketing Act of 1946

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commodity record was first created in the enterprise data catalog. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and SOX financial reporting controls for master data governance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls over Financial Reporting; GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: crop_year
attributes.description: The marketing crop year associated with this commodity definition (e.g., 2024 for the 2024/25 marketing year). Used for WASDE alignment, USDA program eligibility, and seasonal price benchmarking. Follows USDA marketing year conventions by commodity.
attributes.references: USDA World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates (WASDE); USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this commodity record is valid and active in the enterprise catalog. Used for temporal data management, crop year transitions, and regulatory compliance period tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Validity Period; USDA Program Eligibility Dates

attributes.name: exchange_market
attributes.description: Primary futures exchange where this commodity is traded (e.g., CBOT for grains, ICE for cotton and sugar). Determines which price feed and contract specifications apply for hedging and mark-to-market valuation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CBOT|CME|ICE|NYMEX|KCBT|MGE|EURONEXT|OTHER — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT); CME Group; ICE Futures

attributes.name: exchange_ticker
attributes.description: Exchange ticker symbol for the commodity on futures markets (e.g., 'ZC' for CBOT Corn, 'ZS' for CBOT Soybeans, 'ZW' for CBOT Wheat, 'CT' for ICE Cotton). Used for market price benchmarking, hedging, and DTN/WASDE price feed integration.
attributes.references: Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT); Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME); ICE Futures; DTN Market Data

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this commodity record expires or is superseded in the enterprise catalog. Null indicates an open-ended active record. Used for catalog version management and regulatory compliance period end dates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Validity Period

attributes.name: fsma_covered_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Covered Commodity Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity is subject to FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) requirements, including the Produce Safety Rule (21 CFR Part 112) or Preventive Controls for Human Food rule. Drives food safety plan and traceability requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) - 21 CFR Part 112 Produce Safety Rule; FDA FSMA Preventive Controls

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity is derived from genetically modified organisms (GMO), is non-GMO, or holds a certified GMO-free designation. Critical for labeling compliance (USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard), export market access, and customer segregation requirements.
attributes.references: USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (NBFDS); EU Regulation 1829/2003; Non-GMO Project Standard

attributes.name: haccp_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) Category
attributes.description: HACCP food safety category classification for this commodity. Determines the applicable HACCP plan type and critical control point requirements for processing and handling. Aligns with GFSI, SQF, and BRC food safety management standards.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius HACCP Guidelines (CAC/RCP 1-1969); FDA FSMA Preventive Controls; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code; BRC Global Standard for Food Safety

attributes.name: hs_tariff_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System (HS) tariff classification code used for international trade documentation, customs declarations, import/export compliance, and duty rate determination. Typically 6–10 digits per WCO standard.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Nomenclature; U.S. International Trade Commission (USITC) HTS Schedule

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this commodity record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline, audit trail maintenance, and master data synchronization across SAP S/4HANA, Granular, and Climate FieldView.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA MM Change Document; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: moisture_content_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable moisture content percentage for this commodity at point of acceptance or storage. Exceeding this threshold triggers drying requirements or grade dockage. Critical for grain quality management per USDA GIPSA grading standards (e.g., corn ≤15.5%, soybeans ≤13%).
attributes.references: USDA Grain Inspection, Packers and Stockyards Administration (GIPSA) Official Grain Standards; USDA AMS

attributes.name: ndvi_baseline
attributes.description: Reference Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) baseline value for this commodity crop type at optimal growth stage, used for remote sensing yield estimation and crop health benchmarking in Climate FieldView and Esri ArcGIS analytics.
attributes.references: NASA MODIS NDVI Product; Climate FieldView Analytics; Esri ArcGIS Remote Sensing Standards

attributes.name: nop_category
attributes.description: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) classification for this commodity. Certified organic = fully compliant with 7 CFR Part 205; Transitional = in 3-year transition period; Conventional = standard production; Not applicable = non-crop commodity.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) - 7 CFR Part 205; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS)

attributes.name: organic_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity is eligible for organic certification under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). True = eligible for organic production and labeling; False = not eligible (e.g., synthetic inputs required). Drives segregation requirements in storage and logistics.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) - 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the primary country of origin for this commodity (e.g., USA, BRA, ARG). Required for COOL compliance, import/export documentation, and country-of-origin risk assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; USDA COOL Regulations (7 CFR Part 65); WTO Agreement on Rules of Origin

attributes.name: perishable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity is perishable and requires temperature-controlled storage or expedited handling. True = perishable (e.g., fresh produce, dairy, eggs); False = non-perishable (e.g., dry grains, cotton). Drives warehouse task prioritization in Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) - Produce Safety Rule; USDA Perishable Agricultural Commodities Act (PACA)

attributes.name: price_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the benchmark_price (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL). Supports multi-currency operations for international commodity trading and export contracts.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: standard_uom
attributes.description: Primary unit of measure used for trading, pricing, and inventory tracking of this commodity (e.g., BU = Bushel for grains, CWT = Hundredweight for livestock, MT = Metric Ton for export). Aligns with SAP MM base unit of measure and USDA reporting standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|CWT|MT|LB|KG|TON|BBL|GAL|DOZ|HEAD|OTHER — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS); SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure Configuration; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: storage_temp_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this commodity. Exceeding this threshold triggers quality alerts and may result in grade downgrade or rejection per USDA grading standards.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Commodity Storage Standards; FDA FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: storage_temp_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this commodity to maintain quality and safety. Used to configure cold chain requirements in warehouse management and transportation planning.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Commodity Storage Standards; FDA FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: test_weight_min_lbs_bu
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable test weight in pounds per bushel for grade determination of this grain commodity (e.g., US No. 2 Yellow Corn = 54 lbs/bu). Used in USDA GIPSA official grading and price dockage calculations.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Inspection, Packers and Stockyards Administration (GIPSA) Official Grain Standards of the United States

attributes.name: typical_yield_per_acre
attributes.description: Reference average yield per acre for this commodity under standard production conditions, expressed in the standard_uom (e.g., 180 BU/acre for corn, 50 BU/acre for soybeans). Used as baseline for yield variance analysis, crop insurance, and USDA APH (Actual Production History) calculations.
attributes.references: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS) Yield Surveys; USDA Risk Management Agency (RMA) APH

attributes.name: uom_conversion_factor
attributes.description: Numeric factor to convert from standard_uom to alternate_uom (e.g., 1 BU corn = 0.0254 MT; factor = 0.0254). Essential for export documentation, international invoicing, and cross-system inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Inspection, Packers and Stockyards Administration (GIPSA) Weight and Measure Standards

attributes.name: usda_commodity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Commodity Code
attributes.description: Official USDA commodity code assigned by the Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) or Farm Service Agency (FSA). Required for USDA program participation, federal reporting, and commodity loan eligibility determination.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS); USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) Commodity Codes

attributes.name: usda_grade_standard
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Grade Standard
attributes.description: Reference to the applicable USDA grade standard designation for this commodity (e.g., 'US No. 1', 'US No. 2', 'US Extra Fancy', 'USDA Choice'). Determines quality thresholds, price premiums/discounts, and market eligibility. Linked to grading_standard reference product.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Grade Standards; USDA GIPSA Official Grain Standards

products.name: master
products.description: Central master catalog and SSOT for all sellable, transferable, and internally consumed agricultural products. Every product in the enterprise — whether a raw commodity packaged for sale, a processed good, a seed variety, a livestock-derived item, or an agricultural input — has exactly one product_master record. Captures SKU, PLU, UPC, GTIN codes, product hierarchy classification, brand, product line, net weight, packaging type, shelf life, storage requirements (temperature range, humidity, light sensitivity), and product lifecycle status (active, discontinued, seasonal). Distinguishes between conventional, organic (NOP-certified), and non-GMO product lines. Type-specific detail is held in linked detail tables (seed_variety, livestock_product, processed_good, input_product). Aligned with SAP S/4HANA Material Master (MM module).
products.reference: SAP Material Master / USDA Commodity Code

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Primary key for master

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: product_master represents sellable agricultural products that are often based on specific commodities (e.g., a corn product references the corn commodity). Adding commodity_id FK links the product to
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: grading_standard_id
attributes.description: FK to product.grading_standard

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_hierarchy. Business justification: product_master is the central product catalog and must reference product_hierarchy for multi-level classification (division → category → subcategory → product line). This FK enables hierarchical repor
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Commercial brand or trade name under which the product is marketed and sold. Relevant for value-added, processed, and seed products. Used in Salesforce CRM for customer-facing product catalog and sales pipeline management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM Product Catalog

attributes.name: coa_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Analysis (COA) must accompany each shipment of this product. True = COA required for quality verification, regulatory compliance, or customer contract requirements. Drives quality management workflows in SAP QM module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; FDA FSMA; GFSI Standards; ISO 22000

attributes.name: cool_country_of_origin
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Country Code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country of origin for Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance. Mandatory for covered commodities under USDA COOL regulations (7 CFR Part 60 and 65). Used on retail labels and customer documentation.
attributes.references: USDA COOL Regulations 7 CFR Part 60 and 65; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3

attributes.name: cost_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the standard cost value (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Ensures multi-currency financial reporting accuracy for international agricultural operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product master record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for data governance and compliance with SOX financial reporting controls. Aligned with SAP MM material creation timestamp.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this product was or is scheduled to be discontinued and removed from active use in transactions. Null for active products. Used for lifecycle management, inventory liquidation planning, and customer notification workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Status; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this product record becomes active and available for use in transactions (purchasing, sales, production). Corresponds to SAP MM material creation date and marks the start of the product lifecycle in the enterprise catalog.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: food_safety_cert
attributes.description: Primary food safety certification standard applicable to this product (e.g., SQF - Safe Quality Food, BRC - British Retail Consortium, IFS - International Featured Standards, GLOBALG.A.P., HACCP, ISO 22000). Drives audit requirements and customer qualification criteria.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Institute; BRC Global Standards; ISO 22000

attributes.name: fsma_regulated_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Regulated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is subject to FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) regulations, including Preventive Controls for Human Food (21 CFR Part 117) or Produce Safety Rule (21 CFR Part 112). Drives food safety plan requirements and traceability obligations.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Parts 112 and 117; GFSI Standards

attributes.name: gap_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is produced under verified Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) standards. True = GAP-certified production. Required for certain retail customer contracts and export market access. Aligned with USDA GAP/GHP audit program.
attributes.references: USDA GAP/GHP Audit Program; GLOBALG.A.P. Standard; FDA Produce Safety Rule

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Detailed GMO classification of the product per FDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard. 'conventional_gmo' = contains bioengineered ingredients; 'non_gmo_verified' = third-party verified non-GMO; 'bioengineered' = must carry USDA BE disclosure; 'not_applicable' = non-food or non-crop product.
attributes.references: FDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard; USDA AMS; 7 CFR Part 66

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: 14-digit Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) used for global supply chain identification, EDI transactions, and international trade. Encompasses UPC, EAN, and ITF-14 formats under the GS1 standard.
attributes.references: GS1 Global GTIN Standards; ISO/IEC 15459

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: DOT hazardous materials classification code for products that are regulated as dangerous goods during transport (e.g., certain agricultural chemicals, fumigants, compressed gases). Null for non-hazardous products. Required for BOL (Bill of Lading) and shipping documentation.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Parts 171-180; EPA RCRA; OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: humidity_sensitivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product requires controlled humidity storage conditions. True = humidity-sensitive product requiring specific relative humidity (RH) range in storage. Drives warehouse zone assignment and storage condition monitoring.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Storage Guidelines; FDA FSMA; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this product master record. Used for change data capture (CDC), data lineage tracking, and audit compliance. Aligned with SAP MM last change timestamp.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the product in the enterprise catalog. Controls whether the product can be ordered, produced, or sold. Aligned with SAP MM material status (MMSTATUS) field. 'seasonal' indicates availability limited to specific growing or harvest periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Status; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: light_sensitive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product requires protection from light exposure during storage and transport. True = light-sensitive product (e.g., certain produce, seed varieties, specialty crops). Drives packaging and storage specification requirements.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Storage Guidelines; FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: mrl_threshold_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) Threshold in Parts Per Million (PPM)
attributes.description: Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) threshold in parts per million (PPM) for pesticide or chemical residues permitted on this product per EPA and Codex Alimentarius standards. Used in quality control, COA validation, and export compliance. Null for non-food products.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Standard net weight of one sellable unit of this product in kilograms (KG). Used for freight calculations, inventory valuation, customs declarations, and compliance with USDA and FDA labeling requirements. For bulk commodities, represents the standard unit weight (e.g., per bushel, per CWT).
attributes.references: USDA FSIS Labeling Requirements; FDA 21 CFR Part 101; NIST Handbook 44

attributes.name: non_gmo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is verified as non-GMO (Genetically Modified Organism). True = non-GMO verified product. Relevant for labeling compliance, customer preference management, and Non-GMO Project verification programs.
attributes.references: USDA NOP; Non-GMO Project Verified Standard; FDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (7 CFR Part 66)

attributes.name: organic_cert_number
attributes.description: Official USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification number issued by the accredited certifying agent. Required on organic product labels and COA (Certificate of Analysis) documentation. Null for non-organic products.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); 7 CFR Part 205.303

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is certified organic under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). True = NOP-certified organic product. Drives labeling requirements, premium pricing, and supply chain segregation from conventional products.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); 7 CFR Part 205; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Type of packaging used for this product at the sellable unit level (e.g., bulk, bag, box, crate, pallet, drum). Drives warehouse storage configuration, shipping requirements, and labeling compliance. Aligned with SAP MM packaging data and Manhattan Associates WMS container types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bulk|bag|box|crate|pallet|drum|tote|carton|bottle|pouch — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS; USDA FSIS Packaging Standards

attributes.name: plu_code
attributes.description: 4- or 5-digit Price Look-Up (PLU) code assigned to fresh produce and bulk agricultural commodities for retail checkout identification. Managed by the International Federation for Produce Standards (IFPS).
attributes.references: IFPS PLU Code Standards; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Second-level product hierarchy classification (e.g., Grains & Oilseeds, Fresh Produce, Dairy, Poultry, Beef, Pork, Fiber Crops, Horticultural Products, Seeds, Fertilizers). Used for reporting, pricing, and supply chain segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grains_oilseeds|fresh_produce|dairy|poultry|beef|pork|fiber_crops|horticultural|seeds|fertilizers — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; SAP MM Product Hierarchy

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Named product line or portfolio grouping to which this product belongs (e.g., Organic Harvest Line, Premium Grain Series, Non-GMO Select). Supports marketing segmentation, pricing strategy, and customer account management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: The full commercial or trade name of the agricultural product as it appears on labeling, sales orders, and customer-facing documents. Aligned with SAP MM material description field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: product_subcategory
attributes.description: Third-level product hierarchy classification providing granular segmentation within a product category (e.g., within Grains: Corn, Wheat, Soybeans, Rice; within Fresh Produce: Leafy Greens, Root Vegetables, Citrus). Supports detailed analytics and procurement planning.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; SAP MM Product Hierarchy

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the agricultural product type distinguishing between raw commodities (grains, produce, fiber), processed goods, seed/input products, livestock-derived items (meat, dairy, eggs), value-added products, and agricultural inputs (fertilizers, chemicals). Drives linkage to type-specific detail tables.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Type; USDA Commodity Classification

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum shelf life of the product in days from the date of production or harvest under standard storage conditions. Used for inventory rotation (FEFO - First Expired First Out), expiry date calculation, and food safety compliance per FSMA requirements.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; USDA FSIS; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code uniquely identifying a specific product variant for inventory tracking, order management, and warehouse operations. Corresponds to SAP MM material number used in WMS and ERP transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost per base unit of measure used for inventory valuation, variance analysis, and COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation. Set during annual cost roll-up in SAP CO module. Confidential as it reflects internal pricing strategy and margin structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Standard Cost; GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: storage_temp_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum permitted storage temperature in degrees Celsius for maintaining product quality and safety. Exceeding this threshold triggers quarantine hold procedures in the WMS and quality management system.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; USDA FSIS Cold Chain Requirements; ISO 22000

attributes.name: storage_temp_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum required storage temperature in degrees Celsius for maintaining product quality and safety. Used by Manhattan Associates WMS for cold chain storage zone assignment and temperature monitoring compliance.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; USDA FSIS Cold Chain Requirements; ISO 22000

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure (UOM) for this product used in inventory management, purchasing, and sales transactions. Aligned with SAP MM base unit of measure (MEINS). Common agricultural units include BU (Bushel), CWT (Hundredweight), MT (Metric Ton), KG (Kilogram), LB (Pound). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|MT|BU|CWT|EA|CS|BAG|TON|L|GAL — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Base Unit of Measure; USDA AMS; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode identifier used for retail point-of-sale scanning, consumer packaging, and retail distribution. Required for products sold through retail channels.
attributes.references: GS1 US UPC Standards; USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL)

attributes.name: usda_commodity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Commodity Code
attributes.description: Official USDA commodity classification code used for federal reporting, subsidy programs, crop insurance, and WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates) alignment. Maps to USDA Agricultural Marketing Service commodity codes.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; WASDE Reporting Framework

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: SAP MM valuation class code that determines the G/L (General Ledger) account assignment for inventory postings. Controls how inventory value is recorded in financial accounting (FI module) and cost accounting (CO module). Critical for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) and inventory valuation reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Module - Valuation Class; GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2

products.name: hierarchy
products.description: Defines the multi-level classification hierarchy for all agricultural products — from enterprise product division down through category, sub-category, product family, and individual SKU. Supports USDA commodity groupings, internal merchandising hierarchies, and retail category management structures. Enables roll-up reporting across crop commodities, livestock products, processed goods, seed/input products, and value-added lines. Used in SAP S/4HANA SD and MM modules for pricing and reporting hierarchies.
products.reference: SAP Product Hierarchy / USDA ERS Commodity Classification

attributes.name: hierarchy_id

True = COOL labeling required on all products in this node; False = COOL not required. Drives labeling compliance workflows and retail packaging requirements.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Act; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) 7 CFR Part 60 and 65

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product hierarchy node record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: data_steward
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business data steward responsible for maintaining the accuracy and completeness of this hierarchy node. Supports data governance accountability, change management workflows, and master data management (MDM) ownership tracking.
attributes.references: Internal data governance policy; DAMA DMBOK data stewardship framework

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Sales Division code associated with this hierarchy node. Drives pricing, sales organization assignment, and profit center determination. Examples: CROP (Crop Commodities), LVST (Livestock Products), PROC (Processed Goods), SEED (Seed & Inputs), VADD (Value-Added Products).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Division (SPART); USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this product hierarchy node is valid and active for product classification. Supports temporal hierarchy management and ensures historical accuracy when hierarchy structures change. Used in SAP S/4HANA time-dependent product hierarchy configurations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA time-dependent product hierarchy; ISO 8601 date standard

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date after which this product hierarchy node is no longer valid for new product assignments. Null indicates an open-ended, currently active node. Supports hierarchy versioning and ensures products are not assigned to expired classification nodes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA time-dependent product hierarchy; ISO 8601 date standard

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: Cross-reference code mapping this hierarchy node to an external classification system such as UNSPSC (United Nations Standard Products and Services Code), HS (Harmonized System) tariff code, or trading partner category code. attributes.name: food_safety_category
attributes.description: FDA/USDA food safety classification for products in this hierarchy node. Determines applicable food safety regulations, inspection requirements, and labeling rules. Ready-to-Eat products require stricter controls than Raw Agricultural Commodities. Non-Food and Crop Input nodes are exempt from food safety rules.

attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR food safety classifications; USDA FSIS product categories; FSMA Preventive Controls rule

attributes.name: fsma_category

attributes.description: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) regulatory category applicable to products in this hierarchy node. Determines which FSMA rules govern production, handling, and supply chain requirements. Drives compliance program assignment and audit scope.
attributes.value_regex: Produce Safety Rule|Preventive Controls Human Food|Preventive Controls Animal Food|Foreign Supplier Verification|Not Applicable
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); 21 CFR Parts 112, 117, 507; FDA FSVP

attributes.name: gfsi_scheme_applicable

attributes.name: gmo_classification
attributes.description: Indicates the Genetically Modified Organism (GMO) status applicable to products in this hierarchy node. Values: GMO (contains genetically modified material), Non-GMO (no GMO material, not certified), GMO-Free Certified (third-party verified non-GMO), Not Applicable (e.g., agrochemicals). Required for COOL labeling, USDA BE (Bioengineered) disclosure, and export documentation.

attributes.name: gpc_brick_code

attributes.description: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC) Brick-level code for this hierarchy node. Enables standardized product categorization for retail trading partners, EDI transactions, and global supply chain interoperability. Particularly relevant for produce, dairy, and packaged goods nodes.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC) standard; GS1 US

attributes.name: haccp_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) plans are required for products in this hierarchy node. True = HACCP plan mandatory (e.g., meat, poultry, juice, seafood); False = HACCP not required. Drives food safety program assignment and FSIS/FDA audit requirements.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS HACCP regulations (9 CFR Part 417); FDA 21 CFR Part 120; Codex Alimentarius HACCP guidelines

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this hierarchy node are classified as hazardous materials requiring special handling, storage, and transportation documentation (e.g., certain agrochemicals, fertilizers). True = HAZMAT classification applies; False = standard handling. Drives SDS (Safety Data Sheet) requirements and DOT/EPA compliance.
attributes.references: EPA hazardous materials regulations; DOT 49 CFR hazmat transportation; OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (29 CFR 1910.1200)

attributes.name: hierarchy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this hierarchy node. Corresponds to the SAP S/4HANA PRODH (Product Hierarchy) field used in SD pricing and MM material classification. Used for cross-system integration with SAP, Oracle NetSuite, and Granular Farm Management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/MM Product Hierarchy (PRODH); USDA Agricultural Marketing Service commodity codes

attributes.name: hierarchy_description

attributes.name: hierarchy_name

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: level_name

attributes.name: mrl_applicable_flag

attributes.name: organic_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products classified under this hierarchy node are eligible for USDA National Organic Program (NOP) organic certification. True = organic product line; False = conventional or non-organic. Drives organic certification tracking, NOP compliance workflows, and organic premium pricing.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Materialized full path string from root to this node using delimiter notation (e.g., 'Crop Commodities / Grains / Cereal Grains / Corn'). Supports efficient hierarchy traversal queries in Databricks without recursive CTEs. Maintained as a denormalized convenience field.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer best practices; SAP S/4HANA PRODH path

attributes.name: phi_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) tracking is required for products in this hierarchy node. True = PHI compliance mandatory (food/feed crops subject to pesticide application); False = PHI not applicable. Drives crop protection event tracking and harvest scheduling compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) requirements; USDA APHIS; GLOBALG.A.P. crop protection standards

attributes.name: plu_category_code
attributes.description: International Federation for Produce Standards (IFPS) Price Look-Up (PLU) category code for fresh produce hierarchy nodes. Used at retail point-of-sale for produce identification and pricing. Applicable primarily to fresh fruit, vegetable, and herb product hierarchy nodes.
attributes.references: International Federation for Produce Standards (IFPS) PLU code system; USDA AMS produce standards

attributes.name: pricing_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure used for pricing and invoicing products in this hierarchy node. May differ from reporting UOM (e.g., corn priced per BU but reported in MT). Drives SAP S/4HANA SD condition record pricing and Oracle NetSuite invoice generation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|CWT|MT|LB|KG|TON|DOZ|EA|GAL|L — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Unit (KMEIN); USDA AMS commodity pricing conventions

attributes.name: product_line_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the product line represented by this hierarchy node. Distinguishes between Crop Commodity (grains, produce, fiber), Livestock Product (meat, dairy, eggs), Processed Good, Seed Input, Value-Added, and Agrochemical product lines. Drives business rules, compliance requirements, and reporting segmentation.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: reporting_uom
attributes.description: Primary unit of measure used for volume and yield reporting for products in this hierarchy node. Aligned with USDA NASS and WASDE reporting conventions. BU = Bushel, CWT = Hundredweight, MT = Metric Ton, LB = Pound, KG = Kilogram, TON = Short Ton, DOZ = Dozen, EA = Each, GAL = Gallon, L = Liter. Used in SAP S/4HANA MM base unit of measure configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|CWT|MT|LB|KG|TON|DOZ|EA|GAL|L — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NASS reporting units; WASDE commodity reporting; SAP S/4HANA MM Base Unit of Measure (MEINS)

attributes.name: retail_category_code
attributes.description: Internal retail category management code used for merchandising, planogram assignment, and retail buyer reporting. Aligns with PLU (Price Look-Up) category structures and retail trading partner category definitions. Used in Salesforce CRM for customer-facing category reporting.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC); PLU (Price Look-Up) category standards; Salesforce CRM category management

attributes.name: sap_material_group
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Material Group (MATKL field) associated with this hierarchy node. Used in SAP MM for procurement categorization, account determination, and purchasing info records. Enables cross-reference between the product hierarchy and SAP material master classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group (MATKL); SAP S/4HANA SD Product Hierarchy

attributes.name: sap_product_hierarchy
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA native Product Hierarchy (PRODH) code for this node, up to 18 characters. Used directly in SAP SD condition records for pricing, rebate agreements, and sales reporting. Serves as the integration key between this data product and SAP S/4HANA SD/MM modules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Product Hierarchy (PRODH field, table T179); SAP MM material classification

attributes.name: sort_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sort order for displaying this hierarchy node among its siblings at the same parent level. Controls the display sequence in SAP S/4HANA product hierarchy browsers, reporting dashboards, and retail category management tools. Lower numbers appear first.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Product Hierarchy display sequence; internal UI/UX standards

attributes.name: temperature_class
attributes.description: Required storage and handling temperature classification for products in this hierarchy node. Drives cold chain logistics requirements, warehouse slotting in Manhattan Associates WMS, and transportation mode selection in TMS. Values: Ambient, Refrigerated, Frozen, Controlled Atmosphere.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Sanitary Transportation Rule; USDA AMS cold chain standards; Manhattan Associates WMS temperature zone configuration

attributes.name: usda_commodity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Commodity Code
attributes.description: Official USDA commodity classification code assigned to this hierarchy node. Aligns with USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) and National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS) commodity groupings. Required for USDA regulatory reporting, WASDE alignment, and federal program compliance.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Commodity Classification; USDA NASS; WASDE reporting

products.name: seed_variety
products.description: Master catalog of all seed varieties and cultivars used in crop production and sold as input products. Captures variety name, crop species, breeder/licensor, trait package (herbicide tolerance, insect resistance), GMO status, non-GMO verification status, relative maturity rating, yield potential rating, disease resistance profile, and seed treatment applied. Tracks NOP organic seed eligibility and APHIS biotech regulatory status. Sourced from Trimble Ag Software and Climate FieldView variety databases.
products.reference: USDA GRIN / APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services

attributes.name: seed_variety_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each seed variety record in the master catalog. Primary key for the seed_variety data product.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: seed_variety represents cultivars of specific crop species (corn, soybean, wheat) that correspond directly to commodity types in the commodity catalog. Linking seed_variety to commodity via commodity_
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gmo_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.gmo_declaration. Business justification: seed_variety carries three denormalized GMO attributes: aphis_petition_number (the APHIS regulatory petition number for the GMO event), gmo_status (STRING), and non_gmo_verified_flag (BOOLEAN). The gm
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_master. Business justification: seed_variety is a specialized product subtype representing cultivars sold as input products. It must reference product_master for unified SKU/UPC management, lifecycle status, and commercial catalog i
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: breeder_name
attributes.description: Name of the seed company, research institution, or individual breeder that developed and holds intellectual property rights over this variety (e.g., 'Bayer Crop Science', 'Corteva Agriscience', 'Syngenta'). Required for licensing compliance and royalty tracking.
attributes.references: USDA Plant Variety Protection (PVP) Act; International Union for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants (UPOV)

attributes.name: catalog_year
attributes.description: The crop year (4-digit year) for which this seed variety is listed in the commercial product catalog. Used for annual catalog management, variety retirement tracking, and historical performance analysis in Granular Farm Management and Climate FieldView.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management Catalog Management; Climate FieldView Variety Database; Internal Product Lifecycle Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this seed variety record was first created in the master catalog system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; Internal Data Governance Audit Policy; SOX Compliance (Record Creation Audit)

attributes.name: crop_species
attributes.description: Botanical species name of the crop (e.g., 'Zea mays' for corn, 'Glycine max' for soybean, 'Triticum aestivum' for wheat). Aligns with USDA PLANTS Database taxonomy and supports regulatory reporting to APHIS and EPA.
attributes.references: USDA PLANTS Database; APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; Codex Alimentarius Commission

attributes.name: crop_type
attributes.description: High-level agronomic classification of the crop category. Used for product hierarchy segmentation, supply chain routing, and USDA commodity code alignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grain|oilseed|fiber|forage|vegetable|fruit|pulse|tuber|specialty|cover_crop — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS) Crop Classification; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: days_to_maturity
attributes.description: Average number of calendar days from planting to physiological maturity under typical growing conditions for the primary production region. Used for crop scheduling, harvest planning, and frost risk assessment in Climate FieldView and Granular Farm Management.
attributes.references: USDA NASS Crop Progress Reports; Climate FieldView Variety Performance Data; Trimble Ag Software Crop Calendar

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this seed variety was officially discontinued from commercial sale or production. Null if the variety is still active. Used for catalog management, inventory clearance planning, and historical crop planning records.
attributes.references: Internal Product Lifecycle Policy; Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Lifecycle

attributes.name: disease_resistance_profile
attributes.description: Structured description of the variety's resistance or tolerance ratings to key crop diseases (e.g., 'Gray Leaf Spot: R, Northern Corn Leaf Blight: MR, Goss's Wilt: S'). Ratings typically follow industry conventions: R=Resistant, MR=Moderately Resistant, MS=Moderately Susceptible, S=Susceptible. Informs crop protection planning and IPM programs.
attributes.references: USDA ARS Plant Disease Resistance Database; Crop Protection Network Disease Rating Standards; IPM Guidelines

attributes.name: drought_tolerance_rating
attributes.description: Categorical rating of the variety's ability to maintain yield under water-deficit stress conditions. Used for irrigation planning, water resource management, and ET (Evapotranspiration)-based irrigation scheduling in precision agriculture systems.
attributes.references: USDA ARS Drought Tolerance Research; Climate FieldView Variety Analytics; Trimble Ag Software Agronomic Ratings

attributes.name: germination_rate_pct
attributes.description: Minimum guaranteed germination rate percentage for this seed variety as tested under AOSA (Association of Official Seed Analysts) standard germination test conditions. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 = 95%). Required for Federal Seed Act label compliance and quality assurance.
attributes.references: Federal Seed Act (7 U.S.C. § 1551); Association of Official Seed Analysts (AOSA) Rules for Testing Seeds; USDA AMS Seed Regulatory Program

attributes.name: herbicide_tolerance_traits
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of herbicide tolerance traits present in this variety (e.g., 'glyphosate, glufosinate, dicamba'). Used for agrochemical selection, VRA prescription compatibility, and EPA resistance management compliance. Supports IPM resistance group tracking.
attributes.references: EPA Pesticide Registration; Weed Science Society of America (WSSA) Herbicide Resistance Classification; IPM Guidelines

attributes.name: insect_resistance_traits
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of insect resistance traits (e.g., 'Bt Cry1Ab, Cry3Bb1, VIP3A') present in this variety. Used for EPA insect resistance management (IRM) compliance, refuge planning, and IPM program design. Required for APHIS regulatory documentation on Bt crops.
attributes.references: EPA Insect Resistance Management (IRM) Policy; USDA APHIS BRS; Entomological Society of America IRM Guidelines

attributes.name: introduction_date
attributes.description: Date on which this seed variety was first commercially introduced to the market or added to the internal product catalog. Used for variety lifecycle management, performance trend analysis, and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: USDA Plant Variety Protection Office; Internal Product Lifecycle Policy; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this seed variety record in the master catalog. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; Internal Data Governance Audit Policy; SOX Compliance (Record Modification Audit)

attributes.name: licensor_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the seed licensor or technology provider as registered in the ERP procurement master. Used to link seed variety to licensing agreements, royalty schedules, and supplier records in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; USDA Plant Variety Protection Office

attributes.name: nop_organic_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Organic Program (NOP) Organic Seed Eligibility Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this seed variety is eligible for use in USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certified organic production. True = organically produced seed available and eligible; False = not eligible (e.g., treated with prohibited substances or GMO). Drives organic crop planning and NOP compliance documentation.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); 7 CFR Part 205 Organic Regulations; GLOBALG.A.P. Organic Standard

attributes.name: package_weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of the standard commercial seed package in kilograms. Used for freight calculation, warehouse storage planning, and logistics management in Manhattan Associates WMS and TMS (Transportation Management System).
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Item Master; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; USDA AMS Seed Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: plant_height_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the variety's typical plant height at maturity. Used for equipment calibration (combine header height), lodging risk assessment, and field operation planning in John Deere Operations Center.
attributes.references: Crop Science Society of America Variety Description Standards; John Deere Operations Center Field Data

attributes.name: plant_variety_protection_number
attributes.description: USDA Plant Variety Protection Office certificate number assigned to this variety, granting intellectual property protection to the breeder. Null if the variety is not PVP-protected or is in the public domain. Required for licensing compliance and royalty management.
attributes.references: USDA Plant Variety Protection Act (7 U.S.C. § 2321); UPOV Convention

attributes.name: purity_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of pure seed (by weight) of the labeled variety in the seed lot, as determined by official seed analysis. Required for Federal Seed Act label compliance. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 99.50 = 99.5% pure seed).
attributes.references: Federal Seed Act (7 U.S.C. § 1551); AOSA Rules for Testing Seeds; USDA AMS Seed Regulatory Program

attributes.name: recommended_planting_regions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic regions, states, or USDA Plant Hardiness Zones where this variety is agronomically recommended for commercial production (e.g., 'Corn Belt, Northern Plains, Zone 5-7'). Supports geographic segmentation in Esri ArcGIS field mapping and regional sales planning.
attributes.references: USDA Plant Hardiness Zone Map; USDA AMS Regional Variety Trial Data; Trimble Ag Software Regional Recommendations

attributes.name: relative_maturity_rating
attributes.description: Numeric relative maturity rating indicating the number of days or heat units required for the variety to reach physiological maturity relative to a standard check variety (e.g., 108.5 for a 108.5-day corn hybrid, 3.8 for a 3.8 maturity group soybean). Critical for crop planning, planting date optimization, and frost risk management in Climate FieldView and Trimble Ag Software.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Seed Variety Performance Trials; North American Soybean Maturity Group Classification; Corn Belt Relative Maturity Standards

attributes.name: seed_class
attributes.description: Official seed certification class indicating the generation and purity level of the seed as defined by the Association of Official Seed Certifying Agencies (AOSCA). Classes: 'breeder' (source seed from originating breeder), 'foundation' (first generation from breeder seed), 'registered' (second generation), 'certified' (commercially distributed certified seed), 'commercial' (uncertified commercial seed).
attributes.references: Association of Official Seed Certifying Agencies (AOSCA) Seed Certification Standards; USDA AMS Federal Seed Act

attributes.name: seed_size_category
attributes.description: Physical size classification of the seed kernel used for planter plate selection, seeding equipment calibration, and seed unit weight calculations. Affects planter population accuracy and is required for John Deere Operations Center equipment setup.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Planter Configuration; AOSA Seed Testing Standards; Equipment Calibration SOPs

attributes.name: seed_treatment_active_ingredient
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of active ingredients (AI) in the seed treatment formulation (e.g., 'clothianidin, metalaxyl, fludioxonil'). Required for MRL compliance, EPA registration cross-reference, and FSMA produce safety rule documentation.
attributes.references: EPA Active Ingredient Registry; USDA FSMA Produce Safety Rule; Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards

attributes.name: seed_treatment_applied
attributes.description: Name or code of the seed treatment product(s) applied to the seed lot prior to sale or planting (e.g., 'Poncho 1250 + Acceleron', 'Cruiser Maxx Vibrance'). Includes fungicide, insecticide, and biological seed treatments. Required for EPA label compliance, PHI/REI tracking, and NOP organic eligibility determination.
attributes.references: EPA Pesticide Registration (FIFRA); USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.204 (Seed Treatment Restrictions); SDS (Safety Data Sheet) Requirements

attributes.name: seeding_rate_per_acre
attributes.description: Manufacturer or agronomist-recommended seeding rate expressed as seeds per acre for optimal stand establishment. Used for VRA (Variable Rate Application) prescription generation in Trimble Ag Software and seed quantity planning in Granular Farm Management.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software VRA Prescription Standards; Climate FieldView Planting Recommendations; USDA Extension Agronomic Guidelines

attributes.name: seeds_per_unit
attributes.description: Number of seeds per standard commercial unit (e.g., seeds per 80,000-count bag for corn, seeds per 140,000-count bag for soybean). Used for inventory management, seeding rate calculations, and order quantity planning in SAP S/4HANA MM and Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure Configuration; Manhattan Associates WMS Item Master; USDA AMS Seed Labeling

attributes.name: trait_package
attributes.description: Descriptive label of the bundled biotechnology or conventionally bred trait stack applied to this variety (e.g., 'RoundupReady2Xtend + Bollgard3', 'Enlist E3', 'LibertyLink GT27'). Captures herbicide tolerance, insect resistance, drought tolerance, and other engineered or selected traits. Used for IPM planning, agrochemical compatibility, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS BRS Trait Registry; EPA Pesticide Registration (for Bt traits); Integrated Pest Management (IPM) Framework

attributes.name: variety_code
attributes.description: Internally assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the seed variety in ERP and FMIS systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA material master number or Trimble Ag Software variety code). Used as the business key for cross-system integration and SKU linkage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module Material Master; Trimble Ag Software Variety Database

attributes.name: variety_name
attributes.description: Commercial or proprietary name of the seed variety as registered by the breeder or licensor (e.g., 'DeKalb DKC62-08', 'Pioneer P1197AM'). This is the primary human-readable identifier used in field operations, procurement, and sales.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Variety Registration; GLOBALG.A.P. Seed Traceability Standard

attributes.name: variety_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the seed variety in the product catalog. 'active' indicates commercially available; 'discontinued' indicates no longer sold or planted; 'under_review' indicates pending regulatory or internal evaluation; 'pending_approval' indicates awaiting APHIS or NOP certification; 'withdrawn' indicates removed due to regulatory or quality issues.
attributes.references: APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; USDA National Organic Program (NOP); Internal Product Lifecycle Policy

attributes.name: yield_potential_rating
attributes.description: Categorical rating of the variety's yield potential relative to comparable varieties in the same crop class and maturity group, as determined by multi-environment trial (MET) data. Used for variety selection, agronomic planning, and YPM (Yield Per Acre Metric) benchmarking in Granular Farm Management.
attributes.references: USDA NASS Variety Performance Trials; Association of Official Seed Certifying Agencies (AOSCA); Climate FieldView Variety Analytics

products.name: organic_certification
products.description: Tracks USDA National Organic Program (NOP) organic certification records for products, product lines, and production operations. Captures certifying agent name, certificate number, certification scope (crops, livestock, handling/processing), certification effective date, expiration date, annual renewal status, allowed materials list, and any suspension or revocation events. Links products to their certified organic status and supports COOL and organic labeling compliance. Required for organic premium pricing and retail organic claims.
products.reference: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) / 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: organic_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each organic certification record. Primary key for the organic_certification data product.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural product or commodity in the product catalog that is covered under this organic certification. Links the certification record to the specific sellable or transferable item for organic labeling and premium pricing eligibility.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.303; USDA Commodity Codes

attributes.name: allowed_materials_list_reference
attributes.description: Document reference or identifier for the approved materials list associated with this certification. Lists all inputs (fertilizers, pesticides, processing aids) approved for use under the certified organic system plan, cross-referenced against the USDA National List of Allowed and Prohibited Substances.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.601-205.606; OMRI (Organic Materials Review Institute) Listed Products

attributes.name: annual_renewal_status
attributes.description: Tracks the current annual renewal status of the organic certification. Renewed: successfully renewed for the current certification year. Pending_renewal: renewal application submitted and under review. Not_renewed: operation chose not to renew. Overdue: renewal deadline passed without submission.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406(b); USDA NOP Annual Update Requirements

attributes.name: certificate_document_reference
attributes.description: File path, document management system reference, or URL pointing to the scanned or digital copy of the official organic certificate issued by the certifying agent. Supports audit trail, labeling compliance verification, and customer COA (Certificate of Analysis) requests.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406; ISO 22000 Document Control

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Externally-issued certificate number assigned by the accredited certifying agent. This is the official document reference used in regulatory filings, labeling claims, and audit trails under USDA NOP requirements.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406; GLOBALG.A.P. Organic Certification

attributes.name: certification_scope
attributes.description: The operational scope covered by this organic certificate as defined by USDA NOP. Valid values: crops (field and greenhouse crop production), livestock (animal husbandry), handling_processing (post-harvest handling and processing operations), wild_crops (wild-harvested plant materials), aquatic_animals (aquatic animal production). Determines which products and operations are covered under this certificate.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.201; USDA NOP Accreditation Program

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the organic certification. Active: certificate is valid and in good standing. Suspended: temporarily halted pending investigation or corrective action. Revoked: permanently cancelled due to violation. Pending: application submitted, awaiting certifying agent approval. Expired: past expiration date without renewal. Withdrawn: voluntarily relinquished by the operation.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.662; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.665

attributes.name: certified_acreage
attributes.description: Total land area in acres covered under this organic certification. Represents the certified organic production footprint and is used for yield planning, premium pricing calculations, and regulatory reporting to USDA.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.201; USDA NASS Organic Survey

attributes.name: certifying_agent_code
attributes.description: The official USDA-assigned accreditation code or identifier for the certifying agent. Used for regulatory cross-referencing with USDA AMS accreditation records and electronic filing systems.
attributes.references: USDA AMS National Organic Program Accreditation; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.500

attributes.name: certifying_agent_name
attributes.description: The name of the USDA-accredited certifying agent (ACA) that issued and administers this organic certificate. Certifying agents are third-party organizations accredited by the USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) to certify organic operations.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.501; USDA AMS Accredited Certifying Agents List

attributes.name: cool_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the organic certification record supports Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance requirements. COOL mandates disclosure of the country of origin for covered commodities at retail, and organic products must meet both NOP and COOL labeling requirements.
attributes.references: USDA COOL 7 CFR Part 60 and 65; Agricultural Marketing Act of 1946

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the certified organic product was produced or primarily grown. Required for COOL compliance and international organic equivalency agreements.
attributes.references: USDA COOL 7 CFR Part 60; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 2-1985

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this organic certification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage tracking, and compliance record-keeping in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 22000 Record Control; GDPR Article 5(e)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organic certification becomes legally valid and binding. Marks the start of the certified period during which organic labeling claims and premium pricing are authorized.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406(a)

attributes.name: equivalency_standard
attributes.description: Identifies the specific international organic standard or equivalency arrangement recognized by this certification (e.g., EU Organic, Canada Organic, Japan JAS Organic, IFOAM). Populated only when international_equivalency_flag is True.
attributes.references: USDA NOP International Organic Equivalency Arrangements; IFOAM Organic Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organic certification expires and must be renewed to maintain organic status. Organic certificates are typically issued on an annual basis. Expiration triggers renewal workflow and may affect organic premium pricing eligibility.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406(b); USDA NOP Annual Renewal Requirements

attributes.name: fsma_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the certified organic operation is also compliant with applicable Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) rules, including the Produce Safety Rule and Preventive Controls for Human Food. Organic certification does not automatically confer FSMA compliance.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 112; FDA FSMA Produce Safety Rule

attributes.name: globalg_ap_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the operation holds concurrent GLOBALG.A.P. (Global Good Agricultural Practices) certification in addition to USDA NOP organic certification. GLOBALG.A.P. certification is often required by major retail buyers and export markets.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Integrated Farm Assurance (IFA) Standard; GFSI Benchmarking

attributes.name: gmo_free_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the certified operation and its products are verified as free from Genetically Modified Organisms (GMOs). USDA NOP prohibits the use of excluded methods including genetic engineering; this flag confirms GMO-free status as part of organic compliance.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.105(e); Non-GMO Project Standard

attributes.name: international_equivalency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is recognized under an international organic equivalency arrangement (e.g., USDA-EU Organic Equivalency Agreement, USDA-Canada Organic Equivalency Arrangement). Enables certified organic products to be sold as organic in partner countries without additional certification.
attributes.references: USDA NOP International Trade; EU Organic Regulation 2018/848; Canada Organic Regime

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent on-site inspection conducted by the certifying agent at the certified operation. Annual on-site inspections are required under USDA NOP to verify compliance with organic standards.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.403; USDA NOP On-Site Inspection Requirements

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this organic certification record was most recently modified. Tracks changes to certification status, renewal events, suspension/revocation actions, and document updates for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 22000 Record Control; GDPR Article 5(e)

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next on-site inspection by the certifying agent. Used for compliance planning and operational readiness to ensure the operation is prepared for the annual NOP inspection.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.403

attributes.name: nop_system_plan_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Organic Program (NOP) Organic System Plan Reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or identifier for the Organic System Plan (OSP) submitted to and approved by the certifying agent. The OSP is the foundational compliance document describing all practices, materials, and monitoring activities for the certified operation.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.201; USDA NOP Organic System Plan Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional remarks, conditions, or special provisions associated with this organic certification record. May include certifying agent conditions, corrective action requirements, or operational notes relevant to compliance management.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: operation_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the certified organic operation (farm, ranch, or handling facility) as it appears on the organic certificate. This is the entity name recognized by the certifying agent and USDA NOP for compliance purposes.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.401; USDA NOP Organic System Plan

attributes.name: operation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the certified organic operation type. Producer: farms and ranches growing organic crops or raising organic livestock. Handler: facilities processing or packaging organic products. Broker: entities buying and selling organic products. Importer: entities importing certified organic products. Distributor: entities distributing certified organic products.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.2; USDA NOP Definitions

attributes.name: organic_label_type
attributes.description: The USDA NOP-defined organic labeling category authorized for products under this certification. 100_percent_organic: all ingredients are certified organic. Organic: at least 95% certified organic ingredients. Made_with_organic: 70-95% certified organic ingredients. Organic_ingredients: less than 70% organic, may list specific organic ingredients. Determines permissible label claims and USDA Organic Seal usage.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.301-205.310; USDA Organic Seal Usage Guidelines

attributes.name: premium_pricing_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products covered by this certification are currently eligible for organic premium pricing in sales and distribution channels. Eligibility requires active certification status and valid organic label type authorization.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.300; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service Organic Price Reporting

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
