attributes.description: The deadline by which the annual renewal application and supporting documentation must be submitted to the certifying agent to maintain uninterrupted organic certification status.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406(b)

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organic certification was permanently revoked by the certifying agent. Populated only when certification_status is 'revoked'. Revocation is the most severe enforcement action and prohibits the operation from making organic claims.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.665

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for permanent revocation of the organic certification. Documents the specific violation or fraudulent activity that resulted in the certifying agent revoking the certificate.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.665; USDA NOP Adverse Action Procedures

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organic certification was suspended by the certifying agent. Populated only when certification_status is 'suspended'. Suspension may result from non-compliance findings, use of prohibited substances, or failure to submit required documentation.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.662

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for suspension of the organic certification. Documents the specific non-compliance finding or violation that triggered the suspension action by the certifying agent.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.662; USDA NOP Adverse Action Procedures

attributes.name: transition_complete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the mandatory 36-month organic transition period has been completed for the land or operation covered by this certification. True indicates the operation has fulfilled the transition requirement and is eligible for full organic certification.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.202(b)

attributes.name: transition_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the operation began the mandatory 36-month transition period required before land can be certified organic under USDA NOP. During transition, no prohibited substances may be applied to the land.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.202(b); USDA NOP Transition Requirements

products.name: gmo_declaration
products.description: Records GMO status declarations and non-GMO verification records for agricultural products and commodities. Captures GMO trait description, transformation event identifier (APHIS petition number), approved market status by jurisdiction (US, EU, China), non-GMO verification body (Non-GMO Project, USDA Organic), identity preservation (IP) protocol reference, and testing/verification date. Supports USDA BE (Bioengineered Food Disclosure) labeling compliance and export market GMO documentation requirements.
products.reference: USDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard / APHIS BRS

attributes.name: gmo_declaration_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each GMO declaration record. Primary key for the gmo_declaration data product.
attributes.references: USDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (BFDS); APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural product or commodity for which this GMO declaration is recorded. Links to the product catalog master.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS); USDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (BFDS)

attributes.name: organic_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.organic_certification. Business justification: gmo_declaration.organic_certified_flag and organic_certificate_number indicate that a GMO declaration may reference an associated organic certification (non-GMO products are often also organically cer
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: aphis_petition_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) Petition Number
attributes.description: APHIS petition number associated with the deregulation or regulatory approval of the specific bioengineered trait or transformation event. Used to verify US market approval status and cross-reference APHIS regulatory records.
attributes.references: APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services 7 CFR Part 340; USDA

attributes.name: be_disclosure_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product requires Bioengineered (BE) food disclosure labeling under the USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (NBFDS). Drives label generation and compliance workflows.
attributes.references: USDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (BFDS) 7 CFR Part 66; FSMA

attributes.name: be_disclosure_type
attributes.description: Method of BE food disclosure used on product labeling as required by USDA NBFDS. Options include on-package text, USDA BE symbol, electronic/digital link (QR code), or phone number. 'not_required' when product is exempt.
attributes.references: USDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (BFDS) 7 CFR Part 66; AMS

attributes.name: certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the non-GMO certificate or GMO verification certificate expires and must be renewed. Drives compliance monitoring and re-certification workflows.
attributes.references: Non-GMO Project Standard; USDA NOP; GLOBALG.A.P.; GFSI

attributes.name: china_market_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMO transformation event has received regulatory approval for import or commercial use in China. Required for export documentation to Chinese buyers and compliance with MARA (Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs) biosafety certificates.
attributes.references: China MARA Biosafety Certificate; Codex Alimentarius; USDA Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS)

attributes.name: coa_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the Certificate of Analysis (COA) associated with this GMO declaration. The COA contains the full laboratory test results and is provided to customers and regulatory bodies.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GFSI; SQF; BRC Global Standards; ISO 22000

attributes.name: cool_country_of_origin
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Country of Origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country of origin of the product as required for Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance. Relevant for GMO declarations as country of origin may affect applicable GMO regulations.
attributes.references: USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) 7 CFR Part 60; AMS; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this GMO declaration record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 22000; FSMA

attributes.name: declaration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the GMO declaration was formally submitted or issued. Represents the principal business event date for this record, distinct from system audit timestamps.
attributes.references: USDA BFDS 7 CFR Part 66; APHIS; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

attributes.name: declaration_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this GMO declaration record, used in regulatory submissions, export documentation, and audit trails. Follows internal numbering convention (e.g., GMO-2024-00123).
attributes.references: USDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (BFDS); APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: declaration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GMO declaration record. Tracks the workflow from initial draft through regulatory review to approval, expiry, or withdrawal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_review|approved|rejected|expired|withdrawn — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (BFDS); APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; ISO 22000

attributes.name: declared_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or organization responsible for submitting this GMO declaration. Used for accountability, audit trail, and regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: USDA BFDS; APHIS; FSMA; SOX

attributes.name: donor_organism
attributes.description: Scientific name of the organism from which the introduced genetic material was derived (e.g., 'Agrobacterium tumefaciens', 'Bacillus thuringiensis'). Required for regulatory submissions and export documentation.
attributes.references: APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 45-2003; EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003

attributes.name: eu_market_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMO transformation event has received regulatory approval for commercial use or import in the European Union. Critical for export compliance and trade documentation.
attributes.references: EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003; EU Regulation (EC) No 1830/2003; European Food Safety Authority (EFSA)

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Declared GMO classification of the product. 'bioengineered' aligns with USDA BE disclosure requirements. 'non_gmo' indicates verified absence of bioengineered material. 'conventional' indicates no GMO testing performed. 'under_assessment' indicates testing in progress.
attributes.references: USDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (BFDS) 7 CFR Part 66; APHIS; EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003

attributes.name: gmo_threshold_percent
attributes.description: Maximum allowable percentage of GMO material for the product to be classified as non-GMO or to meet the applicable regulatory threshold for the target market (e.g., 0.9% for EU, 5.0% for Japan). Drives compliance determination logic.
attributes.references: EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003; Japan MHLW; Non-GMO Project Standard (0.9%); USDA BFDS

attributes.name: introduced_gene
attributes.description: Name of the gene or genetic construct introduced into the organism (e.g., 'cp4 epsps', 'cry1Ab', 'bar'). Used for scientific documentation, regulatory submissions, and export market approval cross-referencing.
attributes.references: APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 45-2003; EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003

attributes.name: ip_protocol_reference
attributes.description: Reference code or document identifier for the Identity Preservation (IP) protocol applied to maintain the segregation and traceability of non-GMO or specific GMO product streams throughout the supply chain. Supports USDA BE disclosure and export market requirements.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) IP Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000; GFSI

attributes.name: japan_market_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMO transformation event has received regulatory approval for import or commercial use in Japan. Required for export documentation to Japanese buyers under Japan's Food Safety Commission GMO approval framework.
attributes.references: Japan Food Safety Commission; Japan Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW); Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this GMO declaration record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and data freshness monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 22000; FSMA

attributes.name: non_gmo_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate or verification number issued by the non-GMO verification body. Used for audit trail, customer documentation, and regulatory compliance. Null when no third-party verification exists.
attributes.references: Non-GMO Project Standard; USDA National Organic Program (NOP); GFSI

attributes.name: non_gmo_verification_body
attributes.description: Name of the third-party organization that verified and certified the non-GMO status of the product (e.g., Non-GMO Project, USDA Organic NOP). Applicable only when gmo_status is 'non_gmo'. 'none' indicates no third-party verification.
attributes.references: Non-GMO Project Standard; USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product holds USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification. Organic certification inherently prohibits GMO use; this flag supports cross-validation of GMO status against organic certification status.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; IFOAM; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, qualifications, or explanations related to the GMO declaration. May include details on testing anomalies, conditional approvals, or market-specific exceptions.
attributes.references: USDA BFDS; GFSI; ISO 22000

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the GMO declaration was reviewed and approved or rejected by the responsible quality or regulatory team. Supports workflow tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: USDA BFDS; GFSI; SQF; BRC Global Standards; ISO 22000

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the quality assurance or regulatory compliance officer who reviewed and approved or rejected this GMO declaration. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: USDA BFDS; GFSI; ISO 22000; SOX; FSMA

attributes.name: sample_lot_number
attributes.description: Lot or batch number of the product sample submitted for GMO testing. Enables traceability from the GMO declaration back to the specific production lot for recall management and audit purposes.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; USDA AMS; HACCP; ISO 22000

attributes.name: test_result_percent
attributes.description: Quantitative result of GMO testing expressed as a percentage of GMO material detected in the sample (e.g., 0.0500 = 0.05%). Used to assess compliance against regulatory thresholds (e.g., EU 0.9% labeling threshold, Japan 5% threshold).
attributes.references: EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 (0.9% threshold); Japan MHLW (5% threshold); ISO 21570; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: testing_laboratory
attributes.description: Name of the accredited laboratory that performed GMO testing on the product. Must be an ISO 17025-accredited laboratory for regulatory acceptance of results.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; USDA AMS; Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 74-2010

attributes.name: testing_method
attributes.description: Laboratory method used to test for the presence or absence of GMO material in the product (e.g., PCR - Polymerase Chain Reaction, ELISA - Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay). 'not_tested' when no laboratory testing was performed.
attributes.references: ISO 21569; ISO 21570; ISO 21571; Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 74-2010; USDA AMS

attributes.name: threshold_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Jurisdiction or market for which the gmo_threshold_percent applies. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or 'global' for internationally harmonized thresholds. Enables multi-market compliance management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|EU|CHN|JPN|BRA|CAN|AUS|global — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; Codex Alimentarius; USDA Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS)

attributes.name: trait_description
attributes.description: Descriptive name and functional summary of the introduced genetic trait (e.g., 'Herbicide tolerance - glyphosate', 'Insect resistance - Bt Cry1Ab protein', 'Drought tolerance - DREB transcription factor'). Supports product labeling, COA documentation, and export market compliance.
attributes.references: APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 45-2003; USDA BFDS

attributes.name: us_market_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMO transformation event has received regulatory approval for commercial use in the United States market. Verified against APHIS deregulation status and FDA/EPA approvals.
attributes.references: APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; FDA; EPA; USDA BFDS 7 CFR Part 66

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which GMO status was verified through testing, certification, or third-party audit. Used to determine currency of the declaration and trigger re-verification workflows.
attributes.references: USDA BFDS; Non-GMO Project Standard; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

products.name: grading_standard
products.description: Reference catalog of all applicable grading standards and grade specifications for agricultural commodities and products. Captures USDA grade designation (e.g., US No. 1, US Extra Fancy, USDA Prime), commodity type, grading criteria (moisture content, test weight, foreign material tolerance, defect limits), applicable regulation citation, effective date, and administering agency (AMS, FSIS, GIPSA). Supports quality inspection workflows and COA generation. Aligned with USDA AMS and GIPSA official grade standards.
products.reference: USDA AMS / GIPSA Official United States Standards for Grain

attributes.name: grading_standard_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each grading standard record in the agricultural product catalog. Primary key for the grading_standard reference entity.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA Official Grade Standards

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: grading_standard is defined for specific commodity types (e.g., USDA Grade No. 1 Hard Red Winter Wheat). grading_standard.commodity_name is a denormalized string reference to the commodity catalog. Ad
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: mrl_threshold_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.mrl_threshold. Business justification: grading_standard currently stores mrl_threshold_ppm as a denormalized DECIMAL scalar. The mrl_threshold table is the authoritative SSOT for Maximum Residue Limits. A grading standard for an agricultur
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: administering_agency
attributes.description: Federal agency responsible for administering and enforcing this grading standard (e.g., AMS - Agricultural Marketing Service, GIPSA - Grain Inspection Packers and Stockyards Administration, FSIS - Food Safety and Inspection Service). Determines inspection authority and regulatory citation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AMS|GIPSA|FSIS|APHIS|FDA|EPA|NOP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; FSIS; APHIS; FDA; EPA; NOP

attributes.name: applicable_market_class
attributes.description: Market class or sub-class of the commodity to which this grading standard applies (e.g., 'Hard Red Winter', 'Soft White', 'Yellow Dent Corn', 'Angus Beef'). Provides finer commodity segmentation within the commodity type for accurate grade assignment.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA Official Grain Standards; FSIS

attributes.name: coa_template_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the COA document template associated with this grading standard. Used by quality inspection workflows in SAP QM to auto-populate COA documents upon grade assignment.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; SAP S/4HANA QM Module; ISO 22000

attributes.name: color_requirement
attributes.description: Descriptive color specification or color score range required for this grade designation (e.g., 'minimum 50% red color for US Extra Fancy apples', 'bright yellow for US No. 1 corn'). Applies primarily to produce and livestock grading per USDA AMS standards.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Produce Grading Standards; FSIS

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: Broad commodity category to which this grading standard applies (e.g., grain, oilseed, produce, fiber, livestock, dairy, poultry, egg, processed). Aligns with USDA commodity classification for routing to the correct inspection workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grain|oilseed|produce|fiber|livestock|dairy|poultry|egg|processed — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA AMS Commodity Classification; GIPSA

attributes.name: cool_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) is required for products graded under this standard. When True, COA and product labeling must include country of origin per USDA AMS COOL regulations.
attributes.references: USDA AMS COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) Regulations; 7 CFR Part 60

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grading standard record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per SOX and FSMA compliance frameworks.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FSMA; ISO 22000; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this grading standard became or becomes officially effective and enforceable. Used to determine applicability during quality inspection and COA generation workflows.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; Federal Register

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this grading standard expires or is superseded. Null indicates the standard is open-ended with no scheduled expiration. Used to enforce version control in quality inspection workflows.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; Federal Register

attributes.name: foreign_material_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable percentage of foreign material (non-commodity matter) permitted for this grade designation. A standard GIPSA grading factor for grains, oilseeds, and other bulk commodities.
attributes.references: GIPSA Official Grain Standards; USDA AMS

attributes.name: gfsi_scheme_alignment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Scheme Alignment
attributes.description: Identifies the GFSI-recognized food safety scheme (e.g., SQF, BRC, IFS, GLOBALG.A.P., FSSC 22000) with which this grading standard is aligned or compatible. Supports customer audit and certification requirements.
attributes.references: GFSI (Global Food Safety Initiative); SQF; BRC Global Standards; IFS; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

attributes.name: gmo_applicability
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grading standard applies to GMO products, non-GMO products, or both. Supports product line segregation for non-GMO and conventional product lines per USDA and GLOBALG.A.P. requirements.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GLOBALG.A.P.; Non-GMO Project Standard

attributes.name: grade_designation
attributes.description: Official grade label assigned by the administering agency (e.g., 'US No. 1', 'US No. 2', 'US Extra Fancy', 'USDA Prime', 'USDA Choice', 'US Grade A'). Represents the quality tier within the standard. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: US No. 1|US No. 2|US No. 3|US Extra Fancy|USDA Prime|USDA Choice|USDA Select|US Grade A|US Grade B|US Grade C — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA Official Grade Standards; FSIS Grading Standards

attributes.name: grading_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to assess and assign this grade (e.g., visual inspection, mechanical sizing, laboratory analysis, electronic/NIR sensing, or a combination). Determines inspection workflow and equipment requirements in SAP QM and field operations.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; ISO 22000; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: inspection_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency of grading inspections for commodities subject to this standard (e.g., per lot, per shipment, per batch, periodic, continuous). Drives quality inspection scheduling in SAP QM and Manhattan WMS workflows.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; FSMA; ISO 22000; HACCP

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grading standard record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with SAP QM, and regulatory audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FSMA; ISO 22000; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: moisture_content_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable moisture content (%) for a commodity to qualify for this grade designation. A critical grading criterion for grains and oilseeds per GIPSA standards. Exceeding this threshold results in grade reduction or rejection.
attributes.references: GIPSA Official Grain Standards; USDA AMS

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional remarks, special conditions, or clarifications related to this grading standard (e.g., seasonal applicability, regional exceptions, special handling requirements). Used by quality and compliance teams.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA

attributes.name: organic_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grading standard is applicable to USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certified organic products. When True, the standard supports organic product line quality certification and COA generation.
attributes.references: USDA NOP (National Organic Program); 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: Date on which this grading standard was officially published in the Federal Register or by the administering agency. Distinct from the effective date; used for regulatory audit trails and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Federal Register; USDA AMS; GIPSA

attributes.name: regulation_citation
attributes.description: Official regulatory citation for the grading standard, including CFR title, part, and section (e.g., '7 CFR Part 26', '7 CFR Part 868', '9 CFR Part 319'). Required for COA generation and FSMA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; FSIS; Code of Federal Regulations (CFR); FSMA

attributes.name: serious_defects_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable percentage of serious defects (e.g., heat-damaged kernels, mold, insect damage) permitted for this grade. Serious defects are a distinct sub-category of total defects with stricter tolerance limits per GIPSA standards.
attributes.references: GIPSA Official Grain Standards; USDA AMS

attributes.name: size_requirement
attributes.description: Size specification or size range required for this grade designation (e.g., minimum diameter in mm, weight per unit, count per carton). Applies to produce, eggs, and livestock products per USDA AMS grading standards.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Produce Grading Standards; FSIS

attributes.name: standard_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the grading standard (e.g., 'USDA-GR1-CORN', 'AMS-EF-APPLE'). Used as the business key for cross-system reference and COA generation.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA Official Grade Standards; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: standard_document_url
attributes.description: URL link to the official published grading standard document on the administering agency's website (e.g., USDA AMS, GIPSA). Provides direct access to the authoritative source document for quality inspectors and compliance teams.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; Federal Register

attributes.name: standard_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the grading standard as published by the administering agency (e.g., 'United States Standards for Grades of Corn', 'USDA Extra Fancy Grade for Apples'). Used in COA documentation and quality inspection workflows.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA Official Grade Standards

attributes.name: standard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the grading standard. 'active' indicates the standard is currently in force; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version; 'withdrawn' indicates no longer applicable; 'draft' or 'pending' indicates under review or awaiting official publication.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA Official Grade Standards

attributes.name: superseded_by_code
attributes.description: Standard code of the newer grading standard that replaces this record when status is 'superseded'. Enables forward navigation in the version chain for compliance and historical reporting.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA

attributes.name: test_weight_min_lbs_bu
attributes.description: Minimum test weight in pounds per bushel (lbs/bu) required for a grain or oilseed commodity to qualify for this grade. Test weight is a key GIPSA grading factor reflecting grain density and quality.
attributes.references: GIPSA Official Grain Standards; USDA AMS; BU (Bushel) unit of measure

attributes.name: total_defects_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable percentage of total defects (damaged kernels, heat damage, broken kernels, etc.) permitted for this grade designation. Applies to grain, oilseed, and produce grading per GIPSA and AMS standards.
attributes.references: GIPSA Official Grain Standards; USDA AMS

attributes.name: usda_commodity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Commodity Code
attributes.description: Official USDA commodity code associated with this grading standard, enabling alignment with USDA AMS, GIPSA, and WASDE reporting systems. Used for regulatory reporting and supply chain traceability.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Commodity Codes; GIPSA; WASDE

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version or revision number of the grading standard as published by the administering agency (e.g., '1.0', '2023', '3'). Supports audit trails and historical compliance verification.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; Federal Register

products.name: mrl_threshold
products.description: Reference table of Maximum Residue Limits (MRL) for pesticide active ingredients (AI) on specific agricultural commodities by regulatory jurisdiction. Captures active ingredient name, EPA registration number, commodity or commodity group, MRL value (ppm), regulatory jurisdiction (US EPA, EU, Codex Alimentarius, importing country), effective date, and tolerance type (established, exemption, import tolerance). Critical for pre-harvest interval (PHI) compliance, export documentation, and COA verification. Sourced from EPA and Codex Alimentarius databases.
products.reference: EPA 40 CFR Part 180 / Codex Alimentarius MRL Database

attributes.name: mrl_threshold_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each MRL threshold record in the regulatory reference catalog. Primary key for this table.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius CAC/MRL

attributes.name: active_ingredient_cas_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Active Ingredient Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) Registry Number
attributes.description: CAS Registry Number uniquely identifying the pesticide active ingredient chemical substance. Enables unambiguous cross-referencing across regulatory databases and SDS documentation.
attributes.references: Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS); EPA Pesticide Chemical Search

attributes.name: active_ingredient_name
attributes.description: Common or IUPAC chemical name of the pesticide active ingredient (AI) for which the MRL is established. Used to cross-reference against agrochemical product labels and COA verification.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius CAC/MRL; ISO 1750 Pesticide Common Names

attributes.name: analytical_method_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the validated analytical method (e.g., AOAC, EN, EPA method number) used for laboratory detection and quantification of the residue to verify compliance with this MRL. Supports COA and laboratory accreditation alignment.
attributes.references: AOAC International Official Methods; EPA Pesticide Analytical Methods; EU SANTE/11312/2021 Analytical Quality Control

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: Method of pesticide application for which this MRL tolerance is established (e.g., foliar spray, soil application, seed treatment, post-harvest treatment, fumigation). Affects residue behavior and PHI calculation.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; GLOBALG.A.P. Integrated Farm Assurance (IFA) Standard

attributes.name: codex_reference_number
attributes.description: Official Codex Alimentarius MRL reference number (CXL number) for this tolerance, enabling direct cross-reference to the Codex MRL database. Used for international trade documentation and export COA verification.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius Commission CAC/MRL Database; Codex Alimentarius Procedural Manual

attributes.name: commodity_group
attributes.description: Broader commodity group classification under which the specific commodity falls (e.g., cereal grains, fruiting vegetables, root and tuber vegetables, meat and poultry). Supports group tolerance application per EPA and Codex rules.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180 Subpart D; Codex Alimentarius CAC/MISC 4 Commodity Classification

attributes.name: commodity_part
attributes.description: Specific part of the commodity to which the MRL applies (e.g., whole commodity, edible portion only, peel, grain, muscle tissue, fat, liver, milk, eggs). Relevant for processed commodity tolerances and animal product MRLs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: whole_commodity|edible_portion|peel|seed|grain|muscle|fat|liver|kidney|milk|eggs — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius CAC/MISC 4 Commodity Classification; EPA 40 CFR Part 180; EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005 Annex I

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MRL threshold record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking per Databricks Lakehouse governance standards.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018 Food Safety Management; FSMA Records Requirements 21 CFR Part 112; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Originating regulatory database or system from which this MRL record was sourced (e.g., EPA Office of Pesticide Programs tolerance database, Codex MRL database, EU Pesticides database). Supports data lineage and refresh cycle management.
attributes.references: EPA OPP Tolerance Database; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; EU Pesticides Database (ec.europa.eu/food/plant/pesticides)

attributes.name: default_mrl_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MRL is a default/general tolerance applied in the absence of a specific established tolerance (e.g., Codex default of 0.01 ppm, EU default of 0.01 ppm under Regulation EC 396/2005). True = default MRL applies; False = specific established tolerance.
attributes.references: EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005 Article 18(1)(b); Codex Alimentarius CAC/MRL Default

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this MRL tolerance became legally effective and enforceable by the regulatory jurisdiction. Used to determine applicability for current crop season compliance and PHI scheduling.
attributes.references: EPA Federal Register Final Rule; Codex Alimentarius Step 8 Adoption; EU Official Journal Publication

attributes.name: epa_registration_number
attributes.description: EPA pesticide registration number associated with the active ingredient or product formulation. Links MRL tolerance to the registered pesticide product for PHI compliance and export documentation.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3; 40 CFR Part 152

attributes.name: exemption_reason
attributes.description: Regulatory justification for a tolerance exemption, applicable when tolerance_type is 'exemption'. Describes why the active ingredient is exempt from MRL requirements (e.g., naturally occurring substance, minimal risk, biochemical pesticide). Null for non-exemption tolerance types.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180.910-180.960 Exemptions; FIFRA Section 25(b)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this MRL tolerance expires or is scheduled for revocation. Null for indefinite tolerances. Critical for time-limited emergency exemptions (Section 18) and temporary import tolerances.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 18 Emergency Exemption; 40 CFR Part 180.470; Codex Alimentarius Procedural Manual

attributes.name: federal_register_citation
attributes.description: U.S. Federal Register citation (volume, page number, and date) for the EPA final rule establishing or amending this tolerance. Provides regulatory traceability for audit and legal compliance purposes.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; U.S. Federal Register; Administrative Procedure Act

attributes.name: gmo_applicability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MRL tolerance specifically applies to or was established in the context of GMO crop varieties (e.g., herbicide-tolerant GMO crops with higher herbicide residue tolerances). True = GMO-specific tolerance; False = applies to conventional and GMO equally.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003

attributes.name: import_tolerance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MRL was established specifically as an import tolerance to facilitate trade for commodities treated with a pesticide not registered domestically. True = import tolerance; False = domestic tolerance. Relevant for FOB/CIF export documentation.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 408(e); 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius Import Tolerance Procedures

attributes.name: jurisdiction_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the importing or regulating country associated with this MRL. Used for export eligibility checks and Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance. Null for multi-country jurisdictions (e.g., EU, Codex).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; USDA Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS) Export Requirements; COOL 7 USC 1638

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this MRL record was last reviewed and confirmed against the authoritative regulatory source database. Supports data quality management and ensures currency of compliance reference data.
attributes.references: FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR Part 117; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; ISO 22000:2018 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MRL threshold record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data refresh, change detection, and regulatory data currency validation in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018 Food Safety Management; FSMA Records Requirements 21 CFR Part 112; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: limit_of_quantification_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Limit of Quantification (LOQ) in Parts Per Million (ppm)
attributes.description: Lowest concentration of the active ingredient residue that can be reliably quantified by the validated analytical method. Used to determine whether a non-detect result constitutes MRL compliance, particularly for default MRL tolerances.
attributes.references: EU SANTE/11312/2021 Analytical Quality Control Guidelines; AOAC International; EPA Pesticide Analytical Methods

attributes.name: mode_of_action_code
attributes.description: IRAC (Insecticide Resistance Action Committee), FRAC (Fungicide Resistance Action Committee), or HRAC (Herbicide Resistance Action Committee) mode of action classification code for the active ingredient. Supports IPM resistance management planning.
attributes.references: IRAC Mode of Action Classification; FRAC Code List; HRAC Classification; EPA Pesticide Registration

attributes.name: mrl_value_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) Value in Parts Per Million (ppm)
attributes.description: The established maximum residue limit expressed in parts per million (ppm, equivalent to mg/kg) for the active ingredient on the specified commodity. Core compliance threshold used for COA verification, pre-harvest interval enforcement, and export eligibility determination.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database (CXL); EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional regulatory notes, conditions, or qualifications associated with this MRL tolerance (e.g., specific use restrictions, footnotes from regulatory publications, pending review status, or special conditions for application).
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius CAC/MRL; EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005

attributes.name: organic_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the active ingredient is approved for use in certified organic production under USDA National Organic Program (NOP) standards. True = approved for organic use; False = not approved. Supports organic product line compliance and NOP certification maintenance.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; OMRI Listed Materials

attributes.name: phi_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days required between the last pesticide application and harvest to ensure residues do not exceed the MRL at time of harvest. Critical for crop protection scheduling and FSMA compliance. Sourced from EPA label requirements.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112; GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Protection Module

attributes.name: processing_factor
attributes.description: Ratio of residue concentration in the processed commodity to residue concentration in the raw agricultural commodity (RAC). Used to calculate MRL compliance for processed food products derived from the raw commodity. Values >1 indicate concentration; values <1 indicate reduction.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius Guidelines on Pesticide Residues in Processed Foods (CAC/GL 79); EPA 40 CFR Part 180

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory authority or jurisdiction that established this MRL (e.g., US_EPA for United States Environmental Protection Agency, EU for European Union Regulation EC 396/2005, CODEX for Codex Alimentarius Commission). Critical for export documentation and multi-market compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: US_EPA|EU|CODEX|CANADA|JAPAN|AUSTRALIA|CHINA|BRAZIL|MEXICO|KOREA|INDIA|TAIWAN — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005; Codex Alimentarius CAC/MRL; GLOBALG.A.P. MRL Monitoring

attributes.name: residue_definition
attributes.description: Regulatory definition of what constitutes the measurable residue for enforcement purposes, including parent compound and relevant metabolites or degradation products. Critical for laboratory COA analysis method alignment.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180 Tolerance Definitions; Codex Alimentarius Residue Definition Guidelines; EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005 Annex I

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which a previously established MRL tolerance was formally revoked or cancelled by the regulatory authority. Null for active tolerances. Supports historical compliance audit trails and COA re-verification.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180 Revocation Notices; EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005 Amendments

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating regulatory database (e.g., EPA tolerance petition number, Codex CXL reference, EU database entry ID). Enables traceability back to the authoritative source system for audit and refresh purposes.
attributes.references: EPA OPP Tolerance Database; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; EU Pesticides Database

attributes.name: tolerance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the MRL tolerance record: 'active' for currently enforceable tolerances, 'revoked' for cancelled tolerances, 'expired' for time-limited tolerances past their expiry date, 'pending' for proposed tolerances under regulatory review, 'suspended' for temporarily suspended tolerances.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius Procedural Manual; EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005

attributes.name: tolerance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the MRL tolerance type: 'established' for standard EPA/Codex tolerances, 'exemption' for active ingredients exempt from tolerance requirements, 'import_tolerance' for tolerances set specifically for imported commodities, 'emergency_exemption' for Section 18 emergency use tolerances, 'group_tolerance' for tolerances covering a commodity group.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 18; 40 CFR Part 180.1; Codex Alimentarius Procedural Manual

products.name: label
products.description: Manages all regulatory and commercial labeling content and compliance records for agricultural products. Covers COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) designations, USDA organic seal authorization, non-GMO label claims, USDA grade shield usage, allergen declarations (FDA Big 9: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame — including intentional inclusion flags, cross-contact risk levels, and allergen control measure references), nutrition facts panel data (macronutrients, micronutrients, caloric value, serving size, analysis method), net weight declarations, and label artwork file references. Captures label version, effective date, regulatory approval reference, applicable markets/jurisdictions, and HACCP allergen control plan linkage. Tracks FDA FSMA labeling and Preventive Controls allergen management compliance, USDA AMS label approval status, and supports SAP S/4HANA QM module label management.

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural product or commodity this label is associated with in the product catalog (crop commodity, livestock product, processed good, seed/input, or value-added product).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: mrl_threshold_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.mrl_threshold. Business justification: label.mrl_compliance_flag indicates whether the label is MRL-compliant, but there is no reference to the specific MRL threshold being complied with. Adding mrl_threshold_id FK links the label to the a
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organic_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.organic_certification. Business justification: label.organic_certification_code is a denormalized string reference to the NOP organic certification that authorizes the organic seal on the label. Adding organic_certification_id FK normalizes this t
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: allergen_cross_contact_risk
attributes.description: Assessed risk level for unintentional allergen cross-contact during production, handling, or packaging. Drives 'may contain' advisory statement decisions and HACCP allergen control plan requirements.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls — 21 CFR Part 117; HACCP; GFSI; SQF; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: allergen_milk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether milk (FDA Big 9 allergen) is intentionally included as an ingredient in this product. When True, milk must be declared in the ingredient list and allergen statement per FALCPA.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA); FDA FSMA Preventive Controls — 21 CFR Part 117

attributes.name: allergen_soy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether soybeans (FDA Big 9 allergen) are intentionally included as an ingredient. Particularly relevant in agricultural products given soy's prevalence in processed and feed products.
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA; FDA FSMA Preventive Controls — 21 CFR Part 117

attributes.name: allergen_wheat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether wheat (FDA Big 9 allergen) is intentionally included as an ingredient. When True, wheat must be declared in the ingredient list and allergen statement per FALCPA.
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA; FDA FSMA Preventive Controls — 21 CFR Part 117

attributes.name: applicable_markets
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or market identifiers for which this label version is approved and valid (e.g., 'USA,CAN,MEX'). Supports multi-market label management and export compliance.
attributes.references: COOL; Codex Alimentarius; GLOBALG.A.P.; FDA; USDA

attributes.name: artwork_file_reference
attributes.description: File path, document management system reference, or URI pointing to the approved label artwork file (e.g., PDF, AI, EPS). Supports label artwork version control and print production workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; GS1 Label Standards

attributes.name: calories_per_serving
attributes.description: Total caloric value per serving as declared on the Nutrition Facts panel, expressed in kilocalories (kcal). Calculated from macronutrient composition per FDA rounding rules.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.9; Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 2-1985

attributes.name: cool_designation
attributes.description: Country of origin declaration required under COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) regulations. Specifies the country or countries where the product was produced, grown, or processed. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes (e.g., 'USA', 'MEX', 'CAN').
attributes.references: USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) — 7 CFR Part 60 and 65; AMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this label record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; SOX; ISO 22000

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this label version becomes commercially active and legally binding for product packaging and distribution. Aligns with regulatory approval and market launch timelines.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; USDA AMS; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this label version is no longer valid for use on new production runs. Null for open-ended approvals. Triggers label review and renewal workflows.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Label Approval; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: haccp_allergen_control_plan_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) Allergen Control Plan Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the HACCP allergen control plan document governing allergen management for this product label. Links label allergen declarations to the facility's preventive controls documentation.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls — 21 CFR Part 117; HACCP; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

attributes.name: ingredient_statement
attributes.description: Full ingredient list as it appears on the label, listed in descending order of predominance by weight. Must comply with FDA 21 CFR Part 101.4 ingredient declaration requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.4; Codex Alimentarius STAN 1-1985

attributes.name: label_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to this label version, used for cross-referencing with SAP QM label management and regulatory submission tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; USDA AMS Label Approval

attributes.name: label_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the label, typically reflecting the product name, market, and version (e.g., 'Organic Whole Wheat Flour — US Retail v3').
attributes.references: USDA AMS; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: label_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the label record. Tracks progression from draft through regulatory approval to active use, supersession by a newer version, or withdrawal from market.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; USDA AMS Label Approval; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: label_type
attributes.description: Classification of the label by its intended commercial use channel: retail consumer packaging, foodservice bulk, export market, private label, or ingredient/intermediate product.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; USDA AMS

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this label record. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and downstream data synchronization.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; SOX; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: mrl_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this label's associated product has been verified to comply with applicable Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) thresholds for pesticide and agrochemical residues as set by EPA, Codex Alimentarius, or destination market regulators.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; FDA Pesticide Residue Monitoring Program

attributes.name: net_weight_declaration
attributes.description: Mandatory net weight or net quantity statement as it appears on the label (e.g., '5 LB (2.27 kg)', '16 FL OZ (473 mL)'). Must comply with NIST Handbook 133 and FDA net quantity of contents regulations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.105; NIST Handbook 133; Fair Packaging and Labeling Act

attributes.name: nutrition_analysis_method
attributes.description: Method used to determine the nutrition facts panel values: laboratory analysis (wet chemistry), nutrient database calculation (USDA FoodData Central), recipe calculation, or a combination. Affects accuracy and regulatory defensibility.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.9; USDA FoodData Central; AOAC International

attributes.name: organic_seal_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether this label is authorized to display the USDA Organic seal under the National Organic Program (NOP). True only when the product and operation hold valid NOP certification.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) — 7 CFR Part 205; ISO 22000

attributes.name: plu_code
attributes.description: 4 or 5-digit Price Look-Up (PLU) code used for fresh produce identification at retail point-of-sale. Assigned by the International Federation for Produce Standards (IFPS). Applicable to fresh fruit, vegetable, and herb products.
attributes.references: IFPS PLU Code Standard; USDA AMS

attributes.name: protein_g
attributes.description: Protein content per serving in grams as declared on the Nutrition Facts panel. Mandatory declaration on FDA Nutrition Facts label.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.9

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_reference
attributes.description: Official reference number or tracking code issued by the regulatory authority (e.g., USDA AMS label approval number, FDA submission reference) confirming this label has been reviewed and authorized.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; FDA FSMA; FSIS

attributes.name: serving_size_description
attributes.description: Serving size as declared on the Nutrition Facts panel (e.g., '1 cup (240g)', '2 tablespoons (32g)'). Must align with FDA Reference Amounts Customarily Consumed (RACC) for the product category.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.9; FDA RACC Table

attributes.name: servings_per_container
attributes.description: Number of servings per container as declared on the Nutrition Facts panel. May be a whole number or decimal (e.g., 2.5 servings). Required for FDA-compliant Nutrition Facts labeling.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.9

attributes.name: sodium_mg
attributes.description: Sodium content per serving in milligrams as declared on the Nutrition Facts panel. Key nutrient for dietary guidance and FDA mandatory declaration.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.9

attributes.name: total_carbohydrate_g
attributes.description: Total carbohydrate content per serving in grams as declared on the Nutrition Facts panel, including dietary fiber and total sugars.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.9

attributes.name: total_fat_g
attributes.description: Total fat content per serving in grams as declared on the Nutrition Facts panel. Includes saturated fat, trans fat, polyunsaturated fat, and monounsaturated fat.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.9; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: upc_code
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode number printed on the label for retail point-of-sale scanning and supply chain identification. Assigned by GS1 and linked to the product SKU.
attributes.references: GS1 US; FDA FSMA; USDA AMS

attributes.name: usda_ams_approval_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Label Approval Status
attributes.description: Status of the label submission and approval with the USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS), required for meat, poultry, and egg products. Tracks submission through final approval or rejection.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Label Approval Program; FSIS

attributes.name: usda_grade_shield_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this label is authorized to display a USDA grade shield (e.g., USDA Grade A, USDA Choice). Requires grading certificate from USDA AMS grading service.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Grading and Certification Programs

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this label iteration (e.g., '1.0', '2.3'). Incremented whenever label content, claims, or regulatory data changes. Supports label version history and change control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; ISO 22000; FDA FSMA Preventive Controls

products.name: product_certification
products.description: Consolidated SSOT for all third-party, regulatory, and program certifications and declarations held by agricultural products. attributes.name: be_disclosure_required_flag

attributes.name: certifying_body_accreditation_number

products.name: crop_use_registration
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory Crop Use Registration (Contract) between an agrochemical_product and a commodity. It captures the EPA/USDA/international jurisdiction-specific approval of a pesticide, herbicide, fungicide, or fertilizer for application to a specific agricultural commodity. Each record links one agrochemical_product to one commodity and carries commodity-specific application rates, pre-harvest interval days, jurisdiction approvals, and approval dates that cannot be stored on either parent table. Serves as the SSOT for agrochemical compliance data at the product-commodity level, supporting FSMA, EPA label compliance, MRL enforcement, and GLOBALG.A.P. audit requirements.. Existence Justification: In agricultural regulatory practice, a single agrochemical product (e.g., a specific herbicide) is EPA/USDA registered for use on MULTIPLE commodities (corn, soybeans, wheat), and a single commodity (e.g., corn) has MULTIPLE agrochemical products registered for use on it. This crop-use registration is a formally managed regulatory record — not an analytical derivation — that carries commodity-specific application rates, pre-harvest interval days, jurisdiction approvals, and approval dates that cannot reside on either parent table. Regulatory bodies (EPA, USDA, GLOBALG.A.P.) require enterprises to actively maintain, audit, and report these registrations as standalone compliance records.

Ensures MRL compliance at point of harvest. Populated from agrochemical_product PHI data for the commodity's primary crop protection program. [Moved from commodity: phi_days on commodity represents a commodity-level PHI reference, but PHI is actually a function of the specific agrochemical-commodity combination, not the commodity alone. attributes.references: EPA Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA); EPA Pesticide Label Requirements (40 CFR Part 156)

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.references: IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract expires and all delivery obligations must be fulfilled or rolled over. Nullable for open-ended evergreen contracts.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: fsma_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Compliance Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract requires full FSMA compliance documentation including Produce Safety Rule, Preventive Controls, and traceability records. True = FSMA compliance is a contractual obligation.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); FDA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112

attributes.name: fulfilled_volume
attributes.description: Cumulative volume of commodity actually delivered and accepted against this contract to date, expressed in the contract volume UOM. Compared against contracted_volume to determine fulfillment percentage and open position.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Delivery Completion; GLOBALG.A.P. traceability; FSMA traceability rule

attributes.name: futures_contract_month
attributes.description: The CME/CBOT futures delivery month to which this contract's basis or futures-linked price is pegged (e.g., 'DEC-2024', 'MAR-2025'). Null for fixed-price and spot contracts.
attributes.references: CME Group CBOT futures contract specifications; DTN market data

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) governing the transfer of risk and responsibility for freight, insurance, and delivery between seller and buyer. FOB = Free On Board; CIF = Cost Insurance and Freight. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FOB|CIF|EXW|DAP|DDP|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAT|CFR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD Incoterms configuration

attributes.name: moisture_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable moisture content (%) of the commodity at point of delivery as specified in the contract quality terms. Deliveries exceeding this threshold are subject to dockage or rejection per USDA grain standards.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: price
attributes.description: The agreed unit price per volume UOM for fixed-price and forward contracts. For basis and futures-linked contracts, this field captures the locked price once fixation occurs; otherwise null until price fixation date.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; GAAP ASC 606; CME Group futures pricing; DTN market data

attributes.name: price_fixation_date
attributes.description: The date by which the buyer must fix the price on a basis or futures-linked contract. After this date, the price defaults to the prevailing market price per contract terms. Null for fixed-price contracts.
attributes.references: CME Group basis contract terms; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: quality_grade
attributes.description: The minimum USDA commodity grade or quality specification required for delivery acceptance under this contract (e.g., 'US No. 1', 'US No. 2', 'US Grade A'). Drives quality inspection and COA requirements at delivery.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Grain Grading Standards; USDA FGIS; SAP QM Module

attributes.name: sap_contract_number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA SD module contract document number (10-digit) that is the system-of-record identifier for this contract in the ERP. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse and SAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Contract Document

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract was formally executed and signed by both parties. Represents the business event timestamp of contract inception. May differ from effective_date if there is a retroactive or future effective period.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers; GAAP ASC 606; SOX financial reporting controls

attributes.name: special_conditions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any non-standard contractual terms, addenda, or special conditions agreed between the parties (e.g., custom dockage schedules, force majeure clauses, sustainability requirements, organic certification obligations).
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P.; FSMA; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: test_weight_min
attributes.description: Minimum test weight (lbs/bushel) required for grain commodity deliveries under this contract. Test weight is a key USDA grade determinant for corn, soybeans, and wheat. Deliveries below this threshold are subject to grade discount.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract record was most recently modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5; Databricks Delta Lake change data capture

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the contracted volume. BU = Bushel, MT = Metric Ton, CWT = Hundredweight, LB = Pound, KG = Kilogram, TON = Short Ton. Aligns with CME Group and USDA commodity reporting standards.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; CME Group commodity contract specifications

products.name: price_agreement
products.description: Customer-specific or channel-specific pricing agreement defining negotiated price levels, volume tiers, basis adjustments, and discount structures for agricultural commodities and products — capturing effective date range, commodity, grade, pricing basis (FOB elevator, CIF port, DTN market reference), volume thresholds, and approval status. Supports spot, forward, and futures-linked pricing strategies.
products.reference: SAP SD Condition Record (VK11)

attributes.name: price_agreement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for price_agreement

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (buyer, distributor, food manufacturer, or broker) for whom this pricing agreement is established. Links to the customer master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Customer Master (KNA1); Salesforce CRM Account

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Price agreement approval in agriculture commodity sales is a formal governance step requiring an identified approving employee for pricing audit trails and delegation-of-authority compliance. 'approve
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: certification_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.certification_record. Business justification: Price agreements for certified commodities (organic, GlobalG.A.P.) include quality premiums that require verification of the buyer's active certification. Agriculture pricing teams link price agreemen
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural commodity or product (e.g., corn, soybeans, wheat, cattle) covered by this pricing agreement. Links to the commodity or product master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master (MARA); USDA Agricultural Marketing Service commodity classifications

attributes.name: commodity_price_basis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.price_basis. Business justification: A price agreement in commodity agriculture defines the basis and pricing method for a customer relationship. Linking to the canonical price_basis record ensures that all invoices generated under the a

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact. Business justification: Price agreement negotiation audit trail: pricing agreements in ag commodity sales are negotiated with a specific buyer contact. This link enables audit trail of who approved the pricing arrangement an
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.delivery_location. Business justification: Agriculture price agreements include freight allowances and basis adjustments tied to a specific delivery point. The price_agreement.freight_allowance column is meaningless without knowing the deliver
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.distribution_channel. Business justification: The price_agreement table has `sales_channel_code` typed as BIGINT, which is clearly intended as a FK reference to the distribution_channel table (channel-specific pricing is a core SAP SD condition r
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: grading_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.grading_standard. Business justification: Grade-based price premiums and discounts in agriculture require formal reference to the applicable grading standard. Price agreements specify commodity_grade; formalizing this as a grading_standard FK

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_master. Business justification: Price agreements for seeds, crop protection products, and processed goods are negotiated at SKU level, not commodity level. Dealer and distributor price agreements for branded ag inputs require produc
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_organization. Business justification: Price agreements in SAP SD are always scoped to a sales organization — the sales org is a key dimension of the condition record key. The price_agreement table currently has no sales_organization_id FK

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.payment_term. Business justification: price_agreement has payment_terms_code as a plain denormalized text field. A proper FK to invoice.payment_term links negotiated payment terms to the price agreement master, supporting early payment di
