attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Price agreements in agriculture (annual supply contracts with food manufacturers) are tied to profit centers for margin management and pricing authority delegation. Finance uses this link to report co
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: quality_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_certification. Business justification: Price agreements in agriculture include certification-based premiums (organic premium, GlobalG.A.P. surcharge). Linking price_agreement to quality_certification enables automated premium calculation a
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: salesforce_opportunity_id
attributes.description: The Salesforce CRM Opportunity or Contract record ID associated with this pricing agreement. Enables traceability between the CRM sales pipeline and the executed pricing agreement in SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Opportunity and Contract Objects; SAP S/4HANA SD Integration

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Segment-based pricing: ag price agreements are structured by customer segment tier (pricing_tier_code). This link enables segment-level pricing analytics, renewal workflows, and ensures pricing consis
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable identifier for the pricing agreement as assigned by SAP S/4HANA SD or Salesforce CRM. Used in customer communications, contract references, and audit trails (e.g., PA-2024-00123).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Condition Record Key; Salesforce CRM Contract Number

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pricing agreement. 'draft' = under preparation; 'pending_approval' = submitted for authorization; 'active' = currently in force; 'suspended' = temporarily halted; 'expired' = past effective end date; 'terminated' = cancelled before expiry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Record Release Status; Salesforce CRM Contract Status

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing strategy governing this agreement. 'spot' = current market price at time of transaction; 'forward' = fixed price for future delivery; 'futures_linked' = price tied to exchange futures contract (e.g., CBOT); 'contract' = negotiated fixed-term contract price; 'index_based' = price derived from a market index such as DTN or WASDE. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spot|forward|futures_linked|contract|index_based|basis — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; DTN Market Data; WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates); SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Type

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the pricing agreement received final business authorization. Used for audit trail, compliance reporting, and determining when the agreement became actionable.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); SAP S/4HANA SD Release Procedure; GAAP

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Authorization workflow status indicating whether the pricing agreement has been reviewed and approved by the required business authority (e.g., Sales Manager, Pricing Committee). Distinct from agreement_status which reflects the overall lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Release Procedure; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Internal Controls; GAAP

attributes.name: base_price
attributes.description: The negotiated base unit price for the commodity under this agreement, expressed in the agreement currency per unit of measure (e.g., USD per bushel, USD per metric ton, USD per CWT). This is the gross price before basis adjustments or discounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Amount (KBETR); IFRS 15; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: commodity_grade
attributes.description: Quality grade or specification of the agricultural commodity covered by this agreement (e.g., US No. 1, US No. 2, Choice, Prime, Organic). Determines eligibility and price differentials. Aligns with USDA grading standards.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Grain Grading Standards; USDA FSIS Meat Grading; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: cool_country_of_origin
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Country Code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country of origin of the commodity as required by COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) regulations. Mandatory for USDA COOL compliance on covered commodities (e.g., USA, BRA, ARG, CAN).
attributes.references: USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) — 7 U.S.C. § 1638; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this pricing agreement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the base price and all monetary values in this agreement are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL, CAD).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Currency (KONWA); IFRS

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the base price for this agreement, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.50%). Represents negotiated rebates, volume discounts, or promotional allowances. Stored as a rate; the monetary discount amount is computed at order time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Rate (KBETR) for discount condition types; IFRS 15 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pricing agreement ceases to be binding. Nullable for open-ended agreements. Aligns with the SAP S/4HANA condition record validity end date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Validity Period (DATBI); IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this pricing agreement becomes binding and applicable to sales orders (SO). Aligns with the SAP S/4HANA condition record validity start date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Validity Period (DATAB); IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: flat_discount_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary discount per unit applied to the base price under this agreement (e.g., USD 0.05 per bushel). Used when the discount is a fixed amount rather than a percentage. Expressed in currency_code per price_uom.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Absolute Discount Condition (KBETR); IFRS 15

attributes.name: freight_allowance
attributes.description: Negotiated freight cost allowance or deduction included in the pricing agreement, expressed in currency_code per price_uom. Relevant for FOB vs. delivered pricing structures where freight responsibility is shared or subsidized.
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020 (ICC); SAP S/4HANA SD — Freight Condition Type; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: futures_contract_month
attributes.description: The exchange futures contract delivery month used as the pricing reference for futures-linked or basis agreements (e.g., Z24 = December 2024 CBOT corn). Applicable when agreement_type is 'futures_linked' or pricing_basis includes 'basis_cbot/kcbt/mgex'.
attributes.references: CME Group / CBOT Futures Contract Specifications; USDA WASDE

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Indicates the GMO identity preservation status of the commodity covered by this agreement. 'gmo' = conventional GMO commodity; 'non_gmo' = non-GMO but not certified; 'ip_non_gmo' = identity-preserved non-GMO with full chain-of-custody documentation; 'organic' = USDA NOP certified organic (inherently non-GMO).
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulations; EU Regulation 1829/2003; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost responsibilities between seller and buyer under this pricing agreement (e.g., FOB, CIF, DAP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020 — International Chamber of Commerce (ICC); SAP S/4HANA SD — Incoterms (INCO1)

attributes.name: is_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing agreement grants the customer exclusive pricing rights for the specified commodity, grade, and channel — preventing the same terms from being offered to competing buyers during the effective period.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contract Terms; GAAP ASC 606 — Distinct Performance Obligations

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this pricing agreement record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, delta processing in the lakehouse silver layer, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5; Databricks Delta Lake — _commit_timestamp

attributes.name: market_reference_index
attributes.description: The external market data source or price index used as the benchmark for index-based or futures-linked pricing (e.g., DTN ProphetX, WASDE, CME CBOT, Reuters Commodities). Supports traceability of price derivation.
attributes.references: DTN (Data Transmission Network); USDA WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates); CME Group

attributes.name: max_volume_threshold
attributes.description: The maximum quantity of the commodity covered under this pricing agreement tier. Purchases exceeding this threshold may trigger a different price tier or require renegotiation. Expressed in the price_uom.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Scale Quantity Upper Bound (KSTBM); IFRS 15

attributes.name: min_volume_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum quantity of the commodity the customer must purchase to qualify for this pricing agreement tier. Expressed in the price_uom. Used for volume-tiered pricing and commitment enforcement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Scale Quantity (KSTBM); IFRS 15 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional negotiation context, special conditions, broker instructions, or exceptions not captured in structured fields. Examples include harvest season constraints, force majeure clauses, or specific delivery window requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Supplement Text; Salesforce CRM Contract Notes

attributes.name: price_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure against which the base price is quoted. Common agricultural units include BU (Bushel), MT (Metric Ton), CWT (Hundredweight), LB (Pound), KG (Kilogram), TON (Short Ton), BBL (Barrel), DOZ (Dozen). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|MT|CWT|LB|KG|TON|BBL|DOZ — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Unit (KMEIN); ISO 80000-1

attributes.name: quality_premium
attributes.description: Additional price premium per unit awarded for above-standard commodity quality attributes (e.g., high protein content, organic certification, non-GMO identity preservation, low moisture). Expressed in currency_code per price_uom.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service Quality Premiums; GLOBALG.A.P.; National Organic Program (NOP); USDA

attributes.name: renewal_type
attributes.description: Indicates how this pricing agreement is renewed upon expiry. 'manual' = requires explicit renegotiation; 'auto_renew' = automatically renews for the same term; 'evergreen' = continues indefinitely until terminated; 'one_time' = single-use agreement with no renewal.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Validity Management; Salesforce CRM Contract Renewal

attributes.name: sap_condition_record_number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA SD condition record number (KNUMH) that corresponds to this pricing agreement. Provides direct traceability to the source system pricing master data for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Record (KNUMH/KONH/KONP)

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which volume thresholds (min/max) are expressed. May differ from price_uom in some commodity contracts (e.g., price per MT but volume commitment in BU). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|MT|CWT|LB|KG|TON|BBL|DOZ — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Scale Unit (KSTME); USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; ISO 80000-1

products.name: market_price
products.description: Daily or intraday commodity market price reference sourced from DTN, CME futures, WASDE reports, and local elevator bids — capturing commodity code, price date, price type (cash, futures, basis, FOB, CIF), market location or exchange, unit of measure, bid/ask/settlement values, crop year, and data source. Primary reference for sales teams performing pricing validation, basis calculation, quote generation, and revenue benchmarking. Also consumed by procurement and finance for cost benchmarking and margin analysis.
products.reference: DTN/WASDE Market Price Feed

attributes.name: market_price_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each market price record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the market_price data product.
attributes.references: Internal Data Architecture Standard

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Market prices are fundamentally prices FOR specific commodities. commodity_code and commodity_name are denormalized on market_price. Formal FK enables price-to-commodity joins for basis calculations,
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: grading_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.grading_standard. Business justification: Market prices in agriculture are grade-specific — USDA #2 Yellow Corn trades at a different price than #1. The existing grade_or_quality string is denormalized; a FK to grading_standard enables price-
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: growing_season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to crop.growing_season. Business justification: Season-based price analysis: grain market prices are always associated with a specific crop year (e.g., Dec 2024 corn). The existing crop_year plain string is a denormalization. Linking enables season
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ask_price
attributes.description: The price at which a seller is willing to sell the commodity per unit of measure on the price date. Used alongside bid_price to determine the bid-ask spread for market liquidity assessment and quote ceiling setting.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Price Reporting Guidelines; CME Group Market Data Definitions; DTN Commodity Pricing Standards

attributes.name: basis_value
attributes.description: The difference between the local cash price and the nearby futures contract price (cash price minus futures price), expressed in the same currency and unit of measure. Basis reflects local supply/demand conditions, transportation costs, and storage premiums. Critical for sales teams performing basis calculations, forward contract pricing, and local market competitiveness analysis.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Basis Reporting Standards; CME Group Basis Trading Guidelines; DTN Basis Data Definitions

attributes.name: bid_price
attributes.description: The price at which a buyer is willing to purchase the commodity per unit of measure on the price date. Used by sales teams for pricing validation, quote floor setting, and basis calculation. Expressed in the currency and unit of measure specified in this record.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Price Reporting Guidelines; CME Group Market Data Definitions; DTN Commodity Pricing Standards

attributes.name: close_price
attributes.description: The last traded price at the close of the market session on the price date. Distinct from settlement_price which may be calculated differently by the exchange. Used for end-of-day reporting, trend analysis, and daily price comparison across periods.
attributes.references: CME Group Market Data Definitions; DTN Commodity Pricing Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the market or exchange location where this price was observed (e.g., USA, BRA, ARG, CAN, AUS). Required for international trade pricing, COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance, and multi-country revenue benchmarking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) Regulations; USDA Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS) Market Data

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this market price record was first ingested and created in the silver layer lakehouse. Used for data freshness monitoring, SLA compliance tracking, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance and Audit Policy; SOX Section 404 — Data Integrity Controls

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the price is denominated (e.g., USD for US Dollar, EUR for Euro, CAD for Canadian Dollar, BRL for Brazilian Real). Required for multi-currency operations, international trade pricing (CIF/FOB), and IFRS/GAAP financial reporting compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 21 — Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: delivery_point
attributes.description: The specific geographic delivery location or terminal associated with this price (e.g., 'Gulf of Mexico — New Orleans', 'Pacific Northwest — Portland', 'Chicago Delivery', 'On-Farm — Iowa'). Relevant for FOB and CIF price types. Used in logistics cost modeling, transportation benchmarking, and BOL generation.
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020 (ICC) — FOB and CIF Delivery Point Definitions; USDA AMS Delivery Location Codes

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The timestamp from which this price record is considered valid and applicable for use in sales quotes, procurement benchmarking, and financial reporting. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) patterns in the silver layer for historical price tracking and point-in-time analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Data Architecture Standard — SCD Type 2; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Validity Period Standards

attributes.name: effective_to
attributes.description: The timestamp until which this price record is valid. Null indicates the record is currently active (open-ended validity). Used in conjunction with effective_from for SCD Type 2 historical price tracking, enabling point-in-time price lookups for audit, contract dispute resolution, and retrospective margin analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Data Architecture Standard — SCD Type 2; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Validity Period Standards

attributes.name: exchange_code
attributes.description: Standardized exchange or market identifier code where the price was quoted or traded (e.g., CBOT — Chicago Board of Trade, CME — Chicago Mercantile Exchange, KCBT — Kansas City Board of Trade, MGE — Minneapolis Grain Exchange, ICE — Intercontinental Exchange). Null for non-exchange sources such as elevator bids or broker quotes.
attributes.references: CME Group Exchange Codes; ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code (MIC) Standard

attributes.name: futures_contract_month
attributes.description: The delivery month and year code for the futures contract being referenced (e.g., 'Z25' for December 2025, 'H26' for March 2026). Uses standard CME/CBOT contract month letter codes (F=Jan, G=Feb, H=Mar, J=Apr, K=May, M=Jun, N=Jul, Q=Aug, U=Sep, V=Oct, X=Nov, Z=Dec). Null for cash or non-futures price types.
attributes.references: CME Group Futures Contract Specifications; CBOT Grain Futures Contract Codes

attributes.name: high_price
attributes.description: The highest price at which the commodity traded during the market session on the price date. Used for price range analysis, volatility reporting, and sales opportunity identification when prices reach favorable levels.
attributes.references: CME Group Market Data Definitions; DTN Commodity Pricing Standards; USDA AMS Daily Price Reports

attributes.name: is_holiday
attributes.description: Indicates whether the price date falls on a market holiday or exchange closure day (True = holiday/no trading, False = regular trading day). Used to identify non-trading days in price series analysis, gap-filling logic, and seasonal demand forecasting models.
attributes.references: CME Group Exchange Holiday Calendar; USDA AMS Market Holiday Schedule

attributes.name: low_price
attributes.description: The lowest price at which the commodity traded during the market session on the price date. Used alongside high_price for daily price range analysis, risk assessment, and procurement cost benchmarking.
attributes.references: CME Group Market Data Definitions; DTN Commodity Pricing Standards; USDA AMS Daily Price Reports

attributes.name: market_location
attributes.description: The geographic market location, elevator name, port, or exchange venue associated with this price (e.g., 'Chicago Board of Trade', 'Gulf of Mexico Export Terminal', 'Kansas City', 'Minneapolis Grain Exchange', 'Local Elevator — Ames IA'). Used for basis calculation, regional price comparison, and logistics cost benchmarking.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Market Location Codes; CME Group Exchange Venue Definitions

attributes.name: open_interest
attributes.description: The total number of outstanding futures or options contracts that have not been settled or closed as of the price date. A key indicator of market participation and hedging activity. Used by finance and sales teams for market sentiment analysis and forward pricing strategy.
attributes.references: CFTC Commitments of Traders Report; CME Group Open Interest Reporting Standards

attributes.name: open_price
attributes.description: The price at which the commodity first traded at the opening of the market session on the price date. Used for intraday price movement analysis, volatility assessment, and sales team market briefings.
attributes.references: CME Group Market Data Definitions; DTN Commodity Pricing Standards

attributes.name: price_change
attributes.description: The net change in price from the previous trading session's settlement or close price to the current session's settlement or close price. Expressed as a signed decimal (positive = price increase, negative = price decrease). Used for daily market movement reporting and sales team briefings.
attributes.references: CME Group Market Data Definitions; DTN Commodity Pricing Standards

attributes.name: price_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which this market price record is valid. Represents the trading or reporting date of the price observation. Used by sales teams for daily pricing validation, basis calculation, and quote generation aligned with market conditions on a specific date.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Daily Price Reporting; DTN Market Data Standards

attributes.name: price_frequency
attributes.description: The temporal frequency or granularity of this price observation. Values: intraday (tick or interval price within a trading session), daily (end-of-day or daily summary), weekly (weekly average or closing price), monthly (monthly average, used for WASDE and long-term planning). Determines how the record is used in analytics and forecasting pipelines.
attributes.references: DTN Market Data Feed Specifications; USDA AMS Price Reporting Frequency Standards

attributes.name: price_qualifier
attributes.description: Additional qualifier describing the nature or timing of the price within its type. Values: nearby (nearest active futures contract month), deferred (future delivery month beyond nearby), spot (immediate delivery cash price), forward (agreed future delivery price), indicative (non-binding market indication), firm (binding quoted price). Used to distinguish pricing intent for quote generation and contract negotiation.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Price Reporting Terminology; CME Group Contract Specifications; Incoterms 2020 (ICC)

attributes.name: price_source
attributes.description: The originating data source or market feed from which this price record was obtained. Values: DTN (Data Transmission Network market data), CME (Chicago Mercantile Exchange futures), WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates — USDA monthly report), elevator_bid (local grain elevator posted bid), USDA_AMS (USDA Agricultural Marketing Service daily reports), broker (broker or dealer quote). Critical for data lineage, source credibility weighting, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: DTN Market Data Licensing Agreement; USDA WASDE Report Publication Standards; CME Group Data Policy

attributes.name: price_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this price record indicating its current validity and usability. Values: active (current valid price for use), superseded (replaced by a corrected or updated record), preliminary (provisional price pending final confirmation), final (confirmed and authoritative), cancelled (withdrawn price record). Ensures sales teams only use validated prices for quote generation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; USDA AMS Price Correction and Revision Procedures

attributes.name: price_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time of the intraday price observation or quote capture (ISO 8601 format with timezone offset). Applicable for intraday price feeds from CME futures or DTN real-time data. Null for end-of-day or daily summary records.
attributes.references: CME Group Market Data Policy; DTN Real-Time Data Feed Standards

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: Classification of the price observation indicating the commercial pricing mechanism. Values: cash (spot/local elevator cash price), futures (exchange-traded futures contract price), basis (difference between local cash and futures), fob (Free On Board — seller loads at origin), cif (Cost Insurance and Freight — seller delivers to destination). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cash|futures|basis|fob|cif|forward|settlement — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CME Group Futures Market Definitions; USDA AMS Price Reporting; Incoterms 2020 (ICC) — FOB and CIF definitions

attributes.name: settlement_price
attributes.description: The official end-of-day settlement price established by the exchange or market authority for the commodity on the price date. attributes.references: CME Group Daily Settlement Price Procedures; CFTC Commodity Exchange Act — Settlement Price Rules

attributes.name: source_record_reference

attributes.references: Internal Data Lineage and Audit Policy; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Condition Record Standards; DTN Data Feed Documentation

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the price is expressed. Critical for price comparison, quote generation, and cross-commodity benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|CWT|MT|LB|TON|OZ|KG — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA AMS Unit of Measure Standards; CME Group Contract Unit Specifications; Codex Alimentarius Commission Unit Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this market price record was last modified or updated in the silver layer lakehouse (e.g., price correction, status change, source data revision). Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: volume

domains.name: invoice
domains.description: Single source of truth for all billing, invoicing, payments, and revenue recognition. Manages accounts receivable (AR), payment terms, credit management, financial settlements, and invoice lifecycle from generation to payment. Integrates with GL for revenue accounting per GAAP/IFRS standards. Supports agricultural-specific billing scenarios including commodity-based pricing, weight-ticket reconciliation, and seasonal payment terms.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Core accounts receivable invoice header representing the primary billing document issued to food manufacturers, distributors, cooperatives, and agricultural buyers. Captures invoice number, billing date, due date, total amount, tax, currency, payment terms, invoice status (draft/issued/partially_paid/paid/void/disputed), invoice type (commodity sale, service, weight-ticket settlement, contract settlement, advance billing, intercompany transfer, cooperative patronage), and source transaction references (sales order, delivery, contract). Serves as the SSOT for all outbound billing documents including intercompany transactions between farms, elevators, processing plants, and distribution subsidiaries. Links to invoice_line for item detail, payment_allocation for cash application, and billing_account for customer financial relationship.
products.reference: SAP FI-AR Invoice / GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: broken_kernels_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Broken Kernels and Foreign Material Percentage (BCFM)
attributes.description: Percentage of broken corn kernels and foreign material (BCFM) in a corn sample, as defined by USDA FGIS grading standards. A key grade factor for corn that drives price discounts and grade assignment.

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: Broad classification of the commodity category. Drives applicable grading standards, inspection protocols, and settlement calculation rules (e.g., grain uses bushel-based pricing; livestock uses CWT-based pricing).

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting Controls; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the settlement amount (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Required for multi-currency operations and IFRS financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: damage_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of grain kernels that are heat-damaged, mold-damaged, sprouted, or otherwise damaged as determined by USDA FGIS inspection. A primary grade factor affecting commodity grade assignment and price discounts.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; 7 CFR Part 810

attributes.name: dockage_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the gross sample weight consisting of material other than the grain (weed seeds, chaff, straw, sand) that passes through a prescribed sieve. Deducted from net weight before pricing per USDA FGIS grading standards.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; 7 CFR Part 810

attributes.name: driver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the truck driver delivering the commodity. Required for chain-of-custody documentation, FSMA traceability, and facility access records.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; GDPR Article 4 (international operations); DOT Regulations

attributes.name: foreign_material_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the grain sample consisting of foreign material (non-grain matter that does not pass through the dockage sieve). A grade-determining factor per USDA FGIS standards that affects commodity grade and price discounts.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; 7 CFR Part 810

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total certified scale weight of the loaded vehicle (truck/trailer plus commodity) in kilograms as recorded on the certified scale. Foundational quantity for net weight calculation per state weights-and-measures law.
attributes.references: State Weights-and-Measures Regulations; USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; NIST Handbook 44

attributes.name: is_gmo
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity delivered on this weight ticket is derived from genetically modified organisms (GMO). Required for identity preservation programs, non-GMO certification, and international trade compliance (EU GMO labeling regulations).
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulations; EU GMO Labeling Regulation 1829/2003; GLOBALG.A.P. Standard

attributes.name: is_organic
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity is certified organic under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). Drives premium pricing, segregated storage requirements, and organic certificate documentation requirements.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); 7 CFR Part 205; GLOBALG.A.P. Standard

attributes.name: is_split_load
attributes.description: Indicates whether this weight ticket represents a split-load delivery where a single truck carries commodity from multiple fields, farms, or ownership lots. When True, multiple weight tickets may share the same truck/trailer ID and require proportional allocation.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: moisture_pct
attributes.description: Moisture content of the grain or oilseed sample expressed as a percentage of total weight, measured at time of delivery. Used to calculate moisture dockage/shrink adjustments to net weight and price per USDA FGIS grading standards. Null for livestock.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; 7 CFR Part 810; AACC International Method 44-15A

attributes.name: net_weight_bu
attributes.description: Net commodity weight converted to bushels (BU) using USDA standard test weight per bushel for the specific commodity (e.g., 56 lbs/bu for corn, 60 lbs/bu for wheat). Used for grain pricing, settlement, and WASDE reporting. Null for livestock and cotton.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; USDA WASDE; 7 CFR Part 800

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Certified net commodity weight in kilograms, calculated as gross weight minus tare weight. This is the authoritative quantity used for invoice line reconciliation, settlement calculations, and USDA FGIS reporting. Stored as a certified value from the scale system.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; State Weights-and-Measures Regulations; NIST Handbook 44

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for scale operator or receiving clerk notes regarding special conditions, quality observations, load discrepancies, or dispute details associated with this weight ticket. Supports exception handling and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: price_per_unit
attributes.description: Contracted or market price per unit of measure (per bushel for grain, per CWT for livestock, per pound for cotton) applied to this weight ticket for settlement calculation. Sourced from the applicable sales order or commodity contract.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; DTN Market Data

attributes.name: price_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure to which the price per unit applies. BU = Bushel (grain); CWT = Hundredweight (livestock); MT = Metric Ton; LB = Pound (cotton); KG = Kilogram. Drives settlement amount calculation.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards

attributes.name: scale_datetime
attributes.description: The certified date and time the commodity was weighed on the certified scale. This is the principal business event timestamp and the authoritative quantity determination moment per state weights-and-measures law. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: State Weights-and-Measures Regulations; USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Gross settlement amount payable to the vendor/grower for this weight ticket, calculated as adjusted net weight multiplied by price per unit before deductions. Represents the principal monetary value of this transaction for AR/AP reconciliation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: tare_weight_kg
attributes.description: Certified scale weight of the empty vehicle (truck/trailer without commodity) in kilograms. Subtracted from gross weight to determine net commodity weight. May be captured on inbound or outbound weigh.
attributes.references: State Weights-and-Measures Regulations; USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; NIST Handbook 44

attributes.name: test_weight_lbs_per_bu
attributes.description: Measured weight per bushel of the grain sample in pounds per bushel (lbs/bu), indicating grain density and quality. Used as a grade factor per USDA FGIS standards (e.g., minimum 56 lbs/bu for No. 2 Yellow Corn). Null for non-grain commodities.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; 7 CFR Part 810; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: ticket_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable certified scale ticket number assigned by the elevator or receiving facility. Used for reconciliation against invoice lines, grain settlement documents, and USDA FGIS inspection records. Unique within a facility.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; State Weights-and-Measures Regulations; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: ticket_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the weight ticket. 'draft' = captured but not yet certified; 'open' = certified and awaiting settlement; 'settled' = reconciled to an invoice line and payment; 'voided' = cancelled/corrected; 'disputed' = under quality or quantity dispute.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the weight ticket record. Tracks corrections, grade adjustments, or settlement status changes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting Controls; USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards

products.name: billing_account
products.description: Accounts receivable account master for each billing customer entity, representing the financial relationship between the agricultural enterprise and its buyers. Captures AR account number, customer reference, credit limit amount, credit risk category (low/medium/high/watch), credit scoring basis, collateral type (crop lien, equipment lien, letter of credit, surety bond), collateral value, credit review date, credit hold status, credit hold reason, current balance, aging buckets (current/30/60/90/120+ days), payment terms code, currency, last payment date, average days to pay, dispute balance, and account manager. Integrates with SAP FI-AR subledger and Oracle NetSuite AR module.

attributes.name: billing_city

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the billing customer's invoicing address (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'BRA'). Drives export documentation requirements, COOL labeling, and applicable tax/VAT treatment for international agricultural trade.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the billing customer's invoicing address. Used for tax jurisdiction determination, state-level agricultural regulatory reporting, and USDA program eligibility.
attributes.references: USDA; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 740

attributes.name: collateral_type

attributes.name: collateral_value

attributes.references: IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss; GAAP ASC 310; UCC Article 9

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credit_hold_flag

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; Oracle NetSuite AR

attributes.name: credit_hold_reason

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding AR balance authorized for this billing account, expressed in the account currency. Enforced during sales order creation in SAP SD credit management. Reviewed periodically based on crop cycle seasonality and buyer financial health.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9

attributes.name: credit_review_date

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS 9; GAAP ASC 310; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: credit_risk_category

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss; GAAP ASC 310-10

attributes.name: credit_score

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: current_balance

attributes.name: dispute_balance

Disputed amounts are excluded from collections activity and tracked separately per GAAP revenue recognition guidance. Common in agricultural weight-ticket reconciliation disputes.

attributes.name: last_payment_date

attributes.name: applicable_customer_segment
attributes.description: Customer segment classification for which this payment term is designed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all|grower|cooperative|distributor|processor|retailer|export — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Customer Segmentation, GAAP ASC 606, GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: applicable_sales_org
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA sales organization code(s) for which this payment term is valid. Comma-separated if applicable to multiple sales organizations. Null indicates global applicability across all sales organizations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization Configuration

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the finance or credit manager who approved this payment term configuration for use. Supports SOX internal controls over financial reporting and segregation of duties requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404, GAAP Internal Controls, SAP S/4HANA FI Authorization

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this payment term configuration was formally approved by the authorized finance or credit manager. Supports SOX audit trail and change management documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404, GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: baseline_date_type
attributes.description: Defines the reference date from which net due days and discount days are calculated. Agricultural-specific options include weight_ticket_date (grain elevator settlements) and harvest_completion_date (post-harvest deferred programs). Maps to SAP S/4HANA payment term baseline date configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Baseline Date, GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment term configuration record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, GAAP ASC 606, ISO 22000

attributes.name: credit_limit_required
attributes.description: Minimum approved credit limit (in functional currency) that a customer must hold to be eligible for this payment term. Supports credit risk management for extended or deferred agricultural payment programs. Null if no minimum credit limit is required.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management (FCV), GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which this payment term's monetary thresholds and discount calculations are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency agricultural export transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: deferral_max_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of calendar days that payment may be deferred from the invoice date under a seasonal deferral program, regardless of when the trigger event occurs. Caps the deferral window to manage credit exposure. Null when is_seasonal_deferral is false.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency, GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15

attributes.name: deferral_trigger_event
attributes.description: The business event that triggers the start of the payment window for seasonally deferred terms. For example, 'harvest_completion' starts the net due days clock after crop harvest is recorded. Null when is_seasonal_deferral is false.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency, GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition, Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: discount_days_1
attributes.description: Number of days from the baseline date within which payment must be received to qualify for the first-tier early payment discount percentage. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA ZBD1T field. Null if no early payment discount applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI ZBD1T, GAAP ASC 606 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: discount_days_2
attributes.description: Number of days from the baseline date within which payment must be received to qualify for the second-tier early payment discount. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA ZBD2T field. Null if no second discount tier applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI ZBD2T, GAAP ASC 606 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: discount_percent_1
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the invoice amount if payment is received within discount_days_1. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0200 = 2%). Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA ZBD1P field. Null if no early payment discount applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI ZBD1P, GAAP ASC 606 Variable Consideration, IFRS 15

attributes.name: discount_percent_2
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the invoice amount if payment is received within discount_days_2 but after discount_days_1. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA ZBD2P field. Null if no second discount tier applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI ZBD2P, GAAP ASC 606 Variable Consideration, IFRS 15

attributes.name: dunning_procedure_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA dunning procedure code assigned to this payment term, controlling the escalation schedule for overdue AR notices. Seasonal agricultural terms may use specialized dunning procedures that account for harvest timing before escalating collection actions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Dunning (F150), GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: erp_term_key

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/FI ZTERM, Oracle NetSuite Payment Terms

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this payment term configuration is no longer valid for assignment to new transactions. Null indicates an open-ended term with no planned expiration. Supports seasonal program sunset dates.

attributes.name: fsma_compliant

attributes.name: installment_count

attributes.name: installment_schedule_type
attributes.description: Defines how installment amounts are distributed across the payment schedule. 'harvest_triggered' supports agricultural deferred programs where installment timing is tied to crop harvest completion events. Null when is_installment is false.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Installment Terms, GAAP ASC 606, Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: is_installment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment term requires payment in multiple installments rather than a single lump sum. attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Installment Payment Terms, GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15

attributes.name: is_seasonal_deferral

attributes.name: late_payment_grace_days

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Dunning, GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_percent
attributes.description: Annual percentage rate applied to overdue invoice balances as a late payment penalty or interest charge. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0150 = 1.5% per annum). Null if no late payment penalty applies under this term.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310, IFRS 9, SAP S/4HANA FI Dunning Configuration

attributes.name: net_due_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from the invoice date (or baseline date) by which full payment is due. For example, 30 for Net 30 terms. Core field in SAP S/4HANA payment term configuration (ZBD3T). Drives AR due date calculation.

attributes.name: netsuite_term_code

attributes.name: payment_method_restriction

attributes.name: term_code

attributes.name: term_name

attributes.name: term_status

attributes.name: term_type

attributes.name: weight_ticket_reconciliation_required

Supports USDA grain grading dispute workflows and commodity quality arbitration processes.

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the customer formally raised the dispute. This is the principal business event date used for aging calculations, SLA tracking, and regulatory reporting timelines.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15, FSMA Compliance Framework

attributes.name: dispute_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text narrative provided by the customer or AR team describing the nature of the dispute, including specific claims, supporting evidence references, and any relevant field or delivery observations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Dispute Management

attributes.name: dispute_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable unique identifier for the dispute, used in customer communications, USDA grain grading arbitration filings, and audit trails. Format: DSP-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the dispute. 'open' = newly filed; 'under_review' = assigned and being investigated; 'resolved' = final determination reached; 'escalated' = elevated to senior arbitration or regulatory body; 'withdrawn' = customer retracted the claim.

attributes.name: dispute_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reason for the dispute. attributes.references: USDA GIPSA Grain Grading Standards, FDA FSMA, EPA MRL Regulations, SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the invoice amount that the customer is formally contesting. May equal the full invoice amount (full dispute) or a subset (partial dispute) such as a weight variance deduction or MRL exceedance penalty.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Dispute Management, GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent escalation action was taken. Null if the dispute has never been escalated. Used for escalation aging and regulatory timeline compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Dispute Management, USDA GIPSA

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Numeric indicator of how many times the dispute has been escalated to a higher authority. Level 0 = not escalated; Level 1 = escalated to senior AR manager; Level 2 = escalated to legal/compliance; Level 3 = escalated to external arbitration (e.g., USDA GIPSA commodity arbitration).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Dispute Management, USDA GIPSA

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the dispute was escalated, such as failure to reach agreement within SLA, regulatory involvement required, or high-value commodity arbitration triggered.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Dispute Management, USDA GIPSA

attributes.name: invoice_amount
attributes.description: The total billed amount on the original invoice as issued to the customer, captured at the time of dispute initiation for reference and variance calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module, GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15

attributes.name: is_partial_dispute
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispute covers only a portion of the invoice amount (True) or the full invoice amount (False). Drives AR aging treatment and partial payment clearing logic in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Dispute Management, GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: is_regulatory_dispute
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispute involves a regulatory compliance dimension (e.g., FSMA traceability violation, EPA MRL exceedance, USDA grade certification challenge, COOL labeling dispute). Regulatory disputes trigger mandatory escalation and compliance reporting workflows.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA, EPA, USDA GIPSA, COOL (Country of Origin Labeling), GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the dispute, influencing reviewer assignment and resolution SLA targets. 'critical' is typically reserved for disputes involving regulatory violations (e.g., MRL exceedance, FSMA non-compliance) or high-value commodity contracts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Dispute Management, FSMA Compliance Framework

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the dispute was formally closed and a resolution determination was recorded. Null if the dispute is still open or under review. Used for SLA compliance measurement and AR aging reports.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Dispute Management, GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15

attributes.name: resolution_notes

attributes.name: resolution_type
attributes.description: The method by which the dispute was resolved. attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: The final agreed monetary settlement amount upon resolution of the dispute. Populated only when dispute_status = 'resolved'. May reflect a full credit, partial credit, price adjustment, or zero (claim denied).

products.name: billing_schedule
products.description: Defines recurring or milestone-based billing schedules for long-term agricultural contracts including grain storage agreements, crop input supply contracts, and livestock management service agreements. attributes.name: source_system_code

domains.name: procurement
domains.description: Manages sourcing and purchasing of all agricultural inputs including seeds, fertilizers (NPK), crop protection chemicals (AI, MRL compliance), feed ingredients, fuel, parts, and operational supplies. Governs PO lifecycle, GRN processing, vendor qualification, contract terms (FOB, CIF), supplier performance, and spend analytics. Ensures SDS documentation and EPA/APHIS regulatory compliance for chemical and biological inputs. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA MM and Oracle NetSuite for AP processing.
domains.references: EPA Pesticide Standards, APHIS Import, SAP MM

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for all approved agricultural input suppliers and service providers including seed companies, fertilizer distributors, agrochemical suppliers, feed ingredient vendors, fuel suppliers, and equipment parts dealers. Captures vendor identity (tax ID, DUNS number), qualification lifecycle (pending, approved, conditional, suspended, disqualified), GLOBALG.A.P. and GFSI certification numbers and expiry dates, EPA/APHIS registration numbers, SDS documentation compliance flags, payment terms, FOB/CIF contract defaults, bank details, and SAP S/4HANA vendor master integration keys. Qualification attributes: qualification date, re-qualification due date, SQF/BRC/IFS certification status, FSMA SVCP compliance status, audit score, and approved input categories. Performance metrics (periodic): on-time delivery rate, fill rate, quality acceptance rate, invoice accuracy, regulatory compliance score, overall scorecard rating, and corrective action tracking. SSOT for supplier identity, qualification status, and performance within the procurement domain.
products.reference: SAP MM Vendor Master (LFA1/LFB1)

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the vendor master record in the procurement domain. Primary key for all vendor-related transactions and qualifications.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Vendor's bank account number used for electronic funds transfer (EFT) and ACH payment processing. Classified restricted due to PCI/financial data sensitivity.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing transit number identifying the vendor's financial institution for ACH and wire transfer payments. Classified restricted due to financial data sensitivity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI LFBK; Federal Reserve ABA routing number standard; PCI DSS; SOX AP controls

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the vendor's primary registered business address. Used for Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance, import/export documentation, and FOB/CIF contract defaults.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: duns_number

attributes.name: fsma_svcp_compliant

attributes.name: incoterm_default

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_rate

attributes.name: last_audit_date

attributes.name: last_audit_score

attributes.name: legal_name

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate

attributes.name: overall_scorecard_rating

attributes.name: payment_terms_code

Mandatory for seeds (variety purity), crop protection chemicals (MRL compliance), and feed ingredients (FSMA traceability). Drives inventory.commodity_lot creation on receipt.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA traceability rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; GLOBALG.A.P. traceability requirements; ISO 22000 traceability

attributes.name: net_po_value
attributes.description: Net total value of the purchase order after applying header-level discounts but before tax. Represents the actual procurement spend commitment for budget and OPEX/CAPEX reporting. Used in EBITDA and COGS analysis for agricultural input cost management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; GAAP COGS; IFRS IAS 2 inventory costing

attributes.name: netsuite_po_ref

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Vendor payment terms code defining the due date calculation and any early payment discount conditions (e.g., 'NET30', '2/10NET30'). Drives AP payment scheduling in Oracle NetSuite and cash flow forecasting. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO.ZTERM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.ZTERM; Oracle NetSuite AP terms; GAAP accounts payable

attributes.name: po_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the purchase order was formally issued to the vendor. This is the principal real-world event date for the PO transaction. Used for aging analysis, payment term calculation, and regulatory compliance documentation. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO.BEDAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.BEDAT; GAAP invoice matching; FSMA traceability requirements

attributes.name: po_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional instructions, special handling requirements, or procurement-specific notes communicated to the vendor on this PO. May include PHI/REI compliance reminders for crop protection chemical orders, organic certification requirements, or special packaging instructions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO header text; GLOBALG.A.P. documentation requirements

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable PO number issued to the vendor. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO.EBELN (purchasing document number) and Oracle NetSuite PO transaction number. Used on all vendor communications, GRN matching, and AP invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: po_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order. Tracks the PO from initial draft through approval, issuance to vendor, goods receipt, and final closure or cancellation. Drives workflow routing in SAP MM and AP processing in NetSuite. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|sent|partially_received|fully_received|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: po_type

Standard POs are single-event purchases; blanket POs cover recurring supply agreements; contract releases draw against a master contract; emergency POs bypass standard approval for urgent agricultural inputs. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO.BSART (purchasing document type).

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date

Used for supply chain planning, crop season alignment, and vendor on-time delivery KPI measurement. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO.EINDT (delivery date at header level).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.EINDT; GLOBALG.A.P. supply chain traceability

attributes.name: sap_mm_doc_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA MM purchasing document number from the EKKO table (EBELN field). 10-digit numeric identifier used for cross-system traceability between the Databricks Silver Layer and SAP MM. Enables drill-back to source ERP for AP processing and GRN matching.

attributes.name: sds_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) is required for the chemical or biological inputs on this PO per OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom). True for pesticides, fertilizers, fuels, and other hazardous agricultural chemicals. Triggers SDS documentation collection workflow.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 (HazCom/GHS); EPA FIFRA labeling requirements; APHIS biological material documentation

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: total_po_value
attributes.description: Gross total value of the purchase order in the PO currency, representing the sum of all line item totals before any header-level discounts or taxes. Used for spend analytics, budget commitment tracking, and AP liability accrual. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO total value.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; GAAP commitment accounting; IFRS IAS 37 provisions

products.name: procurement_goods_receipt
products.description: Goods Receipt Note (GRN) record capturing the physical receipt and inspection of agricultural inputs at farm, warehouse, feed mill, or processing facility. Header: GRN number, PO reference, vendor delivery note number, receiving location, receipt date/time, overall receipt status, and SAP MM goods movement document number (MIGO). Line items: received quantity vs. ordered quantity, unit of measure, accepted quantity, rejected quantity with rejection reason code, lot/batch number assigned, storage bin/silo assignment, quality inspection status, COA received flag, SDS on file flag, temperature at receipt (for biologicals, vaccines, and cold-chain feed ingredients), and temperature exceedance flag. SSOT for all GRN header and line-level data. Triggers AP invoice three-way match workflow and inventory update. Feeds quality inspection workflow for COA verification and MRL testing.
products.reference: SAP MM Goods Receipt / GRN (MIGO/MSEG)

attributes.name: dispute_root_cause

attributes.name: dispute_type

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_pct

attributes.name: minimum_order_qty
