attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom Standard; EPA FIFRA; GHS (Globally Harmonized System)

attributes.name: seed_treatment_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether seeds are chemically treated (fungicide/insecticide coating), untreated, organically treated, or not applicable for non-seed inputs. Affects handling requirements, PHI/REI applicability, and USDA NOP organic certification eligibility.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205; EPA FIFRA Seed Treatment Registration; GLOBALG.A.P. Seed Module

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days this input remains effective and safe from the date of manufacture or receipt, as specified by the manufacturer. Drives FIFO/FEFO inventory management, reorder policy, and expiry-based quarantine holds in the WMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Shelf Life Management; Manhattan Associates WMS Expiry Management; GMP

attributes.name: signal_word
attributes.description: EPA-mandated signal word on the pesticide label indicating acute toxicity level: DANGER (highest toxicity, Category I/II), WARNING (moderate toxicity, Category III), CAUTION (lowest toxicity, Category IV), or not_applicable for non-pesticide inputs. Required for SDS and worker safety training.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA 40 CFR Part 156.64; GHS Hazard Communication; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Vendor-assigned or internal SKU code for this input, used for order management, barcode scanning, and RFID tracking in the warehouse. Supports Manhattan Associates WMS receiving and inventory control operations.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Item Master; GS1 Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM EAN/UPC

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for this input to maintain efficacy, safety, and regulatory compliance. Drives WMS bin location assignment in Manhattan Associates and warehouse task planning for proper segregation of incompatible materials.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Storage Requirements; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; GMP Storage Guidelines; ISO 22000

products.name: chemical_compliance
products.description: Regulatory compliance record for each procured crop protection chemical and biological input, including associated Safety Data Sheet (SDS) documentation. Captures EPA registration number, APHIS import permit number, active ingredient (AI) name and concentration, MRL values by commodity and market, PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval) in days, REI (Restricted Entry Interval) in hours, restricted use pesticide (RUP) flag, state-specific registration status, label compliance confirmation, and FSMA preventive controls applicability flag. Includes SDS attributes: SDS document number, revision date, GHS hazard classification, signal word, hazard and precautionary statements, first aid measures, storage requirements, disposal instructions, PPE requirements, emergency contact, and SDS expiry/review date. Required for OSHA HazCom compliance, EPA regulatory reporting, GAP certification, and HACCP compliance.
products.reference: EPA Pesticide Registration / APHIS Permit / FSMA PCHF

attributes.name: chemical_compliance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each chemical compliance record in the procurement domain. Primary key for the chemical_compliance data product. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a regulatory compliance record for a procured crop protection chemical or biological input.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; EPA FIFRA Registration

attributes.name: agrochemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agrochemical product master record in the product domain. Links this compliance record to the specific crop protection chemical or biological input product being regulated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; product.agrochemical_product

attributes.name: compliance_officer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: FSMA Preventive Controls and EPA regulations require a named responsible person for each chemical compliance record. Ag compliance officers are accountable for SDS currency, MRL limits, and registrati
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: crop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to crop.crop. Business justification: Chemical compliance records specify which crop a pesticide is registered for and its MRL. Linking to crop enables EPA label compliance verification, MRL reporting by crop, and FSMA preventive control
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: mrl_threshold_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.mrl_threshold. Business justification: Chemical compliance records track MRL values (mrl_value, mrl_commodity, mrl_market) that are denormalized from the mrl_threshold product. Normalizing via FK supports FSMA preventive controls documenta
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: active_ingredient_concentration
attributes.description: Percentage concentration of the active ingredient (AI) in the formulated product, expressed as weight/weight (w/w) or weight/volume (w/v) percent. Used for dose calculation, MRL compliance, and SDS documentation.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; FAO/WHO Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: active_ingredient_name
attributes.description: Common chemical name of the primary active ingredient (AI) responsible for the pesticidal action of the product, as listed on the EPA-approved label. Critical for MRL compliance checks and PHI determination.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards; ISO 1750 Pesticide Nomenclature

attributes.name: aphis_import_permit_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) Import Permit Number
attributes.description: APHIS-issued permit number authorizing the importation of regulated biological inputs, biopesticides, or plant protection products. Required for cross-border procurement of biological agents under APHIS jurisdiction.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 7 CFR Part 330; APHIS PPQ

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the chemical compliance record. 'active' indicates the product is currently registered and compliant for use; 'suspended' indicates temporary regulatory hold; 'cancelled' indicates EPA registration cancellation; 'pending_review' indicates under regulatory review; 'expired' indicates registration or SDS has lapsed.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; SAP S/4HANA QM Status Management

attributes.name: concentration_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the active ingredient concentration value (e.g., % w/w, % w/v, g/L). Ensures correct interpretation of concentration for compliance calculations.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; ISO 1750

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this chemical compliance record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements for OSHA HazCom, EPA regulatory reporting, and FSMA recordkeeping. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA QM or Oracle NetSuite document creation timestamp.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200; FSMA Recordkeeping Requirements; SOX

attributes.name: disposal_instructions
attributes.description: Disposal methods and instructions for the chemical product and its container as specified in SDS Section 13. Includes EPA waste classification, disposal facility requirements, and container rinsing procedures. Required for EPA RCRA compliance and environmental management.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA 40 CFR Parts 260-270; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix D Section 13

attributes.name: emergency_contact
attributes.description: 24-hour emergency telephone number for chemical emergency response, as listed on SDS Section 1 (e.g., CHEMTREC 1-800-424-9300). Required by OSHA HazCom and DOT hazardous materials regulations for emergency response coordination.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix D Section 1; DOT 49 CFR Part 172.604

attributes.name: epa_registration_number
attributes.description: EPA-issued registration number for the pesticide product under the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA). Required for legal sale and use in the United States. Format: registrant-product[-supplemental].
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3; 40 CFR Part 152

attributes.name: first_aid_measures
attributes.description: Summary of first aid instructions for exposure routes (inhalation, skin contact, eye contact, ingestion) as specified in SDS Section 4. Required for OSHA HazCom compliance and emergency response planning at field and warehouse locations.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix D Section 4; GHS Rev 9

attributes.name: formulation_type
attributes.description: Standardized formulation type code for the crop protection product (e.g., EC=Emulsifiable Concentrate, WP=Wettable Powder, SC=Suspension Concentrate, WG=Water Dispersible Granule, GR=Granule, SL=Soluble Liquid). Used for application equipment selection, mixing instructions, and storage classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EC|WP|SC|WG|GR|SL|EW|CS|DP|UL|SP|ZC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FAO/WHO Pesticide Specifications; CropLife International Formulation Codes

attributes.name: gap_certification_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) Certification Applicability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this chemical compliance record is subject to GAP certification requirements, including GLOBALG.A.P. IFA or equivalent scheme. When true, the chemical's use must be documented in the farm's GAP compliance records and subject to third-party audit.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v6; USDA GAP/GHP Audit Program

attributes.name: ghs_hazard_classification
attributes.description: GHS hazard classification category for the chemical product, identifying the type and severity of physical, health, and environmental hazards (e.g., 'Acute Toxicity Category 3', 'Flammable Liquid Category 2'). Drives PPE requirements, storage segregation, and emergency response planning.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System) Rev 9; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200; UN GHS Purple Book

attributes.name: haccp_critical_control_point
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) Critical Control Point Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this chemical input is identified as a critical control point (CCP) in the facility's HACCP plan. When true, mandatory monitoring, corrective action, and verification procedures apply per Codex Alimentarius HACCP principles and FSMA Preventive Controls.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius HACCP Guidelines CAC/RCP 1-1969; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; FDA

attributes.name: hazard_statements
attributes.description: Standardized GHS H-code hazard statements describing the nature and degree of hazards posed by the chemical (e.g., 'H301: Toxic if swallowed; H400: Very toxic to aquatic life'). Stored as a semicolon-delimited list of H-codes and descriptions. Required on SDS Section 2.
attributes.references: GHS Rev 9 Annex 3; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix C

attributes.name: is_fsma_preventive_control
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Preventive Controls Applicability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this chemical input is subject to FSMA preventive controls requirements, triggering mandatory hazard analysis, preventive control measures, monitoring, corrective actions, and recordkeeping under the FSMA Preventive Controls for Human Food rule.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act

attributes.name: is_gmo
attributes.description: Indicates whether the biological input contains or is derived from genetically modified organisms (GMO). Required for APHIS biotechnology regulatory compliance, COOL labeling, and organic certification exclusion under USDA National Organic Program (NOP).
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 7 CFR Part 340; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205; EU GMO Regulation 1829/2003

attributes.name: is_restricted_use_pesticide
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is classified as a Restricted Use Pesticide (RUP) by the EPA, requiring purchase and use only by certified applicators or persons under their direct supervision. Critical for procurement authorization and applicator certification tracking.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3(d); 40 CFR Part 152 Subpart I

attributes.name: label_compliance_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product label has been reviewed and confirmed to comply with all applicable EPA label requirements, including use directions, safety precautions, PHI, REI, and first aid statements. Required for GAP certification and HACCP compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 2(p); GLOBALG.A.P. IFA; HACCP Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this chemical compliance record. Tracks changes to SDS revisions, registration status updates, MRL changes, or label amendments. Required for regulatory audit trail and change management.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200(g)(5); FSMA; SOX

attributes.name: phi_days
attributes.description: Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) in days — the minimum number of days that must elapse between the last application of the chemical and the harvest of the crop. Mandatory for GAP compliance and FSMA preventive controls to ensure MRL compliance at harvest.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA; FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Required personal protective equipment (PPE) for handling, mixing, loading, and applying the chemical product as specified on the EPA label and SDS Section 8. Includes gloves, respirator type, eye protection, and protective clothing specifications. Mandatory for EPA Worker Protection Standard compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard 40 CFR Part 170; OSHA PPE Standard 29 CFR 1910.132; SDS Section 8

attributes.name: precautionary_statements
attributes.description: Standardized GHS P-code precautionary statements describing recommended measures to minimize or prevent adverse effects from exposure, storage, or disposal (e.g., 'P260: Do not breathe dust/fume; P501: Dispose of contents in accordance with local regulations'). Stored as semicolon-delimited P-codes.
attributes.references: GHS Rev 9 Annex 4; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix C

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Classification of the crop protection product by its primary mode of action or target pest category. Drives regulatory pathway, label requirements, and IPM program classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: herbicide|insecticide|fungicide|rodenticide|biopesticide|plant_growth_regulator|adjuvant|nematicide|bactericide — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; USDA NASS Pesticide Use Survey; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA

attributes.name: registration_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the EPA registration for this chemical product became effective. Marks the start of the legally authorized period for sale and use of the product in the United States under FIFRA.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3; 40 CFR Part 152

attributes.name: registration_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the EPA registration for this chemical product expires or is due for renewal. Null for registrations without a fixed expiry. Triggers procurement hold and re-registration workflow when approaching expiry.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3(g); 40 CFR Part 152

attributes.name: rei_hours
attributes.description: Restricted Entry Interval (REI) in hours — the minimum time that must pass after a pesticide application before workers may re-enter the treated area without personal protective equipment (PPE). Required for OSHA HazCom and EPA Worker Protection Standard compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard 40 CFR Part 170; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: sds_document_number
attributes.description: Unique document control number assigned to the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for this chemical product. Used for document management, OSHA HazCom compliance, and audit trail. Corresponds to the SDS document identifier in the supplier's document management system.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; GHS (Globally Harmonized System) Rev 9

attributes.name: sds_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety Data Sheet (SDS) Expiry / Review Date
attributes.description: Date by which the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) must be reviewed and reissued or confirmed current. Typically set 3-5 years from the revision date per industry practice. Triggers SDS renewal workflow to maintain OSHA HazCom compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200; ANSI Z400.1

attributes.name: sds_revision_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent revision of the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) as issued by the chemical manufacturer or supplier. OSHA requires SDS to be updated within 3 months of new hazard information. Critical for ensuring workers have access to current hazard information.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200(g)(5); GHS Rev 9 Section 1

attributes.name: signal_word
attributes.description: GHS/EPA signal word appearing on the product label and SDS indicating the relative level of hazard severity: DANGER (most severe), WARNING (moderate), CAUTION (least severe), or none for non-hazardous products. Required on SDS Section 2 and product label.
attributes.references: GHS Rev 9 Section 1.4; EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (USPS abbreviation) for which the state_registration_status applies. Enables state-by-state compliance tracking for pesticide products that require individual state registrations under FIFRA Section 24(c).
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 24(c); USPS State Abbreviations

attributes.name: state_registration_status
attributes.description: Registration status of the pesticide product in the specific state(s) where it will be used. States may impose additional registration requirements beyond federal EPA registration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: registered|not_registered|pending|cancelled|restricted — promote to reference product if multi-state tracking is required]
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 24(c); State Lead Agency Pesticide Regulations

attributes.name: storage_requirements
attributes.description: Storage conditions and requirements for the chemical product as specified in SDS Section 7, including temperature range, humidity, segregation from incompatible materials, ventilation, and container requirements. Used for warehouse storage planning and EPA/OSHA compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix D Section 7; EPA FIFRA; NFPA 30

products.name: delivery_schedule
products.description: Planned delivery schedule for agricultural inputs under a vendor contract or blanket PO, aligned with seasonal crop planting calendars and livestock feeding programs. Captures schedule line number, PO or contract reference, input material, planned delivery date, scheduled quantity, delivery location (farm gate, grain elevator, warehouse, feed mill, fuel tank), transport mode (truck, rail, barge), carrier reference, bill of lading (BOL) number, estimated arrival window, and schedule status (planned, vendor-confirmed, in-transit, received, delayed, cancelled). Supports just-in-time delivery of perishable biologicals, seasonal fertilizer pre-positioning, and feed ingredient supply continuity planning.
products.reference: SAP MM Schedule Line (EKET) / TMS Delivery Plan

attributes.name: delivery_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each planned delivery schedule line within the procurement domain. Serves as the primary key for the delivery_schedule data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Schedule Line

attributes.name: agrochemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.agrochemical_product. Business justification: Delivery schedules for agrochemicals reference the specific product for hazmat transport compliance (UN number, hazmat class) and PHI/REI application timing planning. Product-level delivery scheduling
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Delivery schedules for commodity inputs reference the specific commodity for storage planning and processing scheduling. Commodity-level delivery tracking drives elevator and feed mill capacity planni
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: farm_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.farm_unit. Business justification: Input delivery schedules (seed, fertilizer, chemicals) are planned to specific farm units for seasonal application timing. Linking delivery_schedule to farm_unit enables logistics coordination, ensure
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: field_crop_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to crop.field_crop_plan. Business justification: Input delivery schedules are planned against specific field crop plans to align delivery timing with planting and application windows. This link enables on-time delivery tracking per field plan, suppo
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.field. Business justification: Field-level delivery scheduling drives application timing and logistics in precision agriculture — inputs must arrive at the right field before planting or application windows. Currently delivery_sche

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to crop.growing_season. Business justification: Input delivery schedules are planned around planting windows within a growing season. A proper FK enables delivery-vs-planting-window compliance reporting and seasonal logistics planning. Replaces den

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural input material (seed, fertilizer NPK, crop protection chemical AI, feed ingredient, fuel, parts) being scheduled for delivery. Links to the material master for specifications, MRL compliance, and SDS documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Material Master; EPA MRL Compliance; SDS

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent Purchase Order (PO) or blanket PO under which this delivery schedule line is created. Links to the procurement PO master for contract terms, pricing, and vendor details.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - ME21N Purchase Order

attributes.name: receiving_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: Agriculture delivery scheduling requires directing inbound shipments to specific grain elevators or warehouses for capacity planning and receiving dock scheduling. The existing delivery_location_id po

attributes.name: seed_variety_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.seed_variety. Business justification: Delivery schedules for seed procurement specify the variety being delivered. Seed delivery timing is variety-specific (planting window, maturity). Variety-level delivery scheduling is essential for pl

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor_contract. Business justification: The domain description explicitly states delivery schedules are created 'under a vendor contract or blanket PO.' While the PO link already exists (delivery_schedule.purchase_order_id → purchase_order)
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the qualified vendor or supplier responsible for fulfilling this delivery schedule line. Supports vendor performance tracking and USDA/EPA-compliant supplier qualification records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Vendor Master; USDA Supplier Qualification

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the agricultural input was physically received at the delivery location. Populated upon Goods Receipt Note (GRN) processing. Used for on-time delivery KPI calculation and vendor performance scoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MIGO Goods Receipt; GRN Processing

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading (BOL) number issued by the carrier as the legal contract of carriage and receipt of goods. Required for FSMA traceability, COOL compliance, and AP invoice matching. Critical for agricultural chemical and biological shipment documentation.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204 Traceability; COOL Regulations; UCC Article 7

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the transportation carrier or logistics provider responsible for delivering the agricultural input. Used for carrier performance tracking and freight audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Forwarding Agent; TMS Carrier Master

attributes.name: carrier_reference
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned reference or tracking number for the shipment. Enables real-time shipment tracking and exception management for in-transit deliveries.
attributes.references: TMS Carrier Reference; SAP S/4HANA MM - Shipment Number

attributes.name: coa_number
attributes.description: Certificate of Analysis (COA) document number provided by the vendor confirming the quality specifications of the delivered agricultural input (e.g., NPK analysis for fertilizers, AI concentration for crop protection chemicals, nutritional profile for feed ingredients).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Quality Certificate; GFSI COA Requirements; ISO 22000

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery schedule record was first created in the system, sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM or Oracle NetSuite. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX financial reporting controls and FSMA traceability.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FSMA Traceability; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the unit price and transaction value (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Required for multi-currency procurement operations and IFRS/GAAP financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: delay_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why a delivery schedule line has been delayed or cancelled. Supports supply chain risk analysis, vendor performance management, and contingency planning for critical agricultural inputs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Exception Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Supplier Performance

attributes.name: delivery_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery destination type. Determines receiving procedures, storage requirements, and compliance checks (e.g., feed mill requires FDA feed safety compliance; chemical warehouse requires SDS and EPA storage regulations). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: farm_gate|grain_elevator|warehouse|feed_mill|fuel_tank|processing_plant — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Feed Safety Regulations; EPA Chemical Storage; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_end
attributes.description: End timestamp of the estimated arrival window at the delivery location. Together with estimated_arrival_start defines the delivery window for receiving operations and carrier coordination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Inbound Delivery; TMS Delivery Window

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_start
attributes.description: Start timestamp of the estimated arrival window at the delivery location. Supports dock scheduling, receiving staff planning, and cold-chain management for perishable biologicals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Inbound Delivery; Manhattan Associates WMS Receiving

attributes.name: grn_number
attributes.description: Goods Receipt Note (GRN) number generated upon physical receipt and inspection of the agricultural input at the delivery location. Triggers three-way match (PO-GRN-Invoice) in SAP S/4HANA MM and Oracle NetSuite AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MIGO GRN; Oracle NetSuite AP Three-Way Match; FSMA

attributes.name: incoterm_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (INCOTERMS) code defining the point of risk and cost transfer between vendor and buyer. Common agricultural trade terms include FOB (Free On Board) and CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight). Governs freight cost allocation and insurance responsibility.
attributes.references: ICC INCOTERMS 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM - Incoterms

attributes.name: input_category
attributes.description: Classification of the agricultural input material being delivered. Drives compliance workflows: crop protection chemicals require SDS and EPA/APHIS documentation; fertilizers require NPK specification; seeds require GMO and phytosanitary certificates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seed|fertilizer|crop_protection|feed_ingredient|fuel|parts|supplies — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; APHIS Phytosanitary; USDA NOP; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: is_perishable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agricultural input is a perishable biological product (e.g., live beneficial insects, biostimulants, inoculants, vaccines) requiring cold-chain management and expedited just-in-time delivery. Triggers special handling and temperature monitoring requirements.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls; APHIS Biological Import Regulations

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this delivery schedule record. Tracks schedule revisions, status changes, and quantity adjustments. Required for data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer and SOX audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Change Log; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Batch or Lot Number (LOT) assigned to the agricultural input shipment by the manufacturer or vendor. Enables end-to-end traceability from supplier to field application, supporting FSMA Section 204 traceability, recall management, and Certificate of Analysis (COA) matching.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204 Traceability; SAP S/4HANA MM - Batch Management; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: phi_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivered crop protection chemical requires Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) compliance tracking. When True, the receiving system must enforce PHI restrictions to ensure MRL compliance at harvest. Applicable to pesticides and herbicides with EPA-registered PHI requirements.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA PHI Requirements; FDA MRL Compliance; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_date
attributes.description: The principal planned calendar date on which the agricultural input is scheduled to arrive at the delivery location. Aligned with seasonal crop planting calendars and livestock feeding program schedules to ensure timely availability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - ME38 Schedule Line Date; FMIS Crop Calendar

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of agricultural input received and confirmed via Goods Receipt Note (GRN) processing. May differ from scheduled_quantity due to short shipments, overages, or quality rejections. Triggers AP invoice matching in Oracle NetSuite.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MIGO GRN; Oracle NetSuite AP Three-Way Match

attributes.name: schedule_line_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the delivery schedule line, typically sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM scheduling agreement or Purchase Order (PO) schedule line. Used for cross-system reconciliation and vendor communication.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - ME38 Scheduling Agreement

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the delivery schedule line. Tracks progression from initial planning through vendor confirmation, transit, receipt, and exception states (delayed, cancelled). Supports just-in-time delivery monitoring and supply continuity planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Schedule Line Status; FSMA Supply Chain Controls

attributes.name: scheduled_quantity
attributes.description: The planned quantity of agricultural input material to be delivered on this schedule line, expressed in the base unit of measure (e.g., MT metric tons, BU bushels, CWT hundredweight, liters, units). Drives pre-positioning and inventory planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Schedule Line Quantity; USDA WASDE Units

attributes.name: sds_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) is required for this delivery. Mandatory for crop protection chemicals, fertilizers, and fuel deliveries per EPA and OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom). SDS must accompany shipment documentation.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom; EPA FIFRA; SDS GHS Standard

attributes.name: seasonal_program
attributes.description: Name or code of the seasonal agricultural program this delivery schedule supports (e.g., 'Spring Planting 2025', 'Fall Fertilizer Pre-Position', 'Q3 Feed Ingredient Program'). Enables grouping of schedule lines by crop season or livestock feeding cycle for supply continuity planning.

attributes.description: Date on which this position is scheduled to expire or be eliminated from the authorized headcount plan. Nullable for permanent positions; populated for seasonal, temporary, or project-based roles with a defined end date.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management; DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655

attributes.name: flsa_exemption_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exemption Status
attributes.description: Classification of the position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) indicating whether the role is exempt, non-exempt, or qualifies for the agricultural exemption under FLSA Section 13(b)(12), which affects overtime pay eligibility and minimum wage requirements.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) 29 U.S.C. § 213; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: Budgeted Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) allocation for this position, expressed as a decimal fraction of a standard full-time schedule (e.g., 1.00 = full-time, 0.50 = half-time). Used for headcount planning, labor cost budgeting, and workforce capacity analysis.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Workforce Planning; GAAP Labor Cost Allocation

attributes.name: h2a_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position qualifies for staffing under the DOL H-2A Temporary Agricultural Worker visa program, which allows agricultural employers to bring foreign nationals to the U.S. to fill temporary or seasonal agricultural jobs. Required for DOL H-2A job order filings.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655; Immigration and Nationality Act Section 101(a)(15)(H)(ii)(a)

attributes.name: housing_provided
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position includes employer-provided housing as required under DOL H-2A regulations, which mandate that agricultural employers provide free housing to H-2A workers and domestic workers who are not reasonably able to return to their residence within the same day.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655.122; DOL ETA H-2A Housing Standards

attributes.name: job_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the duties, responsibilities, and working conditions for this position, as published in DOL H-2A job orders, internal job postings, and USDA labor compliance documentation.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Job Order Requirements 20 CFR Part 655; USDA Labor Compliance

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad functional grouping that classifies the position into an agricultural job family for workforce planning, compensation benchmarking, and labor cost allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: agronomy|livestock|equipment_operations|food_processing|administration|supply_chain|quality_compliance|research_development — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Job Classification; USDA Occupational Classification

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this position record was most recently updated, supporting change tracking, audit compliance, and data freshness monitoring in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Audit Trail; SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: min_education_level
attributes.description: Minimum educational qualification required for this position, used in job postings, H-2A job order filings, and candidate screening within SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Job Order Requirements; SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting

attributes.name: min_experience_years
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant work experience required for this position, as specified in job postings and DOL H-2A job order filings.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Job Order Requirements 20 CFR Part 655; SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting

attributes.name: min_wage_tier
attributes.description: Applicable minimum wage tier for this position, distinguishing between federal minimum wage, state minimum wage, DOL Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) for H-2A positions, piece-rate compensation structures common in agricultural harvesting, or negotiated collective bargaining rates.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR); FLSA Minimum Wage Provisions; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation pay grade band assigned to this position, used for salary range management, compensation benchmarking, and labor cost budgeting within the enterprise pay structure.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Management; GAAP Labor Cost Allocation

attributes.name: physical_demands_rating
attributes.description: DOL Dictionary of Occupational Titles (DOT) physical demands rating for this position, classifying the level of physical exertion required. Used for ADA accommodation assessments, OSHA ergonomic risk evaluation, and H-2A job order physical requirements disclosure.
attributes.references: DOL Dictionary of Occupational Titles (DOT); ADA Title I; OSHA Ergonomics Guidelines

attributes.name: position_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the position within the enterprise, used in DOL H-2A job order filings, USDA labor compliance reporting, and integration with SAP SuccessFactors and payroll systems.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management; DOL H-2A Job Order Requirements

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the authorized position indicating whether it is active and available for staffing, frozen due to budget constraints, pending organizational approval, or eliminated from the headcount plan.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management

attributes.name: remote_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position is eligible for remote or hybrid work arrangements. Most field operations, livestock handling, and equipment operation positions are not remote-eligible; administrative and analytical roles may qualify.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management

attributes.name: requires_cdl
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position requires a valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL) for operating agricultural transport vehicles, grain trucks, or heavy equipment on public roads, as regulated by FMCSA.
attributes.references: FMCSA Commercial Driver's License Standards 49 CFR Part 383; DOT

attributes.name: requires_gap_training
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) Training Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position requires completion of Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) training as part of USDA GAP/GHP certification requirements and FSMA Produce Safety Rule compliance. Applicable to field workers, supervisors, and food handling personnel.
attributes.references: USDA GAP/GHP Audit Program; FDA FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112; GLOBALG.A.P. Standard

attributes.name: requires_haccp_certification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) Certification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position requires HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points) food safety certification, applicable to roles in food processing, packing, and quality assurance functions subject to FDA FSMA and USDA FSIS regulations.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); USDA FSIS HACCP Regulations 9 CFR Part 417; Codex Alimentarius HACCP Guidelines

attributes.name: requires_osha_certification
attributes.description: Specifies the OSHA safety training certification required for this position: OSHA 10-hour General Industry or Construction, OSHA 30-hour for supervisory roles, OSHA Agriculture standard (29 CFR Part 1928), or none required. Used for workforce compliance tracking and training planning.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1928 (Agriculture); OSHA 29 CFR Part 1910 (General Industry); OSHA Outreach Training Program

attributes.name: requires_pesticide_license
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position requires a valid state-issued pesticide applicator license as mandated by the EPA Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA) and state pesticide regulations. Positions such as Pesticide Applicator and Crop Protection Specialist typically require this certification.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA 7 U.S.C. § 136; EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS) 40 CFR Part 170

attributes.name: seasonal_end_month
attributes.description: Calendar month (1–12) in which seasonal positions typically conclude staffing, used for annual workforce planning, H-2A visa petition duration, and labor demand forecasting aligned with crop harvest completion and post-harvest handling.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655; USDA Seasonal Labor Planning

attributes.name: seasonal_start_month
attributes.description: Calendar month (1–12) in which seasonal positions typically begin staffing, used for annual workforce planning, H-2A visa petition timing, and labor demand forecasting aligned with crop planting and harvest cycles.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655; USDA Seasonal Labor Planning

attributes.name: soc_code
attributes.description: U.S. Department of Labor Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) code assigned to this position, required for DOL H-2A job order filings, OSHA recordkeeping, and USDA labor compliance reporting (e.g., 45-2041 for Graders and Sorters, Agricultural Products).
attributes.references: DOL Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) System; DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official human-readable job title for the position as it appears in organizational charts, offer letters, and DOL H-2A job order filings (e.g., Field Crew Supervisor, Pesticide Applicator, Irrigation Technician, Livestock Handler, Grain Elevator Operator, Food Safety Auditor).
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management; DOL H-2A Job Order Requirements

attributes.name: transportation_provided
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position includes employer-provided transportation between housing and the worksite, as required under DOL H-2A regulations for guest worker positions and migrant labor compliance.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655.122; Migrant and Seasonal Agricultural Worker Protection Act (MSPA)

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union or collective bargaining agreement (CBA) applicable to this position, if any. Used for wage rate determination, benefit entitlement, and labor relations compliance tracking.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element code for project-based labor cost allocation, used when the position supports specific capital projects (CAPEX) such as facility construction, irrigation system installation, or precision agriculture technology deployment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; GAAP CAPEX vs OPEX Classification; IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: work_schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the standard work schedule pattern for this position, distinguishing between standard daytime schedules, rotating shifts for processing facilities, seasonally variable hours common in agricultural operations, on-call arrangements, and piece-rate flexible schedules.
attributes.references: FLSA Hours of Work Provisions; SAP SuccessFactors Time Management

Supports DOL wage and hour compliance, H-2A three-fourths guarantee tracking, and labor cost allocation to crop enterprise budgets.

attributes.name: aewr_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the effective hourly wage paid to the employee meets or exceeds the DOL Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) for the applicable state and period. Critical H-2A compliance indicator.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.120; APHIS; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: aewr_rate
attributes.description: The DOL-published Adverse Effect Wage Rate applicable to the employee's state and job classification for the pay period. Used as the minimum wage floor for H-2A guest workers and compliance benchmarking.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.120; USDA Farm Labor Survey

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SAP SuccessFactors Audit Trail; GAAP

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll record. Typically USD for domestic operations; supports international agricultural operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's engagement type, distinguishing permanent staff, seasonal farm workers, H-2A guest workers, and migrant laborers. Drives compliance rule application and wage rate determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: permanent|seasonal|h2a_guest_worker|migrant|contract|part_time|temporary — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655; Migrant and Seasonal Agricultural Worker Protection Act (MSPA); DOL

attributes.name: farm_operation_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific farm operation or production unit (e.g., field, orchard, processing facility) where the employee worked. Enables labor cost allocation to crop enterprise budgets in Granular Farm Management.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; USDA Farm Records

attributes.name: federal_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of federal income tax withheld from the employee's gross wages for the pay period per IRS withholding tables and the employee's W-4 elections.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E); Internal Revenue Code Section 3402

attributes.name: gross_wages
attributes.description: Total pre-deduction earnings for the pay period, including regular pay, overtime premium, piece-rate earnings, and any other compensation components before tax and other deductions.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); IRS Publication 15; GAAP

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: The base hourly wage rate applied to this payroll record. For H-2A workers, must meet or exceed the Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) published by DOL for the applicable state and crop activity.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR); Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); USDA

attributes.name: housing_deduction
attributes.description: Amount deducted from gross wages for employer-provided housing furnished to H-2A workers or other agricultural employees. Must comply with DOL reasonable cost or fair rental value limits.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.122(d); FLSA Section 3(m)

attributes.name: job_classification_code
attributes.description: The DOL Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) or internal job code for the employee's role during the pay period (e.g., crop worker, equipment operator, agronomist). Drives AEWR rate selection and compliance rule application.
attributes.references: DOL Standard Occupational Classification (SOC); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655; USDA

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Required for data lineage, audit trail, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SAP SuccessFactors Audit Trail; GAAP

attributes.name: medicare_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Employee share of Medicare (HI) tax withheld under FICA for the pay period, including the Additional Medicare Tax for high earners where applicable.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA); Internal Revenue Code Section 3101

attributes.name: net_pay
attributes.description: The actual take-home amount disbursed to the employee after all tax withholdings and authorized deductions are subtracted from gross wages.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); IRS Publication 15; GAAP

attributes.name: overtime_earnings
attributes.description: Total overtime premium earnings for the pay period, calculated at 1.5x the regular rate for hours exceeding 40 per week per FLSA requirements.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Section 7; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: overtime_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total overtime hours worked beyond the FLSA 40-hour weekly threshold during the pay period. Required for FLSA overtime premium pay calculation and DOL wage and hour compliance reporting.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Section 7

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employee is paid. Determines pay period boundaries and is critical for H-2A three-fourths guarantee calculations and FLSA overtime compliance.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the payroll processing period. Defines the boundary for wage calculations, overtime determination, and H-2A three-fourths guarantee assessment.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the payroll processing period. Used for DOL wage and hour compliance, H-2A three-fourths guarantee tracking, and labor cost allocation.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: pay_type
attributes.description: The compensation structure applied to this payroll record. Piece-rate is common for harvest operations; hourly applies to FLSA overtime calculations; salary for permanent staff.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which wages were disbursed to the employee. Required for DOL wage payment timeliness compliance and state wage payment law adherence.
attributes.references: DOL Wage and Hour Division; State Wage Payment Laws

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which net pay is disbursed to the employee. Direct deposit is standard; check and pay card are common for seasonal and H-2A workers without bank accounts.
attributes.references: DOL Wage and Hour Division; State Wage Payment Laws; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: payroll_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the payroll record within the SAP SuccessFactors payroll processing lifecycle, from initial calculation through final payment or reversal.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll Module; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: piece_rate_earnings
attributes.description: Total earnings derived from piece-rate compensation (harvest pay) for the pay period, calculated as piece_rate_units multiplied by piece_rate_per_unit. Supports harvest labor cost analysis.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: piece_rate_per_unit
attributes.description: The monetary rate paid per piece-rate unit (e.g., per bin, per pound, per row) for harvest or production work. Confidential compensation data used for piece-rate earnings calculation.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: piece_rate_units
attributes.description: Total number of piece-rate units (e.g., bins picked, rows harvested, pounds collected) completed by the employee during the pay period. Drives piece-rate earnings calculation for harvest pay.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: regular_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total non-overtime hours worked by the employee during the pay period. Used for FLSA compliance, H-2A three-fourths guarantee tracking, and labor cost allocation to farm operations.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: sap_payroll_doc_number
attributes.description: The payroll document reference number generated by SAP S/4HANA payroll processing, used for reconciliation and audit trail back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Payroll Module; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: social_security_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Employee share of Social Security (OASDI) tax withheld under FICA for the pay period, calculated at the statutory rate on wages up to the annual wage base.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA); Internal Revenue Code Section 3101

attributes.name: state_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of state income tax withheld from the employee's gross wages for the pay period per applicable state tax authority withholding requirements.
attributes.references: State Tax Authority Regulations; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: three_fourths_guarantee_hours
attributes.description: The minimum number of hours the employer is obligated to offer the H-2A worker under the three-fourths guarantee provision (75% of contract period workdays). Used for compliance tracking and potential back-pay liability assessment.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.122(i); DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: three_fourths_guarantee_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer has met the H-2A three-fourths guarantee obligation for this pay period. A False value triggers back-pay liability calculation for the shortfall hours.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.122(i); DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: transportation_deduction
attributes.description: Amount deducted from gross wages for employer-provided transportation to/from the worksite. Subject to DOL H-2A regulations limiting deductions to actual cost and prohibiting deductions that reduce wages below AEWR.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.122(h); FLSA Section 3(m)

attributes.name: work_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the employee performed work during the pay period. Determines applicable state income tax withholding, state minimum wage, and H-2A AEWR rate.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655; State Tax Authority Regulations; USDA

attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.29; ANSI Z16.2; BLS

attributes.name: claim_amount
attributes.description: Total incurred cost of the workers compensation claim in USD, including medical expenses and indemnity payments. Used for agricultural insurance premium optimization, EMR management, and OPEX reporting.
attributes.references: NCCI EMR calculation; State Workers Compensation Laws; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current status of the workers compensation claim through its lifecycle from filing through resolution. Drives return-to-work program management and insurance reserve tracking.
attributes.references: State Workers Compensation Laws; NCCI; Insurance Carrier Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the safety event record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 45001

attributes.name: days_away_from_work
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the employee was unable to work due to the injury or illness. Key metric for OSHA 300 log, lost-time incident rate calculation, and EMR (Experience Modification Rate) management.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.7; NCCI EMR calculation

attributes.name: days_on_restricted_duty
attributes.business_glossary_term: Days on Restricted Duty or Job Transfer
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the employee worked on restricted duty or was transferred to another job due to the injury or illness. Required for OSHA 300 log and return-to-work program tracking.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.7; OSHA Form 300

attributes.name: incident_datetime
attributes.description: The exact date and time the safety event occurred in the field, facility, or operation. This is the principal real-world event timestamp used for OSHA 300 log reporting and EMR calculations.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.29; FSMA; ISO 45001

attributes.name: incident_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to the safety incident at time of reporting (e.g., INC-2024-00123). Used for cross-system reference, OSHA 300 log entry, and workers compensation claim linkage.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.29; SAP SuccessFactors EHS Incident Management

attributes.name: incident_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the safety incident record through its lifecycle from initial report through investigation, corrective action, and final closure.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; SAP SuccessFactors EHS

attributes.name: incident_type
attributes.description: Classification of the safety event by the nature of the hazard or mechanism of injury. Drives regulatory reporting routing and corrective action protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pesticide_exposure|equipment_injury|heat_illness|fall|animal_handling_injury|near_miss|chemical_exposure|grain_bin_entrapment|electrical|struck_by|caught_in|overexertion|vehicle_collision|fire_explosion — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; EPA; APHIS; USDA GAP

attributes.name: injury_illness_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the nature of the injury or illness sustained (e.g., 'laceration to right index finger requiring 3 stitches', 'organophosphate pesticide exposure causing nausea and dizziness'). PHI — restricted access. Required for OSHA 300 log.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.29; HIPAA; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: insurance_carrier
attributes.description: Name of the workers compensation insurance carrier handling the claim. Used for insurance premium optimization, carrier performance tracking, and agricultural insurance management.
attributes.references: State Workers Compensation Laws; NCCI; Agricultural Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: job_title_at_incident
attributes.business_glossary_term: Job Title at Time of Incident
attributes.description: The employee's job title at the time of the incident. Captured as a snapshot because the employee's current title may change after the incident. Used for occupational injury pattern analysis.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.29; BLS Occupational Injury Survey

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the safety event record. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 45001

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific location where the incident occurred (e.g., 'North grain bin #3, loading platform', 'Field 12-B near irrigation pivot'). Supplements location_type with precise operational context.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.29; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the physical location where the incident occurred within the agricultural operation. Used for hazard hotspot analysis and BMP safety program targeting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: field|grain_bin|processing_facility|livestock_barn|greenhouse|equipment_yard|office|storage_warehouse|irrigation_site|loading_dock|cold_storage — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; USDA BMP; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: medical_treatment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the highest level of medical treatment received for the injury or illness. Determines OSHA recordability threshold and workers compensation claim type. First aid only incidents are generally not OSHA recordable.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.7; ANSI Z16.1

attributes.name: osha_300_log_entry_number
attributes.description: The sequential case number assigned to this incident on the OSHA 300 Log of Work-Related Injuries and Illnesses. Required for OSHA recordable incidents. Used for annual OSHA 300A summary and regulatory audit.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.29; OSHA Form 300

attributes.name: osha_recordable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident meets OSHA criteria for entry on the OSHA 300 Log of Work-Related Injuries and Illnesses. Drives annual OSHA 300A summary reporting and EMR calculation.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.7; OSHA 300 Log

attributes.name: pesticide_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pesticide, herbicide, fungicide, or other agricultural chemical was involved in the incident. Triggers EPA and state pesticide regulatory reporting requirements and PHI/REI compliance review.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; APHIS; State Pesticide Regulations

attributes.name: ppe_description
attributes.description: Description of the PPE that was in use or should have been in use at the time of the incident (e.g., 'chemical-resistant gloves, face shield, Tyvek suit'). Relevant for pesticide exposure and chemical handling incidents.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.132; EPA 40 CFR; USDA GAP

attributes.name: ppe_in_use
attributes.business_glossary_term: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) In Use Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee was wearing or using required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at the time of the incident. Critical for root cause analysis and PPE compliance program evaluation.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.132; EPA PPE requirements; USDA GAP

attributes.name: reported_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time the safety incident was formally reported to the supervisor or safety officer. OSHA requires incidents to be reported within 24 hours (fatality/hospitalization within 8 hours). Used to measure reporting lag compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.39; ISO 45001

attributes.name: return_to_work_date
attributes.description: The date the employee returned to full or modified duty following the injury or illness. Used for return-to-work program management, lost workday calculation, and workers compensation claim closure.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; NCCI; State Workers Compensation Regulations

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Primary root cause category identified through incident investigation. Drives corrective action prioritization and BMP safety program improvements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: unsafe_act|unsafe_condition|equipment_failure|inadequate_training|ppe_failure|environmental|procedural_violation|management_system_failure|human_error — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; ISO 45001; USDA BMP

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative from the root cause analysis (RCA) investigation describing the underlying factors that contributed to the incident. Supports corrective action development and safety program improvement.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; ISO 45001; ANSI Z10

attributes.name: severity_classification
attributes.description: OSHA-defined severity tier for the incident. Determines OSHA 300 log recordability, workers compensation claim eligibility, and EMR impact. Near-miss events are tracked for proactive safety management but are not OSHA recordable.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.7; ISO 45001; ANSI Z16.1

attributes.name: subrogation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the workers compensation claim has been flagged for subrogation — recovery of claim costs from a liable third party (e.g., equipment manufacturer, chemical supplier). Supports insurance cost recovery efforts.
attributes.references: State Workers Compensation Laws; NCCI; Agricultural Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: task_being_performed
attributes.description: Description of the specific agricultural task or activity the employee was performing when the incident occurred (e.g., 'pesticide application', 'grain bin entry', 'livestock loading'). Critical for root cause analysis and SOP review.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.29; USDA GAP; EPA REI compliance

attributes.name: witness_names
attributes.description: Names of witnesses present at the time of the incident. Stored as a delimited string for investigation documentation. Confidential — used for internal investigation purposes only.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.29; ISO 45001

attributes.name: workers_comp_claim_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a workers compensation claim has been filed in connection with this safety incident. Triggers the workers compensation claim tracking workflow.
attributes.references: State Workers Compensation Laws; NCCI; OSHA 29 CFR 1904

attributes.name: workers_comp_claim_number
attributes.description: The claim number assigned by the insurance carrier for the workers compensation claim associated with this incident. Used for claim tracking, insurance premium management, and EMR calculation.
attributes.references: State Workers Compensation Laws; NCCI EMR; Insurance Carrier Requirements

SSOT for all DOL-regulated worker welfare obligations including housing provision and assignment, transportation, wage guarantees, and migrant worker protections. Critical for DOL audit readiness, APHIS/USCIS compliance, state migrant labor housing inspections, and seasonal agricultural labor program management.

attributes.name: aewr_compliance_status

attributes.name: aewr_hourly_rate

attributes.description: Date the H-2A or migrant worker arrived at the work site or employer-provided housing. Used to calculate three-fourths guarantee period start and AEWR wage compliance windows.

attributes.name: compliance_notes

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The official end date of the H-2A job order contract period as approved by DOL. Defines the end of the three-fourths guarantee calculation period.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The official start date of the H-2A job order contract period as approved by DOL. Defines the beginning of the three-fourths guarantee calculation period.

attributes.name: country_of_origin

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this labor compliance record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and DOL record retention compliance.

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: Date the H-2A or migrant worker departed the work site or employer-provided housing. Used to close the compliance period and finalize three-fourths guarantee hour calculations.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A 20 CFR 655.122; MSPA 29 CFR Part 500

attributes.name: dol_audit_flag

attributes.references: DOL Wage and Hour Division; H-2A 20 CFR Part 655; MSPA 29 CFR Part 500

attributes.name: dol_job_order_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Labor (DOL) Job Order Number
attributes.description: The official job order number assigned by the U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) for the H-2A temporary agricultural worker petition. Required for all H-2A program filings and DOL audit readiness.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR Part 655 Subpart B

attributes.name: epa_housing_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Housing Standard Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer-provided housing facility meets EPA environmental and pesticide exposure standards applicable to agricultural worker housing. Required for DOL H-2A housing certification.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard 40 CFR Part 170; DOL H-2A 20 CFR 655.122(d)

attributes.name: housing_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of workers authorized to occupy the assigned housing unit per OSHA and DOL housing standards. Used for occupancy compliance and state inspection reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.142; DOL H-2A 20 CFR 655.122(d)

attributes.name: housing_occupancy_end_date
attributes.description: Date the worker vacated the employer-provided housing unit. Used to close the housing assignment record and finalize rent deduction calculations.

attributes.name: housing_occupancy_start_date
attributes.description: Date the worker began occupying the employer-provided housing unit. Used to track housing provision obligations and calculate any permissible rent deduction periods.

attributes.name: housing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employer-provided housing structure assigned to the worker. Used for OSHA and EPA housing standard compliance categorization and state migrant labor housing inspection reporting.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A 20 CFR 655.122(d); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.142; EPA

attributes.name: housing_unit_number

attributes.name: inbound_transport_cost

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: mspa_disclosure_date

attributes.name: mspa_disclosure_provided

attributes.description: Indicates whether the required MSPA written disclosure of working conditions, wages, housing, and transportation was provided to the migrant or seasonal agricultural worker prior to recruitment or at time of recruitment.

attributes.name: mspa_registration_number

attributes.description: DOL-issued MSPA farm labor contractor (FLC) registration number, if a third-party contractor is involved in recruiting or employing the migrant worker. Required for MSPA compliance and contractor accountability.
attributes.references: MSPA 29 CFR 500.40; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: osha_housing_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Housing Standard Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer-provided housing facility meets OSHA temporary labor camp standards (29 CFR 1910.142) as of the last inspection. Required for DOL H-2A housing certification.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.142; DOL H-2A 20 CFR 655.122(d)

attributes.name: outbound_transport_cost
attributes.description: Actual cost incurred by the employer for return transportation of the H-2A worker from the worksite to the country of origin upon contract completion or early termination. Required by DOL H-2A regulations.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the labor compliance program governing this worker record: H-2A (temporary agricultural visa), MSPA (Migrant and Seasonal Agricultural Worker Protection Act), or both where applicable.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A 20 CFR Part 655; MSPA 29 CFR Part 500

attributes.name: rent_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount deducted from the worker's wages for employer-provided housing, if applicable. Must comply with DOL permissible deduction limits and must not reduce wages below AEWR. Reported on worker pay stubs.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A 20 CFR 655.122(p); FLSA

attributes.name: surety_bond_number
attributes.description: Surety bond number held by the farm labor contractor (FLC) as required under MSPA to ensure payment of wages and compliance with worker protection obligations. Applicable when a third-party FLC is involved.
attributes.references: MSPA 29 CFR 500.46; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: three_fourths_guarantee_hours
attributes.description: The minimum number of hours the employer is obligated to offer the H-2A worker under the three-fourths guarantee rule — equal to 75% of the total workdays in the contract period multiplied by the daily hours in the job order. Critical for DOL wage compliance.

attributes.name: transportation_provided
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer provided inbound and/or outbound transportation for the H-2A worker as required by DOL regulations. Employer must provide or pay for transportation from the worker's home country to the worksite and return.

attributes.name: visa_petition_status

attributes.name: workers_comp_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the H-2A or migrant worker is covered by the employer's workers' compensation insurance policy as required by DOL H-2A regulations and applicable state law.

attributes.name: workers_comp_policy_number
attributes.description: The insurance policy number for the workers' compensation coverage applicable to this worker. Required for DOL audit documentation and state compliance reporting.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A 20 CFR 655.122(e); State Workers' Compensation Laws

products.name: crew
products.description: Master record for agricultural work crews and gangs — the fundamental operational unit for field labor deployment in row crop, specialty crop, and livestock operations. Captures crew code, crew name, crew type (planting crew, harvest crew, spray crew, irrigation team, livestock handling team, packing line crew, equipment maintenance team), assigned supervisor/crew leader (employee reference), home farm operation or facility, default shift pattern, target crew size, current active member count, active status, seasonal validity start/end dates, and primary language spoken. Crews are the primary unit of labor scheduling, field assignment, productivity tracking, and piece-rate pay calculation in agricultural operations. SSOT for crew identity and composition. Supports H-2A crew-based housing and transportation management, piece-rate pay calculations by crew, DOL crew disclosure requirements under MSPA, and crew-level safety briefing documentation. Crew membership is tracked via employee-to-crew assignment with effective dates to support seasonal rotation and mid-season crew reassignment.

products.name: training_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the Enrollment event between an employee and a training_event session. It captures the per-employee participation record for each training session attended, including enrollment, completion, assessment outcome, and certificate issuance. Each record links one employee to one training_event and holds all attributes that exist only in the context of that specific employee's participation in that specific session. Serves as the SSOT for individual compliance evidence required by FSMA, GLOBALG.A.P., EPA Worker Protection Standard, SQF/BRC certification, and pesticide applicator license CEU renewal audits.. Existence Justification: In agricultural workforce management, employees attend multiple training events over their employment lifecycle (GAP, HACCP, WPS, OSHA, H-2A orientation, etc.), and each training event session is attended by multiple employees simultaneously. This is a genuine operational M:N relationship: the business actively manages individual enrollment records, tracks per-employee completion status, assessment scores, and certificate issuance for each training event, and must produce compliance evidence per employee per training event for FSMA, GLOBALG.A.P., EPA WPS, and pesticide applicator license audits. The relationship is not derivable from existing FKs — it is an independently managed operational record.
