attributes.references: GAAP ASC 205; IFRS IAS 1; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this GL account became active and available for financial postings. Used for chart of accounts versioning and historical financial reporting. Supports GAAP/IFRS comparative period reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 205; IFRS IAS 1; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: Controls which fields are required, optional, or suppressed when posting to this GL account. Corresponds to SAP FSTAG field. Ensures data completeness for cost center, profit center, and commodity allocation fields on agricultural financial postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL FSTAG; SOX Section 404; GAAP

attributes.name: financial_statement_section
attributes.description: Indicates which primary financial statement this account appears in: balance sheet (B/S) for assets, liabilities, and equity; profit and loss (P&L) for revenues and expenses; cash flow statement; or statement of changes in equity. Critical for GAAP/IFRS dual-ledger reporting and EBITDA computation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 205; IFRS IAS 1; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP functional area classification used for cost-of-sales accounting and segment reporting (e.g., production, sales, administration, research and development, procurement). Enables P&L by function reporting per IFRS IAS 1 and supports crop enterprise EBITDA analysis by business function.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Functional Area; IFRS IAS 1; GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: is_balance_sheet_account
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this GL account is a balance sheet account (True) or a profit and loss account (False). Balance sheet accounts carry forward balances at year-end; P&L accounts are closed to retained earnings. Corresponds to SAP XBILK field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL XBILK; GAAP ASC 205; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: is_capex_account
attributes.description: Flags whether this GL account is designated for capital expenditure (CAPEX) tracking, including farm equipment purchases, land improvements, irrigation infrastructure, and precision agriculture technology investments. Supports CAPEX vs OPEX segregation for financial planning and tax depreciation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360; IFRS IAS 16; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: is_cogs_account
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Account Indicator
attributes.description: Flags whether this GL account is used for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) allocation. Supports commodity-level COGS tracking for crop enterprises (e.g., corn, soybeans, wheat) and livestock operations. Critical for gross margin analysis and EBITDA reporting by crop enterprise.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2; SAP S/4HANA CO-PC; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: is_ebitda_relevant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Relevance Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is included in EBITDA calculations for crop enterprise performance reporting. Accounts flagged as EBITDA-relevant are included in operating income before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization line items. Supports management reporting and investor relations.
attributes.references: GAAP Non-GAAP Measures; IFRS IAS 1; SEC Non-GAAP Guidance; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: is_gaap_relevant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) Relevance Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is active and relevant under US GAAP reporting requirements. Supports dual-ledger GAAP/IFRS accounting where certain accounts may apply to one framework but not the other. Used in GAAP-basis financial statement preparation and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 205; SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Ledger Assignment

attributes.name: is_ifrs_relevant
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) Relevance Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is active and relevant under IFRS reporting requirements. Supports dual-ledger GAAP/IFRS accounting for consolidated financial statements filed with international regulators. Used in IFRS-basis financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1; IFRS 10; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Ledger Assignment; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: is_opex_account
attributes.description: Flags whether this GL account is designated for operational expenditure (OPEX) tracking, including seed costs, fertilizer, crop protection chemicals, labor, and irrigation operating costs. Supports CAPEX/OPEX segregation for EBITDA reporting and crop enterprise budgeting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 1; SAP S/4HANA FI-CO; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: is_reconciliation_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a reconciliation account for a subledger (AP, AR, fixed assets, inventory). Reconciliation accounts cannot be posted to directly; postings flow from the subledger. Corresponds to SAP MITKZ field. Critical for SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL MITKZ; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 210

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this GL account record was most recently updated. Tracks chart of accounts maintenance activity and supports SOX change management controls and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; Oracle NetSuite; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: line_item_display
attributes.description: When True, individual line items posted to this GL account are stored and displayable for detailed audit trail and drill-down analysis. Corresponds to SAP XKRES field. Required for SOX audit trail requirements and financial controls documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL XKRES; SOX Section 404; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account normally carries a debit or credit balance per double-entry bookkeeping rules. Assets and expenses are normally debit; liabilities, equity, and revenues are normally credit. Used for trial balance validation and period-end close controls.
attributes.references: GAAP Double-Entry Accounting; IFRS IAS 1; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL

attributes.name: open_item_management
attributes.description: When True, individual line items posted to this account are managed as open items that must be explicitly cleared (e.g., GR/IR clearing accounts, bank clearing accounts, advance payment accounts). Corresponds to SAP XOPVW field. Essential for AP/AR reconciliation and period-end close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL XOPVW; GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: posting_block
attributes.description: When True, prevents any new financial postings to this GL account. Used during period-end close, account restructuring, or SOX-mandated account freeze periods. Corresponds to SAP XSPEB field. Critical for financial controls and audit integrity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL XSPEB; SOX Section 404; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: profit_center_required
attributes.description: When True, a profit center assignment is mandatory for all postings to this GL account. Ensures segment-level profitability reporting by crop enterprise, livestock operation, or business unit. Supports IFRS 8 operating segment disclosure and management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; IFRS 8; GAAP ASC 280; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_type
attributes.description: When is_reconciliation_account is True, identifies which subledger this account reconciles: accounts payable (vendor), accounts receivable (customer), fixed assets, or inventory. Null or not_applicable for non-reconciliation accounts. Supports period-end close and SOX subledger-to-GL reconciliation controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: Three-digit code that determines the assignment field populated in line items posted to this GL account (e.g., 001=posting date, 003=document number, 009=external document number, 014=assignment field). Corresponds to SAP ZUAWA field. Controls how line items are sorted and displayed in account statements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL ZUAWA; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this GL account master data originates: SAP S/4HANA FI module or Oracle NetSuite GL. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer and reconciliation between ERP systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; Oracle NetSuite GL; GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Specifies the tax relevance of the GL account for input/output tax determination (e.g., input tax, output tax, not tax-relevant, tax-exempt). Corresponds to SAP MWSKZ field. Relevant for agricultural input tax recovery on seed, fertilizer, and equipment purchases per applicable tax regulations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL MWSKZ; IRS Tax Code; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Cost center and profit center master data representing organizational units and profitability segments used for cost allocation, internal management accounting, and segment reporting across the agricultural enterprise. Captures cost center code, name, hierarchy level (including profit center hierarchy nodes), responsible manager, controlling area, company code, valid-from/to dates, cost center category (production, administration, R&D, field operations), profit center assignment and attributes (commodity/crop segment, livestock operation, supply chain segment), and project cost collection flags. Supports OPEX tracking, crop enterprise budgeting, overhead allocation, COGS allocation by commodity, EBITDA reporting by crop enterprise or livestock operation per GAAP/IFRS segment reporting requirements.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center (CSKS/CSKT)

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the cost center record in the enterprise data platform (Silver Layer). Primary key for the cost_center data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP ASC 280; IFRS 8

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: cost_center has company_code as a STRING. Cost centers belong to a specific legal entity (company code) in SAP CO. Normalizing to a proper FK ensures referential integrity between the controlling area
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_cost_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the manager accountable for this cost center's budget and expenditures, as maintained in SAP SuccessFactors HR. Used for budget approval workflows, variance reporting, and SOX financial controls accountability. Stored as employee identifier, not personal name.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: activity_type_code
attributes.description: SAP CO activity type code representing the primary activity performed by this cost center (e.g., 'MACH' for machine hours, 'LABOR' for labor hours, 'IRRIG' for irrigation hours, 'SPRAY' for spraying operations). Used for activity-based cost allocation and internal price calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA Module KL01; GAAP; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status of the cost center master record per SOX internal controls. Draft: initial creation not yet submitted. Pending_approval: submitted for authorization. Approved: authorized by finance controller and available for use. Rejected: returned for correction. Ensures segregation of duties and financial control compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP business area code representing a distinct area of operations for internal balance sheet and P&L reporting (e.g., 'CROP' for crop operations, 'LVST' for livestock, 'SUPL' for supply chain). Enables cross-company-code segment reporting per GAAP ASC 280 and IFRS 8.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 280; IFRS 8

attributes.name: capex_budget_annual
attributes.description: Approved annual CAPEX budget amount for this cost center in the controlling currency. Represents planned capital investments (equipment, infrastructure, land improvements) for the fiscal year. Supports CAPEX tracking and ROI analysis per GAAP ASC 360 / IFRS IAS 16.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO/FI Module; GAAP ASC 360; IFRS IAS 16; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: Primary agricultural commodity or livestock type associated with this cost center for COGS allocation and crop enterprise budgeting (e.g., 'corn', 'soybeans', 'wheat', 'cattle', 'hogs', 'poultry', 'cotton', 'rice'). Enables commodity-level profitability analysis and WASDE-aligned reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: corn|soybeans|wheat|cattle|hogs|poultry|cotton|rice|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA WASDE; GAAP ASC 280; IFRS 8; USDA Farm Financial Standards Council

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling Area code to which this cost center belongs. The controlling area defines the organizational unit within which cost accounting is performed. All cost centers within the same controlling area share the same chart of accounts and fiscal year variant.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP; IFRS 8

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: Functional classification of the cost center indicating its primary business purpose. Drives overhead allocation rules, COGS allocation by commodity, and OPEX tracking. Values: production (direct crop/livestock production), administration (G&A overhead), research_and_development (R&D per GAAP ASC 730), field_operations (planting, harvesting, irrigation), supply_chain (logistics, warehousing), overhead (indirect shared services).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP ASC 730 (R&D); IFRS 8; USDA Farm Financial Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the cost center within the SAP S/4HANA CO controlling area. This is the business-facing identifier used in journal entries, purchase orders, and management reports (e.g., 'CC-FIELD-001', 'CC-ADMIN-HQ').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module KS01; GAAP ASC 280; IFRS 8 Segment Reporting

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context about the cost center's purpose, scope, and operational activities (e.g., 'Manages all field operations costs for the 5,000-acre corn production unit in Iowa, including planting, fertilization, crop protection, and harvest activities'). Supports management reporting and organizational documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module KS01; GAAP; IFRS 8

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the cost center as maintained in SAP S/4HANA CO master data (e.g., 'North Field Operations – Corn Belt', 'Livestock Feed Management – Hog Unit 3'). Used in financial reports and management dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module KS01; IFRS 8

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center master record. Active: available for cost postings. Inactive: temporarily disabled. Locked: blocked for new postings (e.g., period-end close). Pending_approval: awaiting authorization per SOX controls. Archived: historical record no longer in use.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country in which this cost center operates (e.g., 'USA', 'BRA', 'ARG', 'CAN'). Supports multi-national agricultural operations, IFRS/GAAP consolidated reporting, GDPR compliance for international operations, and country-of-origin tracking per COOL regulations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IFRS; GAAP; GDPR; USDA COOL Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center master record was first created in the source system or data platform. Supports audit trail requirements, SOX financial controls, and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Controls; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost center's controlling currency (e.g., 'USD' for US Dollar). Defines the currency in which cost center budgets, actual costs, and variances are reported. Aligns with the controlling area currency in SAP CO.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP fiscal year variant code defining the fiscal year structure for this cost center (e.g., 'K4' for calendar year January–December, 'V3' for April–March agricultural fiscal year). Determines period-end close schedules and budget planning cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1; USDA Farm Financial Standards

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: SAP functional area code classifying the cost center by business function for cost-of-sales accounting (e.g., 'PROD' for production/COGS, 'ADMIN' for G&A, 'SALES' for selling expenses, 'RD' for R&D). Supports COGS allocation by commodity and functional income statement reporting per GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1; USDA Farm Financial Standards

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or territory associated with this cost center (e.g., 'Midwest Corn Belt', 'Southeast Poultry Region', 'Great Plains Wheat Belt', 'Pacific Northwest'). Supports regional OPEX analysis, GIS-based land management integration with Esri ArcGIS, and USDA regional reporting.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Districts; Esri ArcGIS; USDA Farm Financial Standards

attributes.name: gl_account_assignment_group
attributes.description: GL account assignment group linking this cost center to the appropriate general ledger accounts in SAP FI for automatic account determination. Ensures correct GL posting for COGS, OPEX, and overhead entries per the chart of accounts and GAAP/IFRS financial reporting requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this cost center within the standard hierarchy (cost center group tree) in SAP CO. Level 1 represents the top-level controlling area node; higher numbers represent more granular operational units. Used for roll-up reporting and overhead allocation across the agricultural enterprise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module OKEON; GAAP ASC 280; IFRS 8

attributes.name: hierarchy_node_code
attributes.description: Code of the standard hierarchy node (cost center group) to which this cost center belongs in SAP CO. Enables hierarchical roll-up of costs for management reporting, budget consolidation, and EBITDA analysis by business segment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module OKEON; IFRS 8; GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: is_project_cost_collector
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is designated as a project cost collector for capital projects, R&D programs, or special agricultural initiatives (e.g., precision agriculture rollout, irrigation infrastructure project). When True, costs posted here are tracked against a project budget in SAP PS/CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO/PS Module; GAAP ASC 730 (R&D); IFRS IAS 38; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: is_statistical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical cost center used only for reporting and allocation base calculations (e.g., tracking headcount, acreage, or machine hours as statistical key figures) without receiving actual cost postings. Statistical cost centers support overhead distribution in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA Module; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cost center master record in the source system or data platform. Critical for SOX change management controls, audit trails, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Controls; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: SAP CO lock indicator controlling which types of postings are permitted to this cost center. Unlocked: all postings allowed. Locked_actual: actual cost postings blocked. Locked_plan: planning postings blocked. Locked_all: all postings blocked (e.g., during period-end close or organizational restructuring).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module KS02; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: opex_budget_annual
attributes.description: Approved annual OPEX budget amount for this cost center in the controlling currency. Represents planned operational expenditures for the fiscal year as entered in SAP CO planning. Used for budget vs. actual variance analysis, EBITDA forecasting, and crop enterprise budgeting per GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PA Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1; USDA Farm Financial Standards

attributes.name: overhead_allocation_key
attributes.description: SAP overhead allocation key (costing sheet key) assigned to this cost center, determining how indirect overhead costs are allocated from overhead cost centers to production/field operations cost centers. Critical for accurate COGS allocation by commodity and crop enterprise profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 2; USDA Farm Financial Standards

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code representing the physical agricultural facility or farm location associated with this cost center (e.g., grain elevator, livestock facility, processing plant, field operations hub). Links cost center to physical operations for OPEX tracking and asset management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Module; GAAP; USDA FMIS Standards

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP profit center code to which this cost center is assigned for profitability analysis. Profit centers represent autonomous business segments (e.g., corn enterprise, soybean enterprise, hog operation, supply chain segment) enabling EBITDA reporting and GAAP/IFRS segment reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Module; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Business segment classification of the cost center for GAAP ASC 280 / IFRS 8 segment reporting. Identifies whether the cost center belongs to a crop enterprise (e.g., corn, soybeans, wheat), livestock operation (e.g., cattle, hogs, poultry), supply chain segment, corporate overhead, or shared services. Drives EBITDA reporting by segment.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 280 Segment Reporting; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; USDA Farm Financial Standards

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name of the cost center (up to 20 characters) used in condensed financial reports, budget variance summaries, and SAP CO transaction screens where space is limited.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module KS01

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this cost center master data originates. SAP_S4HANA: primary ERP source (CO module). ORACLE_NETSUITE: secondary ERP for certain legal entities. GRANULAR: Granular Farm Management for farm-level cost centers. MANUAL: manually created in the data platform.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Oracle NetSuite; Granular Farm Management; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_key
attributes.description: The natural key or primary identifier of this cost center record in the originating source system (e.g., SAP cost center number, Oracle NetSuite internal ID, Granular cost center reference). Enables data lineage tracing and reconciliation between the Silver Layer and operational systems.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Standards; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Oracle NetSuite

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this cost center is active and available for cost postings in SAP CO. Supports time-dependent master data management and ensures costs are only allocated to active cost centers within their valid period. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module KS01; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this cost center is active and available for cost postings. After this date, the cost center is locked for new postings. Null indicates an open-ended validity. Supports fiscal year planning and organizational restructuring in SAP CO. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module KS01; GAAP; IFRS

products.name: company_code
products.description: Legal entity and company code master representing individual legal entities within the agricultural enterprise for consolidated financial statements. Captures company code, legal entity name, country, currency, fiscal year variant, chart of accounts assignment, consolidation group, tax jurisdiction, and regulatory filing identifiers (USDA, FDA, SEC). Supports SOX financial controls, multi-entity consolidation, and GAAP/IFRS segment reporting.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code (T001)

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for the company code record in the enterprise data lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Company Code Master

attributes.name: address_city
attributes.description: City of the legal entity's registered office address. Used for tax jurisdiction determination, regulatory filings, and geographic segmentation in financial reporting.
attributes.references: USDA; FDA; EPA; GAAP ASC 280; IFRS 8

attributes.name: address_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the registered office address. Used for international regulatory compliance, COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) reporting, and IFRS geographic segment disclosures.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; COOL; IFRS 8; GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: address_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the legal entity's registered office address. Used for tax jurisdiction mapping, regulatory filings, and geographic analytics in the enterprise GIS.
attributes.references: USDA; IRS; EPA; Esri ArcGIS — Geographic Reference

attributes.name: address_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the legal entity's registered office. Drives state-level tax jurisdiction, USDA state program eligibility, and EPA regional compliance requirements.
attributes.references: USDA; EPA; IRS; GAAP ASC 740

attributes.name: address_street
attributes.description: Street address of the legal entity's registered office as recorded with government authorities. Used for regulatory correspondence, USDA/FDA/EPA filings, and legal notices.
attributes.references: USDA; FDA; EPA; SEC Regulation S-K; GDPR Article 4 (EU entities)

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts
attributes.description: The SAP chart of accounts key assigned to this company code, defining the GL account structure used for all financial postings, cost center accounting, and COGS allocation by commodity. Ensures consistency across consolidated financial statements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Chart of Accounts (KTOPL); GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: company_code_code
attributes.description: The 4-character alphanumeric company code as defined in SAP S/4HANA FI module. Serves as the primary external business identifier for the legal entity across all financial transactions, general ledger postings, and regulatory filings. Aligns with SAP company code (BUKRS) field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BUKRS; GAAP ASC 280; IFRS 8

attributes.name: company_code_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the company code. Controls whether financial postings, procurement transactions, and payroll processing are permitted for this entity in SAP S/4HANA and Oracle NetSuite.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Company Code Status; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: consolidation_chart_of_accounts
attributes.description: The group-level chart of accounts used for intercompany consolidation and segment reporting. Maps local GL accounts to the group reporting structure for GAAP/IFRS consolidated financial statements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Group Reporting; GAAP ASC 810; IFRS 10

attributes.name: consolidation_group
attributes.description: Identifier for the consolidation group to which this company code belongs within the enterprise group structure. Used for multi-entity financial consolidation, intercompany elimination, and GAAP ASC 810 / IFRS 10 consolidated statement preparation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 810; IFRS 10; SAP S/4HANA FI — Group Reporting

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP controlling area code to which this company code is assigned. The controlling area defines the scope of cost center accounting, internal orders, and profitability analysis (CO-PA) for CAPEX/OPEX tracking and crop enterprise budgeting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Controlling Area (KOKRS); GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country in which the legal entity is incorporated and registered. Drives tax jurisdiction determination, regulatory reporting obligations (USDA, FDA, EPA), and currency defaulting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; USDA; FDA; EPA; IFRS 21

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this company code record was first created in the enterprise data lakehouse. Supports SOX audit trail requirements, data lineage tracking, and financial control documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 27001; GDPR Article 30 (EU entities)

attributes.name: credit_control_area
attributes.description: SAP credit control area assigned to this company code for accounts receivable credit limit management and customer credit risk monitoring across the agricultural supply chain and sales distribution operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/FI — Credit Control Area; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the local (functional) currency of the company code. Used for all general ledger postings, COGS allocation, EBITDA reporting, and GAAP/IFRS financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GAAP ASC 830; IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI — WAERS

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this company code became active and financial postings were permitted in the ERP system. Marks the start of the entity's operational financial lifecycle for GAAP/IFRS reporting periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Company Code Activation; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date on which this company code was deactivated or closed. Null for currently active entities. Used for historical consolidation scope management and SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Company Code Deactivation; SOX Section 404; GAAP

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal entity structure within the agricultural enterprise group. Determines consolidation treatment under GAAP ASC 810 / IFRS 10 and applicable regulatory reporting obligations.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 810; IFRS 10; IFRS 3

attributes.name: epa_facility_identifier
attributes.description: EPA-assigned facility identifier for environmental compliance reporting, pesticide registration, and agricultural chemical use tracking under EPA regulations. Supports IPM program documentation and BMP compliance.
attributes.references: EPA; EPA FIFRA; EPA Clean Water Act; BMP; IPM

attributes.name: fda_establishment_number

products.name: journal_entry

Line-level detail captures GL account, debit/credit indicator, amounts in transaction and company code currencies, cost center, profit center, WBS element, tax code, assignment field, and line item text. For intercompany postings: sending/receiving company code, elimination status, reconciliation status, and netting agreement reference. SSOT for all GL postings across the agricultural enterprise. attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: company_code_amount
attributes.description: The journal entry amount converted to the company code (local) currency. Used for entity-level financial reporting, statutory filings, and GAAP/IFRS consolidated financial statements. Derived from transaction_amount using the exchange rate at posting_date.

attributes.name: company_code_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the company code (local) currency in which company_code_amount is expressed. Typically USD for US-based agricultural entities but may differ for international subsidiaries.

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the line item is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting per double-entry bookkeeping principles. Fundamental to GL balance verification, trial balance generation, and GAAP/IFRS financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the original source document (invoice, receipt, contract, etc.) that triggered this journal entry. May differ from posting_date for accruals, reversals, or late-arriving documents. Used for aging analysis and audit trail verification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-BLDAT; GAAP ASC 450; IFRS IAS 37

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known accounting document number assigned by SAP S/4HANA FI or Oracle NetSuite upon posting. Serves as the primary business identifier for the journal entry and is referenced in audit trails, reconciliation reports, and SOX compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-BELNR; GAAP ASC 250; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: SAP document type code classifying the nature of the journal entry (e.g., SA=GL account document, KR=vendor invoice, DR=customer invoice, AB=accounting document, ZP=payment posting, AA=asset posting). attributes.name: elimination_status
attributes.description: Status of the intercompany elimination process for this journal entry in the consolidated financial statements. 'pending' = awaiting elimination; 'eliminated' = successfully eliminated in consolidation; 'not_required' = not an intercompany entry; 'exception' = elimination discrepancy requiring investigation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting; GAAP ASC 810; IFRS 10; IFRS IAS 27

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this journal entry record was first created in the source system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle NetSuite). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED timestamp for SOX-compliant audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Functional classification of the journal entry indicating its business purpose. 'standard' = routine operational posting; 'accrual' = period-end accrual; 'reversal' = reversal of a prior entry; 'intercompany' = cross-entity transaction; 'manual' = manually entered by accountant; 'recurring' = template-based periodic entry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 37; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (1–16, including special periods for year-end adjustments) within the fiscal year in which this journal entry is posted. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA period-end close cycles and supports monthly/quarterly EBITDA and COGS reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-MONAT; GAAP ASC 270; IFRS IAS 34

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this journal entry is recorded, as defined by the agricultural enterprise's accounting calendar. Used for annual financial reporting, USDA farm program year alignment, and GAAP/IFRS period-end close processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-GJAHR; GAAP ASC 270; IFRS IAS 34

attributes.name: functional_area

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BSEG-FKBER; GAAP ASC 280; IFRS IFRS 8

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Flag identifying this journal entry as an intercompany transaction between two legal entities within the agricultural enterprise group. True = intercompany posting requiring elimination in consolidated financial statements; False = intracompany or third-party posting.

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp

attributes.name: line_item_text

attributes.name: posting_date

attributes.name: posting_status

attributes.name: posting_user

attributes.name: reference_document_number

attributes.name: payment_block_code
attributes.description: Code indicating a payment block applied to this line item preventing automatic payment processing (e.g., quality hold, dispute, manual review required). Used in agricultural AP workflows for invoice verification and HACCP-related quality disputes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 230; GFSI; HACCP

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the agricultural facility (farm, processing plant, storage facility, feedlot) associated with this posting. Enables plant-level cost tracking and operational financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Module; USDA FSIS; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: SAP posting key (two-digit code) that determines the account type, debit/credit indicator, and field selection for this line item (e.g., 40=GL debit, 50=GL credit, 31=vendor credit, 01=customer debit). Controls the accounting logic of the posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 230; Double-Entry Bookkeeping Principles

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Physical quantity associated with this line item posting (e.g., bushels of grain, metric tons of fertilizer, hundredweight of livestock). Supports quantity-based COGS allocation and commodity volume reconciliation. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE role LINE_QUANTITY category requirement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Module; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; GAAP ASC 330

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity field (e.g., BU=Bushel, MT=Metric Ton, CWT=Hundredweight, KG=Kilogram). Aligns with USDA standard agricultural units and SAP base unit of measure configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|MT|CWT|KG|LB|EA|L|GAL|TON — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; ISO 80000-1

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference document number associated with this line item (e.g., vendor invoice number, purchase order number, GRN number, sales order number). Enables cross-system traceability between SAP FI and source operational documents.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 230; SOX Section 302/404; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the reversing journal entry that cancelled this line item. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Provides the audit chain link required for SOX Section 302/404 compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line item has been reversed by a subsequent correcting journal entry. True if reversed; False if original and active. Supports SOX audit trail integrity and financial restatement tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Reporting segment identifier for this posting, enabling disaggregated financial disclosures by operating segment (e.g., Crop Production, Livestock, Agri-Supply Chain). Required for IFRS 8 and GAAP ASC 280 segment reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IFRS 8; GAAP ASC 280; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating system that generated this journal entry line (e.g., SAP_FI=SAP S/4HANA FI, NETSUITE=Oracle NetSuite, GRANULAR=Granular Farm Management, MANUAL=manual entry, INTERFACE=automated interface). Supports data lineage and SOX IT general controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite; Granular Farm Management; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: special_gl_indicator
attributes.description: SAP Special GL indicator for non-standard postings such as down payments, guarantees, or bill of exchange transactions. Used in agricultural advance payment scenarios (e.g., prepaid seed contracts, crop advance payments).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 37

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Calculated tax amount in company code currency for this line item based on the assigned tax code. Used for VAT/GST reporting and tax liability reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 12; GAAP ASC 740

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code assigned to this line item, determining the applicable tax rate and tax account for VAT, GST, or sales tax calculations. Critical for tax compliance in multi-jurisdiction agricultural operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 12; GAAP ASC 740; EPA/USDA tax compliance

attributes.name: transaction_currency_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of this line item expressed in the originating transaction currency. Represents the raw posting value before currency translation. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE role LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT category requirement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the originating transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL). Used for multi-currency agricultural commodity trading and international supply chain transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The bank value date for this posting, representing when funds are available or debited at the bank. Used for cash management, bank reconciliation, and liquidity planning in agricultural treasury operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 7; GAAP ASC 230

products.name: finance_ap_invoice
products.description: Accounts payable invoice representing vendor invoices for agricultural inputs (seeds, fertilizers NPK, crop protection chemicals, feed, equipment parts) with embedded line-level detail. Header captures vendor invoice number, vendor ID, invoice date, posting date, payment terms, gross amount, tax amount, net amount, currency, payment block status, three-way match status (PO/GRN/invoice), and approval workflow status. Line-level detail captures material/service description, quantity, unit of measure (MT, BU, CWT), unit price, line amount, GL account assignment, cost center, purchase order reference, goods receipt reference (GRN), tax code, and commodity classification. Supports COGS allocation by commodity, crop enterprise budget variance analysis, and seasonal input cost tracking.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating purchase order record. Used for three-way match validation (PO/GRN/invoice) to confirm invoice legitimacy before payment. Critical for agricultural input procurement controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; GAAP Procurement Controls; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: seed_variety_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.seed_variety. Business justification: Seed purchases are a major AP category in agriculture. Linking AP invoices to seed_variety_id enables seed cost tracking per variety, supports crop enterprise budget reconciliation, and enables ROI an

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier) master record who issued this invoice. Links to the vendor/supplier master party entity for agricultural input suppliers (seed, fertilizer NPK, crop protection chemicals, feed, equipment parts). Supports PARTY_REFERENCE requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Vendor Master; Oracle NetSuite Vendor

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of the invoice in the approval workflow. 'pending' = awaiting approver action; 'approved' = authorized for payment; 'rejected' = returned to AP team; 'escalated' = routed to higher authority due to amount threshold or exception. Supports SOX segregation of duties controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the person who approved this invoice in the workflow. Required for SOX audit trail and segregation of duties documentation. Sourced from SAP workflow approval log.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Workflow; GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the invoice was approved in the workflow. Supports SOX audit trail, SLA monitoring for invoice processing cycle time, and period-end close reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Workflow; GAAP

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.description: Classifies the invoice as a capital expenditure (CAPEX) or operational expenditure (OPEX). CAPEX invoices relate to long-term asset acquisition (equipment, infrastructure); OPEX invoices relate to recurring operational costs (inputs, services, maintenance). Critical for EBITDA reporting, ROI analysis, and GAAP/IFRS asset capitalization rules.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360; IFRS IAS 16; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; SOX

attributes.name: commodity_category
attributes.description: Agricultural commodity or input category for this invoice. Enables COGS allocation by commodity, seasonal input cost tracking, and crop enterprise budget variance analysis. Categories align with core agricultural input types: seeds, fertilizers (NPK), crop protection chemicals, animal feed, equipment parts, agronomic services, fuel, and other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seeds|fertilizers|crop_protection|feed|equipment_parts|services|fuel|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Input Classification; GAAP COGS Allocation; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Groups

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this AP invoice record was first created in the system. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Supports SOX audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the invoice amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Required for multi-currency operations in global agricultural supply chains. Corresponds to SAP field WAERS.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Cash discount amount available if payment is made within the early payment discount period as defined by payment terms. Supports working capital optimization and vendor discount capture reporting for agricultural input procurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 310; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: discount_due_date
attributes.description: Last date by which payment must be made to qualify for the early payment discount. Enables treasury teams to prioritize payments and capture available discounts on high-volume agricultural input invoices.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Calculated date by which payment must be made to the vendor based on payment terms (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30). Critical for cash flow management, early payment discount capture, and avoiding late payment penalties on agricultural input purchases.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Accounting period (1-12 or 1-16 for special periods) within the fiscal year for this invoice posting. Supports monthly period-end close, seasonal input cost tracking, and crop enterprise budget variance analysis. Corresponds to SAP field MONAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 34

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which this invoice is recorded for financial reporting purposes. Used for period-end close, annual budget variance analysis, and GAAP/IFRS consolidated financial statement preparation. Corresponds to SAP field GJAHR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1; SOX

attributes.name: grn_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the goods receipt note (GRN) confirming physical receipt of agricultural inputs (seeds, fertilizers, chemicals, feed, parts) at the warehouse or farm location. Key document in three-way match. Corresponds to SAP MIGO goods receipt document number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS; USDA FSMA; GAAP

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before tax deductions. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Represents the full billed value for agricultural inputs (seeds, fertilizers NPK, crop protection chemicals, feed, equipment parts). Used for COGS allocation and crop enterprise budget variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 2; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the vendor's invoice document. Represents the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for the invoice issuance event. Used for payment terms calculation, aging analysis, and seasonal input cost tracking. Corresponds to SAP field BLDAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: invoice_line_count
attributes.description: Total number of line items on this invoice. Supports invoice complexity analysis, processing time benchmarking, and validation that all line-level detail records are present in the silver layer. Derived from the source system header record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the AP invoice. LIFECYCLE_STATUS for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. 'draft' = entered but not posted; 'posted' = recorded in GL; 'approved' = workflow approved; 'paid' = payment cleared; 'blocked' = payment block active; 'cancelled' = reversed/voided.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type. 'standard' = regular vendor invoice; 'credit_memo' = vendor credit for returns/adjustments; 'debit_memo' = additional charge; 'recurring' = periodic service invoice; 'intercompany' = between related legal entities. Corresponds to SAP field BLART.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice is part of a recurring payment schedule (e.g., land lease payments, equipment rental, subscription services). Supports automated invoice matching and cash flow forecasting for seasonal agricultural operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net payable amount after tax adjustments (gross_amount minus tax_amount or as applicable per tax treatment). Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Represents the actual cash outflow for payment processing and AP aging reports.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: payment_block_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice is blocked from payment and the reason. 'unblocked' = cleared for payment; 'manual_block' = manually held; 'quality_block' = QM hold pending COA review; 'price_variance' = unit price exceeds PO tolerance; 'duplicate_check' = potential duplicate invoice detected. Corresponds to SAP field ZLSPR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/MM Module; SOX Section 404; GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which payment was made to the vendor. Used for AP aging analysis, on-time payment KPI reporting, and cash flow reconciliation. Populated upon payment clearing. Corresponds to SAP field AUGDT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which payment will be or was made to the vendor. Supports treasury operations, bank reconciliation, and payment run configuration. Corresponds to SAP field ZLSCH. Common methods for agricultural suppliers include ACH, wire transfer, check, and EFT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the payment document (check number, ACH transaction ID, wire reference) that cleared this invoice. Populated after payment is executed. Used for bank reconciliation and vendor payment confirmation. Corresponds to SAP field AUGBL (clearing document).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Vendor payment terms code defining the payment schedule and early payment discount conditions (e.g., NT30 = Net 30 days, 2/10NT30 = 2% discount if paid within 10 days, net 30). Drives due_date calculation and cash discount management. Corresponds to SAP field ZTERM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was posted to the general ledger (GL). Determines the accounting period for GAAP/IFRS period-end close. May differ from invoice_date due to processing lag. Corresponds to SAP field BUDAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: Internal SAP S/4HANA FI accounting document number assigned upon invoice posting. Used for cross-referencing with the general ledger and audit trail. Corresponds to SAP field BELNR in table BKPF.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating operational system from which this AP invoice record was ingested into the Databricks silver layer. Supports data lineage, reconciliation between SAP S/4HANA FI and Oracle NetSuite AP, and audit trail for the lakehouse pipeline.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle NetSuite AP; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the invoice (e.g., sales tax, VAT, use tax). Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Supports tax reporting, recoverability analysis, and GAAP/IFRS tax accounting. Corresponds to SAP field WMWST.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12; EPA Tax Compliance

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax determination code applied to the invoice for calculating applicable taxes (sales tax, VAT, use tax, agricultural exemptions). Corresponds to SAP field MWSKZ. Supports tax compliance reporting for EPA, USDA, and state agricultural tax exemption programs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12; EPA; USDA

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Result of the three-way match validation comparing the purchase order (PO), goods receipt note (GRN), and vendor invoice. 'matched' = all three documents align within tolerance; 'quantity_variance' = invoice quantity differs from GRN; 'price_variance' = invoice price differs from PO; 'grn_missing' = goods receipt not yet recorded. Critical SOX control for agricultural input procurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Module; SOX Section 404; GAAP Internal Controls; USDA Procurement Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this AP invoice record. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Tracks changes for SOX compliance, workflow audit trail, and delta processing in the Databricks silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_number
attributes.description: The externally-assigned invoice number as printed on the vendor's invoice document. Serves as the primary BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for three-way match (PO/GRN/invoice) and vendor dispute resolution. Must be unique per vendor. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI document header field BELNR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 302

Captures payment document number, vendor ID, payment date, payment method (ACH, wire, check), bank account, payment amount, currency, cleared invoice references, discount taken, payment run ID, and bank clearing status. Supports seasonal payment cycles aligned with planting and harvest, early-pay discount optimization for input purchases, and cash flow management.

attributes.description: User ID or name of the financial controller or AP manager who approved this payment for disbursement. Required for SOX dual-control and segregation of duties compliance. Supports payment authorization audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp

attributes.name: bank_clearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bank confirmed the payment as cleared in the bank statement. Used for bank reconciliation, outstanding check tracking, and cash flow actuals reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Statement Processing; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: bank_clearing_status
attributes.description: Status of the payment as reported by the bank clearing system. Indicates whether the payment has been confirmed as cleared by the bank, returned (e.g., invalid account), or rejected. Drives bank reconciliation and outstanding payment follow-up.

attributes.description: Physical check number assigned when payment method is CHECK. Used for check register management, positive pay file submission to the bank, and outstanding check reconciliation. Null for electronic payment methods (ACH, WIRE, EFT).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment record was first created in the financial system. Provides audit trail for record origination and supports SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency of this payment (e.g., USD for domestic, EUR for European suppliers, BRL for Brazilian commodity purchases). Supports multi-currency AP management for global agricultural supply chain.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: discount_taken_amount
attributes.description: Early payment discount amount deducted from the invoice total at time of payment. Reflects early-pay discount optimization for agricultural input purchases (e.g., seed, fertilizer, crop protection chemicals). Reduces COGS and improves ROI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied at the time of payment to convert the transaction currency to the company code local currency (USD). Used for foreign currency gain/loss calculation and IFRS IAS 21 compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Currency; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal accounting period (1-12 or 1-16 for special periods) within the fiscal year in which this payment is posted. Used for period-level cash flow reporting, EBITDA analysis, and month-end close reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which this payment is recorded for financial reporting purposes. Agricultural businesses may use non-calendar fiscal years aligned with growing seasons. Required for period-end close, GAAP/IFRS consolidated statements, and SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: invoice_count
attributes.description: Number of individual invoices cleared by this single payment transaction. Supports partial vs. full payment analysis and multi-invoice payment run reconciliation for bulk agricultural input purchases.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: Payment amount converted to the company code local currency (USD) using the exchange_rate at time of payment. Used for consolidated financial statements, EBITDA reporting, and GAAP/IFRS compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Actual net amount remitted to the vendor after deducting any early payment discount taken. Equals payment_amount minus discount_taken_amount. Represents the true cash disbursement recorded in the bank statement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 7

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Gross payment amount disbursed to the vendor in the transaction currency before any discount deduction. Represents the total cash outflow for this payment event. Used for cash flow management and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 7; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: Reason code indicating why a payment is blocked from processing (e.g., invoice dispute, missing COA, quality hold, vendor master incomplete). Null when payment is not blocked. Supports AP workflow management and vendor dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Block Indicators; Oracle NetSuite AP; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual business date on which the payment was issued or disbursed to the vendor. Used for cash flow reporting, early-pay discount optimization, and seasonal payment cycle analysis aligned with planting and harvest periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 7

attributes.name: payment_document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known payment document number assigned by the financial system (SAP FI or Oracle NetSuite) at the time of payment posting. Used for audit trails, bank reconciliation, and vendor remittance communication.

attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the crop enterprise budget. Drives approval workflow and financial reporting inclusion. LIFECYCLE_STATUS for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Version classification of the crop enterprise budget indicating whether it represents the original plan, a mid-season revision, or the final locked version. Supports variance analysis between original and revised plans per GAAP budgetary control requirements.

attributes.name: land_rent_per_ha

attributes.name: planned_price_per_unit

attributes.references: WASDE; DTN (Data Transmission Network); USDA AMS; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: planned_revenue_per_ha
attributes.description: Total planned gross revenue per hectare calculated as planned yield per hectare multiplied by planned price per unit. Core metric for crop enterprise profitability analysis, break-even determination, and ROI reporting. Confidential as it reflects forward pricing strategy.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS IFRS 15; Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: planned_total_cost
attributes.description: Total planned cost of production for the entire budgeted area, aggregating all cost line items (seed, fertilizer NPK, crop protection, labor, equipment, irrigation, land rent, crop insurance, custom hire). Used for COGS allocation, break-even analysis, and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: planned_total_revenue
attributes.description: Total planned gross revenue for the entire budgeted area (planned revenue per hectare × budget area). Represents the gross income line in the crop enterprise budget P&L. attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA CO/FI Module; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: planned_yield_per_ha
